ar: قال ألم أقل لك إنك لن تستطيع معى صبرا
tr: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
y: He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me?"
p: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?
t: qaala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa

ar: قال إن سألتك عن شىء بعدها فلا تصحبنى قد بلغت من لدنى عذرا
tr: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."
y: (Moses) said: "If ever I ask thee about anything after this, keep me not in thy company: then wouldst thou have received (full) excuse from my side."
p: (Moses) said: If I ask thee after this concerning aught, keep not company with me. Thou hast received an excuse from me.
t: qaala in sa altuka 'an shai'im ba'dahaa falaa tusaahibnee qad balaghta mil ladunnee 'uzraa

ar: فٱنطلقا حتى إذا أتيا أهل قرية ٱستطعما أهلها فأبوا أن يضيفوهما فوجدا فيها جدارا يريد أن ينقض فأقامه قال لو شئت لتخذت عليه أجرا
tr: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
y: Then they proceeded: until, when they came to the inhabitants of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused them hospitality. They found there a wall on the point of falling down, but he set it up straight. (Moses) said: "If thou hadst wished, surely thou couldst have exacted some recompense for it!"
p: So they twain journeyed on till, when they came unto the folk of a certain township, they asked its folk for food, but they refused to make them guests. And they found therein a wall upon the point of falling into ruin, and he repaired it. (Moses) said: If thou hadst wished, thou couldst have taken payment for it.
t: fantalaqaa hattaaa izaaa atayaaa ahla qaryatinis tat'amaaa ahlahaa fa abaw any yudaiyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaarany yureedu any yanqadda fa aqaamah; qaala law shi'ta lattakhazta 'alaihi ajraa

ar: قال هذا فراق بينى وبينك سأنبئك بتأويل ما لم تستطع عليه صبرا
tr: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
y: He answered: "This is the parting between me and thee: now will I tell thee the interpretation of (those things) over which thou wast unable to hold patience.
p: He said: This is the parting between thee and me! I will announce unto thee the interpretation of that thou couldst not bear with patience.
t: qaala haazaa firaaqu bainee wa bainik; sa unabi 'uka bitaaweeli maa lam tastati' 'alaihi sabraa

ar: أما ٱلسفينة فكانت لمسكين يعملون فى ٱلبحر فأردت أن أعيبها وكان وراءهم ملك يأخذ كل سفينة غصبا
tr: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
y: "As for the boat, it belonged to certain men in dire want: they plied on the water: I but wished to render it unserviceable, for there was after them a certain king who seized on every boat by force.
p: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working on the river, and I wished to mar it, for there was a king behind them who is taking every ship by force.
t: ammas safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya'maloona fil bahri fa arattu an a'eebahaa wa kaana waraaa' ahum malikuny yaakhuzu kulla safeenatin ghasbaa

ar: وأما ٱلغلم فكان أبواه مؤمنين فخشينا أن يرهقهما طغينا وكفرا
tr: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
y: "As for the youth, his parents were people of Faith, and we feared that he would grieve them by obstinate rebellion and ingratitude (to Allah and man).
p: And as for the lad, his parents were believers and we feared lest he should oppress them by rebellion and disbelief.
t: wa aammal ghulaamu fakaana abawaahu mu'minaini fakhasheenaaa any yurhiqa humaa tughyaananw wa kufraa

ar: فأردنا أن يبدلهما ربهما خيرا منه زكوة وأقرب رحما
tr: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
y: "So we desired that their Lord would give them in exchange (a son) better in purity (of conduct) and closer in affection.
p: And we intended that their Lord should change him for them for one better in purity and nearer to mercy.
t: faradnaa any yubdila humaa rabbuhumaa khairam minhu zakaatanw wa aqraba ruhmaa

ar: وأما ٱلجدار فكان لغلمين يتيمين فى ٱلمدينة وكان تحته كنز لهما وكان أبوهما صلحا فأراد ربك أن يبلغا أشدهما ويستخرجا كنزهما رحمة من ربك وما فعلته عن أمرى ذلك تأويل ما لم تسطع عليه صبرا
tr: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
y: "As for the wall, it belonged to two youths, orphans, in the Town; there was, beneath it, a buried treasure, to which they were entitled: their father had been a righteous man: So thy Lord desired that they should attain their age of full strength and get out their treasure - a mercy (and favour) from thy Lord. I did it not of my own accord. Such is the interpretation of (those things) over which thou wast unable to hold patience."
p: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear.
t: wa ammal jidaaru fakaana lighulaamaini yateemaini fil madeenati wa kaana tahtahoo kanzul lahumaa wa kaana aboohumaa saalihan fa araada rabbuka any yablughaaa ashuddahumaa wa yastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmatam mir rabbik; wa maa fa'altuhoo 'an amree; zaalika taaweelu maa lam tasti' 'alaihi sabra

ar: ويسـلونك عن ذى ٱلقرنين قل سأتلوا عليكم منه ذكرا
tr: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
y: They ask thee concerning Zul-qarnain. Say, "I will rehearse to you something of his story."
p: They will ask thee of Dhu'l-Qarneyn. Say: I shall recite unto you a remembrance of him.
t: wa yas'aloonaka 'an zil qarnaini qul sa atloo 'alaikum minhu zikraa

ar: إنا مكنا له فى ٱلأرض وءاتينه من كل شىء سببا
tr: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.
y: Verily We established his power on earth, and We gave him the ways and the means to all ends.
p: Lo! We made him strong in the land and gave him unto every thing a road.
t: innaa makkannaa lahoo fil ardi wa aatainaahu min kulli shai'in sababaa

ar: فأتبع سببا
tr: So he followed a way
y: One (such) way he followed,
p: And he followed a road
t: fa atba'a sababaa

ar: حتى إذا بلغ مغرب ٱلشمس وجدها تغرب فى عين حمئة ووجد عندها قوما قلنا يذا ٱلقرنين إما أن تعذب وإما أن تتخذ فيهم حسنا
tr: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
y: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it set in a spring of murky water: Near it he found a People: We said: "O Zul-qarnain! (thou hast authority,) either to punish them, or to treat them with kindness."
p: Till, when he reached the setting-place of the sun, he found it setting in a muddy spring, and found a people thereabout. We said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Either punish or show them kindness.
t: hattaaa izaa balagha maghribash shamsi wajadahaaa taghrubu fee 'aynin hami'a tinw wa wajada 'indahaa qawmaa; qulnaa yaa zal qarnaini immaaa an tu'az ziba wa immaaa an tattakhiza feehim husnaa

ar: قال أما من ظلم فسوف نعذبه ثم يرد إلى ربه فيعذبه عذابا نكرا
tr: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment.
y: He said: "Whoever doth wrong, him shall we punish; then shall he be sent back to his Lord; and He will punish him with a punishment unheard-of (before).
p: He said: As for him who doeth wrong, we shall punish him, and then he will be brought back unto his Lord, Who will punish him with awful punishment!
t: qaala amaa man zalama fasawfa nu'azzibuhoo summa yuraddu ilaa rabbihee fa yu 'azzibuhoo azaaban nukraa

ar: وأما من ءامن وعمل صلحا فله جزاء ٱلحسنى وسنقول له من أمرنا يسرا
tr: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease."
y: "But whoever believes, and works righteousness,- he shall have a goodly reward, and easy will be his task as We order it by our Command."
p: But as for him who believeth and doeth right, good will be his reward, and We shall speak unto him a mild command.
t: wa ammaa man aamana wa 'amila saalihan falahoo jazaaa'anil husnaa wa sanaqoolu lahoo min amrinaa yusraa

ar: ثم أتبع سببا
tr: Then he followed a way
y: Then followed he (another) way,
p: Then he followed a road
t: summa atba'a sababaa

ar: حتى إذا بلغ مطلع ٱلشمس وجدها تطلع على قوم لم نجعل لهم من دونها سترا
tr: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
y: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no covering protection against the sun.
p: Till, when he reached the rising-place of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had appointed no shelter therefrom.
t: hattaaa izaa balagha matli'ash shamsi wajdahaa tatlu'u alaa qawmil lam naj'al lahum min doonihaa sitraa

ar: كذلك وقد أحطنا بما لديه خبرا
tr: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
y: (He left them) as they were: We completely understood what was before him.
p: So (it was). And We knew all concerning him.
t: kazaalika wa qad ahatnaa bimaa ladaihi khubraa

ar: ثم أتبع سببا
tr: Then he followed a way
y: Then followed he (another) way,
p: Then he followed a road
t: summa atba'a sababaa

ar: حتى إذا بلغ بين ٱلسدين وجد من دونهما قوما لا يكادون يفقهون قولا
tr: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
y: Until, when he reached (a tract) between two mountains, he found, beneath them, a people who scarcely understood a word.
p: Till, when he came between the two mountains, he found upon their hither side a folk that scarce could understand a saying.
t: hattaaa izaa balagha bainas saddaini wajada min doonihimaa qawmal laa yakaa doona yafqahoona qawlaa

ar: قالوا يذا ٱلقرنين إن يأجوج ومأجوج مفسدون فى ٱلأرض فهل نجعل لك خرجا على أن تجعل بيننا وبينهم سدا
tr: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
y: They said: "O Zul-qarnain! the Gog and Magog (People) do great mischief on earth: shall we then render thee tribute in order that thou mightest erect a barrier between us and them?
p: They said: O Dhu'l-Qarneyn! Lo! Gog and Magog are spoiling the land. So may we pay thee tribute on condition that thou set a barrier between us and them?
t: qaaloo yaa zal qarnaini inna yaajooja wa maajooja mufsidoona fil ardi fahal naj'alu laka kharjan 'alaaa an taj'ala bainanaa wa bainahum saddas

ar: قال ما مكنى فيه ربى خير فأعينونى بقوة أجعل بينكم وبينهم ردما
tr: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam.
y: He said: "(The power) in which my Lord has established me is better (than tribute): Help me therefore with strength (and labour): I will erect a strong barrier between you and them:
p: He said: That wherein my Lord hath established me is better (than your tribute). Do but help me with strength (of men), I will set between you and them a bank.
t: qaala maa makkannee feehi rabbee khairun fa-a'eenoonee biquwwatin aj'al bainakum wa bainahum radmaa

ar: ءاتونى زبر ٱلحديد حتى إذا ساوى بين ٱلصدفين قال ٱنفخوا حتى إذا جعله نارا قال ءاتونى أفرغ عليه قطرا
tr: Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
y: "Bring me blocks of iron." At length, when he had filled up the space between the two steep mountain-sides, He said, "Blow (with your bellows)" Then, when he had made it (red) as fire, he said: "Bring me, that I may pour over it, molten lead."
p: Give me pieces of iron - till, when he had levelled up (the gap) between the cliffs, he said: Blow! - till, when he had made it a fire, he said: Bring me molten copper to pour thereon.
t: aatoonee zubaral hadeed, hattaaa izaa saawaa bainas sadafaini qaalan fukhoo hattaaa izaa ja'alahoo naaran qaala aatooneee ufrigh 'alaihi qitraa

ar: فما ٱسطعوا أن يظهروه وما ٱستطعوا له نقبا
tr: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
y: Thus were they made powerless to scale it or to dig through it.
p: And (Gog and Magog) were not able to surmount, nor could they pierce (it).
t: famas taa'ooo any yazharoohu wa mastataa'oo lahoo naqbaa

ar: قال هذا رحمة من ربى فإذا جاء وعد ربى جعله دكاء وكان وعد ربى حقا
tr: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
y: He said: "This is a mercy from my Lord: But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass, He will make it into dust; and the promise of my Lord is true."
p: He said: This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord cometh to pass, He will lay it low, for the promise of my Lord is true.
t: qaala haaza rahmatummir rabbee fa izaa jaaa'a wa'du rabbee ja'alahoo dakkaaa'a; wa kaana; wa du rabbee haqqaa

ar: وتركنا بعضهم يومئذ يموج فى بعض ونفخ فى ٱلصور فجمعنهم جمعا
tr: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
y: On that day We shall leave them to surge like waves on one another: the trumpet will be blown, and We shall collect them all together.
p: And on that day we shall let some of them surge against others, and the Trumpet will be blown. Then We shall gather them together in one gathering.
t: wa taraknaa ba'dahum yawma'iziny yamooju fee ba'dinw wa nufikha fis soori fajama'naahum jam'aa

ar: وعرضنا جهنم يومئذ للكفرين عرضا
tr: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display -
y: And We shall present Hell that day for Unbelievers to see, all spread out,-
p: On that day we shall present hell to the disbelievers, plain to view,
t: wa 'aradnaa jahannama yawma'izil lilkaafireena 'ardaa

ar: ٱلذين كانت أعينهم فى غطاء عن ذكرى وكانوا لا يستطيعون سمعا
tr: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
y: (Unbelievers) whose eyes had been under a veil from remembrance of Me, and who had been unable even to hear.
p: Those whose eyes were hoodwinked from My reminder, and who could not bear to hear.
t: allazeena kaanat a'yunuhum fee ghitaaa'in 'an zikree wa kaanoo la yastatee'oona sam'aa

ar: أفحسب ٱلذين كفروا أن يتخذوا عبادى من دونى أولياء إنا أعتدنا جهنم للكفرين نزلا
tr: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
y: Do the Unbelievers think that they can take My servants as protectors besides Me? Verily We have prepared Hell for the Unbelievers for (their) entertainment.
p: Do the disbelievers reckon that they can choose My bondmen as protecting friends beside Me? Lo! We have prepared hell as a welcome for the disbelievers.
t: afahasibal lazeena kafarooo any yattakhizoo 'ibaadee min dooneee awliyaaa'; innaaa a'tadnaa jahannama lilkaafi reena nuzulaa

ar: قل هل ننبئكم بٱلأخسرين أعملا
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
y: Say: "Shall we tell you of those who lose most in respect of their deeds?-
p: Say: Shall We inform you who will be the greatest losers by their works?
t: qul hal nunabbi'ukum bilakhsareena a'maalaa

ar: ٱلذين ضل سعيهم فى ٱلحيوة ٱلدنيا وهم يحسبون أنهم يحسنون صنعا
tr: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
y: "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life, while they thought that they were acquiring good by their works?"
p: Those whose effort goeth astray in the life of the world, and yet they reckon that they do good work.
t: allazeena dalla sa'yuhum fil hayaatid dunyaa wa hum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sun'aa

ar: أولئك ٱلذين كفروا بـايت ربهم ولقائه فحبطت أعملهم فلا نقيم لهم يوم ٱلقيمة وزنا
tr: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.
y: They are those who deny the Signs of their Lord and the fact of their having to meet Him (in the Hereafter): vain will be their works, nor shall We, on the Day of Judgment, give them any weight.
p: Those are they who disbelieve in the revelations of their Lord and in the meeting with Him. Therefor their works are vain, and on the Day of Resurrection We assign no weight to them.
t: ulaaa'ikal lazeena kafaroo bi aayaati rabbihim wa liqaaa'ihee fahabitat a'maaluhum falaa nuqeemu lahum yawmal qiyaamati waznaa

ar: ذلك جزاؤهم جهنم بما كفروا وٱتخذوا ءايتى ورسلى هزوا
tr: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
y: That is their reward, Hell, because they rejected Faith, and took My Signs and My Messengers by way of jest.
p: That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers.
t: zaalika jazaaa'uhum jahannamu bimaa kafaroo wattakhazooo aayaatee wa rusulee huzuwaa

ar: إن ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت كانت لهم جنت ٱلفردوس نزلا
tr: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
y: As to those who believe and work righteous deeds, they have, for their entertainment, the Gardens of Paradise,
p: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs are the Gardens of Paradise for welcome,
t: innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati kaanat lahum jannaatul firdawsi nuzulaa

ar: خلدين فيها لا يبغون عنها حولا
tr: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
y: Wherein they shall dwell (for aye): no change will they wish for from them.
p: Wherein they will abide, with no desire to be removed from thence.
t: khaalideena feeha la yabghoona 'anhaa hiwalaa

ar: قل لو كان ٱلبحر مدادا لكلمت ربى لنفد ٱلبحر قبل أن تنفد كلمت ربى ولو جئنا بمثله مددا
tr: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."
y: Say: "If the ocean were ink (wherewith to write out) the words of my Lord, sooner would the ocean be exhausted than would the words of my Lord, even if we added another ocean like it, for its aid."
p: Say: Though the sea became ink for the Words of my Lord, verily the sea would be used up before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even though We brought the like thereof to help.
t: qul law kaanal bahru midaadal lik kalimaati rabbee lanafidal bahru qabla an tanfada kalimaatu rabbee wa law ji'naa bimislihee madadaa

ar: قل إنما أنا بشر مثلكم يوحى إلى أنما إلهكم إله وحد فمن كان يرجوا لقاء ربه فليعمل عملا صلحا ولا يشرك بعبادة ربه أحدا
tr: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
y: Say: "I am but a man like yourselves, (but) the inspiration has come to me, that your Allah is one Allah: whoever expects to meet his Lord, let him work righteousness, and, in the worship of his Lord, admit no one as partner.
p: Say: I am only a mortal like you. My Lord inspireth in me that your Allah is only One Allah. And whoever hopeth for the meeting with his Lord, let him do righteous work, and make none sharer of the worship due unto his Lord.
t: qul innamaaa ana basharum mislukum yoohaaa ilaiya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahunw waahid; faman kaana yarjoo liqaaa'a rabbihee falya'mal 'amalan saalihanw wa laa yushrik bi'ibaadati rabbiheee ahadaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم كهيعص
tr: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.
y: Kaf. Ha. Ya. 'Ain. Sad.
p: Kaf. Ha. Ya. A'in. Sad.
t: kaaaf-haa-yaa-'ayyyn-saaad

ar: ذكر رحمت ربك عبده زكريا
tr: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
y: (This is) a recital of the Mercy of thy Lord to His servant Zakariya.
p: A mention of the mercy of thy Lord unto His servant Zachariah.
t: zikru rahmati rabbika 'abdahoo zakariyya

ar: إذ نادى ربه نداء خفيا
tr: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
y: Behold! he cried to his Lord in secret,
p: When he cried unto his Lord a cry in secret,
t: iz naadaa rabbahoo nidaaa'an khafiyyaa

ar: قال رب إنى وهن ٱلعظم منى وٱشتعل ٱلرأس شيبا ولم أكن بدعائك رب شقيا
tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
y: Praying: "O my Lord! infirm indeed are my bones, and the hair of my head doth glisten with grey: but never am I unblest, O my Lord, in my prayer to Thee!
p: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.
t: qaala rabbi innee wahanal'azmu minnee washta'alar raasu shaibanw wa lam akum bidu'aaa'ika rabbi shaqiyyaa

ar: وإنى خفت ٱلمولى من وراءى وكانت ٱمرأتى عاقرا فهب لى من لدنك وليا
tr: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
y: "Now I fear (what) my relatives (and colleagues) (will do) after me: but my wife is barren: so give me an heir as from Thyself,-
p: Lo! I fear my kinsfolk after me, since my wife is barren. Oh, give me from Thy presence a successor
t: wa innee khiftul mawaa liya minw waraaa'ee wa kaana tim ra atee 'aairan fahab lee mil ladunka waliyyaa

ar: يرثنى ويرث من ءال يعقوب وٱجعله رب رضيا
tr: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
y: "(One that) will (truly) represent me, and represent the posterity of Jacob; and make him, O my Lord! one with whom Thou art well-pleased!"
p: Who shall inherit of me and inherit (also) of the house of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, acceptable (unto Thee).
t: yarisunee wa yarisu min aali ya'qoob, waj'alhu rabbi radiyya

ar: يزكريا إنا نبشرك بغلم ٱسمه يحيى لم نجعل له من قبل سميا
tr: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
y: (His prayer was answered): "O Zakariya! We give thee good news of a son: His name shall be Yahya: on none by that name have We conferred distinction before."
p: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).
t: yaa zakariyyaaa innaa nubashshiruka bighulaami nismuhoo yahyaa lam naj'al lahoo min qablu samiyyaa

ar: قال رب أنى يكون لى غلم وكانت ٱمرأتى عاقرا وقد بلغت من ٱلكبر عتيا
tr: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
y: He said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren and I have grown quite decrepit from old age?"
p: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?
t: qaala rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa kaanatim ra atee aaqiranw wa qad balaghtu minal kibari 'itiyyaa

ar: قال كذلك قال ربك هو على هين وقد خلقتك من قبل ولم تك شيـا
tr: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "
y: He said: "So (it will be) thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: I did indeed create thee before, when thou hadst been nothing!'"
p: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me, even as I created thee before, when thou wast naught.
t: qaala kazaalika qaala rabbuka huwa 'alaiya haiyinunw wa qad khalaqtuka min qablu wa lam taku shai'aa

ar: قال رب ٱجعل لى ءاية قال ءايتك ألا تكلم ٱلناس ثلث ليال سويا
tr: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
y: (Zakariya) said: "O my Lord! give me a Sign." "Thy Sign," was the answer, "Shall be that thou shalt speak to no man for three nights, although thou art not dumb."
p: He said: My Lord! Appoint for me some token. He said: Thy token is that thou, with no bodily defect, shalt not speak unto mankind three nights.
t: qaala rabbij 'al leee aayah; qaala aayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasa layaalin sawiyyaa

ar: فخرج على قومه من ٱلمحراب فأوحى إليهم أن سبحوا بكرة وعشيا
tr: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.
y: So Zakariya came out to his people from him chamber: He told them by signs to celebrate Allah's praises in the morning and in the evening.
p: Then he came forth unto his people from the sanctuary, and signified to them: Glorify your Lord at break of day and fall of night.
t: fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee minal mihraabi fa-awhaaa ilaihim an sabbihoo bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa

ar: ييحيى خذ ٱلكتب بقوة وءاتينه ٱلحكم صبيا
tr: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
y: (To his son came the command): "O Yahya! take hold of the Book with might": and We gave him Wisdom even as a youth,
p: (And it was said unto his son): O John! Hold fast the Scripture. And we gave him wisdom when a child,
t: yaa yahyaa khuzil kitaaba biquwwatinw wa aatainaahul hukma saiyyaa

ar: وحنانا من لدنا وزكوة وكان تقيا
tr: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
y: And piety (for all creatures) as from Us, and purity: He was devout,
p: And compassion from Our presence, and purity; and he was devout,
t: wa hanaanam mil ladunnaa wa zakaatanw wa kaana taqiyyaa

ar: وبرا بولديه ولم يكن جبارا عصيا
tr: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
y: And kind to his parents, and he was not overbearing or rebellious.
p: And dutiful toward his parents. And he was not arrogant, rebellious.
t: wa barram biwaalidayhi wa lam yakum jabbaaran 'asiyyaa

ar: وسلم عليه يوم ولد ويوم يموت ويوم يبعث حيا
tr: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
y: So Peace on him the day he was born, the day that he dies, and the day that he will be raised up to life (again)!
p: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!
t: wa salaamun 'alaihi yawma wulida wa yawma yamootu wa yawma yub'asu haiyaa

ar: وٱذكر فى ٱلكتب مريم إذ ٱنتبذت من أهلها مكانا شرقيا
tr: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
y: Relate in the Book (the story of) Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place in the East.
p: And make mention of Mary in the Scripture, when she had withdrawn from her people to a chamber looking East,
t: wazkur fil kitaabi marya; izin tabazat min ahlihaa makaanan shariqyyaa

ar: فٱتخذت من دونهم حجابا فأرسلنا إليها روحنا فتمثل لها بشرا سويا
tr: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
y: She placed a screen (to screen herself) from them; then We sent her our angel, and he appeared before her as a man in all respects.
p: And had chosen seclusion from them. Then We sent unto her Our Spirit and it assumed for her the likeness of a perfect man.
t: fattakhazat min doonihim hijaaban fa arsalnaaa ilaihaa roohanaa fatamassala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa

ar: قالت إنى أعوذ بٱلرحمن منك إن كنت تقيا
tr: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."
y: She said: "I seek refuge from thee to (Allah) Most Gracious: (come not near) if thou dost fear Allah."
p: She said: Lo! I seek refuge in the Beneficent One from thee, if thou art Allah-fearing.
t: qaalat inneee a'oozu bir rahmaani minka in kunta taqiyyaa

ar: قال إنما أنا رسول ربك لأهب لك غلما زكيا
tr: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
y: He said: "Nay, I am only a messenger from thy Lord, (to announce) to thee the gift of a holy son.
p: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.
t: qaala innamaa ana rasoolu rabbiki li ahaba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa

ar: قالت أنى يكون لى غلم ولم يمسسنى بشر ولم أك بغيا
tr: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
y: She said: "How shall I have a son, seeing that no man has touched me, and I am not unchaste?"
p: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?
t: qaalat anna yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa lam yamsasnee bashrunw wa lam aku baghiyyaa

ar: قال كذلك قال ربك هو على هين ولنجعله ءاية للناس ورحمة منا وكان أمرا مقضيا
tr: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "
y: He said: "So (it will be): Thy Lord saith, 'that is easy for Me: and (We wish) to appoint him as a Sign unto men and a Mercy from Us': It is a matter (so) decreed."
p: He said: So (it will be). Thy Lord saith: It is easy for Me. And (it will be) that We may make of him a revelation for mankind and a mercy from Us, and it is a thing ordained.
t: qaala kazaaliki qaala rabbuki huwa 'alaiya yaiyimunw wa linaj 'alahooo aayatal linnaasi wa rahmatam minnaa; wa kaana amram maqdiyyaa

ar: فحملته فٱنتبذت به مكانا قصيا
tr: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
y: So she conceived him, and she retired with him to a remote place.
p: And she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a far place.
t: fahamalat hu fantabazat bihee makaanan qasiyyaa

ar: فأجاءها ٱلمخاض إلى جذع ٱلنخلة قالت يليتنى مت قبل هذا وكنت نسيا منسيا
tr: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
y: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm-tree: She cried (in her anguish): "Ah! would that I had died before this! would that I had been a thing forgotten and out of sight!"
p: And the pangs of childbirth drove her unto the trunk of the palm-tree. She said: Oh, would that I had died ere this and had become a thing of naught, forgotten!
t: fa ajaaa 'ahal makhaadu ilaa jiz'in nakhlati qaalat yaa laitanee mittu qabla haazaa wa kuntu nasyam mansiyyaa

ar: فنادىها من تحتها ألا تحزنى قد جعل ربك تحتك سريا
tr: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
y: But (a voice) cried to her from beneath the (palm-tree): "Grieve not! for thy Lord hath provided a rivulet beneath thee;
p: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,
t: fanaadaahaa min tahtihaan allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa

ar: وهزى إليك بجذع ٱلنخلة تسقط عليك رطبا جنيا
tr: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
y: "And shake towards thyself the trunk of the palm-tree: It will let fall fresh ripe dates upon thee.
p: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree toward thee, thou wilt cause ripe dates to fall upon thee.
t: wa huzzeee ilaiki bijiz 'in nakhlati tusaaqit 'alaiki rutaban janiyyaa

ar: فكلى وٱشربى وقرى عينا فإما ترين من ٱلبشر أحدا فقولى إنى نذرت للرحمن صوما فلن أكلم ٱليوم إنسيا
tr: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
y: "So eat and drink and cool (thine) eye. And if thou dost see any man, say, 'I have vowed a fast to (Allah) Most Gracious, and this day will I enter into not talk with any human being'"
p: So eat and drink and be consoled. And if thou meetest any mortal, say: Lo! I have vowed a fast unto the Beneficent, and may not speak this day to any mortal.
t: fakulee washrabee wa qarree 'ainaa; fa immaa tarayinnna minal bashari ahadan faqooleee innee nazartu lir rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal yawma insiyyaa

ar: فأتت به قومها تحمله قالوا يمريم لقد جئت شيـا فريا
tr: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
y: At length she brought the (babe) to her people, carrying him (in her arms). They said: "O Mary! truly an amazing thing hast thou brought!
p: Then she brought him to her own folk, carrying him. They said: O Mary! Thou hast come with an amazing thing.
t: fa atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluhoo qaaloo yaa maryamoo laqad ji'ti shai'an fariyyaa

ar: يأخت هرون ما كان أبوك ٱمرأ سوء وما كانت أمك بغيا
tr: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
y: "O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a man of evil, nor thy mother a woman unchaste!"
p: O sister of Aaron! Thy father was not a wicked man nor was thy mother a harlot.
t: yaaa ukkhta haaroona maa kaana abokim ra-a saw'inw wa maa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa

ar: فأشارت إليه قالوا كيف نكلم من كان فى ٱلمهد صبيا
tr: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
y: But she pointed to the babe. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?"
p: Then she pointed to him. They said: How can we talk to one who is in the cradle, a young boy?
t: fa ashaarat ilaih; qaaloo kaifa nukallimu man kaana fil mahdi sabiyyaa

ar: قال إنى عبد ٱلله ءاتىنى ٱلكتب وجعلنى نبيا
tr: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
y: He said: "I am indeed a servant of Allah: He hath given me revelation and made me a prophet;
p: He spake: Lo! I am the slave of Allah. He hath given me the Scripture and hath appointed me a Prophet,
t: qaala innee 'abdullaahi aataaniyal kitaaba wa ja'alanee nabiyyaa

ar: وجعلنى مباركا أين ما كنت وأوصنى بٱلصلوة وٱلزكوة ما دمت حيا
tr: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
y: "And He hath made me blessed wheresoever I be, and hath enjoined on me Prayer and Charity as long as I live;
p: And hath made me blessed wheresoever I may be, and hath enjoined upon me prayer and almsgiving so long as I remain alive,
t: wa ja'alanee mubaarakan aina maa kuntu wa awsaanee bis salaati waz zakaati maa dumtu haiyaa

ar: وبرا بولدتى ولم يجعلنى جبارا شقيا
tr: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
y: "(He) hath made me kind to my mother, and not overbearing or miserable;
p: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.
t: wa barram biwaalidatee wa lam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa

ar: وٱلسلم على يوم ولدت ويوم أموت ويوم أبعث حيا
tr: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
y: "So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)"!
p: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!
t: wassalaamu 'alaiya yawma wulittu wa yawma amootu wa yawma ub'asu baiyaa

ar: ذلك عيسى ٱبن مريم قول ٱلحق ٱلذى فيه يمترون
tr: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
y: Such (was) Jesus the son of Mary: (it is) a statement of truth, about which they (vainly) dispute.
p: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.
t: zaalika 'eesab-nu marya; qawlal haqqil lazee feehi yamtaroon

ar: ما كان لله أن يتخذ من ولد سبحنه إذا قضى أمرا فإنما يقول له كن فيكون
tr: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
y: It is not befitting to (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glory be to Him! when He determines a matter, He only says to it, "Be", and it is.
p: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
t: maa kaana lillaahi ai yattakhiza minw waladin subhaanah; izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fa yakoon

ar: وإن ٱلله ربى وربكم فٱعبدوه هذا صرط مستقيم
tr: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
y: Verily Allah is my Lord and your Lord: Him therefore serve ye: this is a Way that is straight.
p: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.
t: wa innal laaha rabbee wa rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa siraatum mustaqeem

ar: فٱختلف ٱلأحزاب من بينهم فويل للذين كفروا من مشهد يوم عظيم
tr: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
y: But the sects differ among themselves: and woe to the unbelievers because of the (coming) Judgment of a Momentous Day!
p: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.
t: fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena kafaroo mim mashhadi yawmin 'azeem

ar: أسمع بهم وأبصر يوم يأتوننا لكن ٱلظلمون ٱليوم فى ضلل مبين
tr: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
y: How plainly will they see and hear, the Day that they will appear before Us! but the unjust today are in error manifest!
p: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.
t: asmi' bihim wa absir yawma yaatoonanaa laakiniz zaalimoonal yawma fee dalaalim mubeen

ar: وأنذرهم يوم ٱلحسرة إذ قضى ٱلأمر وهم فى غفلة وهم لا يؤمنون
tr: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
y: But warn them of the Day of Distress, when the matter will be determined: for (behold,) they are negligent and they do not believe!
p: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.
t: wa anzirhum yawmal hasrati iz qudiyal amr; wa hum fee ghaflatinw wa hum laa yu'minoon

ar: إنا نحن نرث ٱلأرض ومن عليها وإلينا يرجعون
tr: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
y: It is We Who will inherit the earth, and all beings thereon: to Us will they all be returned.
p: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.
t: innaa nnahnu narisul arda wa man 'alaihaa wa ilainaa yurja'oon

ar: وٱذكر فى ٱلكتب إبرهيم إنه كان صديقا نبيا
tr: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
y: (Also mention in the Book (the story of) Abraham: He was a man of Truth, a prophet.
p: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.
t: wazkur fil kitaabi ibraaheem; innahoo kaana siddeeqan nabiyyaa

ar: إذ قال لأبيه يأبت لم تعبد ما لا يسمع ولا يبصر ولا يغنى عنك شيـا
tr: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
y: Behold, he said to his father: "O my father! why worship that which heareth not and seeth not, and can profit thee nothing?
p: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?
t: iz qaala li abeehi yaaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u wa laa yubsiru wa laa yughnee 'anka shai'aa

ar: يأبت إنى قد جاءنى من ٱلعلم ما لم يأتك فٱتبعنى أهدك صرطا سويا
tr: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
y: "O my father! to me hath come knowledge which hath not reached thee: so follow me: I will guide thee to a way that is even and straight.
p: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.
t: yaaa abati innee qad jaaa'anee minal 'ilmi maa lam yaatika fattabi'neee ahdika siraatan sawiyyaa

ar: يأبت لا تعبد ٱلشيطن إن ٱلشيطن كان للرحمن عصيا
tr: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
y: "O my father! serve not Satan: for Satan is a rebel against (Allah) Most Gracious.
p: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.
t: yaaa abati laa ta'budish shaitaana innash shaitaana kaana lir rahmaani 'asiyyaa

ar: يأبت إنى أخاف أن يمسك عذاب من ٱلرحمن فتكون للشيطن وليا
tr: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
y: "O my father! I fear lest a Penalty afflict thee from (Allah) Most Gracious, so that thou become to Satan a friend."
p: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.
t: yaaa abati innee akhaafu ai yamssaka 'azaabum minar rahmaani fatakoona lish shaitaani waliyyaa

ar: قال أراغب أنت عن ءالهتى يإبرهيم لئن لم تنته لأرجمنك وٱهجرنى مليا
tr: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
y: (The father) replied: "Dost thou hate my gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will indeed stone thee: Now get away from me for a good long while!"
p: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!
t: qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaaa ibraaheemu la 'il lam tantahi la arjumannaka wahjumee maliyyaa

ar: قال سلم عليك سأستغفر لك ربى إنه كان بى حفيا
tr: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
y: Abraham said: "Peace be on thee: I will pray to my Lord for thy forgiveness: for He is to me Most Gracious.
p: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.
t: qaala salaamun 'alaika sa astaghfiru laka rabbeee innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa

ar: وأعتزلكم وما تدعون من دون ٱلله وأدعوا ربى عسى ألا أكون بدعاء ربى شقيا
tr: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
y: "And I will turn away from you (all) and from those whom ye invoke besides Allah: I will call on my Lord: perhaps, by my prayer to my Lord, I shall be not unblest."
p: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
t: wa a'tazilukum wa maa tad'oona min doonil laahi wa ad'o rabbee 'asaaa allaaa akoona bidu'aaa'i rabbee shaqiyyaa

ar: فلما ٱعتزلهم وما يعبدون من دون ٱلله وهبنا له إسحق ويعقوب وكلا جعلنا نبيا
tr: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
y: When he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each one of them We made a prophet.
p: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.
t: falamma' tazalahum wa maa ya'budoona min doonil laahi wahabnaa lahoo is-haaqa wa ya'qoob, wa kullan ja'alnaa nabiyyaa

ar: ووهبنا لهم من رحمتنا وجعلنا لهم لسان صدق عليا
tr: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.
y: And We bestowed of Our Mercy on them, and We granted them lofty honour on the tongue of truth.
p: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.
t: wa wahabnaa lahum mirrahmatinaa wa ja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa

ar: وٱذكر فى ٱلكتب موسى إنه كان مخلصا وكان رسولا نبيا
tr: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
y: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Moses: for he was specially chosen, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
p: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
t: wazkur fil kitaabi moosaaa; innahoo kaana mukhlasanw wa kaana rasoolan nabiyyaa

ar: وندينه من جانب ٱلطور ٱلأيمن وقربنه نجيا
tr: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
y: And we called him from the right side of Mount (Sinai), and made him draw near to Us, for mystic (converse).
p: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.
t: wa naadainaahu min jaanibit tooril aimani wa qarrabnaahu najiyyaa

ar: ووهبنا له من رحمتنا أخاه هرون نبيا
tr: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
y: And, out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Aaron, (also) a prophet.
p: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).
t: wa wahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaaa akhaahu haaroona nabiyyaa

ar: وٱذكر فى ٱلكتب إسمعيل إنه كان صادق ٱلوعد وكان رسولا نبيا
tr: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
y: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Isma'il: He was (strictly) true to what he promised, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
p: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
t: wazkur fil kitaabi ismaa'eel; innahoo kaana saadiqal wa'di wa kaana rasoolan nabiyyaa

ar: وكان يأمر أهله بٱلصلوة وٱلزكوة وكان عند ربه مرضيا
tr: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.
y: He used to enjoin on his people Prayer and Charity, and he was most acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
p: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
t: wa kaana yaamuru ahlahoo bis salaati waz zakaati wa kaana 'inda rabbihee mardiyyaa

ar: وٱذكر فى ٱلكتب إدريس إنه كان صديقا نبيا
tr: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
y: Also mention in the Book the case of Idris: He was a man of truth (and sincerity), (and) a prophet:
p: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;
t: wazkur fil kitaabi idrees; innahoo kaana siddeeqan nabiyyaa

ar: ورفعنه مكانا عليا
tr: And We raised him to a high station.
y: And We raised him to a lofty station.
p: And We raised him to high station.
t: wa rafa'naahu makaanan 'aliyyaa

ar: أولئك ٱلذين أنعم ٱلله عليهم من ٱلنبين من ذرية ءادم وممن حملنا مع نوح ومن ذرية إبرهيم وإسرءيل وممن هدينا وٱجتبينا إذا تتلى عليهم ءايت ٱلرحمن خروا سجدا وبكيا
tr: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
y: Those were some of the prophets on whom Allah did bestow His Grace,- of the posterity of Adam, and of those who We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel of those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the Signs of (Allah) Most Gracious were rehearsed to them, they would fall down in prostrate adoration and in tears.
p: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.
t: ulaaa'ikal lazeena an'amal laahu 'alaihim minan nabiyyeena min zurriyyati aadama wa mimman hamalnaa ma'a noohinw wa min zurriyyati ibraaheema wa israaa'eela wa mimman hadainaa wajta bainaaa; izaa tutlaa 'alaihim aayaatur rahmaani kharroo sujjadanw wa bukiyyaa

ar: فخلف من بعدهم خلف أضاعوا ٱلصلوة وٱتبعوا ٱلشهوت فسوف يلقون غيا
tr: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
y: But after them there followed a posterity who missed prayers and followed after lusts soon, then, will they face Destruction,-
p: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.
t: fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us salaata wattaba'ush shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghaiyaa

ar: إلا من تاب وءامن وعمل صلحا فأولئك يدخلون ٱلجنة ولا يظلمون شيـا
tr: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
y: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness: for these will enter the Garden and will not be wronged in the least,-
p: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -
t: illaa man taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yadkhuloonal jannata wa laa yuzlamoona shai'aa

ar: جنت عدن ٱلتى وعد ٱلرحمن عباده بٱلغيب إنه كان وعده مأتيا
tr: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.
y: Gardens of Eternity, those which (Allah) Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the Unseen: for His promise must (necessarily) come to pass.
p: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -
t: jannaati 'adninil latee wa'adar rahmaanu ibaadahoo bilghaib; innahoo kaana wa'duhoo maatiyyaa

ar: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا إلا سلما ولهم رزقهم فيها بكرة وعشيا
tr: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
y: They will not there hear any vain discourse, but only salutations of Peace: And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and evening.
p: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
t: laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa; wa lahum rizquhum feehaa bukratanw wa 'ashiyyaa

ar: تلك ٱلجنة ٱلتى نورث من عبادنا من كان تقيا
tr: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
y: Such is the Garden which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who guard against Evil.
p: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.
t: tilkal jannatul latee oorisu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa

ar: وما نتنزل إلا بأمر ربك له ما بين أيدينا وما خلفنا وما بين ذلك وما كان ربك نسيا
tr: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
y: (The angels say:) "We descend not but by command of thy Lord: to Him belongeth what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between: and thy Lord never doth forget,-
p: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -
t: wa maa natanazzalu illaa bi amri rabbika lahoo maa baina aideenaa wa maa khalfanaa wa maa baina zaalik; wa maa kaana rabbuka nasiyyaa

ar: رب ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما فٱعبده وٱصطبر لعبدته هل تعلم له سميا
tr: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
y: "Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that is between them; so worship Him, and be constant and patient in His worship: knowest thou of any who is worthy of the same Name as He?"
p: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?
t: rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa fa'bud hu wastabir li'ibaadatih; hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa

ar: ويقول ٱلإنسن أءذا ما مت لسوف أخرج حيا
tr: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
y: Man says: "What! When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
p: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?
t: wa yaqoolul insaanu 'aizaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju haiyaa

ar: أولا يذكر ٱلإنسن أنا خلقنه من قبل ولم يك شيـا
tr: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
y: But does not man call to mind that We created him before out of nothing?
p: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?
t: awalaa yazkurul insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu wa lam yaku shai'aa

ar: فوربك لنحشرنهم وٱلشيطين ثم لنحضرنهم حول جهنم جثيا
tr: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
y: So, by thy Lord, without doubt, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Evil Ones (with them); then shall We bring them forth on their knees round about Hell;
p: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.
t: fawa rabbika lanahshu rannahum wash shayaateena summa lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jisiyyaa

ar: ثم لننزعن من كل شيعة أيهم أشد على ٱلرحمن عتيا
tr: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
y: Then shall We certainly drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against (Allah) Most Gracious.
p: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.
t: summa lananzi 'anna min kulli shee'atin aiyuhum ashaddu 'alar rahmaani 'itiyyaa

ar: ثم لنحن أعلم بٱلذين هم أولى بها صليا
tr: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
y: And certainly We know best those who are most worthy of being burned therein.
p: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.
t: summa lanahnu a'lamu billazeena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa

ar: وإن منكم إلا واردها كان على ربك حتما مقضيا
tr: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
y: Not one of you but will pass over it: this is, with thy Lord, a Decree which must be accomplished.
p: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.
t: wa im minkum illaa waa riduhaa; kaana 'alaa rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa

ar: ثم ننجى ٱلذين ٱتقوا ونذر ٱلظلمين فيها جثيا
tr: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
y: But We shall save those who guarded against evil, and We shall leave the wrong-doers therein, (humbled) to their knees.
p: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.
t: summa nunajjil lazeenat taqaw wa nazaruz zaalimeena feehaa jisiyyaa

ar: وإذا تتلى عليهم ءايتنا بينت قال ٱلذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا أى ٱلفريقين خير مقاما وأحسن نديا
tr: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
y: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say to those who believe, "Which of the two sides is best in point of position? Which makes the best show in council?"
p: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?
t: wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo aiyul fareeqaini khairum maqaamanw wa ahsanu nadiyyaa

ar: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم أحسن أثثا ورءيا
tr: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
y: But how many (countless) generations before them have we destroyed, who were even better in equipment and in glitter to the eye?
p: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!
t: wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu asaasanw wa ri'yaa

ar: قل من كان فى ٱلضللة فليمدد له ٱلرحمن مدا حتى إذا رأوا ما يوعدون إما ٱلعذاب وإما ٱلساعة فسيعلمون من هو شر مكانا وأضعف جندا
tr: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
y: Say: "If any men go astray, (Allah) Most Gracious extends (the rope) to them, until, when they see the warning of Allah (being fulfilled) - either in punishment or in (the approach of) the Hour,- they will at length realise who is worst in position, and (who) weakest in forces!
p: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.
t: qul man kaana fidda laalati falyamdud lahur rahmaanu maddaa; hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona immal 'azaaba wa immas saa'ata fasa ya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaananw wa ad'afu jundaa

ar: ويزيد ٱلله ٱلذين ٱهتدوا هدى وٱلبقيت ٱلصلحت خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير مردا
tr: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
y: "And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return."
p: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.
t: wa yazeedul laahul lazeenah tadaw hudaa; wal baaqiyaatus saalihaatu khairun 'inda rabbika sawaabanw wa khairum maraddaa

ar: أفرءيت ٱلذى كفر بـايتنا وقال لأوتين مالا وولدا
tr: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"
y: Hast thou then seen the (sort of) man who rejects Our Signs, yet says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children?"
p: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?
t: afara'aytal lazee kafara bi aayaatinaa wa qaala la oota yanna maalanw wa waladaa

ar: أطلع ٱلغيب أم ٱتخذ عند ٱلرحمن عهدا
tr: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
y: Has he penetrated to the Unseen, or has he taken a contract with (Allah) Most Gracious?
p: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?
t: attala'al ghaiba amitta khaza'indar rahmaani 'ahdaa

ar: كلا سنكتب ما يقول ونمد له من ٱلعذاب مدا
tr: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
y: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall add and add to his punishment.
p: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.
t: kallaa; sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wa namuddu lahoo minal 'azaabi maddaa

ar: ونرثه ما يقول ويأتينا فردا
tr: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
y: To Us shall return all that he talks of and he shall appear before Us bare and alone.
p: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).
t: wa narisuhoo maa yaqoolu wa yaateenaa fardaa

ar: وٱتخذوا من دون ٱلله ءالهة ليكونوا لهم عزا
tr: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
y: And they have taken (for worship) gods other than Allah, to give them power and glory!
p: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.
t: wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa

ar: كلا سيكفرون بعبادتهم ويكونون عليهم ضدا
tr: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
y: Instead, they shall reject their worship, and become adversaries against them.
p: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.
t: kallaa; sa yakfuroona bi'ibaadatihim wa yakoonoona 'alaihim diddaa

ar: ألم تر أنا أرسلنا ٱلشيطين على ٱلكفرين تؤزهم أزا
tr: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
y: Seest thou not that We have set the Evil Ones on against the unbelievers, to incite them with fury?
p: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?
t: alam tara annaaa arsalnash shayaateena 'alal kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa

ar: فلا تعجل عليهم إنما نعد لهم عدا
tr: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.
y: So make no haste against them, for We but count out to them a (limited) number (of days).
p: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).
t: falaa ta'jal alaihim innamaa na 'uddu lahum 'addaa

ar: يوم نحشر ٱلمتقين إلى ٱلرحمن وفدا
tr: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
y: The day We shall gather the righteous to (Allah) Most Gracious, like a band presented before a king for honours,
p: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.
t: yawma nahshurul muttaqeena ilar rahmaani wafdaa

ar: ونسوق ٱلمجرمين إلى جهنم وردا
tr: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
y: And We shall drive the sinners to Hell, like thirsty cattle driven down to water,-
p: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,
t: wa nasooqul mujrimeena ilaa jahannama wirdaa

ar: لا يملكون ٱلشفعة إلا من ٱتخذ عند ٱلرحمن عهدا
tr: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
y: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from (Allah) Most Gracious.
p: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.
t: laa yamlikoonash shafaa'ta illaa manittakhaza 'indar rahmaani 'ahdaa

ar: وقالوا ٱتخذ ٱلرحمن ولدا
tr: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
y: They say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
p: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.
t: wa qaalut takhazar rahmaanu waladaa

ar: لقد جئتم شيـا إدا
tr: You have done an atrocious thing.
y: Indeed ye have put forth a thing most monstrous!
p: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing
t: laqad ji'tum shai'an iddaa

ar: تكاد ٱلسموت يتفطرن منه وتنشق ٱلأرض وتخر ٱلجبال هدا
tr: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
y: At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin,
p: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,
t: takaadus samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu wa tanshaq qul ardu wa takhirrul jibaalu haddaa

ar: أن دعوا للرحمن ولدا
tr: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
y: That they should invoke a son for (Allah) Most Gracious.
p: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,
t: an da'aw lir rahmaani waladaa

ar: وما ينبغى للرحمن أن يتخذ ولدا
tr: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
y: For it is not consonant with the majesty of (Allah) Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
p: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.
t: wa maa yambaghee lir rahmaani ai yattakhiza waladaa

ar: إن كل من فى ٱلسموت وٱلأرض إلا ءاتى ٱلرحمن عبدا
tr: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
y: Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant.
p: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.
t: in kullu man fis samaawaati wal ardi illaaa aatir rahmaani 'abdaa

ar: لقد أحصىهم وعدهم عدا
tr: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
y: He does take an account of them (all), and hath numbered them (all) exactly.
p: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.
t: laqad ahsaahum wa addahum 'addaa

ar: وكلهم ءاتيه يوم ٱلقيمة فردا
tr: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
y: And everyone of them will come to Him singly on the Day of Judgment.
p: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.
t: wa kulluhum aateehi yawmal qiyaamati fardaa

ar: إن ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت سيجعل لهم ٱلرحمن ودا
tr: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
y: On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
p: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
t: innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati sa yaj'alu lahumur rahmaanu wuddaa

ar: فإنما يسرنه بلسانك لتبشر به ٱلمتقين وتنذر به قوما لدا
tr: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
y: So have We made the (Qur'an) easy in thine own tongue, that with it thou mayest give Glad Tidings to the righteous, and warnings to people given to contention.
p: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.
t: fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil muttaqeena wa tunzira bihee qawmal luddaa

ar: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هل تحس منهم من أحد أو تسمع لهم ركزا
tr: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
y: But how many (countless) generations before them have We destroyed? Canst thou find a single one of them (now) or hear (so much as) a whisper of them?
p: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?
t: wa kam ahlaknaa qabla hum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم طه
tr: Ta, Ha.
y: Ta-Ha.
p: Ta. Ha.
t: taa-haa

ar: ما أنزلنا عليك ٱلقرءان لتشقى
tr: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
y: We have not sent down the Qur'an to thee to be (an occasion) for thy distress,
p: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,
t: maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal qur-aana litashqaaa

ar: إلا تذكرة لمن يخشى
tr: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -
y: But only as an admonition to those who fear (Allah),-
p: But as a reminder unto him who feareth,
t: illaa tazkiratal limany yakshaa

ar: تنزيلا ممن خلق ٱلأرض وٱلسموت ٱلعلى
tr: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
y: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the heavens on high.
p: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens,
t: tanzeelam mimman khalaqal arda was samaawaatil 'ulaa

ar: ٱلرحمن على ٱلعرش ٱستوى
tr: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
y: (Allah) Most Gracious is firmly established on the throne (of authority).
p: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne.
t: ar-rahmaanu 'alal 'arshis tawaa

ar: له ما فى ٱلسموت وما فى ٱلأرض وما بينهما وما تحت ٱلثرى
tr: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
y: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and on earth, and all between them, and all beneath the soil.
p: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod.
t: lahoo maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa maa tahtassaraa

ar: وإن تجهر بٱلقول فإنه يعلم ٱلسر وأخفى
tr: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
y: If thou pronounce the word aloud, (it is no matter): for verily He knoweth what is secret and what is yet more hidden.
p: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.
t: wa in tajhar bilqawli fainnahoo ya'lamus sirra wa akhfaa

ar: ٱلله لا إله إلا هو له ٱلأسماء ٱلحسنى
tr: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
y: Allah! there is no god but He! To Him belong the most Beautiful Names.
p: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names.
t: allaahu laaa ilasha illaa huwa lahul asmaaa'ul husnaa

ar: وهل أتىك حديث موسى
tr: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
y: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
p: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?
t: wa hal ataaka hadeesu moosa

ar: إذ رءا نارا فقال لأهله ٱمكثوا إنى ءانست نارا لعلى ءاتيكم منها بقبس أو أجد على ٱلنار هدى
tr: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
y: Behold, he saw a fire: So he said to his family, "Tarry ye; I perceive a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."
p: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.
t: iz ra aa naaran faqaala li alhlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la'alleee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan naari hudaa

ar: فلما أتىها نودى يموسى
tr: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
y: But when he came to the fire, a voice was heard: "O Moses!
p: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses!
t: falammaaa ataahaa noodiya yaa moosaa

ar: إنى أنا ربك فٱخلع نعليك إنك بٱلواد ٱلمقدس طوى
tr: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
y: "Verily I am thy Lord! therefore (in My presence) put off thy shoes: thou art in the sacred valley Tuwa.
p: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa.
t: inneee ana rabbuka fakhla' na'laika innaka bilwaadil muqaddasi tuwaa

ar: وأنا ٱخترتك فٱستمع لما يوحى
tr: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
y: "I have chosen thee: listen, then, to the inspiration (sent to thee).
p: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.
t: wa anakhtartuka fastami' limaa yoohaa

ar: إننى أنا ٱلله لا إله إلا أنا فٱعبدنى وأقم ٱلصلوة لذكرى
tr: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
y: "Verily, I am Allah: There is no god but I: So serve thou Me (only), and establish regular prayer for celebrating My praise.
p: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.
t: innaneee anal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa ana fa'budnee wa aqimis-salaata lizikree

ar: إن ٱلساعة ءاتية أكاد أخفيها لتجزى كل نفس بما تسعى
tr: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
y: "Verily the Hour is coming - My design is to keep it hidden - for every soul to receive its reward by the measure of its Endeavour.
p: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve).
t: innas saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas'aa

ar: فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يؤمن بها وٱتبع هوىه فتردى
tr: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
y: "Therefore let not such as believe not therein but follow their own lusts, divert thee therefrom, lest thou perish!"..
p: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.
t: falaa yasuddannnaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa

ar: وما تلك بيمينك يموسى
tr: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
y: "And what is that in the right hand, O Moses?"
p: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?
t: wa maa tilka bi yamee nika yaa moosaa

ar: قال هى عصاى أتوكؤا عليها وأهش بها على غنمى ولى فيها مـارب أخرى
tr: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
y: He said, "It is my rod: on it I lean; with it I beat down fodder for my flocks; and in it I find other uses."
p: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.
t: qaala hiya 'asaaya atawakka'u alaihaa wa ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee wa liya feehaa ma aaribu ukhraa

ar: قال ألقها يموسى
tr: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
y: (Allah) said, "Throw it, O Moses!"
p: He said: Cast it down, O Moses!
t: qaala alqihaa yaa moosaa

ar: فألقىها فإذا هى حية تسعى
tr: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
y: He threw it, and behold! It was a snake, active in motion.
p: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding.
t: fa-alqaahaa fa -izaa hiya haiyatun tas'aa

ar: قال خذها ولا تخف سنعيدها سيرتها ٱلأولى
tr: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
y: (Allah) said, "Seize it, and fear not: We shall return it at once to its former condition"..
p: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state.
t: qaala khuzhaa wa laa ta khaf sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal oolaa

ar: وٱضمم يدك إلى جناحك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء ءاية أخرى
tr: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
y: "Now draw thy hand close to thy side: It shall come forth white (and shining), without harm (or stain),- as another Sign,-
p: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.
t: wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'in aayatan ukhraa

ar: لنريك من ءايتنا ٱلكبرى
tr: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
y: "In order that We may show thee (two) of our Greater Signs.
p: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents,
t: linuriyaka min aayaatinal kubra

ar: ٱذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى
tr: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
y: "Go thou to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds."
p: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
t: izhab ilaa fir'awna innahoo taghaa

ar: قال رب ٱشرح لى صدرى
tr: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
y: (Moses) said: "O my Lord! expand me my breast;
p: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind
t: qaala rabbish rah lee sadree

ar: ويسر لى أمرى
tr: And ease for me my task
y: "Ease my task for me;
p: And ease my task for me;
t: wa yassir leee amree

ar: وٱحلل عقدة من لسانى
tr: And untie the knot from my tongue
y: "And remove the impediment from my speech,
p: And loose a knot from my tongue,
t: wahlul 'uqdatam milli saanee

ar: يفقهوا قولى
tr: That they may understand my speech.
y: "So they may understand what I say:
p: That they may understand my saying.
t: yafqahoo qawlee

ar: وٱجعل لى وزيرا من أهلى
tr: And appoint for me a minister from my family -
y: "And give me a Minister from my family,
p: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,
t: waj'al lee wazeeram min ahlee

ar: هرون أخى
tr: Aaron, my brother.
y: "Aaron, my brother;
p: Aaron, my brother.
t: haaroona akhee

ar: ٱشدد به أزرى
tr: Increase through him my strength
y: "Add to my strength through him,
p: Confirm my strength with him
t: ushdud biheee azree

ar: وأشركه فى أمرى
tr: And let him share my task
y: "And make him share my task:
p: And let him share my task,
t: wa ashrik hu feee amree

ar: كى نسبحك كثيرا
tr: That we may exalt You much
y: "That we may celebrate Thy praise without stint,
p: That we may glorify Thee much
t: kai nusabbihaka kaseeraa

ar: ونذكرك كثيرا
tr: And remember You much.
y: "And remember Thee without stint:
p: And much remember Thee.
t: wa nazkuraka kaseeraa

ar: إنك كنت بنا بصيرا
tr: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
y: "For Thou art He that (ever) regardeth us."
p: Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us.
t: innaka kunta binaa baseeraa

ar: قال قد أوتيت سؤلك يموسى
tr: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
y: (Allah) said: "Granted is thy prayer, O Moses!"
p: He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses.
t: qaala qad ooteeta su'laka yaa moosaa

ar: ولقد مننا عليك مرة أخرى
tr: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
y: "And indeed We conferred a favour on thee another time (before).
p: And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour,
t: wa laqad manannaa 'alaika marratan ukhraaa

ar: إذ أوحينا إلى أمك ما يوحى
tr: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
y: "Behold! We sent to thy mother, by inspiration, the message:
p: When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired,
t: iz awhainaaa ilaaa ummika maa yoohaaa

ar: أن ٱقذفيه فى ٱلتابوت فٱقذفيه فى ٱليم فليلقه ٱليم بٱلساحل يأخذه عدو لى وعدو له وألقيت عليك محبة منى ولتصنع على عينى
tr: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
y: "'Throw (the child) into the chest, and throw (the chest) into the river: the river will cast him up on the bank, and he will be taken up by one who is an enemy to Me and an enemy to him': But I cast (the garment of) love over thee from Me: and (this) in order that thou mayest be reared under Mine eye.
p: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,
