y: Seest thou not that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and forthwith the earth becomes clothed with green? for Allah is He Who understands the finest mysteries, and is well-acquainted (with them).
p: Seest thou not how Allah sendeth down water from the sky and then the earth becometh green upon the morrow? Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.
t: alam tara annal laaha anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fatusbihul ardu mukhdarrah; innal laaha lateefun khabeer

ar: له ما فى ٱلسموت وما فى ٱلأرض وإن ٱلله لهو ٱلغنى ٱلحميد
tr: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
y: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: for verily Allah,- He is free of all wants, Worthy of all Praise.
p: Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Lo! Allah, He verily is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.
t: lahoo ma fis samaawaati wa ma fil ard; wa innal laaha la huwal ghaniyyul hameed

ar: ألم تر أن ٱلله سخر لكم ما فى ٱلأرض وٱلفلك تجرى فى ٱلبحر بأمره ويمسك ٱلسماء أن تقع على ٱلأرض إلا بإذنه إن ٱلله بٱلناس لرءوف رحيم
tr: Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allah, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.
y: Seest thou not that Allah has made subject to you (men) all that is on the earth, and the ships that sail through the sea by His Command? He withholds the sky (rain) from failing on the earth except by His leave: for Allah is Most Kind and Most Merciful to man.
p: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath made all that is in the earth subservient unto you? And the ship runneth upon the sea by His command, and He holdeth back the heaven from falling on the earth unless by His leave. Lo! Allah is, for mankind, Full of Pity, Merciful.
t: alam tara annal laaha sakhkhara lakum maa fil ardi wal fulka tajree fil bahri bi amrihee wa yumsikus samaaa'a an taqa'a 'alal ardi illaa biiznih; innal laaha binnaasi la ra'oofur raheem

ar: وهو ٱلذى أحياكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم إن ٱلإنسن لكفور
tr: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.
y: It is He Who gave you life, will cause you to die, and will again give you life: Truly man is a most ungrateful creature!
p: And He it is Who gave you life, then He will cause you to die, and then will give you life (again). Lo! man is verily an ingrate.
t: wa huwal lazee ahyaakum summa yumeetukum summma yuheekum; innal insaana lakafoor

ar: لكل أمة جعلنا منسكا هم ناسكوه فلا ينزعنك فى ٱلأمر وٱدع إلى ربك إنك لعلى هدى مستقيم
tr: For every religion We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muhammad], let the disbelievers not contend with you over the matter but invite them to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
y: To every People have We appointed rites and ceremonies which they must follow: let them not then dispute with thee on the matter, but do thou invite (them) to thy Lord: for thou art assuredly on the Right Way.
p: Unto each nation have We given sacred rites which they are to perform; so let them not dispute with thee of the matter, but summon thou unto thy Lord. Lo! thou indeed followest right guidance.
t: likulli ummatin ja'alnaa mansakan hum naasikoohu falaa yunaazi 'unnaka fil amr; wad'u ilaa rabbika innaka la 'alaa hudam mustaqeem

ar: وإن جدلوك فقل ٱلله أعلم بما تعملون
tr: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allah is most knowing of what you do.
y: If they do wrangle with thee, say, "Allah knows best what it is ye are doing."
p: And if they wrangle with thee, say: Allah is Best Aware of what ye do.
t: wa in jaadalooka faqulil laahu a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon

ar: ٱلله يحكم بينكم يوم ٱلقيمة فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون
tr: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
y: "Allah will judge between you on the Day of Judgment concerning the matters in which ye differ."
p: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein ye used to differ.
t: allaahu yahkumu bainakum yawmal qiyaamati feemaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon

ar: ألم تعلم أن ٱلله يعلم ما فى ٱلسماء وٱلأرض إن ذلك فى كتب إن ذلك على ٱلله يسير
tr: Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allah, is easy.
y: Knowest thou not that Allah knows all that is in heaven and on earth? Indeed it is all in a Record, and that is easy for Allah.
p: Hast thou not known that Allah knoweth all that is in the heaven and the earth? Lo! it is in a record. Lo! that is easy for Allah.
t: alam ta'lam annal laaha ya'lamu maa fis samaaa'i wal ard; inna zaalika fee kitaab; inna zaalika 'alal laahi yaseer

ar: ويعبدون من دون ٱلله ما لم ينزل به سلطنا وما ليس لهم به علم وما للظلمين من نصير
tr: And they worship besides Allah that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
y: Yet they worship, besides Allah, things for which no authority has been sent down to them, and of which they have (really) no knowledge: for those that do wrong there is no helper.
p: And they worship instead of Allah that for which He hath sent down no warrant, and that whereof they have no knowledge. For evil-doers there is no helper.
t: wa ya'budoona min doonil laahi maa lam yunazzil bihee sultaananw wa maa laisa lahum bihee 'ilm; wa maa lizzaalimeena min naseer

ar: وإذا تتلى عليهم ءايتنا بينت تعرف فى وجوه ٱلذين كفروا ٱلمنكر يكادون يسطون بٱلذين يتلون عليهم ءايتنا قل أفأنبئكم بشر من ذلكم ٱلنار وعدها ٱلله ٱلذين كفروا وبئس ٱلمصير
tr: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."
y: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, thou wilt notice a denial on the faces of the Unbelievers! they nearly attack with violence those who rehearse Our Signs to them. Say, "Shall I tell you of something (far) worse than these Signs? It is the Fire (of Hell)! Allah has promised it to the Unbelievers! and evil is that destination!"
p: And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey's end!
t: wa izaa tutlaa 'laihim aayaatunaa baiyinaatin ta'rifu fee wujoohil lazeena kafarul munkara yakaadoona yastoona bil lazeena yatloona 'alaihim aayaatinaa; qul afa unab bi'ukum bisharrim min zaalikum; an naaru wa 'adahal laahul lazeena kafaroo wa bi'sal maseer

ar: يأيها ٱلناس ضرب مثل فٱستمعوا له إن ٱلذين تدعون من دون ٱلله لن يخلقوا ذبابا ولو ٱجتمعوا له وإن يسلبهم ٱلذباب شيـا لا يستنقذوه منه ضعف ٱلطالب وٱلمطلوب
tr: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. And if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.
y: O men! Here is a parable set forth! listen to it! Those on whom, besides Allah, ye call, cannot create (even) a fly, if they all met together for the purpose! and if the fly should snatch away anything from them, they would have no power to release it from the fly. Feeble are those who petition and those whom they petition!
p: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought!
t: yaaa ayyuhan naasu duriba masalun fastami'oo lah; innal lazeena tad'oona min doonil laahi lai yakhluqoo zubaabanw wa lawijtama'oo lahoo wa iny yaslub humuz zubbabu shai'al laa yastan qizoohu minh; da'ufat taalibu walmatloob

ar: ما قدروا ٱلله حق قدره إن ٱلله لقوى عزيز
tr: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
y: No just estimate have they made of Allah: for Allah is He Who is strong and able to Carry out His Will.
p: They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
t: maa qadrul laaha haqqa qadrih; innal laaha la qawiyyun 'azeez

ar: ٱلله يصطفى من ٱلملئكة رسلا ومن ٱلناس إن ٱلله سميع بصير
tr: Allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
y: Allah chooses messengers from angels and from men for Allah is He Who hears and sees (all things).
p: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer.
t: allahu yastafee minal malaaa'ikati rusulanw wa minan naas; innal laaha samee'um baseer

ar: يعلم ما بين أيديهم وما خلفهم وإلى ٱلله ترجع ٱلأمور
tr: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allah will be returned [all] matters.
y: He knows what is before them and what is behind them: and to Allah go back all questions (for decision).
p: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A
t: ya'lamu maa baina aydeehim wa maa khalfahum; wa ilal laahi turja'ul umoor

ar: يأيها ٱلذين ءامنوا ٱركعوا وٱسجدوا وٱعبدوا ربكم وٱفعلوا ٱلخير لعلكم تفلحون
tr: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.
y: O ye who believe! bow down, prostrate yourselves, and adore your Lord; and do good; that ye may prosper.
p: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper.
t: yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanur ka'oo wasjudoo wa'budoo rabbakum waf'alul khaira la'allakum tuflihoon

ar: وجهدوا فى ٱلله حق جهاده هو ٱجتبىكم وما جعل عليكم فى ٱلدين من حرج ملة أبيكم إبرهيم هو سمىكم ٱلمسلمين من قبل وفى هذا ليكون ٱلرسول شهيدا عليكم وتكونوا شهداء على ٱلناس فأقيموا ٱلصلوة وءاتوا ٱلزكوة وٱعتصموا بٱلله هو مولىكم فنعم ٱلمولى ونعم ٱلنصير
tr: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
y: And strive in His cause as ye ought to strive, (with sincerity and under discipline). He has chosen you, and has imposed no difficulties on you in religion; it is the cult of your father Abraham. It is He Who has named you Muslims, both before and in this (Revelation); that the Messenger may be a witness for you, and ye be witnesses for mankind! So establish regular Prayer, give regular Charity, and hold fast to Allah! He is your Protector - the Best to protect and the Best to help!
p: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!
t: wa jaahidoo fil laahi haqqa jihaadih; huwaj tabaakum wa maa ja'ala 'alaikum fid deeni min haraj; millata abeekum ibraaheem; huwa sammaakumul muslimeena min qablu wa fee haaza li yakoonar rasoolu shaheedan 'alaikum wa takoonoo shuhadaaa'a 'alan naas; fa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata wa'tasimoo billaahi huwa mawlaakum fani'mal mawlaa wa ni'man naseer

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم قد أفلح ٱلمؤمنون
tr: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
y: The believers must (eventually) win through,-
p: Successful indeed are the believers
t: qad aflahal mu'minoon

ar: ٱلذين هم فى صلاتهم خشعون
tr: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
y: Those who humble themselves in their prayers;
p: Who are humble in their prayers,
t: allazeena hum fee salaatihim khaashi'oon

ar: وٱلذين هم عن ٱللغو معرضون
tr: And they who turn away from ill speech
y: Who avoid vain talk;
p: And who shun vain conversation,
t: wallazeena hum 'anillaghwimu'ridoon

ar: وٱلذين هم للزكوة فعلون
tr: And they who are observant of zakah
y: Who are active in deeds of charity;
p: And who are payers of the poor-due;
t: wallazeena hum liz zakaati faa'iloon

ar: وٱلذين هم لفروجهم حفظون
tr: And they who guard their private parts
y: Who abstain from sex,
p: And who guard their modesty -
t: wallazeena hum lifuroo jihim haafizoon

ar: إلا على أزوجهم أو ما ملكت أيمنهم فإنهم غير ملومين
tr: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
y: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame,
p: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,
t: illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aimaanuhum fa innahum ghairu maloomeen

ar: فمن ٱبتغى وراء ذلك فأولئك هم ٱلعادون
tr: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
y: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors;-
p: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -
t: famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

ar: وٱلذين هم لأمنتهم وعهدهم رعون
tr: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
y: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants;
p: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,
t: wallazeena hum li amaanaatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon

ar: وٱلذين هم على صلوتهم يحافظون
tr: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
y: And who (strictly) guard their prayers;-
p: And who pay heed to their prayers.
t: wallazeena hum 'alaa salawaatihim yuhaafizoon

ar: أولئك هم ٱلورثون
tr: Those are the inheritors
y: These will be the heirs,
p: These are the heirs
t: ulaaa'ika humul waarisoon

ar: ٱلذين يرثون ٱلفردوس هم فيها خلدون
tr: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
y: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
p: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.
t: allazeena yarisoonal firdawsa hum feehaa khaalidoon

ar: ولقد خلقنا ٱلإنسن من سللة من طين
tr: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
y: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
p: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
t: wa laqad khalaqnal insaana min sulaalatim minteen

ar: ثم جعلنه نطفة فى قرار مكين
tr: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.
y: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
p: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;
t: summa ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen

ar: ثم خلقنا ٱلنطفة علقة فخلقنا ٱلعلقة مضغة فخلقنا ٱلمضغة عظما فكسونا ٱلعظم لحما ثم أنشأنه خلقا ءاخر فتبارك ٱلله أحسن ٱلخلقين
tr: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
y: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be Allah, the best to create!
p: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!
t: summa khalaqnan nutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnal 'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaq nal mudghata 'izaaman fakasawnal 'izaama lahman summa anshaanaahu khalqan aakhar; fatabaarakal laahu ahsanul khaaliqeen

ar: ثم إنكم بعد ذلك لميتون
tr: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
y: After that, at length ye will die
p: Then lo! after that ye surely die.
t: summa innakum ba'da zaalika la maaiyitoon

ar: ثم إنكم يوم ٱلقيمة تبعثون
tr: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
y: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up.
p: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).
t: summa innakum yawmal qiyaamati tub'asoon

ar: ولقد خلقنا فوقكم سبع طرائق وما كنا عن ٱلخلق غفلين
tr: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
y: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation.
p: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.
t: wa laqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraaa'iqa wa maa kunnaa 'anil khalqi ghaafileen

ar: وأنزلنا من ٱلسماء ماء بقدر فأسكنه فى ٱلأرض وإنا على ذهاب به لقدرون
tr: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
y: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease).
p: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.
t: wa anzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am biqadarin fa-askannaahu fil ardi wa innaa 'alaa zahaabim bihee laqaa diroon

ar: فأنشأنا لكم به جنت من نخيل وأعنب لكم فيها فوكه كثيرة ومنها تأكلون
tr: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
y: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment),-
p: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;
t: fa anshaanaa lakum bihee jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naab; lakum feehaa fawaakihu kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon

ar: وشجرة تخرج من طور سيناء تنبت بٱلدهن وصبغ للءاكلين
tr: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.
y: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food.
p: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.
t: wa shajaratan takhruju min toori sainaaa'a tambutu bidduhni wa sibghil lil aakileen

ar: وإن لكم فى ٱلأنعم لعبرة نسقيكم مما فى بطونها ولكم فيها منفع كثيرة ومنها تأكلون
tr: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
y: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat;
p: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;
t: wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u kaseeratunw wa minhaa taakuloon

ar: وعليها وعلى ٱلفلك تحملون
tr: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
y: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride.
p: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.
t: wa 'alaihaa wa'alal fulki tuhmaloon

ar: ولقد أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه فقال يقوم ٱعبدوا ٱلله ما لكم من إله غيره أفلا تتقون
tr: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
y: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship Allah! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
p: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t: wa laqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaa qawmi'budul laaha maa lakum min ilahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

ar: فقال ٱلملؤا ٱلذين كفروا من قومه ما هذا إلا بشر مثلكم يريد أن يتفضل عليكم ولو شاء ٱلله لأنزل ملئكة ما سمعنا بهذا فى ءابائنا ٱلأولين
tr: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
y: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if Allah had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old."
p: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.
t: faqaalal mala'ul lazeena kafaroo min qawmihee maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yureedu ai yatafaddala 'alaikum wa law shaaa'al laahu la anzala malaaa'ikatam maa sami'naa bihaazaa feee aabaaa'inal awwaleen

ar: إن هو إلا رجل به جنة فتربصوا به حتى حين
tr: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
y: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time."
p: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.
t: in huwa illaa rajulum bihee jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihee hattan heen

ar: قال رب ٱنصرنى بما كذبون
tr: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
y: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood!"
p: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
t: qaala rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon

ar: فأوحينا إليه أن ٱصنع ٱلفلك بأعيننا ووحينا فإذا جاء أمرنا وفار ٱلتنور فٱسلك فيها من كل زوجين ٱثنين وأهلك إلا من سبق عليه ٱلقول منهم ولا تخطبنى فى ٱلذين ظلموا إنهم مغرقون
tr: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
y: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood).
p: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.
t: fa awhainaaa ilaihi anis na'il fulka bi a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa fa izaa jaaa'a amrunaa wa faarat tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjainis naini wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alaihil qawlu minhum wa laa tukhaat ibnee fil lazeena zalamooo innaahum mughraqoon

ar: فإذا ٱستويت أنت ومن معك على ٱلفلك فقل ٱلحمد لله ٱلذى نجىنا من ٱلقوم ٱلظلمين
tr: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
y: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong."
p: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
t: fa izas tawaita ata wa mam ma'aka 'alal fulki faqulil hamdu lillaahil lazee najjaanaa minal qawmiz zalimeen

ar: وقل رب أنزلنى منزلا مباركا وأنت خير ٱلمنزلين
tr: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "
y: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
p: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
t: wa qur rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakanw wa anta khairul munzileen

ar: إن فى ذلك لءايت وإن كنا لمبتلين
tr: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
y: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men).
p: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.
t: inna fee zaalika la aayaatinw wa in kunnaa lamubtaleen

ar: ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم قرنا ءاخرين
tr: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
y: Then We raised after them another generation.
p: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
t: summaa anshaana mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen

ar: فأرسلنا فيهم رسولا منهم أن ٱعبدوا ٱلله ما لكم من إله غيره أفلا تتقون
tr: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
y: And We sent to them a messenger from among themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
p: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t: fa arsalnaa feehim rasoolam minhum ani'budul laaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghairuhoo afalaa tattaqoon

ar: وقال ٱلملأ من قومه ٱلذين كفروا وكذبوا بلقاء ٱلءاخرة وأترفنهم فى ٱلحيوة ٱلدنيا ما هذا إلا بشر مثلكم يأكل مما تأكلون منه ويشرب مما تشربون
tr: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
y: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink.
p: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
t: wa qaalal mala-u min qawmihil lazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi liqaaa'il aakhirati wa atrafnaahum fil hayaatid dunyaa maa haazaaa illaa basharum mislukum yaakulu mimmaa taakuloona minhu wa yashrabu mimmaa tashraboon

ar: ولئن أطعتم بشرا مثلكم إنكم إذا لخسرون
tr: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
y: "If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost.
p: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.
t: wa la'in at'atum basharam mislakum innakum izal lakhaasiroon

ar: أيعدكم أنكم إذا متم وكنتم ترابا وعظما أنكم مخرجون
tr: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
y: "Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)?
p: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?
t: a-ya'idukum annakum izaa mittum wa kuntum turaabanw wa izaaman annakum mukhrajoon

ar: هيهات هيهات لما توعدون
tr: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
y: "Far, very far is that which ye are promised!
p: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!
t: haihaata haihaata limaa too'adoon

ar: إن هى إلا حياتنا ٱلدنيا نموت ونحيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
tr: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
y: "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
p: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
t: in hiya illaa hayaatunad dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa nahnu bimab'ooseen

ar: إن هو إلا رجل ٱفترى على ٱلله كذبا وما نحن له بمؤمنين
tr: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."
y: "He is only a man who invents a lie against Allah, but we are not the ones to believe in him!"
p: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.
t: in huwa illaa rajulunif taraa 'alal laahi kazibanw wa maa nahnuu lahoo bimu'mineen

ar: قال رب ٱنصرنى بما كذبون
tr: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
y: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."
p: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
t: qaala rabbin surnee bimaa kazzaboon

ar: قال عما قليل ليصبحن ندمين
tr: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
y: (Allah) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry!"
p: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.
t: qaala 'ammaa qaleelil la yusbihunna naadimeen

ar: فأخذتهم ٱلصيحة بٱلحق فجعلنهم غثاء فبعدا للقوم ٱلظلمين
tr: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
y: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong!
p: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!
t: fa akhazat humus saihatu bilhaqqi faja'alnaahum ghusaaa'aa; fabu;dal lilqaw miz zaalimeen

ar: ثم أنشأنا من بعدهم قرونا ءاخرين
tr: Then We produced after them other generations.
y: Then We raised after them other generations.
p: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
t: summa anshaanaa mim ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen

ar: ما تسبق من أمة أجلها وما يستـخرون
tr: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
y: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it).
p: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.
t: maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yastaakhiroon

ar: ثم أرسلنا رسلنا تترا كل ما جاء أمة رسولها كذبوه فأتبعنا بعضهم بعضا وجعلنهم أحاديث فبعدا لقوم لا يؤمنون
tr: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
y: Then sent We our messengers in succession: every time there came to a people their messenger, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe!
p: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
t: summa arsalnaa rusulanaa tatraa kulla maa jaaa'a ummatar rasooluhaa kazzabooh; fa atba'naa ba'dahum ba'danw wa ja'alnaahum ahaadees; fabu'dal liqawmil laa yu'minoon

ar: ثم أرسلنا موسى وأخاه هرون بـايتنا وسلطن مبين
tr: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
y: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest,
p: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant
t: summa arsalnaa moosaa wa akhaahu haaroona bi aayaatinaa wa sultaanim mubeen

ar: إلى فرعون وملإيه فٱستكبروا وكانوا قوما عالين
tr: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
y: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people.
p: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.
t: ilaa fir'awna wa mala'ihee fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman 'aaleem

ar: فقالوا أنؤمن لبشرين مثلنا وقومهما لنا عبدون
tr: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
y: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
p: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?
t: faqaaloo annu'minu libasharaini mislinaa wa qawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon

ar: فكذبوهما فكانوا من ٱلمهلكين
tr: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
y: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed.
p: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.
t: fakazzaboohumaa fakaanoo minal mmuhlakeen

ar: ولقد ءاتينا موسى ٱلكتب لعلهم يهتدون
tr: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
y: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance.
p: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.
t: wa laqad aatainaa moosal kitaaba la'allahum yahtadoon

ar: وجعلنا ٱبن مريم وأمه ءاية وءاوينهما إلى ربوة ذات قرار ومعين
tr: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
y: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.
p: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.
t: wa ja'alnab na maryama wa ummahooo aayatannw wa aawainaahumaaa ilaa rabwatin zaati qaraarinw wa ma'een

ar: يأيها ٱلرسل كلوا من ٱلطيبت وٱعملوا صلحا إنى بما تعملون عليم
tr: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.
y: O ye messengers! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
p: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.
t: yaaa aiyuhar rusulu kuloo minat taiyibaati wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona 'aleem

ar: وإن هذه أمتكم أمة وحدة وأنا ربكم فٱتقون
tr: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
y: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other).
p: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.
t: wa inna haaziheee ummatukum ummatanw waahidatanw wa ana rabbukum fattaqoon

ar: فتقطعوا أمرهم بينهم زبرا كل حزب بما لديهم فرحون
tr: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
y: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself.
p: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.
t: fataqatta'ooo amrahum bainahum zuburaa; kullu hizbim bimaa ladaihim farihoon

ar: فذرهم فى غمرتهم حتى حين
tr: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
y: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time.
p: So leave them in their error till a time.
t: fazarhum fee ghamratihim hattaa heen

ar: أيحسبون أنما نمدهم به من مال وبنين
tr: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
y: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons,
p: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them
t: a-yahsaboona annnamaa numiduhum bihee mimmaalinw wa baneen

ar: نسارع لهم فى ٱلخيرت بل لا يشعرون
tr: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
y: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand.
p: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not.
t: nusaari'u lahum fil khairaat; bal laa yash'uroon

ar: إن ٱلذين هم من خشية ربهم مشفقون
tr: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
y: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
p: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.
t: innal lazeena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoon

ar: وٱلذين هم بـايت ربهم يؤمنون
tr: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
y: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord;
p: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
t: wallazeena hum bi aayaati rabbihim yu'minoon

ar: وٱلذين هم بربهم لا يشركون
tr: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
y: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord;
p: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,
t: wallazeena hum bi rabbihim laa yushrikoon

ar: وٱلذين يؤتون ما ءاتوا وقلوبهم وجلة أنهم إلى ربهم رجعون
tr: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
y: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord;-
p: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,
t: wallazeena yu'toona maaa aataw wa quloobuhum wajilatun annahum ilaa rabbihim raaji'oon

ar: أولئك يسرعون فى ٱلخيرت وهم لها سبقون
tr: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
y: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them.
p: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.
t: ulaaa'ika yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa hum lahaa saabiqoon

ar: ولا نكلف نفسا إلا وسعها ولدينا كتب ينطق بٱلحق وهم لا يظلمون
tr: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
y: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
p: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
t: wa laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa wa ladainaa kitaabuny yantiqu bilhaqqi w ahum la yuzlamoon

ar: بل قلوبهم فى غمرة من هذا ولهم أعمل من دون ذلك هم لها عملون
tr: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,
y: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do,-
p: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;
t: bal quloobuhum fee ghamratim min haazaa wa lahum a'maalum min dooni zaalika hum lahaa 'aamiloon

ar: حتى إذا أخذنا مترفيهم بٱلعذاب إذا هم يجـرون
tr: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.
y: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication!
p: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.
t: hattaaa izaaa akhznaa mutrafeehim bil'azaabi izaa hum yaj'aroon

ar: لا تجـروا ٱليوم إنكم منا لا تنصرون
tr: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
y: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us.
p: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.
t: laa taj'arul yawma innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon

ar: قد كانت ءايتى تتلى عليكم فكنتم على أعقبكم تنكصون
tr: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
y: "My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels-
p: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,
t: qad kaanat aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum 'alaaa a'qaabikum tankisoon

ar: مستكبرين به سمرا تهجرون
tr: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
y: "In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur'an), like one telling fables by night."
p: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.
t: mustakbireena bihee saamiran tahjuroon

ar: أفلم يدبروا ٱلقول أم جاءهم ما لم يأت ءاباءهم ٱلأولين
tr: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
y: Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
p: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
t: afalam yaddabbarrul qawla am jaaa'ahum maa lam yaati aabaaa'ahumul awwaleen

ar: أم لم يعرفوا رسولهم فهم له منكرون
tr: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
y: Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him?
p: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him?
t: am lam ya'rifoo rasoolahum fahum lahoo munkiroon

ar: أم يقولون به جنة بل جاءهم بٱلحق وأكثرهم للحق كرهون
tr: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
y: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
p: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.
t: am yaqooloona bihee jinnnah; bal jaaa'ahum bilhaqqi wa aksaruhum lil haqqi kaarihoon

ar: ولو ٱتبع ٱلحق أهواءهم لفسدت ٱلسموت وٱلأرض ومن فيهن بل أتينهم بذكرهم فهم عن ذكرهم معرضون
tr: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
y: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition.
p: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.
t: wa lawit taba'al haqqu ahwaaa'ahum lafasadatis samaawaatu wal ardu wa man feehinnn; bal atainaahum bizikrihim fahum 'an zikrihim mu'ridon

ar: أم تسـلهم خرجا فخراج ربك خير وهو خير ٱلرزقين
tr: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
y: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
p: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.
t: am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju rabbika khairunw wa huwa khairur raaziqeen

ar: وإنك لتدعوهم إلى صرط مستقيم
tr: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
y: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way;
p: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.
t: wa innaka latad'oohum ilaa siraatim mustaqeem

ar: وإن ٱلذين لا يؤمنون بٱلءاخرة عن ٱلصرط لنكبون
tr: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
y: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way.
p: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.
t: wa innnal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati 'anis siraati lanaakiboon

ar: ولو رحمنهم وكشفنا ما بهم من ضر للجوا فى طغينهم يعمهون
tr: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
y: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro.
p: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.
t: wa law rahimnaahum wa kashafnaa maa bihim min durril lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon

ar: ولقد أخذنهم بٱلعذاب فما ٱستكانوا لربهم وما يتضرعون
tr: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
y: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)!-
p: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,
t: wa laqad akhaznaahum bil'azaabi famastakaanoo li rabbihim wa maa yatadarra'oon

ar: حتى إذا فتحنا عليهم بابا ذا عذاب شديد إذا هم فيه مبلسون
tr: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
y: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein!
p: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.
t: hattaaa izaa fatahnaa 'alaihim baaban zaa 'azaabin shadeedin izaa hum feehi mublisoon

ar: وهو ٱلذى أنشأ لكم ٱلسمع وٱلأبصر وٱلأفـدة قليلا ما تشكرون
tr: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
y: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
p: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
t: wa huwal lazeee ansha a-lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idah; qaleelam maa tashkuroon

ar: وهو ٱلذى ذرأكم فى ٱلأرض وإليه تحشرون
tr: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
y: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back.
p: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.
t: wa huwal lazee zara akum fil ardi wa ilaihi tuhsharoon

ar: وهو ٱلذى يحى ويميت وله ٱختلف ٱليل وٱلنهار أفلا تعقلون
tr: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
y: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand?
p: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense?
t: wa huwal lazee yuhyee wa yumeetu wa lahukh tilaaful laili wannahaar; afalaa ta'qiloon

ar: بل قالوا مثل ما قال ٱلأولون
tr: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
y: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said.
p: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;
t: bal qaaloo misla maa qaalal awwaloon

ar: قالوا أءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما أءنا لمبعوثون
tr: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
y: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
p: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
t: qaalooo 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'a-innaa lamab 'oosoon

ar: لقد وعدنا نحن وءاباؤنا هذا من قبل إن هذا إلا أسطير ٱلأولين
tr: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
y: "Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients!"
p: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.
t: laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa aabaaa'unaa haazaa min qablu in haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen

ar: قل لمن ٱلأرض ومن فيها إن كنتم تعلمون
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
y: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein? (say) if ye know!"
p: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge?
t: qul limanil ardu wa man feehaaa in kuntum ta'lamoon

ar: سيقولون لله قل أفلا تذكرون
tr: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
y: They will say, "To Allah!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition?"
p: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember?
t: sa-yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tazakkkaroon

ar: قل من رب ٱلسموت ٱلسبع ورب ٱلعرش ٱلعظيم
tr: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
y: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme?"
p: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?
t: qul mar rabbus samaawaatis sab'i wa rabbul 'arshil 'azeem

ar: سيقولون لله قل أفلا تتقون
tr: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
y: They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe?"
p: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?
t: sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul afalaa tattaqoon

ar: قل من بيده ملكوت كل شىء وهو يجير ولا يجار عليه إن كنتم تعلمون
tr: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
y: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects (all), but is not protected (of any)? (say) if ye know."
p: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge?
t: qul mam bi yadihee malakootu kulli shai'inw wa huwa yujeeru wa laa yujaaru 'alaihi in kuntum ta'lamoon

ar: سيقولون لله قل فأنى تسحرون
tr: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
y: They will say, "(It belongs) to Allah." Say: "Then how are ye deluded?"
p: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched?
t: sa yaqooloona lillaah; qul fa annaa tus haroon

ar: بل أتينهم بٱلحق وإنهم لكذبون
tr: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
y: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood!
p: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.
t: bal atainaahum bil haqqi wa innahum lakaaziboon

ar: ما ٱتخذ ٱلله من ولد وما كان معه من إله إذا لذهب كل إله بما خلق ولعلا بعضهم على بعض سبحن ٱلله عما يصفون
tr: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].
y: No son did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him!
p: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.
t: mat takhazal laahu minw waladinw wa maa kaana ma'ahoo min ilaah; izal lazahaba kullu ilaahim bimaa khalaqa wa la'alaa ba'duhum 'alaa ba'd; subhaannal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon

ar: علم ٱلغيب وٱلشهدة فتعلى عما يشركون
tr: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
y: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him!
p: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!
t: 'aalimil ghaibi wash shahhaadati fata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon

ar: قل رب إما ترينى ما يوعدون
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
y: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me (in my lifetime) that which they are warned against,-
p: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.
t: qur rabbi immmaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon

ar: رب فلا تجعلنى فى ٱلقوم ٱلظلمين
tr: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
y: "Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong!"
p: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.
t: rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil qawmiz zaalimeen

ar: وإنا على أن نريك ما نعدهم لقدرون
tr: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.
y: And We are certainly able to show thee (in fulfilment) that against which they are warned.
p: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.
t: wa innaa 'alaaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon

ar: ٱدفع بٱلتى هى أحسن ٱلسيئة نحن أعلم بما يصفون
tr: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
y: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say.
p: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.
t: idfa' billate hiya ahsanus saiyi'ah; nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon

ar: وقل رب أعوذ بك من همزت ٱلشيطين
tr: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
y: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones.
p: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,
t: wa qur rabbi a'oozu bika min hamazaatish shayaateen

ar: وأعوذ بك رب أن يحضرون
tr: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
y: "And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me."
p: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,
t: wa a'oozu bika rabbi ai-yahduroon

ar: حتى إذا جاء أحدهم ٱلموت قال رب ٱرجعون
tr: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
y: (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back (to life),-
p: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,
t: hattaaa izaa jaaa'a ahada humul mawtu qaala rabbir ji'oon

ar: لعلى أعمل صلحا فيما تركت كلا إنها كلمة هو قائلها ومن ورائهم برزخ إلى يوم يبعثون
tr: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
y: "In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up.
p: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.
t: la'alleee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa; innahaa kalimatun huwa qaaa'iluhaa wa minw waraaa'him barzakhun ilaa yawmi yub'asoon

ar: فإذا نفخ فى ٱلصور فلا أنساب بينهم يومئذ ولا يتساءلون
tr: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
y: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another!
p: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.
t: fa izaa nufikha fis soori falaaa ansaaba bainahum yawma'izinw wa laa yatasaaa'aloon

ar: فمن ثقلت موزينه فأولئك هم ٱلمفلحون
tr: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
y: Then those whose balance (of good deeds) is heavy,- they will attain salvation:
p: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.
t: faman saqulat mawaazee nuhoo fa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon

ar: ومن خفت موزينه فأولئك ٱلذين خسروا أنفسهم فى جهنم خلدون
tr: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
y: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide.
p: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.
t: wa man khaffat mawaa zeenuhoo fa ulaaa'ikal lazeena khasiroon anfusahum fee jahannnama khaalidoon

ar: تلفح وجوههم ٱلنار وهم فيها كلحون
tr: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
y: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced.
p: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.
t: talfahu wujoohahumun naaru wa hum feehaa kaalihood

ar: ألم تكن ءايتى تتلى عليكم فكنتم بها تكذبون
tr: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
y: "Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood?"
p: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them?
t: alam takun aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fakuntum bihaa tukazziboon

ar: قالوا ربنا غلبت علينا شقوتنا وكنا قوما ضالين
tr: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
y: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray!
p: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.
t: qaaloo rabbanaa ghalabat 'alainaa shiqwatunaa wa kunnaa qawman daaalleen

ar: ربنا أخرجنا منها فإن عدنا فإنا ظلمون
tr: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
y: "Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return (to Evil), then shall we be wrong-doers indeed!"
p: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.
t: rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa in 'udnaa fa innaa zaalimoon

ar: قال ٱخسـوا فيها ولا تكلمون
tr: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
y: He will say: "Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me!
p: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.
t: qaalakh sa'oo feehaa wa laa tukallimoon

ar: إنه كان فريق من عبادى يقولون ربنا ءامنا فٱغفر لنا وٱرحمنا وأنت خير ٱلرحمين
tr: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
y: "A part of My servants there was, who used to pray 'our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
p: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;
t: innahoo kaana fareequm min 'ibaadee yaqooloona rabbanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa anta khairur raahimeen

ar: فٱتخذتموهم سخريا حتى أنسوكم ذكرى وكنتم منهم تضحكون
tr: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
y: "But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them!
p: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.
t: fattakhaztumoohum sikhriyyan hattaaa ansawkum zikree wa kuntum minhum tadhakoon

ar: إنى جزيتهم ٱليوم بما صبروا أنهم هم ٱلفائزون
tr: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
y: "I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss..."
p: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.
t: inee jazaituhumul yawma bimaa sabarooo annahum humul faaa'izoon

ar: قل كم لبثتم فى ٱلأرض عدد سنين
tr: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
y: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth?"
p: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years?
t: qaala kam labistum fil ardi 'adada sineen

ar: قالوا لبثنا يوما أو بعض يوم فسـل ٱلعادين
tr: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
y: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account."
p: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!
t: qaaloo labisnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin fas'alil 'aaaddeen

ar: قل إن لبثتم إلا قليلا لو أنكم كنتم تعلمون
tr: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
y: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known!
p: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.
t: qaala il labistum illaa qaleelal law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon

ar: أفحسبتم أنما خلقنكم عبثا وأنكم إلينا لا ترجعون
tr: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
y: "Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us (for account)?"
p: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us?
t: afahsibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum 'abasanw wa annakum ilainaa laa turja'oon

ar: فتعلى ٱلله ٱلملك ٱلحق لا إله إلا هو رب ٱلعرش ٱلكريم
tr: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
y: Therefore exalted be Allah, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour!
p: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.
t: fata'aalal laahul malikul haqq; laaa ilaaha illaa huwa rabbul 'arshil kareem

ar: ومن يدع مع ٱلله إلها ءاخر لا برهن له به فإنما حسابه عند ربه إنه لا يفلح ٱلكفرون
tr: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
y: If anyone invokes, besides Allah, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through!
p: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.
t: wa mai yad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara laa burhaana lahoo bihee fa innnamaa hisaabuhoo 'inda rabbih; innahoo laa yuflihul kaafiroon

ar: وقل رب ٱغفر وٱرحم وأنت خير ٱلرحمين
tr: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
y: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
p: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
t: wa qur rabbigh fir warham wa anta khairur raahimeen

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم سورة أنزلنها وفرضنها وأنزلنا فيها ءايت بينت لعلكم تذكرون
tr: [This is] a surah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
y: A sura which We have sent down and which We have ordained in it have We sent down Clear Signs, in order that ye may receive admonition.
p: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.
t: sooratun anzalnaahaa wa faradnaahaa wa anzalnaa feehaaa aayaatim baiyinaatil la'allakum tazakkaroon

ar: ٱلزانية وٱلزانى فٱجلدوا كل وحد منهما مائة جلدة ولا تأخذكم بهما رأفة فى دين ٱلله إن كنتم تؤمنون بٱلله وٱليوم ٱلءاخر وليشهد عذابهما طائفة من ٱلمؤمنين
tr: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion of Allah, if you should believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.
y: The woman and the man guilty of adultery or fornication,- flog each of them with a hundred stripes: Let not compassion move you in their case, in a matter prescribed by Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day: and let a party of the Believers witness their punishment.
p: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment.
t: azzaaniyatu wazzaanee fajlidoo kulla waahidim minhumaa mi'ata jaldatinw wa laa taakhuzkum bihimaa raafatun fee deenil laahi in kuntum tu'minoona billaahi wal yawmil aakhiri wal yashhad 'azaabahumaa taaa'ifatum minal mu'mineen

ar: ٱلزانى لا ينكح إلا زانية أو مشركة وٱلزانية لا ينكحها إلا زان أو مشرك وحرم ذلك على ٱلمؤمنين
tr: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that has been made unlawful to the believers.
y: Let no man guilty of adultery or fornication marry and but a woman similarly guilty, or an Unbeliever: nor let any but such a man or an Unbeliever marry such a woman: to the Believers such a thing is forbidden.
p: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers.
t: azzaanee laa yankihu illaa zaaniyatan aw mushrikatanw wazzaaniyatu laa yankihuhaaa illaa zaanin aw mushrik; wa hurrima zaalika 'alal mu'mineen

ar: وٱلذين يرمون ٱلمحصنت ثم لم يأتوا بأربعة شهداء فٱجلدوهم ثمنين جلدة ولا تقبلوا لهم شهدة أبدا وأولئك هم ٱلفسقون
tr: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,
y: And those who launch a charge against chaste women, and produce not four witnesses (to support their allegations),- flog them with eighty stripes; and reject their evidence ever after: for such men are wicked transgressors;-
p: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -
t: wallazeena yarmoonal muhsanaati summa lam yaatoo bi-arba'ati shuhadaaa'a fajlidoohum samaaneena jaldatanw wa laa taqbaloo lahum shahaadatan abadaa; wa ulaaa'ika humul faasiqoon

ar: إلا ٱلذين تابوا من بعد ذلك وأصلحوا فإن ٱلله غفور رحيم
tr: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
y: Unless they repent thereafter and mend (their conduct); for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
p: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
t: illal lazeena taaboo mim ba'di zaalika wa aslahoo fa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem

ar: وٱلذين يرمون أزوجهم ولم يكن لهم شهداء إلا أنفسهم فشهدة أحدهم أربع شهدت بٱلله إنه لمن ٱلصدقين
tr: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the truthful.
y: And for those who launch a charge against their spouses, and have (in support) no evidence but their own,- their solitary evidence (can be received) if they bear witness four times (with an oath) by Allah that they are solemnly telling the truth;
p: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth;
t: wallazeena yarmoona azwaajahum wa lam yakul lahum shuhadaaa'u illaaa anfusuhum fashahaadatu ahadihim arb'u shahaadaatim billaahi innahoo laminas saadiqeen

ar: وٱلخمسة أن لعنت ٱلله عليه إن كان من ٱلكذبين
tr: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allah be upon him if he should be among the liars.
y: And the fifth (oath) (should be) that they solemnly invoke the curse of Allah on themselves if they tell a lie.
p: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie.
t: wal khaamisatu anna la'natal laahi 'alaihi in kaana minal kaazibeen

ar: ويدرؤا عنها ٱلعذاب أن تشهد أربع شهدت بٱلله إنه لمن ٱلكذبين
tr: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the liars.
y: But it would avert the punishment from the wife, if she bears witness four times (with an oath) By Allah, that (her husband) is telling a lie;
p: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false,
t: wa yadra'u anhal 'azaaba an tashhada arba'a shahaa daatim billaahi innahoo laminal kaazibeen

ar: وٱلخمسة أن غضب ٱلله عليها إن كان من ٱلصدقين
tr: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was of the truthful.
y: And the fifth (oath) should be that she solemnly invokes the wrath of Allah on herself if (her accuser) is telling the truth.
p: And a fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaketh truth.
t: wal khaamisata anna ghadabal laahi 'alaihaaa in kaana minas saadiqeen

ar: ولولا فضل ٱلله عليكم ورحمته وأن ٱلله تواب حكيم
tr: And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy... and because Allah is Accepting of repentance and Wise.
y: If it were not for Allah's grace and mercy on you, and that Allah is Oft-Returning, full of Wisdom,- (Ye would be ruined indeed).
p: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone).
t: wa law laa fadlul laahi 'alaikum wa rahmatuhoo wa annal laaha tawwaabun hakeem

ar: إن ٱلذين جاءو بٱلإفك عصبة منكم لا تحسبوه شرا لكم بل هو خير لكم لكل ٱمرئ منهم ما ٱكتسب من ٱلإثم وٱلذى تولى كبره منهم له عذاب عظيم
tr: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment.
y: Those who brought forward the lie are a body among yourselves: think it not to be an evil to you; On the contrary it is good for you: to every man among them (will come the punishment) of the sin that he earned, and to him who took on himself the lead among them, will be a penalty grievous.
p: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom.
t: innal lazeena jaaa'oo bilifki 'usbatum minkum; laa tahsaboohu sharral lakum bal huwa khairul lakum; likul limri'im minhum mak tasaba minal-ism; wallazee tawallaa kibrahoo minhum lahoo 'azaabun 'azeem

ar: لولا إذ سمعتموه ظن ٱلمؤمنون وٱلمؤمنت بأنفسهم خيرا وقالوا هذا إفك مبين
tr: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of one another and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?
y: Why did not the believers - men and women - when ye heard of the affair,- put the best construction on it in their own minds and say, "This (charge) is an obvious lie"?
p: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth?
t: law laaa iz sami'tumoohu zannal mu'minoona walmu'minaatu bi anfusihim khairanw wa qaaloo haazaaa ifkum mmubeen

ar: لولا جاءو عليه بأربعة شهداء فإذ لم يأتوا بٱلشهداء فأولئك عند ٱلله هم ٱلكذبون
tr: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allah, who are the liars.
y: Why did they not bring four witnesses to prove it? When they have not brought the witnesses, such men, in the sight of Allah, (stand forth) themselves as liars!
p: Why did they not produce four witnesses? Since they produce not witnesses, they verily are liars in the sight of Allah.
t: law laa jaaa'oo 'alaihi bi-arba'ati shuhadaaa'; fa iz lam yaatoo bishshuhadaaa'i fa ulaaa 'ika 'indal laahi humul kaaziboon

ar: ولولا فضل ٱلله عليكم ورحمته فى ٱلدنيا وٱلءاخرة لمسكم فى ما أفضتم فيه عذاب عظيم
tr: And if it had not been for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment
y: Were it not for the grace and mercy of Allah on you, in this world and the Hereafter, a grievous penalty would have seized you in that ye rushed glibly into this affair.
p: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in the world and the Hereafter an awful doom had overtaken you for that whereof ye murmured.
t: wa law laa fadlul laahi 'alaikum wa rahmatuhoo fiddunyaa wal aakhirati lamassakum fee maaa afadtum feehi 'azaabun 'azeem

ar: إذ تلقونه بألسنتكم وتقولون بأفواهكم ما ليس لكم به علم وتحسبونه هينا وهو عند ٱلله عظيم
tr: When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allah, tremendous.
y: Behold, ye received it on your tongues, and said out of your mouths things of which ye had no knowledge; and ye thought it to be a light matter, while it was most serious in the sight of Allah.
p: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.
t: iz talaqqawnahoo bi alsinatikum wa taqooloona bi afwaahikum maa laisa lakum bihee 'ilmunw wa tahsaboo nahoo haiyinanw wa huwa 'indl laahi 'azeem

ar: ولولا إذ سمعتموه قلتم ما يكون لنا أن نتكلم بهذا سبحنك هذا بهتن عظيم
tr: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allah]; this is a great slander"?
y: And why did ye not, when ye heard it, say? - "It is not right of us to speak of this: Glory to Allah! this is a most serious slander!"
p: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny.
t: wa law laaa iz sami'tu moohu qultum maa yakoonu lanaaa an natakallama bihaazaa subhaanaka haaza buhtaanun 'azeem

ar: يعظكم ٱلله أن تعودوا لمثله أبدا إن كنتم مؤمنين
tr: Allah warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.
y: Allah doth admonish you, that ye may never repeat such (conduct), if ye are (true) Believers.
p: Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers.
t: ya'izukumul laahu an ta'oodoo limisliheee abadan in kuntum mu'mineen

ar: ويبين ٱلله لكم ٱلءايت وٱلله عليم حكيم
tr: And Allah makes clear to you the verses, and Allah is Knowing and Wise.
y: And Allah makes the Signs plain to you: for Allah is full of knowledge and wisdom.
p: And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise.
t: wa yubaiyinul laahu lakumul aayaat; wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem

ar: إن ٱلذين يحبون أن تشيع ٱلفحشة فى ٱلذين ءامنوا لهم عذاب أليم فى ٱلدنيا وٱلءاخرة وٱلله يعلم وأنتم لا تعلمون
tr: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allah knows and you do not know.
y: Those who love (to see) scandal published broadcast among the Believers, will have a grievous Penalty in this life and in the Hereafter: Allah knows, and ye know not.
p: Lo! those who love that slander should be spread concerning those who believe, theirs will be a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knoweth. Ye know not.
t: innal lazeena yuhibboona an tashee'al faahishatu fil lazeena aamanoo lahum 'azaabun aleemun fid dunyaa wal aakhirah; wallaahu ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamoon

ar: ولولا فضل ٱلله عليكم ورحمته وأن ٱلله رءوف رحيم
tr: And if it had not been for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy... and because Allah is Kind and Merciful.
y: Were it not for the grace and mercy of Allah on you, and that Allah is full of kindness and mercy, (ye would be ruined indeed).
p: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Merciful, (ye had been undone).
t: wa law laa fadlul laahi 'alaikum wa rahmatuhoo wa annal laaha ra'oofur raheem

ar: يأيها ٱلذين ءامنوا لا تتبعوا خطوت ٱلشيطن ومن يتبع خطوت ٱلشيطن فإنه يأمر بٱلفحشاء وٱلمنكر ولولا فضل ٱلله عليكم ورحمته ما زكى منكم من أحد أبدا ولكن ٱلله يزكى من يشاء وٱلله سميع عليم
tr: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allah upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allah purifies whom He wills, and Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
y: O ye who believe! follow not Satan's footsteps: if any will follow the footsteps of Satan, he will (but) command what is shameful and wrong: and were it not for the grace and mercy of Allah on you, not one of you would ever have been pure: but Allah doth purify whom He pleases: and Allah is One Who hears and knows (all things).
p: O ye who believe! Follow not the footsteps of the devil. Unto whomsoever followeth the footsteps of the devil, lo! he commandeth filthiness and wrong. Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, not one of you would ever have grown pure. But Allah causeth whom He will to grow. And Allah is Hearer, Knower.
t: yaaa aiyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish shaitaan; wa many-yattabi' khutuwaatish shaitaani fa innahoo yaamuru bilfahshaaa'i walmunkar; wa law laa fadlul laahi 'alaikum wa rahmatuhoo maa zakaa minkum min ahadin abadanw wa laakinnal laaha yuzakkee many-yashaaa'; wallaahu samee'un 'aleem

ar: ولا يأتل أولوا ٱلفضل منكم وٱلسعة أن يؤتوا أولى ٱلقربى وٱلمسكين وٱلمهجرين فى سبيل ٱلله وليعفوا وليصفحوا ألا تحبون أن يغفر ٱلله لكم وٱلله غفور رحيم
tr: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allah, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allah should forgive you? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
y: Let not those among you who are endued with grace and amplitude of means resolve by oath against helping their kinsmen, those in want, and those who have left their homes in Allah's cause: let them forgive and overlook, do you not wish that Allah should forgive you? For Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
p: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
t: wa laa yaatali ulul fadli minkum wassa'ati ai yu'tooo ulil qurbaa walmasaakeena walmuhaajireena fee sabeelillaahi walya'foo walyasfahoo; alaa tuhibboona ai yaghfiral laahu lakum; wal laahu ghafoorur raheem

ar: إن ٱلذين يرمون ٱلمحصنت ٱلغفلت ٱلمؤمنت لعنوا فى ٱلدنيا وٱلءاخرة ولهم عذاب عظيم
tr: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment
y: Those who slander chaste women, indiscreet but believing, are cursed in this life and in the Hereafter: for them is a grievous Penalty,-
p: Lo! as for those who traduce virtuous, believing women (who are) careless, cursed are they in the world and the Hereafter. Theirs will be an awful doom
t: innal lazeena yarmoonal muhsanaatil ghaafilaatil mu'minaati lu'inoo fid dunyaa wal aakhirati wa lahum 'azaabun 'azeem

ar: يوم تشهد عليهم ألسنتهم وأيديهم وأرجلهم بما كانوا يعملون
