p: Blessed be He Who hath placed in the heaven mansions of the stars, and hath placed therein a great lamp and a moon giving light!
t: tabaarakal lazee ja'ala fis samaaa'i buroojanw wa ja'ala feehaa siraajanw wa qamaram muneeraa

ar: وهو ٱلذى جعل ٱليل وٱلنهار خلفة لمن أراد أن يذكر أو أراد شكورا
tr: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
y: And it is He Who made the Night and the Day to follow each other: for such as have the will to celebrate His praises or to show their gratitude.
p: And He it is Who hath appointed night and day in succession, for him who desireth to remember, or desireth thankfulness.
t: wa huwal lazee ja'alal laila wannahaara khilfatal liman araada ai yazzakkara aw araadaa shookooraa

ar: وعباد ٱلرحمن ٱلذين يمشون على ٱلأرض هونا وإذا خاطبهم ٱلجهلون قالوا سلما
tr: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
y: And the servants of (Allah) Most Gracious are those who walk on the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, "Peace!";
p: The (faithful) slaves of the Beneficent are they who walk upon the earth modestly, and when the foolish ones address them answer: Peace;
t: wa 'ibaadur rahmaanil lazeena yamshoona 'alal ardi hawnanw wa izaa khaata bahumul jaahiloona qaaloo salaamaa

ar: وٱلذين يبيتون لربهم سجدا وقيما
tr: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
y: Those who spend the night in adoration of their Lord prostrate and standing;
p: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,
t: wallazeena yabeetoona li rabbihim sujjadanw wa qiyaamaa

ar: وٱلذين يقولون ربنا ٱصرف عنا عذاب جهنم إن عذابها كان غراما
tr: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
y: Those who say, "Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous,-
p: And who say: Our Lord! Avert from us the doom of hell; lo! the doom thereof is anguish;
t: wallazeena yaqooloona rabbanas rif 'annnaa 'azaaba jahannama inn 'azaabahaa kaana gharaamaa

ar: إنها ساءت مستقرا ومقاما
tr: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
y: "Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in";
p: Lo! it is wretched as abode and station;
t: innahaa saaa'at mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa

ar: وٱلذين إذا أنفقوا لم يسرفوا ولم يقتروا وكان بين ذلك قواما
tr: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
y: Those who, when they spend, are not extravagant and not niggardly, but hold a just (balance) between those (extremes);
p: And those who, when they spend, are neither prodigal nor grudging; and there is ever a firm station between the two;
t: wallazeena izaaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo wa lam yaqturoo wa kaana baina zaalika qawaamaa

ar: وٱلذين لا يدعون مع ٱلله إلها ءاخر ولا يقتلون ٱلنفس ٱلتى حرم ٱلله إلا بٱلحق ولا يزنون ومن يفعل ذلك يلق أثاما
tr: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
y: Those who invoke not, with Allah, any other god, nor slay such life as Allah has made sacred except for just cause, nor commit fornication; - and any that does this (not only) meets punishment.
p: And those who cry not unto any other god along with Allah, nor take the life which Allah hath forbidden save in (course of) justice, nor commit adultery - and whoso doeth this shall pay the penalty;
t: wallazeena laa yad'oona ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara wa laa yaqtuloonan nafsal latee harramal laahu illaa bilhaqqi wa laa yaznoon; wa mai yaf'al zaalika yalqa asaamaa

ar: يضعف له ٱلعذاب يوم ٱلقيمة ويخلد فيه مهانا
tr: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
y: (But) the Penalty on the Day of Judgment will be doubled to him, and he will dwell therein in ignominy,-
p: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;
t: yudaa'af lahul 'azaabu yawmal qiyaamati wa yakhlud feehee muhaanaa

ar: إلا من تاب وءامن وعمل عملا صلحا فأولئك يبدل ٱلله سيـاتهم حسنت وكان ٱلله غفورا رحيما
tr: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
y: Unless he repents, believes, and works righteous deeds, for Allah will change the evil of such persons into good, and Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful,
p: Save him who repenteth and believeth and doth righteous work; as for such, Allah will change their evil deeds to good deeds. Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful.
t: illaa man taaba wa 'aamana wa 'amila 'amalan saalihan fa ulaaa'ika yubad dilul laahu saiyi aatihim hasanaat; wa kaanal laahu ghafoorar raheemaa

ar: ومن تاب وعمل صلحا فإنه يتوب إلى ٱلله متابا
tr: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
y: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah with an (acceptable) conversion;-
p: And whosoever repenteth and doeth good, he verily repenteth toward Allah with true repentance -
t: wa man taaba wa 'amila saalihan fa innnahoo yatoobu ilal laahi mataabaa

ar: وٱلذين لا يشهدون ٱلزور وإذا مروا بٱللغو مروا كراما
tr: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
y: Those who witness no falsehood, and, if they pass by futility, they pass by it with honourable (avoidance);
p: And those who will not witness vanity, but when they pass near senseless play, pass by with dignity.
t: wallazeena laa yash hadoonaz zoora wa izaa marroo billaghwi marroo kiraamaa

ar: وٱلذين إذا ذكروا بـايت ربهم لم يخروا عليها صما وعميانا
tr: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
y: Those who, when they are admonished with the Signs of their Lord, droop not down at them as if they were deaf or blind;
p: And those who, when they are reminded of the revelations of their Lord, fall not deaf and blind thereat.
t: wallazeena izaa zukkiroo bi aayaati rabbihim lam yakhirroo 'alaihaa summanw wa'umyaanaa

ar: وٱلذين يقولون ربنا هب لنا من أزوجنا وذريتنا قرة أعين وٱجعلنا للمتقين إماما
tr: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
y: And those who pray, "Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes, and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous."
p: And who say: Our Lord! Vouchsafe us comfort of our wives and of our offspring, and make us patterns for (all) those who ward off (evil).
t: wallazeena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa zurriyaatinaa qurrata a'yuninw waj 'alnaa lilmuttaqeena imaamaa

ar: أولئك يجزون ٱلغرفة بما صبروا ويلقون فيها تحية وسلما
tr: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
y: Those are the ones who will be rewarded with the highest place in heaven, because of their patient constancy: therein shall they be met with salutations and peace,
p: They will be awarded the high place forasmuch as they were steadfast, and they will meet therein with welcome and the ward of peace,
t: ulaaa'ika yujzawnal ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wa yulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyatanw wa salaamaa

ar: خلدين فيها حسنت مستقرا ومقاما
tr: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
y: Dwelling therein;- how beautiful an abode and place of rest!
p: Abiding there for ever. Happy is it as abode and station!
t: khaalideena feehaa; hasunat mustaqarranw wa muqaamaa

ar: قل ما يعبؤا بكم ربى لولا دعاؤكم فقد كذبتم فسوف يكون لزاما
tr: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
y: Say (to the Rejecters): "My Lord is not uneasy because of you if ye call not on Him: But ye have indeed rejected (Him), and soon will come the inevitable (punishment)!"
p: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): My Lord would not concern Himself with you but for your prayer. But now ye have denied (the Truth), therefor there will be judgment.
t: qul maa ya'ba'u bikum rabbee law laa du'aaa'ukum faqad kazzabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم طسم
tr: Ta, Seen, Meem.
y: Ta. Sin. Mim.
p: Ta. Sin. Mim.
t: taa-seeen-meeem

ar: تلك ءايت ٱلكتب ٱلمبين
tr: These are the verses of the clear Book.
y: These are verses of the Book that makes (things) clear.
p: These are revelations of the Scripture that maketh plain.
t: tilka aayaatul kitaabil mubeen

ar: لعلك بخع نفسك ألا يكونوا مؤمنين
tr: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
y: It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers.
p: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
t: la'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen

ar: إن نشأ ننزل عليهم من ٱلسماء ءاية فظلت أعنقهم لها خضعين
tr: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
y: If (such) were Our Will, We could send down to them from the sky a Sign, to which they would bend their necks in humility.
p: If We will, We can send down on them from the sky a portent so that their necks would remain bowed before it.
t: in nashaa nunazzil 'alaihim minas samaaa'i aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een

ar: وما يأتيهم من ذكر من ٱلرحمن محدث إلا كانوا عنه معرضين
tr: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
y: But there comes not to them a newly-revealed Message from (Allah) Most Gracious, but they turn away therefrom.
p: Never cometh there unto them a fresh reminder from the Beneficent One, but they turn away from it.
t: wa maa yaateehim min zikrim minar rahmaani muhdasin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen

ar: فقد كذبوا فسيأتيهم أنبؤا ما كانوا به يستهزءون
tr: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
y: They have indeed rejected (the Message): so they will know soon (enough) the truth of what they mocked at!
p: Now they have denied (the Truth); but there will come unto them tidings of that whereat they used to scoff.
t: faqad kazzaboo fasa yaateehim ambaaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

ar: أولم يروا إلى ٱلأرض كم أنبتنا فيها من كل زوج كريم
tr: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
y: Do they not look at the earth,- how many noble things of all kinds We have produced therein?
p: Have they not seen the earth, how much of every fruitful kind We make to grow therein?
t: awa lam yaraw ilal ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem

ar: إن فى ذلك لءاية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
y: Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
p: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
t: inn fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ar: وإن ربك لهو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: And verily, thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
p: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa inna rabbaka la huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: وإذ نادى ربك موسى أن ٱئت ٱلقوم ٱلظلمين
tr: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
y: Behold, thy Lord called Moses: "Go to the people of iniquity,-
p: And when thy Lord called Moses, saying: Go unto the wrongdoing folk,
t: wa iz naadaa rabbuka moosaaa ani'-til qawmaz zaalimeen

ar: قوم فرعون ألا يتقون
tr: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
y: "The people of the Pharaoh: will they not fear Allah?"
p: The folk of Pharaoh. Will they not ward off (evil)?
t: qawma fir'awn; alaa yattaqoon

ar: قال رب إنى أخاف أن يكذبون
tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
y: He said: "O my Lord! I do fear that they will charge me with falsehood:
p: He said: My Lord! Lo! I fear that they will deny me,
t: qaala rabbi inneee akhaafu ai yukazziboon

ar: ويضيق صدرى ولا ينطلق لسانى فأرسل إلى هرون
tr: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
y: "My breast will be straitened. And my speech may not go (smoothly): so send unto Aaron.
p: And I shall be embarrassed, and my tongue will not speak plainly, therefor send for Aaron (to help me).
t: wa yadeequ sadree wa laa yantaliqu lisaanee fa arsil ilaa haaroon

ar: ولهم على ذنب فأخاف أن يقتلون
tr: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
y: "And (further), they have a charge of crime against me; and I fear they may slay me."
p: And they have a crime against me, so I fear that they will kill me.
t: wa lahum 'alaiya zambun fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon

ar: قال كلا فٱذهبا بـايتنا إنا معكم مستمعون
tr: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
y: Allah said: "By no means! proceed then, both of you, with Our Signs; We are with you, and will listen (to your call).
p: He said: Nay, verily. So go ye twain with Our tokens. Lo! We shall be with you, Hearing.
t: qaala kallaa fazhabaa bi aayaatinaaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon

ar: فأتيا فرعون فقولا إنا رسول رب ٱلعلمين
tr: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
y: "So go forth, both of you, to Pharaoh, and say: 'We have been sent by the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds;
p: And come together unto Pharaoh and say: Lo! we bear a message of the Lord of the Worlds,
t: faatiyaa fir'awna faqoolaaa innaa rasoolu rabbil 'aalameen

ar: أن أرسل معنا بنى إسرءيل
tr: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
y: "'Send thou with us the Children of Israel.'"
p: (Saying): Let the Children of Israel go with us.
t: an arsil ma'anaa baneee israaa'eel

ar: قال ألم نربك فينا وليدا ولبثت فينا من عمرك سنين
tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
y: (Pharaoh) said: "Did we not cherish thee as a child among us, and didst thou not stay in our midst many years of thy life?
p: (Pharaoh) said (unto Moses): Did we not rear thee among us as a child? And thou didst dwell many years of thy life among us,
t: qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedanw wa labista feenaa min 'umurika sineen

ar: وفعلت فعلتك ٱلتى فعلت وأنت من ٱلكفرين
tr: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
y: "And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)!"
p: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.
t: wa fa'alta fa'latakal latee fa'alta wa anta minal kaafireen

ar: قال فعلتها إذا وأنا من ٱلضالين
tr: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
y: Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error.
p: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
t: qaala fa'altuhaaa izanw wa ana minad daaaleen

ar: ففررت منكم لما خفتكم فوهب لى ربى حكما وجعلنى من ٱلمرسلين
tr: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
y: "So I fled from you (all) when I feared you; but my Lord has (since) invested me with judgment (and wisdom) and appointed me as one of the messengers.
p: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).
t: fafarartu minkum lam maa khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukmanw wa ja'alanee minal mursaleen

ar: وتلك نعمة تمنها على أن عبدت بنى إسرءيل
tr: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
y: "And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel!"
p: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.
t: wa tilka ni'matun tamun nuhaa 'alaiya an 'abbatta baneee israaa'eel

ar: قال فرعون وما رب ٱلعلمين
tr: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
y: Pharaoh said: "And what is the 'Lord and Cherisher of the worlds'?"
p: Pharaoh said: And what is the Lord of the Worlds?
t: qaala fir'awnu wa maa rabbul 'aalameen

ar: قال رب ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما إن كنتم موقنين
tr: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
y: (Moses) said: "The Lord and Cherisher of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- if ye want to be quite sure."
p: (Moses) said: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye had but sure belief.
t: qaala rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa in kuntum mooqineen

ar: قال لمن حوله ألا تستمعون
tr: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
y: (Pharaoh) said to those around: "Did ye not listen (to what he says)?"
p: (Pharaoh) said unto those around him: Hear ye not?
t: qaala liman hawlahooo alaa tastami'oon

ar: قال ربكم ورب ءابائكم ٱلأولين
tr: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
y: (Moses) said: "Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers from the beginning!"
p: He said: Your Lord and the Lord of your fathers.
t: qaala rabbukum wa rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

ar: قال إن رسولكم ٱلذى أرسل إليكم لمجنون
tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
y: (Pharaoh) said: "Truly your messenger who has been sent to you is a veritable madman!"
p: (Pharaoh) said: Lo! your messenger who hath been sent unto you is indeed a madman!
t: qaala inna rasoolakumul lazee ursila ilaikum lamajnoon

ar: قال رب ٱلمشرق وٱلمغرب وما بينهما إن كنتم تعقلون
tr: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
y: (Moses) said: "Lord of the East and the West, and all between! if ye only had sense!"
p: He said: Lord of the East and the West and all that is between them, if ye did but understand.
t: qaala rabbul mashriqi wal maghribi wa maa baina humaa in kuntum ta'qiloon

ar: قال لئن ٱتخذت إلها غيرى لأجعلنك من ٱلمسجونين
tr: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
y: (Pharaoh) said: "If thou dost put forward any god other than me, I will certainly put thee in prison!"
p: (Pharaoh) said: If thou choosest a god other than me, I assuredly shall place thee among the prisoners.
t: qaala la'init takhazta ilaahan ghairee la aj'alannaka minal masjooneen

ar: قال أولو جئتك بشىء مبين
tr: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
y: (Moses) said: "Even if I showed you something clear (and) convincing?"
p: He said: Even though I show thee something plain?
t: qaala awalw ji'tuka bishai'im mubeen

ar: قال فأت به إن كنت من ٱلصدقين
tr: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
y: (Pharaoh) said: "Show it then, if thou tellest the truth!"
p: (Pharaoh) said: Produce it then, if thou art of the truthful!
t: qaala faati biheee in kunta minas saadiqeen

ar: فألقى عصاه فإذا هى ثعبان مبين
tr: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
y: So (Moses) threw his rod, and behold, it was a serpent, plain (for all to see)!
p: Then he flung down his staff and it became a serpent manifest,
t: fa alqaa 'asaahu fa izaaa hiya su'baanum mubeen

ar: ونزع يده فإذا هى بيضاء للنظرين
tr: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
y: And he drew out his hand, and behold, it was white to all beholders!
p: And he drew forth his hand and lo! it was white to the beholders.
t: wa naza'a yadahoo faizaa hiya baidaaa'u linnaa zireen

ar: قال للملإ حوله إن هذا لسحر عليم
tr: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
y: (Pharaoh) said to the Chiefs around him: "This is indeed a sorcerer well-versed:
p: (Pharaoh) said unto the chiefs about him: Lo! this is verily a knowing wizard,
t: qaala lilmala-i hawlahooo inna haazaa lasaahirun 'aleem

ar: يريد أن يخرجكم من أرضكم بسحره فماذا تأمرون
tr: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
y: "His plan is to get you out of your land by his sorcery; then what is it ye counsel?"
p: Who would drive you out of your land by his magic. Now what counsel ye?
t: yureedu ai yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihee famaazaa taamuroon

ar: قالوا أرجه وأخاه وٱبعث فى ٱلمدائن حشرين
tr: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
y: They said: "Keep him and his brother in suspense (for a while), and dispatch to the Cities heralds to collect-
p: They said: Put him off, (him) and his brother, and send into the cities summoners
t: qaalooo arjih wa akhaahu wab'as filmadaaa'ini haashireen

ar: يأتوك بكل سحار عليم
tr: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
y: "And bring up to thee all (our) sorcerers well-versed."
p: Who shall bring unto thee every knowing wizard.
t: yaatooka bikulli sah haarin 'aleem

ar: فجمع ٱلسحرة لميقت يوم معلوم
tr: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
y: So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known,
p: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.
t: fa jumi'as saharatu limeeqaati yawmim ma'loom

ar: وقيل للناس هل أنتم مجتمعون
tr: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
y: And the people were told: "Are ye (now) assembled?-
p: And it was said unto the people: Are ye (also) gathering?
t: wa qeela linnaasi hal antum mujtami'oon

ar: لعلنا نتبع ٱلسحرة إن كانوا هم ٱلغلبين
tr: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
y: "That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win?"
p: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.
t: la'allanaa nattabi'us saharata in kaanoo humul ghaalibeen

ar: فلما جاء ٱلسحرة قالوا لفرعون أئن لنا لأجرا إن كنا نحن ٱلغلبين
tr: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
y: So when the sorcerers arrived, they said to Pharaoh: "Of course - shall we have a (suitable) reward if we win?
p: And when the wizards came they said unto Pharaoh: Will there surely be a reward for us if we are the winners?
t: falammaa jaaa'as saharatu qaaloo li fir'awna a'inna lanaa la ajjran in kunnaa nahnul ghaalibeen

ar: قال نعم وإنكم إذا لمن ٱلمقربين
tr: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
y: He said: "Yea, (and more),- for ye shall in that case be (raised to posts) nearest (to my person)."
p: He said: Aye, and ye will then surely be of those brought near (to me).
t: qaala na'am wa innakum izal laminal muqarrabeen

ar: قال لهم موسى ألقوا ما أنتم ملقون
tr: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
y: Moses said to them: "Throw ye - that which ye are about to throw!"
p: Moses said unto them: Throw what ye are going to throw!
t: qaala lahum moosaaa alqoo maaa antum mulqoon

ar: فألقوا حبالهم وعصيهم وقالوا بعزة فرعون إنا لنحن ٱلغلبون
tr: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
y: So they threw their ropes and their rods, and said: "By the might of Pharaoh, it is we who will certainly win!"
p: Then they threw down their cords and their staves and said: By Pharaoh's might, lo! we verily are the winners.
t: fa alqaw hibaalahum wa 'isiyyahum wa qaaloo bi'izzati fir'awna innaa lanahnul ghaaliboon

ar: فألقى موسى عصاه فإذا هى تلقف ما يأفكون
tr: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
y: Then Moses threw his rod, when, behold, it straightway swallows up all the falsehoods which they fake!
p: Then Moses threw his staff and lo! it swallowed that which they did falsely show.
t: fa alqaa moosaa 'asaahu fa izaa hiya talqafu maa yaafikoon

ar: فألقى ٱلسحرة سجدين
tr: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
y: Then did the sorcerers fall down, prostrate in adoration,
p: And the wizards were flung prostrate,
t: fa ulqiyas saharatu saajideen

ar: قالوا ءامنا برب ٱلعلمين
tr: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
y: Saying: "We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
p: Crying: We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
t: qaalooo aamannaa bi rabbil 'aalameen

ar: رب موسى وهرون
tr: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
y: "The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
p: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.
t: rabbi moosaa wa haaroon

ar: قال ءامنتم له قبل أن ءاذن لكم إنه لكبيركم ٱلذى علمكم ٱلسحر فلسوف تعلمون لأقطعن أيديكم وأرجلكم من خلف ولأصلبنكم أجمعين
tr: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
y: Said (Pharaoh): "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? surely he is your leader, who has taught you sorcery! but soon shall ye know! Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross!"
p: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.
t: qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aazana lakum innahoo lakabeerukumul lazee 'alla makumus sihra falasawfa ta'lamoon; la uqatti'anna aidiyakum wa arjulakum min khilaafinw wa la usallibanna kum ajma'een

ar: قالوا لا ضير إنا إلى ربنا منقلبون
tr: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
y: They said: "No matter! for us, we shall but return to our Lord!
p: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.
t: qaaloo la daira innaaa ilaa rabbinaa munqalliboon

ar: إنا نطمع أن يغفر لنا ربنا خطينا أن كنا أول ٱلمؤمنين
tr: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
y: "Only, our desire is that our Lord will forgive us our faults, that we may become foremost among the believers!"
p: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.
t: innaa natma'u ai yaghfira lanaa rabbunna khataa yaanaaa an kunnaaa awwalal mu'mineen

ar: وأوحينا إلى موسى أن أسر بعبادى إنكم متبعون
tr: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
y: By inspiration we told Moses: "Travel by night with my servants; for surely ye shall be pursued."
p: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.
t: wa awhainaaa ilaa moosaaa an asri bi'ibaadeee innakum muttaba'oon

ar: فأرسل فرعون فى ٱلمدائن حشرين
tr: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
y: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to (all) the Cities,
p: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,
t: fa arsala fir'awnu filmadaaa'ini haashireen

ar: إن هؤلاء لشرذمة قليلون
tr: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
y: (Saying): "These (Israelites) are but a small band,
p: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,
t: inna haaa'ulaaa'i lashir zimatun qaleeloon

ar: وإنهم لنا لغائظون
tr: And indeed, they are enraging us,
y: "And they are raging furiously against us;
p: And lo! they are offenders against us.
t: wa innahum lanaa laghaaa'izoon

ar: وإنا لجميع حذرون
tr: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
y: "But we are a multitude amply fore-warned."
p: And lo! we are a ready host.
t: wa innaa lajamee'un haaziroon

ar: فأخرجنهم من جنت وعيون
tr: So We removed them from gardens and springs
y: So We expelled them from gardens, springs,
p: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,
t: fa akhrajnaahum min jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ar: وكنوز ومقام كريم
tr: And treasures and honorable station -
y: Treasures, and every kind of honourable position;
p: And treasures and a fair estate.
t: wa kunoozinw wa ma qaamin kareem

ar: كذلك وأورثنها بنى إسرءيل
tr: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
y: Thus it was, but We made the Children of Israel inheritors of such things.
p: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.
t: kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa baneee israaa'eel

ar: فأتبعوهم مشرقين
tr: So they pursued them at sunrise.
y: So they pursued them at sunrise.
p: And they overtook them at sunrise.
t: fa atba'oohum mushriqeen

ar: فلما ترءا ٱلجمعان قال أصحب موسى إنا لمدركون
tr: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
y: And when the two bodies saw each other, the people of Moses said: "We are sure to be overtaken."
p: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.
t: falammaa taraaa'al jam'aani qaala as haabu moosaaa innaa lamudrakoon

ar: قال كلا إن معى ربى سيهدين
tr: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
y: (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me!"
p: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
t: qaala kallaaa inna ma'iya rabbee sa yahdeen

ar: فأوحينا إلى موسى أن ٱضرب بعصاك ٱلبحر فٱنفلق فكان كل فرق كٱلطود ٱلعظيم
tr: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
y: Then We told Moses by inspiration: "Strike the sea with thy rod." So it divided, and each separate part became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain.
p: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.
t: fa awhainaaa ilaa moosaaa anidrib bi'asaakal bahra fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kattawdil 'azeem

ar: وأزلفنا ثم ٱلءاخرين
tr: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
y: And We made the other party approach thither.
p: Then brought We near the others to that place.
t: wa azlafnaa sammal aakhareen

ar: وأنجينا موسى ومن معه أجمعين
tr: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
y: We delivered Moses and all who were with him;
p: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;
t: wa anjainaa moosaa wa mam ma'ahooo ajma'een

ar: ثم أغرقنا ٱلءاخرين
tr: Then We drowned the others.
y: But We drowned the others.
p: And We drowned the others.
t: summa aghraqnal aakhareen

ar: إن فى ذلك لءاية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
y: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
p: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
t: inna fee zaalika la aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaru hu mu'mineen

ar: وإن ربك لهو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
p: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa inna rabbaka la huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: وٱتل عليهم نبأ إبرهيم
tr: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
y: And rehearse to them (something of) Abraham's story.
p: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:
t: watlu 'alaihim naba-a ibraaheem

ar: إذ قال لأبيه وقومه ما تعبدون
tr: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
y: Behold, he said to his father and his people: "What worship ye?"
p: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?
t: iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maa ta'budoon

ar: قالوا نعبد أصناما فنظل لها عكفين
tr: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
y: They said: "We worship idols, and we remain constantly in attendance on them."
p: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.
t: qaaloo na'budu asnaaman fanazallu lahaa 'aakifeen

ar: قال هل يسمعونكم إذ تدعون
tr: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
y: He said: "Do they listen to you when ye call (on them)?"
p: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?
t: qaala hal yasma'oona kum iz tad'oon

ar: أو ينفعونكم أو يضرون
tr: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
y: "Or do you good or harm?"
p: Or do they benefit or harm you?
t: aw yanfa'oonakum aw yadurroon

ar: قالوا بل وجدنا ءاباءنا كذلك يفعلون
tr: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
y: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing thus (what we do)."
p: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.
t: qaaloo bal wajadnaaa aabaaa 'anaa kazaalika yaf'aloon

ar: قال أفرءيتم ما كنتم تعبدون
tr: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
y: He said: "Do ye then see whom ye have been worshipping,-
p: He said: See now that which ye worship,
t: qaala afara 'aitum maa kuntum ta'budoon

ar: أنتم وءاباؤكم ٱلأقدمون
tr: You and your ancient forefathers?
y: "Ye and your fathers before you?-
p: Ye and your forefathers!
t: antum wa aabaaa'ukumul aqdamoon

ar: فإنهم عدو لى إلا رب ٱلعلمين
tr: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
y: "For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds;
p: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,
t: fa innahum 'aduwwwul leee illaa rabbal 'aalameen

ar: ٱلذى خلقنى فهو يهدين
tr: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
y: "Who created me, and it is He Who guides me;
p: Who created me, and He doth guide me,
t: allazee khalaqanee fa huwa yahdeen

ar: وٱلذى هو يطعمنى ويسقين
tr: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
y: "Who gives me food and drink,
p: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.
t: wallazee huwa yut'imunee wa yasqeen

ar: وإذا مرضت فهو يشفين
tr: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
y: "And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me;
p: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,
t: wa izaa mardtu fahuwa yashfeen

ar: وٱلذى يميتنى ثم يحيين
tr: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
y: "Who will cause me to die, and then to life (again);
p: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),
t: wallazee yumeetunee summa yuhyeen

ar: وٱلذى أطمع أن يغفر لى خطيـتى يوم ٱلدين
tr: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
y: "And who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the day of Judgment.
p: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.
t: wallazeee atma'u ai yaghfira lee khateee' atee yawmad deen

ar: رب هب لى حكما وألحقنى بٱلصلحين
tr: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
y: "O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous;
p: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.
t: rabbi hab lee hukmanw wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen

ar: وٱجعل لى لسان صدق فى ٱلءاخرين
tr: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
y: "Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations);
p: And give unto me a good report in later generations.
t: waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen

ar: وٱجعلنى من ورثة جنة ٱلنعيم
tr: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
y: "Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss;
p: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,
t: waj'alnee minw warasati jannnatin na'eem

ar: وٱغفر لأبى إنه كان من ٱلضالين
tr: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
y: "Forgive my father, for that he is among those astray;
p: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.
t: waghfir li abeee innahoo kaana mind daalleen

ar: ولا تخزنى يوم يبعثون
tr: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
y: "And let me not be in disgrace on the Day when (men) will be raised up;-
p: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,
t: wa laa tukhzinee yawma yub'asoon

ar: يوم لا ينفع مال ولا بنون
tr: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
y: "The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,
p: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)
t: yawma laa yanfa'u maalunw wa laa banoon

ar: إلا من أتى ٱلله بقلب سليم
tr: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
y: "But only he (will prosper) that brings to Allah a sound heart;
p: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.
t: illaa man atal laaha biqalbin saleem

ar: وأزلفت ٱلجنة للمتقين
tr: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
y: "To the righteous, the Garden will be brought near,
p: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).
t: wa uzlifatil jannatu lilmuttaqeen

ar: وبرزت ٱلجحيم للغاوين
tr: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
y: "And to those straying in Evil, the Fire will be placed in full view;
p: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.
t: wa burrizatil jaheemu lilghaaween

ar: وقيل لهم أين ما كنتم تعبدون
tr: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
y: "And it shall be said to them: 'Where are the (gods) ye worshipped-
p: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship
t: wa qeela lahum aina maa kuntum ta'budoon

ar: من دون ٱلله هل ينصرونكم أو ينتصرون
tr: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
y: "'Besides Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?'
p: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?
t: min doonil laahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroon

ar: فكبكبوا فيها هم وٱلغاون
tr: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
y: "Then they will be thrown headlong into the (Fire),- they and those straying in Evil,
p: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers
t: fakubkiboo feehaa hum walghaawoon

ar: وجنود إبليس أجمعون
tr: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
y: "And the whole hosts of Iblis together.
p: And the hosts of Iblis, together.
t: wa junoodu ibleesa ajma'oon

ar: قالوا وهم فيها يختصمون
tr: They will say while they dispute therein,
y: "They will say there in their mutual bickerings:
p: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:
t: qaaloo wa hum feehaa yakkhtasimoon

ar: تٱلله إن كنا لفى ضلل مبين
tr: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
y: "'By Allah, we were truly in an error manifest,
p: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
t: tallaahi in kunnaa lafee dalaalim mubeen

ar: إذ نسويكم برب ٱلعلمين
tr: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
y: "'When we held you as equals with the Lord of the Worlds;
p: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
t: iz nusawweekum bi rabbil 'aalameen

ar: وما أضلنا إلا ٱلمجرمون
tr: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
y: "'And our seducers were only those who were steeped in guilt.
p: It was but the guilty who misled us.
t: wa maaa adallanaaa illal mujrimoon

ar: فما لنا من شفعين
tr: So now we have no intercessors
y: "'Now, then, we have none to intercede (for us),
p: Now we have no intercessors
t: famaa lanaa min shaa fi'een

ar: ولا صديق حميم
tr: And not a devoted friend.
y: "'Nor a single friend to feel (for us).
p: Nor any loving friend.
t: wa laa sadeeqin hameem

ar: فلو أن لنا كرة فنكون من ٱلمؤمنين
tr: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
y: "'Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe!'"
p: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!
t: falaw anna lanaa karratan fanakoona minal mu'mineen

ar: إن فى ذلك لءاية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
y: Verily in this is a Sign but most of them do not believe.
p: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!
t: inna fee zaalika la aayatanw wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ar: وإن ربك لهو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
p: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa inna rabbaka la huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: كذبت قوم نوح ٱلمرسلين
tr: The people of Noah denied the messengers
y: The people of Noah rejected the messengers.
p: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),
t: kazzabat qawmu noohinil mursaleen

ar: إذ قال لهم أخوهم نوح ألا تتقون
tr: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
y: Behold, their brother Noah said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
p: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t: iz qaala lahum akhoohum noohun alaa tattaqoon

ar: إنى لكم رسول أمين
tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
y: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:
p: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
t: innee lakum rasoolun ameen

ar: فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
y: "So fear Allah, and obey me.
p: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
t: fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

ar: وما أسـلكم عليه من أجر إن أجرى إلا على رب ٱلعلمين
tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
y: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds:
p: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
t: wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil 'aalameen

ar: فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: So fear Allah and obey me."
y: "So fear Allah, and obey me."
p: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
t: fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ar: قالوا أنؤمن لك وٱتبعك ٱلأرذلون
tr: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
y: They said: "Shall we believe in thee when it is the meanest that follow thee?"
p: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?
t: qaalooo anu'minu laka wattaba 'akal arzaloon

ar: قال وما علمى بما كانوا يعملون
tr: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
y: He said: "And what do I know as to what they do?
p: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?
t: qaala wa maa 'ilmee bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

ar: إن حسابهم إلا على ربى لو تشعرون
tr: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
y: "Their account is only with my Lord, if ye could (but) understand.
p: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;
t: in hisaabuhum illaa 'alaa rabbee law tash'uroon

ar: وما أنا بطارد ٱلمؤمنين
tr: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
y: "I am not one to drive away those who believe.
p: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.
t: wa maaa ana bitaaridil mu'mineen

ar: إن أنا إلا نذير مبين
tr: I am only a clear warner."
y: "I am sent only to warn plainly in public."
p: I am only a plain warner.
t: in ana illaa nazeerum mubeen

ar: قالوا لئن لم تنته ينوح لتكونن من ٱلمرجومين
tr: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
y: They said: "If thou desist not, O Noah! thou shalt be stoned (to death)."
p: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).
t: qaaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa noohu latakoonanna minal marjoomeen

ar: قال رب إن قومى كذبون
tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
y: He said: "O my Lord! truly my people have rejected me.
p: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.
t: qaala rabbi inna qawmee kazzaboon

ar: فٱفتح بينى وبينهم فتحا ونجنى ومن معى من ٱلمؤمنين
tr: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
y: "Judge Thou, then, between me and them openly, and deliver me and those of the Believers who are with me."
p: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.
t: faftab bainee wa bai nahum fat hanw wa najjinee wa mam ma'iya minal mu'mineen

ar: فأنجينه ومن معه فى ٱلفلك ٱلمشحون
tr: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
y: So We delivered him and those with him, in the Ark filled (with all creatures).
p: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
t: fa anjainaahu wa mamma'ahoo fil fulkil mashhoon

ar: ثم أغرقنا بعد ٱلباقين
tr: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
y: Thereafter We drowned those who remained behind.
p: Then afterward We drowned the others.
t: summa aghraqnaa ba'dul baaqeen

ar: إن فى ذلك لءاية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
y: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
p: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
t: inna fee zaalika la aayaah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ar: وإن ربك لهو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
p: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa inna rabbaka la huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: كذبت عاد ٱلمرسلين
tr: 'Aad denied the messengers
y: The 'Ad (people) rejected the messengers.
p: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).
t: kazzabat 'aadunil mursaleen

ar: إذ قال لهم أخوهم هود ألا تتقون
tr: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
y: Behold, their brother Hud said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
p: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t: iz qaala lahum akhoohum hoodun alaa tattaqoon

ar: إنى لكم رسول أمين
tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
y: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:
p: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
t: innee lakum rasoolun ameen

ar: فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
y: "So fear Allah and obey me.
p: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
t: fattaqullaaha wa atee'oon

ar: وما أسـلكم عليه من أجر إن أجرى إلا على رب ٱلعلمين
tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
y: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
p: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
t: wa maa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil 'aalameen

ar: أتبنون بكل ريع ءاية تعبثون
tr: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
y: "Do ye build a landmark on every high place to amuse yourselves?
p: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?
t: atabnoona bikulli ree'in aayatan ta'basoon

ar: وتتخذون مصانع لعلكم تخلدون
tr: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
y: "And do ye get for yourselves fine buildings in the hope of living therein (for ever)?
p: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever?
t: wa tattakhizoona masaani'a la'allakum takhludoon

ar: وإذا بطشتم بطشتم جبارين
tr: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
y: "And when ye exert your strong hand, do ye do it like men of absolute power?
p: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?
t: wa izaa batashtum batashtum jabbaareen

ar: فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
y: "Now fear Allah, and obey me.
p: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
t: fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ar: وٱتقوا ٱلذى أمدكم بما تعلمون
tr: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
y: "Yea, fear Him Who has bestowed on you freely all that ye know.
p: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,
t: wattaqul lazeee amad dakum bimaa ta'lamoon

ar: أمدكم بأنعم وبنين
tr: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
y: "Freely has He bestowed on you cattle and sons,-
p: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.
t: amaddakum bi an'aa minw wa baneen

ar: وجنت وعيون
tr: And gardens and springs.
y: "And Gardens and Springs.
p: And gardens and watersprings.
t: wa jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ar: إنى أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
tr: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
y: "Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Great Day."
p: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.
t: innee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem

ar: قالوا سواء علينا أوعظت أم لم تكن من ٱلوعظين
tr: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
y: They said: "It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or be not among (our) admonishers!
p: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;
t: qaaloo sawaaa'un 'alainaaa awa 'azta am lam takum minal waa'izeen

ar: إن هذا إلا خلق ٱلأولين
tr: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
y: "This is no other than a customary device of the ancients,
p: This is but a fable of the men of old,
t: in haazaaa illaa khuluqul awwaleen

ar: وما نحن بمعذبين
tr: And we are not to be punished."
y: "And we are not the ones to receive Pains and Penalties!"
p: And we shall not be doomed.
t: wa maa nahnu bimu 'azzabeen

ar: فكذبوه فأهلكنهم إن فى ذلك لءاية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
tr: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
y: So they rejected him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
p: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
t: fakazzaboohu fa ahlaknaahum; inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ar: وإن ربك لهو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
p: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa inna rabbaka la huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: كذبت ثمود ٱلمرسلين
tr: Thamud denied the messengers
y: The Thamud (people) rejected the messengers.
p: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)
t: kazzabat samoodul mursaleen

ar: إذ قال لهم أخوهم صلح ألا تتقون
tr: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
y: Behold, their brother Salih said to them: "Will you not fear (Allah)?
p: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t: iz qaala lahum akhoohum saalihun alaa tattaqoon

ar: إنى لكم رسول أمين
tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
y: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
p: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
t: innee lakum rasoolun ameen

ar: فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
y: "So fear Allah, and obey me.
p: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
t: fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ar: وما أسـلكم عليه من أجر إن أجرى إلا على رب ٱلعلمين
tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
y: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
p: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
t: wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil 'aalameen

ar: أتتركون فى ما ههنا ءامنين
tr: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
y: "Will ye be left secure, in (the enjoyment of) all that ye have here?-
p: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,
t: atutrakoona fee maa haahunnaaa aamineen

ar: فى جنت وعيون
tr: Within gardens and springs
y: "Gardens and Springs,
p: In gardens and watersprings.
t: fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ar: وزروع ونخل طلعها هضيم
tr: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
y: "And corn-fields and date-palms with spathes near breaking (with the weight of fruit)?
p: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,
t: wa zuroo inw wa nakhlin tal 'uhaa hadeem

ar: وتنحتون من ٱلجبال بيوتا فرهين
tr: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
y: "And ye carve houses out of (rocky) mountains with great skill.
p: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?
t: wa tanhitoona minal jibaali buyootan faariheen

ar: فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
y: "But fear Allah and obey me;
p: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,
t: fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ar: ولا تطيعوا أمر ٱلمسرفين
tr: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
y: "And follow not the bidding of those who are extravagant,-
p: And obey not the command of the prodigal,
t: wa laa tutee'ooo amral musrifeen

ar: ٱلذين يفسدون فى ٱلأرض ولا يصلحون
tr: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
y: "Who make mischief in the land, and mend not (their ways)."
p: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.
t: allazeena yufsidoona fil ardi wa laa yuslihoon

ar: قالوا إنما أنت من ٱلمسحرين
tr: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
y: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
p: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
t: qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

ar: ما أنت إلا بشر مثلنا فأت بـاية إن كنت من ٱلصدقين
tr: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
y: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us: then bring us a Sign, if thou tellest the truth!"
p: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.
t: maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa faati bi aayatin in kunta minas saadiqeen

ar: قال هذه ناقة لها شرب ولكم شرب يوم معلوم
tr: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
y: He said: "Here is a she-camel: she has a right of watering, and ye have a right of watering, (severally) on a day appointed.
p: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.
t: qaala haazihee naaqatul lahaa shirbunw w alakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom

ar: ولا تمسوها بسوء فيأخذكم عذاب يوم عظيم
tr: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
y: "Touch her not with harm, lest the Penalty of a Great Day seize you."
p: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.
t: wa laa tamassoohaa bisooo'in fa yaakhuzakum 'azaabu yawmin 'azeem

ar: فعقروها فأصبحوا ندمين
tr: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
y: But they ham-strung her: then did they become full of regrets.
p: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.
t: fa'aqaroohaa fa asbahoo naadimeen

ar: فأخذهم ٱلعذاب إن فى ذلك لءاية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
tr: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
y: But the Penalty seized them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
p: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
t: fa akhazahumul 'azaab; inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum m'mineen

ar: وإن ربك لهو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
p: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa inna rabbaka la huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: كذبت قوم لوط ٱلمرسلين
tr: The people of Lot denied the messengers
y: The people of Lut rejected the messengers.
p: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),
t: kazzabat qawmu lootinil mursaleen

ar: إذ قال لهم أخوهم لوط ألا تتقون
tr: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
y: Behold, their brother Lut said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
p: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t: iz qaala lahum akhoohum lootun alaa tattaqoon

ar: إنى لكم رسول أمين
tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
y: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
p: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
t: innee lakum rasoolun ameen

ar: فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
y: "So fear Allah and obey me.
p: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
t: fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ar: وما أسـلكم عليه من أجر إن أجرى إلا على رب ٱلعلمين
tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
y: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the lord of the Worlds.
p: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
t: wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil 'aalameen

ar: أتأتون ٱلذكران من ٱلعلمين
tr: Do you approach males among the worlds
y: "Of all the creatures in the world, will ye approach males,
p: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males,
t: ataatoonaz zukraana minal 'aalameen

ar: وتذرون ما خلق لكم ربكم من أزوجكم بل أنتم قوم عادون
tr: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
y: "And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your mates? Nay, ye are a people transgressing (all limits)!"
p: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk.
t: wa tazaroona maa khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwaajikum; bal antum qawmun 'aadoon

ar: قالوا لئن لم تنته يلوط لتكونن من ٱلمخرجين
tr: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
y: They said: "If thou desist not, O Lut! thou wilt assuredly be cast out!"
p: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast.
t: qaloo la'il lam tantahi yaa lootu latakoonanna minal mukhrajeen

ar: قال إنى لعملكم من ٱلقالين
tr: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
y: He said: "I do detest your doings."
p: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct.
t: qaala innee li'amalikum minal qaaleen

ar: رب نجنى وأهلى مما يعملون
tr: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
y: "O my Lord! deliver me and my family from such things as they do!"
p: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.
t: rabbi najjjinee wa ahlee mimmmaa ya'maloon

ar: فنجينه وأهله أجمعين
tr: So We saved him and his family, all,
y: So We delivered him and his family,- all
p: So We saved him and his household, every one,
t: fanajjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een

ar: إلا عجوزا فى ٱلغبرين
tr: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
y: Except an old woman who lingered behind.
p: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.
t: illaa 'ajoozan filghaabireen

ar: ثم دمرنا ٱلءاخرين
tr: Then We destroyed the others.
y: But the rest We destroyed utterly.
p: Then afterward We destroyed the others.
t: summa dammarnal aa khareen

ar: وأمطرنا عليهم مطرا فساء مطر ٱلمنذرين
tr: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
y: We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)!
p: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.
t: wa amtarnaa 'alaihim mataran fasaaa'a matarul munzareen

ar: إن فى ذلك لءاية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
y: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
p: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
t: inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ar: وإن ربك لهو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might Most Merciful.
p: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa inna rabbaka la huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: كذب أصحب لـيكة ٱلمرسلين
tr: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
y: The Companions of the Wood rejected the messengers.
p: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),
t: kazzaba as haabul aykatil mursaleen

ar: إذ قال لهم شعيب ألا تتقون
tr: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
y: Behold, Shu'aib said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
p: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t: iz qaala lahum shu'aybun alaa tattaqoon

ar: إنى لكم رسول أمين
tr: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
y: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
p: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
t: innee lakum rasoolun ameen

ar: فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: So fear Allah and obey me.
y: "So fear Allah and obey me.
p: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
t: fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ar: وما أسـلكم عليه من أجر إن أجرى إلا على رب ٱلعلمين
tr: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
y: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
p: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
t: wa maaa as'alukum 'alaihi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil 'aalameen

ar: أوفوا ٱلكيل ولا تكونوا من ٱلمخسرين
tr: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
y: "Give just measure, and cause no loss (to others by fraud).
p: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).
t: awful kaila wa laa takoonoo minal mukhsireen

ar: وزنوا بٱلقسطاس ٱلمستقيم
tr: And weigh with an even balance.
y: "And weigh with scales true and upright.
p: And weigh with the true balance.
t: wa zinoo bilqistaasil mustaqeem

ar: ولا تبخسوا ٱلناس أشياءهم ولا تعثوا فى ٱلأرض مفسدين
tr: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
y: "And withhold not things justly due to men, nor do evil in the land, working mischief.
p: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.
t: wa laa tabkhasun naasa ashyaaa 'ahum wa laa ta'saw fil ardi mufsideen

ar: وٱتقوا ٱلذى خلقكم وٱلجبلة ٱلأولين
tr: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
y: "And fear Him Who created you and (who created) the generations before (you)"
p: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.
t: wattaqul lazee khalaqakum waljibillatal awwaleen

ar: قالوا إنما أنت من ٱلمسحرين
tr: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
y: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
p: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
t: qaalooo innamaa anta minal musahhareen

ar: وما أنت إلا بشر مثلنا وإن نظنك لمن ٱلكذبين
tr: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
y: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us, and indeed we think thou art a liar!
p: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.
t: wa maaa anta illaa basharum mislunaa wa innazunnuka laminal kaazibeen

ar: فأسقط علينا كسفا من ٱلسماء إن كنت من ٱلصدقين
tr: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
y: "Now cause a piece of the sky to fall on us, if thou art truthful!"
p: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.
t: fa asqit 'alainaa kisafam minas samaaa'i in kunta minas saadiqeen

ar: قال ربى أعلم بما تعملون
tr: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
y: He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do."
p: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.
t: qaala rabbeee a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon

ar: فكذبوه فأخذهم عذاب يوم ٱلظلة إنه كان عذاب يوم عظيم
tr: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
y: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day.
p: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.
t: fakazzaboohu fa akhazahum 'azaabu yawmiz zullah; innahoo kaana 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem

ar: إن فى ذلك لءاية وما كان أكثرهم مؤمنين
tr: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
y: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
p: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
t: inna fee zaalika la aayah; wa maa kaana aksaruhum mu'mineen

ar: وإن ربك لهو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
p: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa inna rabbaka la huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: وإنه لتنزيل رب ٱلعلمين
tr: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
y: Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds:
p: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
t: wa innahoo latanzeelu rabbil 'aalameen

ar: نزل به ٱلروح ٱلأمين
tr: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
y: With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth-
p: Which the True Spirit hath brought down
t: nazala bihir roohul ameen

ar: على قلبك لتكون من ٱلمنذرين
tr: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
y: To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish.
p: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
t: 'alaa qalbika litakoona minal munzireen

ar: بلسان عربى مبين
tr: In a clear Arabic language.
y: In the perspicuous Arabic tongue.
p: In plain Arabic speech.
t: bilisaanin 'arabiyyim mubeen

ar: وإنه لفى زبر ٱلأولين
tr: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
y: Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples.
p: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.
t: wa innahoo lafee zuburil awwaleen

ar: أولم يكن لهم ءاية أن يعلمه علمؤا بنى إسرءيل
tr: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
y: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
p: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?
t: awalam yakul lahum aayatan ai ya'lamahoo 'ulamaaa'u baneee israaa'eel

ar: ولو نزلنه على بعض ٱلأعجمين
tr: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
y: Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs,
p: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,
t: wa law nazzalnaahu 'alaa ba'dil a'jameen

ar: فقرأه عليهم ما كانوا به مؤمنين
tr: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
y: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
p: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
t: faqara ahoo 'alaihim maa kaanoo bihee mu'mineen

ar: كذلك سلكنه فى قلوب ٱلمجرمين
tr: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
y: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners.
p: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
t: kazaalika salaknaahu fee quloobil mujrimeen

ar: لا يؤمنون به حتى يروا ٱلعذاب ٱلأليم
tr: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
y: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty;
p: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,
t: laa yu'minoona bihee hattaa yarawul 'azaabal aleem

ar: فيأتيهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
tr: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
y: But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
p: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
t: fayaatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon

ar: فيقولوا هل نحن منظرون
tr: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
y: Then they will say: "Shall we be respited?"
p: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
t: fa yaqooloo hal nahnu munzaroon

ar: أفبعذابنا يستعجلون
tr: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
y: Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on?
p: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?
t: aafabi 'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon

ar: أفرءيت إن متعنهم سنين
tr: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
y: Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years,
p: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,
t: aara'aita im matta'naahum sineen

ar: ثم جاءهم ما كانوا يوعدون
tr: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
y: Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised!
p: And then cometh that which they were promised,
t: summa jaaa'ahum maa kaanoo yoo'adoon

ar: ما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يمتعون
tr: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
y: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)!
p: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?
t: maaa aghnaaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yumaatoo'oon

ar: وما أهلكنا من قرية إلا لها منذرون
tr: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
y: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners -
p: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
t: wa maaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa munziroon

ar: ذكرى وما كنا ظلمين
tr: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
y: By way of reminder; and We never are unjust.
p: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.
t: zikraa wa maa kunnaa zaalimeen

ar: وما تنزلت به ٱلشيطين
tr: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
y: No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation):
p: The devils did not bring it down.
t: wa maa tanazzalat bihish shayaateen

ar: وما ينبغى لهم وما يستطيعون
tr: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
y: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it).
p: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
t: wa maa yambaghee lahum wa maa yastatee'oon

ar: إنهم عن ٱلسمع لمعزولون
tr: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
y: Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it.
p: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.
t: innahum 'anis sam'i lama'zooloon

ar: فلا تدع مع ٱلله إلها ءاخر فتكون من ٱلمعذبين
tr: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
y: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty.
p: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.
t: falaa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal mu'azzabeen

ar: وأنذر عشيرتك ٱلأقربين
tr: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
y: And admonish thy nearest kinsmen,
p: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,
t: wa anzir 'asheeratakal aqrabeen

ar: وٱخفض جناحك لمن ٱتبعك من ٱلمؤمنين
tr: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
y: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee.
p: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.
t: wakhfid janaahaka limanit taba 'aka minal mu'mineen

ar: فإن عصوك فقل إنى برىء مما تعملون
tr: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
y: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"
p: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
t: fa in asawka faqul innee bareee'um mimmmaa ta'maloon

ar: وتوكل على ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
y: And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,-
p: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: wa tawakkal alal 'azeezir raheem

ar: ٱلذى يرىك حين تقوم
tr: Who sees you when you arise
y: Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer),
p: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
t: allazee yaraaka heena taqoom

ar: وتقلبك فى ٱلسجدين
tr: And your movement among those who prostrate.
y: And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves,
p: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).
t: wa taqallubaka fis saajideen

ar: إنه هو ٱلسميع ٱلعليم
tr: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
y: For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things.
p: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.
t: innahoo huwas samee'ul 'aleem

ar: هل أنبئكم على من تنزل ٱلشيطين
tr: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
y: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend?
p: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
t: hal unabbi'ukum 'alaa man tanazzalush shayaateen

ar: تنزل على كل أفاك أثيم
tr: They descend upon every sinful liar.
y: They descend on every lying, wicked person,
p: They descend on every sinful, false one.
t: tanazzalu 'alaa kulli affaakin aseem

ar: يلقون ٱلسمع وأكثرهم كذبون
tr: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
y: (Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars.
p: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
t: yulqoonas sam'a wa aksaruhum aaziboon

ar: وٱلشعراء يتبعهم ٱلغاون
tr: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
y: And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them:
p: As for poets, the erring follow them.
t: washshu 'araaa'u yattabi 'uhumul ghaawoon

ar: ألم تر أنهم فى كل واد يهيمون
tr: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
y: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley?-
p: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,
t: alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiny yaheemoon

ar: وأنهم يقولون ما لا يفعلون
tr: And that they say what they do not do? -
y: And that they say what they practise not?-
p: And how they say that which they do not?
t: wa annahum yaqooloona ma laa yaf'aloon

ar: إلا ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت وذكروا ٱلله كثيرا وٱنتصروا من بعد ما ظلموا وسيعلم ٱلذين ظلموا أى منقلب ينقلبون
tr: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
y: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take!
p: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
t: illal lazeena aamanoo w a'amilus saalihaati wa zakarul laaha kaseeranw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo; wa saya'lamul lazeena zalamooo aiya munqalbiny yanqaliboon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم طس تلك ءايت ٱلقرءان وكتاب مبين
tr: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book
y: These are verses of the Qur'an,-a book that makes (things) clear;
p: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;
t: taa-seeen; tilka aayaatul qur-aani wa kitaabim mubeen

ar: هدى وبشرى للمؤمنين
tr: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
y: A guide: and glad tidings for the believers,-
p: A guidance and good tidings for believers
t: hudanw wa bushraa lil mu'mineen

ar: ٱلذين يقيمون ٱلصلوة ويؤتون ٱلزكوة وهم بٱلءاخرة هم يوقنون
tr: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
y: Those who establish regular prayers and give in regular charity, and also have (full) assurance of the hereafter.
p: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.
t: allazeena yuqeemoonas salaata wa yu'toonaz zakaata wa hum bil aakhirati hum yooqinoon

ar: إن ٱلذين لا يؤمنون بٱلءاخرة زينا لهم أعملهم فهم يعمهون
tr: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
y: As to those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds pleasing in their eyes; and so they wander about in distraction.
p: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray.
t: innal lazeena laa yu'mimoona bil aakhirati zaiyannaa lahum a'maalahum fahum ya'mahoon

ar: أولئك ٱلذين لهم سوء ٱلعذاب وهم فى ٱلءاخرة هم ٱلأخسرون
tr: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
y: Such are they for whom a grievous Penalty is (waiting); and in the Hereafter theirs will be the greatest loss.
p: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
t: ulaaa'ikal lazeena lahum sooo'ul 'azaabi wa hum fil aakhirati humul akhsaroon

ar: وإنك لتلقى ٱلقرءان من لدن حكيم عليم
tr: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.
y: As to thee, the Qur'an is bestowed upon thee from the presence of one who is wise and all-knowing.
p: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.
t: wa innaka latulaqqal qur-aana mil ladun hakeemin 'aleem

ar: إذ قال موسى لأهله إنى ءانست نارا سـاتيكم منها بخبر أو ءاتيكم بشهاب قبس لعلكم تصطلون
tr: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
y: Behold! Moses said to his family: "I perceive a fire; soon will I bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand to light our fuel, that ye may warm yourselves.
p: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.
t: iz qaala moosaa li ahliheee inneee aanastu naaran saaateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw aateekum bishihaabin qabasil la'allakum tastaloon

ar: فلما جاءها نودى أن بورك من فى ٱلنار ومن حولها وسبحن ٱلله رب ٱلعلمين
tr: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
y: But when he came to the (fire), a voice was heard: "Blessed are those in the fire and those around: and glory to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
p: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
t: falammaa jaaa'ahaa noodiya am boorika man finnnnaari wa man hawlahaa wa subhaanal laahi rabbil 'aalameen

ar: يموسى إنه أنا ٱلله ٱلعزيز ٱلحكيم
tr: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
y: "O Moses! verily, I am Allah, the exalted in might, the wise!....
p: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
t: yaa moosaaa innahooo anal laahul 'azeezul hakeem

ar: وألق عصاك فلما رءاها تهتز كأنها جان ولى مدبرا ولم يعقب يموسى لا تخف إنى لا يخاف لدى ٱلمرسلون
tr: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
y: "Now do thou throw thy rod!" But when he saw it moving (of its own accord) as if it had been a snake, he turned back in retreat, and retraced not his steps: "O Moses!" (it was said), "Fear not: truly, in My presence, those called as messengers have no fear,-
p: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence,
t: wa alqi 'asaak; falammmaa ra aahaa tahtazzu ka annahaa jaaannunw wallaa mudbiranw wa lam yu'aqqib; yaa moosaa laa takhaf innee laa yakhaafu ladaiyal mursaloon

ar: إلا من ظلم ثم بدل حسنا بعد سوء فإنى غفور رحيم
tr: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
y: "But if any have done wrong and have thereafter substituted good to take the place of evil, truly, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
p: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful.
t: illaa man zalama summa baddala husnam ba'da sooo'in fa innee ghafoorur raheem

ar: وأدخل يدك فى جيبك تخرج بيضاء من غير سوء فى تسع ءايت إلى فرعون وقومه إنهم كانوا قوما فسقين
tr: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
y: "Now put thy hand into thy bosom, and it will come forth white without stain (or harm): (these are) among the nine Signs (thou wilt take) to Pharaoh and his people: for they are a people rebellious in transgression."
