tr: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
y: And the sun runs his course for a period determined for him: that is the decree of (Him), the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing.
p: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
t: wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'azeezil aleem

ar: وٱلقمر قدرنه منازل حتى عاد كٱلعرجون ٱلقديم
tr: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
y: And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk.
p: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
t: walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem

ar: لا ٱلشمس ينبغى لها أن تدرك ٱلقمر ولا ٱليل سابق ٱلنهار وكل فى فلك يسبحون
tr: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
y: It is not permitted to the Sun to catch up the Moon, nor can the Night outstrip the Day: Each (just) swims along in (its own) orbit (according to Law).
p: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
t: lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon

ar: وءاية لهم أنا حملنا ذريتهم فى ٱلفلك ٱلمشحون
tr: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
y: And a Sign for them is that We bore their race (through the Flood) in the loaded Ark;
p: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,
t: wa aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon

ar: وخلقنا لهم من مثله ما يركبون
tr: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
y: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride.
p: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
t: wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon

ar: وإن نشأ نغرقهم فلا صريخ لهم ولا هم ينقذون
tr: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
y: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered,
p: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
t: wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon

ar: إلا رحمة منا ومتعا إلى حين
tr: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
y: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time.
p: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
t: illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen

ar: وإذا قيل لهم ٱتقوا ما بين أيديكم وما خلفكم لعلكم ترحمون
tr: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
y: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back).
p: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
t: wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon

ar: وما تأتيهم من ءاية من ءايت ربهم إلا كانوا عنها معرضين
tr: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
y: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom.
p: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!
t: wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen

ar: وإذا قيل لهم أنفقوا مما رزقكم ٱلله قال ٱلذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا أنطعم من لو يشاء ٱلله أطعمه إن أنتم إلا فى ضلل مبين
tr: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
y: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which Allah has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if Allah had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error."
p: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
t: wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen

ar: ويقولون متى هذا ٱلوعد إن كنتم صدقين
tr: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
y: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true?"
p: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?
t: wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen

ar: ما ينظرون إلا صيحة وحدة تأخذهم وهم يخصمون
tr: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
y: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!
p: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.
t: maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon

ar: فلا يستطيعون توصية ولا إلى أهلهم يرجعون
tr: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
y: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!
p: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
t: falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon

ar: ونفخ فى ٱلصور فإذا هم من ٱلأجداث إلى ربهم ينسلون
tr: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
y: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
p: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
t: wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa rabbihim yansiloon

ar: قالوا يويلنا من بعثنا من مرقدنا هذا ما وعد ٱلرحمن وصدق ٱلمرسلون
tr: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
y: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"
p: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
t: qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon

ar: إن كانت إلا صيحة وحدة فإذا هم جميع لدينا محضرون
tr: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
y: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!
p: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!
t: in kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon

ar: فٱليوم لا تظلم نفس شيـا ولا تجزون إلا ما كنتم تعملون
tr: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
y: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.
p: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.
t: fal-yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

ar: إن أصحب ٱلجنة ٱليوم فى شغل فكهون
tr: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
y: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
p: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,
t: inna ashaabal jannatil yawma fee shughulin faakihoon

ar: هم وأزوجهم فى ظلل على ٱلأرائك متكـون
tr: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
y: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);
p: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;
t: hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon

ar: لهم فيها فكهة ولهم ما يدعون
tr: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
y: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;
p: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
t: lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon

ar: سلم قولا من رب رحيم
tr: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
y: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
p: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
t: salaamun qawlam mir rabbir raheem

ar: وٱمتزوا ٱليوم أيها ٱلمجرمون
tr: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
y: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!
p: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
t: wamtaazul yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon

ar: ألم أعهد إليكم يبنى ءادم أن لا تعبدوا ٱلشيطن إنه لكم عدو مبين
tr: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
y: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-
p: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
t: alam a'had ilaikum yaa baneee aadama al-laa ta'budush shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen

ar: وأن ٱعبدونى هذا صرط مستقيم
tr: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
y: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?
p: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.
t: wa ani'budoonee; haazaa siraatum mustaqeem

ar: ولقد أضل منكم جبلا كثيرا أفلم تكونوا تعقلون
tr: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
y: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?
p: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?
t: wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon

ar: هذه جهنم ٱلتى كنتم توعدون
tr: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
y: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
p: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
t: haazihee jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon

ar: ٱصلوها ٱليوم بما كنتم تكفرون
tr: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
y: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."
p: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
t: islawhal yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon

ar: ٱليوم نختم على أفوههم وتكلمنا أيديهم وتشهد أرجلهم بما كانوا يكسبون
tr: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
y: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
p: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
t: al-yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon

ar: ولو نشاء لطمسنا على أعينهم فٱستبقوا ٱلصرط فأنى يبصرون
tr: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
y: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?
p: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?
t: wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon

ar: ولو نشاء لمسخنهم على مكانتهم فما ٱستطعوا مضيا ولا يرجعون
tr: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
y: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).
p: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
t: wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon

ar: ومن نعمره ننكسه فى ٱلخلق أفلا يعقلون
tr: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
y: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
p: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?
t: wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon

ar: وما علمنه ٱلشعر وما ينبغى له إن هو إلا ذكر وقرءان مبين
tr: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
y: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear:
p: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
t: wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa qur-aanum mubeen

ar: لينذر من كان حيا ويحق ٱلقول على ٱلكفرين
tr: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
y: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).
p: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
t: liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen

ar: أولم يروا أنا خلقنا لهم مما عملت أيدينا أنعما فهم لها ملكون
tr: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
y: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-
p: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,
t: awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon

ar: وذللنها لهم فمنها ركوبهم ومنها يأكلون
tr: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
y: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:
p: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?
t: wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon

ar: ولهم فيها منفع ومشارب أفلا يشكرون
tr: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
y: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
p: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?
t: wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon

ar: وٱتخذوا من دون ٱلله ءالهة لعلهم ينصرون
tr: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
y: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped!
p: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
t: wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon

ar: لا يستطيعون نصرهم وهم لهم جند محضرون
tr: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
y: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).
p: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.
t: laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon

ar: فلا يحزنك قولهم إنا نعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون
tr: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
y: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.
p: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
t: falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon

ar: أولم ير ٱلإنسن أنا خلقنه من نطفة فإذا هو خصيم مبين
tr: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
y: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!
p: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
t: awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen

ar: وضرب لنا مثلا ونسى خلقه قال من يحى ٱلعظم وهى رميم
tr: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
y: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"
p: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
t: wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem

ar: قل يحييها ٱلذى أنشأها أول مرة وهو بكل خلق عليم
tr: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
y: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-
p: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
t: qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa huwa bikulli khalqin 'aleem

ar: ٱلذى جعل لكم من ٱلشجر ٱلأخضر نارا فإذا أنتم منه توقدون
tr: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
y: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!
p: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
t: allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon

ar: أوليس ٱلذى خلق ٱلسموت وٱلأرض بقدر على أن يخلق مثلهم بلى وهو ٱلخلق ٱلعليم
tr: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
y: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!
p: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,
t: awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa huwal khallaaqul 'aleem

ar: إنما أمره إذا أراد شيـا أن يقول له كن فيكون
tr: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
y: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!
p: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
t: innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon

ar: فسبحن ٱلذى بيده ملكوت كل شىء وإليه ترجعون
tr: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
y: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.
p: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.
t: fa subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلصفت صفا
tr: By those [angels] lined up in rows
y: By those who range themselves in ranks,
p: By those who set the ranks in battle order
t: wassaaaffaati saffaa

ar: فٱلزجرت زجرا
tr: And those who drive [the clouds]
y: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
p: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
t: fazzaajiraati zajraa

ar: فٱلتليت ذكرا
tr: And those who recite the message,
y: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!
p: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
t: fattaaliyaati zikra

ar: إن إلهكم لوحد
tr: Indeed, your God is One,
y: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-
p: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
t: inna illaahakum la waahid

ar: رب ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما ورب ٱلمشرق
tr: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
y: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
p: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.
t: rabbus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa rabbul mashaariq

ar: إنا زينا ٱلسماء ٱلدنيا بزينة ٱلكواكب
tr: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
y: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
p: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
t: innaa zaiyannas samaaa 'ad dunyaa bizeenatinil kawaakib

ar: وحفظا من كل شيطن مارد
tr: And as protection against every rebellious devil
y: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
p: With security from every froward devil.
t: wa hifzam min kulli shaitaanim maarid

ar: لا يسمعون إلى ٱلملإ ٱلأعلى ويقذفون من كل جانب
tr: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
y: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
p: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
t: laa yassamma 'oona ilal mala il a'alaa wa yuqzafoona min kulli jaanib

ar: دحورا ولهم عذاب واصب
tr: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
y: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
p: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
t: duhooranw wa lahum 'azaabunw waasib

ar: إلا من خطف ٱلخطفة فأتبعه شهاب ثاقب
tr: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
y: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
p: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
t: illaa man khatifal khatfata fa atba'ahoo shihaabun saaqib

ar: فٱستفتهم أهم أشد خلقا أم من خلقنا إنا خلقنهم من طين لازب
tr: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
y: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
p: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
t: fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnaa; innaa khalaqnaahum min teenil laazib

ar: بل عجبت ويسخرون
tr: But you wonder, while they mock,
y: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
p: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
t: bal'ajibta wa yaskharoon

ar: وإذا ذكروا لا يذكرون
tr: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
y: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
p: And heed not when they are reminded,
t: wa izaa zukkiroo laa yazkuroon

ar: وإذا رأوا ءاية يستسخرون
tr: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
y: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
p: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
t: wa izaa ra aw aayatinw yastaskhiroon

ar: وقالوا إن هذا إلا سحر مبين
tr: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
y: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
p: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
t: wa qaalooo in haazaa illaa sihrum mubeen

ar: أءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما أءنا لمبعوثون
tr: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
y: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
p: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
t: 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamab'oosoon

ar: أوءاباؤنا ٱلأولون
tr: And our forefathers [as well]?"
y: "And also our fathers of old?"
p: And our forefathers?
t: awa aabaa'unal awwaloon

ar: قل نعم وأنتم دخرون
tr: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
y: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
p: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
t: qul na'am wa antum daakhiroon

ar: فإنما هى زجرة وحدة فإذا هم ينظرون
tr: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
y: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
p: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
t: fa innamaa hiya zajra tunw waahidatun fa izaa hum yanzuroon

ar: وقالوا يويلنا هذا يوم ٱلدين
tr: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
y: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
p: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
t: qa qaaloo yaa wailanaa haazaa yawmud-deen

ar: هذا يوم ٱلفصل ٱلذى كنتم به تكذبون
tr: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
y: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
p: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
t: haazaa yawmul faslil lazee kuntum bihee tukaziboon

ar: ٱحشروا ٱلذين ظلموا وأزوجهم وما كانوا يعبدون
tr: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
y: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
p: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
t: uhshurul lazeena zalamoo wa azwaajahum wa maa kaanoo ya'budoon

ar: من دون ٱلله فٱهدوهم إلى صرط ٱلجحيم
tr: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
y: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
p: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
t: min doonil laahi fahdoohum ilaa siraatil jaheem

ar: وقفوهم إنهم مسـولون
tr: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
y: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
p: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
t: wa qifoohum innahum mas'ooloon

ar: ما لكم لا تناصرون
tr: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
y: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"
p: What aileth you that ye help not one another?
t: maa lakum laa tanaasaroon

ar: بل هم ٱليوم مستسلمون
tr: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
y: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
p: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
t: bal humul yawma mustaslimoon

ar: وأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون
tr: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
y: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
p: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
t: wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon

ar: قالوا إنكم كنتم تأتوننا عن ٱليمين
tr: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
y: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
p: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
t: qaalooo innakum kuntum taatoonanaa 'anil yameen

ar: قالوا بل لم تكونوا مؤمنين
tr: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
y: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
p: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
t: qaaloo bal lam takoonoo mu'mineen

ar: وما كان لنا عليكم من سلطن بل كنتم قوما طغين
tr: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
y: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
p: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
t: wa maa kaana lanaa 'alaikum min sultaanim bal kuntum qawman taagheen

ar: فحق علينا قول ربنا إنا لذائقون
tr: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
y: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
p: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
t: fahaqqa 'alainaa qawlu rabbinaaa innaa lazaaa'iqoon

ar: فأغوينكم إنا كنا غوين
tr: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
y: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
p: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
t: fa aghwainaakum innaa kunnaa ghaaween

ar: فإنهم يومئذ فى ٱلعذاب مشتركون
tr: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
y: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
p: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
t: fa innahum yawma'izin fil'azaabi mushtarikoon

ar: إنا كذلك نفعل بٱلمجرمين
tr: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
y: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
p: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
t: innaa kazaalika naf'alu bil mujrimeen

ar: إنهم كانوا إذا قيل لهم لا إله إلا ٱلله يستكبرون
tr: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
y: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,
p: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
t: innahum kaanooo izaa qeela lahum laaa ilaaha illal laahu yastakbiroon

ar: ويقولون أئنا لتاركوا ءالهتنا لشاعر مجنون
tr: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
y: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
p: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
t: wa yaqooloona a'innaa lataarikooo aalihatinaa lishaa'irim majnoon

ar: بل جاء بٱلحق وصدق ٱلمرسلين
tr: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
y: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).
p: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
t: bal jaaa'a bilhaqqi wa saddaqal mursaleen

ar: إنكم لذائقوا ٱلعذاب ٱلأليم
tr: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
y: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
p: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
t: innakum lazaaa'iqul 'azaabil aleem

ar: وما تجزون إلا ما كنتم تعملون
tr: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
y: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
p: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
t: wa maa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon

ar: إلا عباد ٱلله ٱلمخلصين
tr: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
y: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-
p: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;
t: illaa 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen

ar: أولئك لهم رزق معلوم
tr: Those will have a provision determined -
y: For them is a Sustenance determined,
p: For them there is a known provision,
t: ulaaa'ika lahum rizqum ma'loom

ar: فوكه وهم مكرمون
tr: Fruits; and they will be honored
y: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
p: Fruits. And they will be honoured
t: fa waakihu wa hum mukramoon

ar: فى جنت ٱلنعيم
tr: In gardens of pleasure
y: In Gardens of Felicity,
p: In the Gardens of delight,
t: fee jannaatin na'eem

ar: على سرر متقبلين
tr: On thrones facing one another.
y: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
p: On couches facing one another;
t: 'alaa sururim mutaqaa bileen

ar: يطاف عليهم بكأس من معين
tr: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
y: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
p: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
t: yutaafu 'alaihim bikaasim mim ma'een

ar: بيضاء لذة للشربين
tr: White and delicious to the drinkers;
y: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),
p: White, delicious to the drinkers,
t: baidaaa'a laz zatil lish shaaribeen

ar: لا فيها غول ولا هم عنها ينزفون
tr: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
y: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
p: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.
t: laa feehaa ghawlunw wa laa hum 'anhaa yunzafoon

ar: وعندهم قصرت ٱلطرف عين
tr: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
y: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).
p: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,
t: wa 'indahum qaasiraatut tarfi 'een

ar: كأنهن بيض مكنون
tr: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
y: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.
p: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).
t: ka annahunna baidum maknoon

ar: فأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون
tr: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
y: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.
p: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
t: fa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa badiny yatasaaa 'aloon

ar: قال قائل منهم إنى كان لى قرين
tr: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
y: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),
p: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
t: qaala qaaa'ilum minhum innee kaana lee qareen

ar: يقول أءنك لمن ٱلمصدقين
tr: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
y: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?
p: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?
t: yaqoolu a'innnaka laminal musaddiqeen

ar: أءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما أءنا لمدينون
tr: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
y: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"
p: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
t: 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa 'izaaman 'ainnaa lamadeenoon

ar: قال هل أنتم مطلعون
tr: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
y: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"
p: He saith: Will ye look?
t: qaala hal antum muttali'oon

ar: فٱطلع فرءاه فى سواء ٱلجحيم
tr: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
y: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
p: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
t: fattala'a fara aahu fee sawaaa'il jaheem

ar: قال تٱلله إن كدت لتردين
tr: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.
y: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!
p: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
t: qaala tallaahi in kitta laturdeen

ar: ولولا نعمة ربى لكنت من ٱلمحضرين
tr: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
y: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!
p: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).
t: wa law laa ni'matu rabbee lakuntu minal muhdareen

ar: أفما نحن بميتين
tr: Then, are we not to die
y: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,
p: Are we then not to die
t: afamaa nahnu bimaiyiteen

ar: إلا موتتنا ٱلأولى وما نحن بمعذبين
tr: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
y: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"
p: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?
t: illa mawtatanal oola wa maa nahnu bimu'azzabeen

ar: إن هذا لهو ٱلفوز ٱلعظيم
tr: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
y: Verily this is the supreme achievement!
p: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.
t: inna haazaa falya'ma lil'aamiloon

ar: لمثل هذا فليعمل ٱلعملون
tr: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
y: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.
p: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
t: limisli haaza falya'ma lil 'aamiloon

ar: أذلك خير نزلا أم شجرة ٱلزقوم
tr: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
y: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?
p: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?
t: azaalika khairun nuzulan am shajaratuz zaqqom

ar: إنا جعلنها فتنة للظلمين
tr: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
y: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.
p: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.
t: innaa ja'alnaahaa fitnatal lizzaalimeen

ar: إنها شجرة تخرج فى أصل ٱلجحيم
tr: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
y: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:
p: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
t: innahaa shajaratun takhruju feee aslil jaheem

ar: طلعها كأنه رءوس ٱلشيطين
tr: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
y: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:
p: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils
t: tal'uhaa ka annahoo ru'oosush shayaateen

ar: فإنهم لءاكلون منها فمالـون منها ٱلبطون
tr: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
y: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
p: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.
t: fa innahum la aakiloona minhaa famaali'oona minhal butoon

ar: ثم إن لهم عليها لشوبا من حميم
tr: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
y: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.
p: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
t: summa inna lahum 'alaihaa lashawbam min hameem

ar: ثم إن مرجعهم لإلى ٱلجحيم
tr: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
y: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.
p: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
t: summa inna marji'ahum la ilal jaheem

ar: إنهم ألفوا ءاباءهم ضالين
tr: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
y: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;
p: They indeed found their fathers astray,
t: innahum alfaw aabaaa'ahum daaalleen

ar: فهم على ءاثرهم يهرعون
tr: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
y: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!
p: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
t: fahum 'alaa aasaarihim yuhra'oon

ar: ولقد ضل قبلهم أكثر ٱلأولين
tr: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
y: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-
p: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
t: wa laqad dalla qablahum aksarul awwaleen

ar: ولقد أرسلنا فيهم منذرين
tr: And We had already sent among them warners.
y: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-
p: And verily We sent among them warners.
t: wa laqad arsalnaa feehim munzireen

ar: فٱنظر كيف كان عقبة ٱلمنذرين
tr: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
y: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-
p: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,
t: fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul munzareen

ar: إلا عباد ٱلله ٱلمخلصين
tr: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
y: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.
p: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
t: illaa 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen

ar: ولقد نادىنا نوح فلنعم ٱلمجيبون
tr: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
y: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.
p: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
t: wa laqad naadaanaa noohun falani'mal mujeeboon

ar: ونجينه وأهله من ٱلكرب ٱلعظيم
tr: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
y: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,
p: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
t: wa jajainaahu wa ahlahoo minal karbil 'azeem

ar: وجعلنا ذريته هم ٱلباقين
tr: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
y: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);
p: And made his seed the survivors,
t: wa ja'alnaa zurriyyatahoo hummul baaqeen

ar: وتركنا عليه فى ٱلءاخرين
tr: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
y: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:
p: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
t: wa taraknaa 'alaihi fil aakhireen

ar: سلم على نوح فى ٱلعلمين
tr: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
y: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"
p: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
t: salaamun 'alaa noohin fil 'aalameen

ar: إنا كذلك نجزى ٱلمحسنين
tr: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
y: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.
p: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
t: innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

ar: إنه من عبادنا ٱلمؤمنين
tr: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
y: For he was one of our believing Servants.
p: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
t: innahoo min 'ibaadinal mu'mineen

ar: ثم أغرقنا ٱلءاخرين
tr: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
y: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.
p: Then We did drown the others.
t: summa aghraqnal aakhareen

ar: وإن من شيعته لإبرهيم
tr: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
y: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.
p: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
t: wa ina min shee'atihee la ibraaheem

ar: إذ جاء ربه بقلب سليم
tr: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
y: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.
p: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;
t: iz jaaa'a rabbahoo bi qalbin saleem

ar: إذ قال لأبيه وقومه ماذا تعبدون
tr: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
y: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?
p: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
t: iz qaala li abeehi wa qawmihee maazaa ta'budoon

ar: أئفكا ءالهة دون ٱلله تريدون
tr: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
y: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?
p: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?
t: a'ifkan aalihatan doonal laahi tureedoon

ar: فما ظنكم برب ٱلعلمين
tr: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
y: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"
p: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
t: famaa zannukum bi rabbil'aalameen

ar: فنظر نظرة فى ٱلنجوم
tr: And he cast a look at the stars
y: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.
p: And he glanced a glance at the stars
t: fanazara nazratan finnujoom

ar: فقال إنى سقيم
tr: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
y: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"
p: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
t: faqaala inee saqeem

ar: فتولوا عنه مدبرين
tr: So they turned away from him, departing.
y: So they turned away from him, and departed.
p: And they turned their backs and went away from him.
t: fatawallaw 'anhu mudbireen

ar: فراغ إلى ءالهتهم فقال ألا تأكلون
tr: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
y: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...
p: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
t: faraagha ilaaa aalihatihim faqaala alaa taakuloon

ar: ما لكم لا تنطقون
tr: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
y: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"
p: What aileth you that ye speak not?
t: maa lakum laa tantiqoon

ar: فراغ عليهم ضربا بٱليمين
tr: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
y: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.
p: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.
t: faraagha 'alaihim darbam bilyameen

ar: فأقبلوا إليه يزفون
tr: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
y: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).
p: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
t: fa aqbalooo ilaihi yaziffoon

ar: قال أتعبدون ما تنحتون
tr: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
y: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?
p: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
t: qaala ata'budoona maa tanhitoon

ar: وٱلله خلقكم وما تعملون
tr: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
y: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"
p: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?
t: wallaahu khalaqakum wa maa ta'maloon

ar: قالوا ٱبنوا له بنينا فألقوه فى ٱلجحيم
tr: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
y: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"
p: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
t: qaalub noo lahoo bun yaanan fa alqoohu fil jaheem

ar: فأرادوا به كيدا فجعلنهم ٱلأسفلين
tr: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
y: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!
p: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.
t: fa araadoo bihee kaidan faja 'alnaahumul asfaleen

ar: وقال إنى ذاهب إلى ربى سيهدين
tr: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
y: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!
p: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
t: wa qaala innee zaahibun ilaa rabbee sa yahdeen

ar: رب هب لى من ٱلصلحين
tr: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
y: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"
p: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.
t: rabbi hab lee minas saaliheen

ar: فبشرنه بغلم حليم
tr: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
y: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.
p: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.
t: fabashsharnaahu bighulaamin haleem

ar: فلما بلغ معه ٱلسعى قال يبنى إنى أرى فى ٱلمنام أنى أذبحك فٱنظر ماذا ترى قال يأبت ٱفعل ما تؤمر ستجدنى إن شاء ٱلله من ٱلصبرين
tr: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
y: Then, when (the son) reached (the age of) (serious) work with him, he said: "O my son! I see in vision that I offer thee in sacrifice: Now see what is thy view!" (The son) said: "O my father! Do as thou art commanded: thou will find me, if Allah so wills one practising Patience and Constancy!"
p: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.
t: falamma balagha ma'a hus sa'ya qaala yaa buniya inneee araa fil manaami anneee azbahuka fanzur maazaa taraa; qaala yaaa abatif 'al maa tu'maru satajidunee in shaaa'allaahu minas saabireen

ar: فلما أسلما وتله للجبين
tr: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
y: So when they had both submitted their wills (to Allah), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (for sacrifice),
p: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,
t: falammaaa aslamaa wa tallahoo liljabeen

ar: وندينه أن يإبرهيم
tr: We called to him, "O Abraham,
y: We called out to him "O Abraham!
p: We called unto him: O Abraham!
t: wa naadainaahu ai yaaaa ibraheem

ar: قد صدقت ٱلرءيا إنا كذلك نجزى ٱلمحسنين
tr: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
y: "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
p: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.
t: qad saddaqtar ru'yaa; innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

ar: إن هذا لهو ٱلبلؤا ٱلمبين
tr: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
y: For this was obviously a trial-
p: Lo! that verily was a clear test.
t: inna haazaa lahuwal balaaa'ul mubeen

ar: وفدينه بذبح عظيم
tr: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
y: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:
p: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.
t: wa fadainaahu bizibhin 'azeem

ar: وتركنا عليه فى ٱلءاخرين
tr: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
y: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
p: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
t: wa taraknaa 'alaihi fil aakhireen

ar: سلم على إبرهيم
tr: "Peace upon Abraham."
y: "Peace and salutation to Abraham!"
p: Peace be unto Abraham!
t: salaamun 'alaaa ibraaheem

ar: كذلك نجزى ٱلمحسنين
tr: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
y: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
p: Thus do We reward the good.
t: kazaalika najzil muhsineen

ar: إنه من عبادنا ٱلمؤمنين
tr: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
y: For he was one of our believing Servants.
p: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
t: innahoo min 'ibaadinal mu'mineen

ar: وبشرنه بإسحق نبيا من ٱلصلحين
tr: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
y: And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.
p: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.
t: wa bashsharnaahu bi ishaaqa nabiyayam minas saaliheen

ar: وبركنا عليه وعلى إسحق ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين
tr: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
y: We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.
p: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
t: wa baaraknaa 'alaihi wa 'alaaa ishaaq; wa min zurriyya tihimaa muhsinunw wa zaalimul linafshihee mubeen

ar: ولقد مننا على موسى وهرون
tr: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
y: Again (of old) We bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron,
p: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,
t: wa laqad mananna alaa moosaa wa haaroon

ar: ونجينهما وقومهما من ٱلكرب ٱلعظيم
tr: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
y: And We delivered them and their people from (their) Great Calamity;
p: And saved them and their people from the great distress,
t: wa najjainaahumaa wa qawmahumaa minal karbil 'azeem

ar: ونصرنهم فكانوا هم ٱلغلبين
tr: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
y: And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);
p: And helped them so that they became the victors.
t: wa nasarnaahum fakaanoo humul ghaalibeen

ar: وءاتينهما ٱلكتب ٱلمستبين
tr: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
y: And We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;
p: And We gave them the clear Scripture
t: wa aatainaahumal kitaabal mustabeen

ar: وهدينهما ٱلصرط ٱلمستقيم
tr: And We guided them on the straight path.
y: And We guided them to the Straight Way.
p: And showed them the right path.
t: wa hadainaahumus siraatal mustaqeem

ar: وتركنا عليهما فى ٱلءاخرين
tr: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
y: And We left (this blessing) for them among generations (to come) in later times:
p: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):
t: wa taraknaa 'alaihimaa fil aakhireen

ar: سلم على موسى وهرون
tr: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
y: "Peace and salutation to Moses and Aaron!"
p: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!
t: salaamun 'alaa moosaa wa haaroon

ar: إنا كذلك نجزى ٱلمحسنين
tr: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
y: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
p: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
t: innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

ar: إنهما من عبادنا ٱلمؤمنين
tr: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
y: For they were two of our believing Servants.
p: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.
t: innahumaa min 'ibaadinal mu'mineen

ar: وإن إلياس لمن ٱلمرسلين
tr: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
y: So also was Elias among those sent (by Us).
p: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),
t: wa inna ilyaasa laminal mursaleen

ar: إذ قال لقومه ألا تتقون
tr: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?
y: Behold, he said to his people, "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
p: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
t: iz qaala liqawmiheee alaa tattaqoon

ar: أتدعون بعلا وتذرون أحسن ٱلخلقين
tr: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
y: "Will ye call upon Baal and forsake the Best of Creators,-
p: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,
t: atad'oona ba'lanw wa tazaroona ahsanal khaaliqeen

ar: ٱلله ربكم ورب ءابائكم ٱلأولين
tr: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
y: "Allah, your Lord and Cherisher and the Lord and Cherisher of your fathers of old?"
p: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?
t: allaaha rabbakum wa rabba aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

ar: فكذبوه فإنهم لمحضرون
tr: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
y: But they rejected him, and they will certainly be called up (for punishment),-
p: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
t: fakazzaboohu fa inna hum lamuhdaroon

ar: إلا عباد ٱلله ٱلمخلصين
tr: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
y: Except the sincere and devoted Servants of Allah (among them).
p: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
t: illaa 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen

ar: وتركنا عليه فى ٱلءاخرين
tr: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
y: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
p: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
t: wa taraknaa 'alaihi fil aakhireen

ar: سلم على إل ياسين
tr: "Peace upon Elias."
y: "Peace and salutation to such as Elias!"
p: Peace be unto Elias!
t: salaamun 'alaaa ilyaaseen

ar: إنا كذلك نجزى ٱلمحسنين
tr: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
y: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
p: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
t: innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

ar: إنه من عبادنا ٱلمؤمنين
tr: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
y: For he was one of our believing Servants.
p: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.
t: innahoo min 'ibaadinal mu'mineen

ar: وإن لوطا لمن ٱلمرسلين
tr: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
y: So also was Lut among those sent (by Us).
p: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).
t: wa inna lootal laminal mursaleen

ar: إذ نجينه وأهله أجمعين
tr: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
y: Behold, We delivered him and his adherents, all
p: When We saved him and his household, every one,
t: iz najjainaahu wa ahlahooo ajma'een

ar: إلا عجوزا فى ٱلغبرين
tr: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
y: Except an old woman who was among those who lagged behind:
p: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;
t: illaa 'ajoozan fil ghaabireen

ar: ثم دمرنا ٱلءاخرين
tr: Then We destroyed the others.
y: Then We destroyed the rest.
p: Then We destroyed the others.
t: summa dammarnal aakhareen

ar: وإنكم لتمرون عليهم مصبحين
tr: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
y: Verily, ye pass by their (sites), by day-
p: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning
t: wa innakum latamurroona 'alaihim musbiheen

ar: وبٱليل أفلا تعقلون
tr: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
y: And by night: will ye not understand?
p: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?
t: wa billail; afalaa ta'qiloon

ar: وإن يونس لمن ٱلمرسلين
tr: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
y: So also was Jonah among those sent (by Us).
p: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
t: wa inna yoonusa laminal mursaleen

ar: إذ أبق إلى ٱلفلك ٱلمشحون
tr: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
y: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,
p: When he fled unto the laden ship,
t: iz abaqa ilal fulkil mash hoon

ar: فساهم فكان من ٱلمدحضين
tr: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
y: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:
p: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;
t: fasaahama fakaana minal mudhadeen

ar: فٱلتقمه ٱلحوت وهو مليم
tr: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
y: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.
p: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;
t: faltaqamahul hootu wa huwa muleem

ar: فلولا أنه كان من ٱلمسبحين
tr: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,
y: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,
p: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)
t: falaw laaa annahoo kaana minal musabbiheen

ar: للبث فى بطنه إلى يوم يبعثون
tr: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
y: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.
p: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;
t: lalabisa fee batniheee ilaa yawmi yub'asoon

ar: فنبذنه بٱلعراء وهو سقيم
tr: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
y: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,
p: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;
t: fanabaznaahu bil'araaa'i wa huwa saqeem

ar: وأنبتنا عليه شجرة من يقطين
tr: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
y: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.
p: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;
t: wa ambatnaa 'alaihi shajaratam mai yaqteen

ar: وأرسلنه إلى مائة ألف أو يزيدون
tr: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
y: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.
p: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
t: wa arsalnaahu ilaa mi'ati alfin aw yazeedoon

ar: فـامنوا فمتعنهم إلى حين
tr: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
y: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.
p: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.
t: fa aamanoo famatta' naahum ilaa heen

ar: فٱستفتهم ألربك ٱلبنات ولهم ٱلبنون
tr: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
y: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-
p: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?
t: fastaftihim ali rabbikal banaatu wa lahumul banoon

ar: أم خلقنا ٱلملئكة إنثا وهم شهدون
tr: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
y: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?
p: Or created We the angels females while they were present?
t: am khalaqnal malaaa'i kata inaasanw wa hm shaahidoon

ar: ألا إنهم من إفكهم ليقولون
tr: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
y: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,
p: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:
t: alaaa innahum min ifkihim la yaqooloon

ar: ولد ٱلله وإنهم لكذبون
tr: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
y: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!
p: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.
t: waladal laahu wa innhum lakaaziboon

ar: أصطفى ٱلبنات على ٱلبنين
tr: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
y: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?
p: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.
t: astafal banaati 'alal baneen

ar: ما لكم كيف تحكمون
tr: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
y: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
p: What aileth you? How judge ye?
t: maa lakum kaifa tahkumoon

ar: أفلا تذكرون
tr: Then will you not be reminded?
y: Will ye not then receive admonition?
p: Will ye not then reflect?
t: afalaa tazakkaroon

ar: أم لكم سلطن مبين
tr: Or do you have a clear authority?
y: Or have ye an authority manifest?
p: Or have ye a clear warrant?
t: am lakum sultaanum mubeen

ar: فأتوا بكتبكم إن كنتم صدقين
tr: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
y: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
p: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
t: faatoo bi kitaabikum in kuntum saadiqeen

ar: وجعلوا بينه وبين ٱلجنة نسبا ولقد علمت ٱلجنة إنهم لمحضرون
tr: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
y: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!
p: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
t: wa ja'aloo bainahoo wa bainal jinnati nasabaa; wa laqad 'alimatil jinnatu innahum lamuhdaroon

ar: سبحن ٱلله عما يصفون
tr: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
y: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!
p: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),
t: subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yasifoon

ar: إلا عباد ٱلله ٱلمخلصين
tr: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
y: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.
p: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
t: illaa 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen

ar: فإنكم وما تعبدون
tr: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
y: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-
p: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,
t: fa innakum wa maa ta'ubdoon

ar: ما أنتم عليه بفتنين
tr: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
y: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,
p: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.
t: maaa antum 'alaihi befaaatineen

ar: إلا من هو صال ٱلجحيم
tr: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
y: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!
p: Save him who is to burn in hell.
t: illaa man huwa saalil jaheem

ar: وما منا إلا له مقام معلوم
tr: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
y: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
p: There is not one of us but hath his known position.
t: wa maa minnasa illaa lahoo maqaamum ma'loom

ar: وإنا لنحن ٱلصافون
tr: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
y: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);
p: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,
t: wa innaa llanah nus saaffoon

ar: وإنا لنحن ٱلمسبحون
tr: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
y: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"
p: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
t: wa innaa lanah nul musabbihoon

ar: وإن كانوا ليقولون
tr: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
y: And there were those who said,
p: And indeed they used to say:
t: wa in kaanoo la yaqooloon

ar: لو أن عندنا ذكرا من ٱلأولين
tr: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
y: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,
p: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
t: law anna 'indana zikram minal awwaleen

ar: لكنا عباد ٱلله ٱلمخلصين
tr: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
y: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"
p: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.
t: lakunna 'ibaadal laahil mukhlaseen

ar: فكفروا به فسوف يعلمون
tr: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
y: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!
p: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.
t: fakafaroo bihee fasawfa ya'lamoon

ar: ولقد سبقت كلمتنا لعبادنا ٱلمرسلين
tr: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
y: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),
p: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
t: wa laqad sabaqat kalimatunaa li'ibaadinal mursa leen

ar: إنهم لهم ٱلمنصورون
tr: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
y: That they would certainly be assisted,
p: That they verily would be helped,
t: innaa hum lahumul mansooroon

ar: وإن جندنا لهم ٱلغلبون
tr: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
y: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
p: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
t: wa inna jundana lahumul ghaaliboon

ar: فتول عنهم حتى حين
tr: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
y: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
p: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,
t: fatawalla 'anhum hatta heen

ar: وأبصرهم فسوف يبصرون
tr: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
y: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
p: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
t: wa absirhum fasawfa yubsiroon

ar: أفبعذابنا يستعجلون
tr: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
y: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?
p: Would they hasten on Our doom?
t: afabi'azaabinaa yasta'jiloon

ar: فإذا نزل بساحتهم فساء صباح ٱلمنذرين
tr: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
y: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!
p: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.
t: fa izaa nazala bisaahatihim fasaaa'a sabaahul munzareen

ar: وتول عنهم حتى حين
tr: And leave them for a time.
y: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
p: Withdraw from them awhile
t: wa tawalla 'anhum hattaa heen

ar: وأبصر فسوف يبصرون
tr: And see, for they are going to see.
y: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
p: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
t: wa absir fasawfa yubsiroon

ar: سبحن ربك رب ٱلعزة عما يصفون
tr: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
y: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!
p: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
t: subhaana rabbika rabbil 'izzati 'amma yasifoon

ar: وسلم على ٱلمرسلين
tr: And peace upon the messengers.
y: And Peace on the messengers!
p: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
t: wa salaamun 'alalmursaleen

ar: وٱلحمد لله رب ٱلعلمين
tr: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
y: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
p: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
t: walhamdu lillaahi rabbil 'aalameen

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ص وٱلقرءان ذى ٱلذكر
tr: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
y: Sad: By the Qur'an, Full of Admonition: (This is the Truth).
p: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,
t: saaad; wal-qur-aani ziz zikr

ar: بل ٱلذين كفروا فى عزة وشقاق
tr: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
y: But the Unbelievers (are steeped) in self-glory and Separatism.
p: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.
t: balil lazeena kafaroo fee 'izzatilnw wa shiqaaq

ar: كم أهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
tr: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
y: How many generations before them did We destroy? In the end they cried (for mercy)- when there was no longer time for being saved!
p: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!
t: kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw wa laata heena manaas

ar: وعجبوا أن جاءهم منذر منهم وقال ٱلكفرون هذا سحر كذاب
tr: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
y: So they wonder that a Warner has come to them from among themselves! and the Unbelievers say, "This is a sorcerer telling lies!
p: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
t: wa 'ajibooo an jaaa'a hum munzirum minhum wa qaalal kaafiroona haazaa saahirun kazzaab

ar: أجعل ٱلءالهة إلها وحدا إن هذا لشىء عجاب
tr: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
y: "Has he made the gods (all) into one Allah? Truly this is a wonderful thing!"
p: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.
t: aja'alal aalihata ilaahanw waahidan inna haazaa lashai'un 'ujaab

ar: وٱنطلق ٱلملأ منهم أن ٱمشوا وٱصبروا على ءالهتكم إن هذا لشىء يراد
tr: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
y: And the leader among them go away (impatiently), (saying), "Walk ye away, and remain constant to your gods! For this is truly a thing designed (against you)!
p: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.
t: wantalaqal mala-u minhum anim shoo wasbiroo 'alaaa aalihatikum innna haazaa lashai 'uny yuraad

ar: ما سمعنا بهذا فى ٱلملة ٱلءاخرة إن هذا إلا ٱختلق
tr: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
y: "We never heard (the like) of this among the people of these latter days: this is nothing but a made-up tale!"
p: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.
t: maa sami'naa bihaazaa fil millatil aakhirati in haazaaa illakh tilaaq

ar: أءنزل عليه ٱلذكر من بيننا بل هم فى شك من ذكرى بل لما يذوقوا عذاب
tr: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
y: "What! has the Message been sent to him - (Of all persons) among us?"... but they are in doubt concerning My (Own) Message! Nay, they have not yet tasted My Punishment!
p: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.
t: 'a-unzila 'alaihiz zikru mim baininaa; bal hum fee shakkim min zikree bal lammaa yazooqoo 'azaab

ar: أم عندهم خزائن رحمة ربك ٱلعزيز ٱلوهاب
tr: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
y: Or have they the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord,- the Exalted in Power, the Grantor of Bounties without measure?
p: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?
t: am'indahum khazaaa 'inu rahmati rabbikal 'azeezil wahhab

ar: أم لهم ملك ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما فليرتقوا فى ٱلأسبب
tr: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
y: Or have they the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all between? If so, let them mount up with the ropes and means (to reach that end)!
p: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!
t: am lahum mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa falyartaqoo fil asbaab

ar: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من ٱلأحزاب
tr: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
y: But there - will be put to flight even a host of confederates.
p: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.
t: jundum maa hunaalika mahzoomum minal ahzaab

ar: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو ٱلأوتاد
tr: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
y: Before them (were many who) rejected messengers,- the people of Noah, and 'Ad, and Pharaoh, the Lord of Stakes,
p: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,
t: kazzabat qablahum qawmu lootinw-wa 'aadunw wa fir'awnu zul awtaad

ar: وثمود وقوم لوط وأصحب لـيكة أولئك ٱلأحزاب
tr: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
y: And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Companions of the Wood; - such were the Confederates.
p: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.
t: wa samoodu wa qawmu lootinw wa ashaabul 'aykah; ulaaa'ikal ahzaab

ar: إن كل إلا كذب ٱلرسل فحق عقاب
tr: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
y: Not one (of them) but rejected the messengers, but My punishment came justly and inevitably (on them).
p: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,
t: in kullun illaa kazzabar rusula fahaqqa 'iqaab

ar: وما ينظر هؤلاء إلا صيحة وحدة ما لها من فواق
tr: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
y: These (today) only wait for a single mighty Blast, which (when it comes) will brook no delay.
p: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.
t: wa maa yanzuru haaa ulaaa'i illaa saihatanw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq

ar: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم ٱلحساب
tr: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
y: They say: "Our Lord! hasten to us our sentence (even) before the Day of Account!"
p: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.
t: wa qaaloo rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla yawmil hisaab

ar: ٱصبر على ما يقولون وٱذكر عبدنا داود ذا ٱلأيد إنه أواب
tr: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
y: Have patience at what they say, and remember our servant David, the man of strength: for he ever turned (to Allah).
p: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
t: isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wazkur 'abdanaa daawooda zal aidi aidi innahooo awwaab

ar: إنا سخرنا ٱلجبال معه يسبحن بٱلعشى وٱلإشراق
tr: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
y: It was We that made the hills declare, in unison with him, Our Praises, at eventide and at break of day,
p: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,
t: innaa sakhkharnal jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil'ashaiyi wal ishraaq

ar: وٱلطير محشورة كل له أواب
tr: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
y: And the birds gathered (in assemblies): all with him did turn (to Allah).
p: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.
t: wattayra mahshoorah; kullul lahooo awwaab

ar: وشددنا ملكه وءاتينه ٱلحكمة وفصل ٱلخطاب
tr: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
y: We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment in speech and decision.
p: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
t: wa shadadnaa mulkahoo wa aatainaahul hikmata wa faslal khitaab

ar: وهل أتىك نبؤا ٱلخصم إذ تسوروا ٱلمحراب
tr: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
y: Has the Story of the Disputants reached thee? Behold, they climbed over the wall of the private chamber;
p: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;
t: wa hal ataaka naba'ul khasm; iz tasawwarul mihraab

ar: إذ دخلوا على داود ففزع منهم قالوا لا تخف خصمان بغى بعضنا على بعض فٱحكم بيننا بٱلحق ولا تشطط وٱهدنا إلى سواء ٱلصرط
tr: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
y: When they entered the presence of David, and he was terrified of them, they said: "Fear not: we are two disputants, one of whom has wronged the other: Decide now between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, but guide us to the even Path..
p: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.
t: iz dakhaloo 'alaa daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo la takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum bainanaaa bilhaqqi wa laa tushtit wahdinaaa ilaa sawaaa'is siraat

ar: إن هذا أخى له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولى نعجة وحدة فقال أكفلنيها وعزنى فى ٱلخطاب
tr: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
y: "This man is my brother: He has nine and ninety ewes, and I have (but) one: Yet he says, 'commit her to my care,' and is (moreover) harsh to me in speech."
p: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.
t: inna haazaaa akhee lahoo tis'unw wa tis'oona na'jatanw wa liya na'jatunw waahidah; faqaala akfilneeha wa 'azzanee filkhitaab

ar: قال لقد ظلمك بسؤال نعجتك إلى نعاجه وإن كثيرا من ٱلخلطاء ليبغى بعضهم على بعض إلا ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت وقليل ما هم وظن داود أنما فتنه فٱستغفر ربه وخر راكعا وأناب
tr: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].
y: (David) said: "He has undoubtedly wronged thee in demanding thy (single) ewe to be added to his (flock of) ewes: truly many are the partners (in business) who wrong each other: Not so do those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, and how few are they?"... and David gathered that We had tried him: he asked forgiveness of his Lord, fell down, bowing (in prostration), and turned (to Allah in repentance).
p: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.
t: qaala laqad zalamaka bisu 'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajihee wa inna kaseeram minal khulataaa'i la-yabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati wa qaleehum maa hum; wa zanna daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghrara rabbahoo wa kharra raaki'anw wa anaab

ar: فغفرنا له ذلك وإن له عندنا لزلفى وحسن مـاب
tr: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
y: So We forgave him this (lapse): he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful place of (Final) Return.
p: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.
t: faghafarnaa lahoo zaalik; wa inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma aab

ar: يداود إنا جعلنك خليفة فى ٱلأرض فٱحكم بين ٱلناس بٱلحق ولا تتبع ٱلهوى فيضلك عن سبيل ٱلله إن ٱلذين يضلون عن سبيل ٱلله لهم عذاب شديد بما نسوا يوم ٱلحساب
tr: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
y: O David!
