tr: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
y: We showed them Sign after Sign, each greater than its fellow, and We seized them with Punishment, in order that they might turn (to Us).
p: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.
t: wa maa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa wa akhaznaahum bil'azaabi la'allahum yarji'oon

ar: وقالوا يأيه ٱلساحر ٱدع لنا ربك بما عهد عندك إننا لمهتدون
tr: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
y: And they said, "O thou sorcerer! Invoke thy Lord for us according to His covenant with thee; for we shall truly accept guidance."
p: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
t: wa qaaloo yaaa ayyuhas saahirud'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka innanaa lamuhtadoon

ar: فلما كشفنا عنهم ٱلعذاب إذا هم ينكثون
tr: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
y: But when We removed the Penalty from them, behold, they broke their word.
p: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.
t: falammaa kashafnaa 'anhumul 'azaaba izaa hum yankusoon

ar: ونادى فرعون فى قومه قال يقوم أليس لى ملك مصر وهذه ٱلأنهر تجرى من تحتى أفلا تبصرون
tr: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
y: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Does not the dominion of Egypt belong to me, (witness) these streams flowing underneath my (palace)? What! see ye not then?
p: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?
t: wa naadaa fir'awnu fee qawmihee qaala yaa qawmi alaisa lee mulku misra wa haazihil anhaaru tajree min tahtee afalaa tubsiroon

ar: أم أنا خير من هذا ٱلذى هو مهين ولا يكاد يبين
tr: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
y: "Am I not better than this (Moses), who is a contemptible wretch and can scarcely express himself clearly?
p: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!
t: am ana khairum min haazal lazee huwa maheenunw wa laa yuakaadu yubeen

ar: فلولا ألقى عليه أسورة من ذهب أو جاء معه ٱلملئكة مقترنين
tr: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
y: "Then why are not gold bracelets bestowed on him, or (why) come (not) with him angels accompanying him in procession?"
p: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him?
t: falaw laa ulqiya 'alaihi aswiratum min zahabin awjaaa'a ma'ahul malaaa'ikatu muqtarineen

ar: فٱستخف قومه فأطاعوه إنهم كانوا قوما فسقين
tr: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].
y: Thus did he make fools of his people, and they obeyed him: truly were they a people rebellious (against Allah).
p: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.
t: fastakhaffa qawmahoo fa ataa'ooh; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen

ar: فلما ءاسفونا ٱنتقمنا منهم فأغرقنهم أجمعين
tr: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
y: When at length they provoked Us, We exacted retribution from them, and We drowned them all.
p: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.
t: falammaaa aasafoonan taqamnaa minhum fa aghraqnaahum ajma'een

ar: فجعلنهم سلفا ومثلا للءاخرين
tr: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
y: And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages.
p: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).
t: faja'alnaahum salafanw wa masalal lil aakhireen

ar: ولما ضرب ٱبن مريم مثلا إذا قومك منه يصدون
tr: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
y: When (Jesus) the son of Mary is held up as an example, behold, thy people raise a clamour thereat (in ridicule)!
p: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,
t: wa lammaa duribab nu maryama masalan izaa qawmu ka minhu yasidoon

ar: وقالوا ءألهتنا خير أم هو ما ضربوه لك إلا جدلا بل هم قوم خصمون
tr: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
y: And they say, "Are our gods best, or he?" This they set forth to thee, only by way of disputation: yea, they are a contentious people.
p: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.
t: wa qaalooo 'a-aalihatunaa khairun am hoo; maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalaa; balhum qawmun khasimoon

ar: إن هو إلا عبد أنعمنا عليه وجعلنه مثلا لبنى إسرءيل
tr: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
y: He was no more than a servant: We granted Our favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel.
p: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.
t: in huwa illaa 'abdun an'amnaa 'alaihi wa ja'alnaahu masalal li baneee israaa'eel

ar: ولو نشاء لجعلنا منكم ملئكة فى ٱلأرض يخلفون
tr: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
y: And if it were Our Will, We could make angels from amongst you, succeeding each other on the earth.
p: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.
t: wa law nashaaa'u laja'alnaa minkum malaaa'ikatan fil ardi yakhlufoon

ar: وإنه لعلم للساعة فلا تمترن بها وٱتبعون هذا صرط مستقيم
tr: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
y: And (Jesus) shall be a Sign (for the coming of) the Hour (of Judgment): therefore have no doubt about the (Hour), but follow ye Me: this is a Straight Way.
p: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.
t: wa innahoo la'ilmul lis saa'ati fala tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'oon; haazaa siraatum mustaqeem

ar: ولا يصدنكم ٱلشيطن إنه لكم عدو مبين
tr: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
y: Let not the Evil One hinder you: for he is to you an enemy avowed.
p: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
t: wa laa yasuddan nakumush shaitaanu innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen

ar: ولما جاء عيسى بٱلبينت قال قد جئتكم بٱلحكمة ولأبين لكم بعض ٱلذى تختلفون فيه فٱتقوا ٱلله وأطيعون
tr: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
y: When Jesus came with Clear Signs, he said: "Now have I come to you with Wisdom, and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which ye dispute: therefore fear Allah and obey me.
p: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
t: wa lammaa jaaa'a 'eesaa bilbaiyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil hikmati wa li-ubaiyina lakum ba'dal lazee takhtalifoona feehi fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon

ar: إن ٱلله هو ربى وربكم فٱعبدوه هذا صرط مستقيم
tr: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
y: "For Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way."
p: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
t: innal laaha huwa rabbee wa rabbukum fa'budooh; haaza siraatum mustaqeem

ar: فٱختلف ٱلأحزاب من بينهم فويل للذين ظلموا من عذاب يوم أليم
tr: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
y: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day!
p: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.
t: fakhtalafal ahzaabu mim bainihim fawailul lillazeena zalamoo min 'azaabi yawmin aleem

ar: هل ينظرون إلا ٱلساعة أن تأتيهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
tr: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
y: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not?
p: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?
t: hal yanzuroona illas saa'ata an taatiyahum baghtatanw wa hum laa yash'uroon

ar: ٱلأخلاء يومئذ بعضهم لبعض عدو إلا ٱلمتقين
tr: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
y: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous.
p: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).
t: al akhillaaa'u yawma'izim ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illal muttaqeen

ar: يعباد لا خوف عليكم ٱليوم ولا أنتم تحزنون
tr: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
y: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve,-
p: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;
t: yaa 'ibaadi laa khawfun 'alaikumul yawma wa laaa antum tahzanoon

ar: ٱلذين ءامنوا بـايتنا وكانوا مسلمين
tr: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
y: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam.
p: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,
t: allazeena aamanoo bi aayaatinaa wa kaanoo muslimeen

ar: ٱدخلوا ٱلجنة أنتم وأزوجكم تحبرون
tr: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
y: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
p: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.
t: udkhulul jannata antum wa azwaajukum tuhbaroon

ar: يطاف عليهم بصحاف من ذهب وأكواب وفيها ما تشتهيه ٱلأنفس وتلذ ٱلأعين وأنتم فيها خلدون
tr: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
y: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their eyes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye).
p: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
t: yutaafu 'alaihim bishaa fim min zahabinw wa akwaab, wa feehaa maatashtaheehil anfusu wa talazzul a'yunu wa antum feehaa khaalidoon

ar: وتلك ٱلجنة ٱلتى أورثتموها بما كنتم تعملون
tr: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
y: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
p: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.
t: wa tilkal jannatul lateee ooristumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

ar: لكم فيها فكهة كثيرة منها تأكلون
tr: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
y: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction.
p: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.
t: lakum feehaa faakihatun kaseeratum minhaa taakuloon

ar: إن ٱلمجرمين فى عذاب جهنم خلدون
tr: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
y: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye):
p: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.
t: innal mujrimeena fee 'azaabi jahannama khaalidoon

ar: لا يفتر عنهم وهم فيه مبلسون
tr: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
y: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed.
p: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.
t: laa yufattaru 'anhum wa hum feehi mublisoon

ar: وما ظلمنهم ولكن كانوا هم ٱلظلمين
tr: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
y: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves.
p: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.
t: wa maa zalamnaahum wa laakin kaanoo humuz zaalimeen

ar: ونادوا يملك ليقض علينا ربك قال إنكم مكثون
tr: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
y: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide!"
p: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
t: wa naadaw yaa maaliku liyaqdi 'alainaa rabbuka qaala innakum maakisson

ar: لقد جئنكم بٱلحق ولكن أكثركم للحق كرهون
tr: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
y: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth.
p: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.
t: laqad ji'naakum bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarakum lilhaqqi kaarihoon

ar: أم أبرموا أمرا فإنا مبرمون
tr: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
y: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things.
p: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.
t: am abramooo amran fainnaa mubrimoon

ar: أم يحسبون أنا لا نسمع سرهم ونجوىهم بلى ورسلنا لديهم يكتبون
tr: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
y: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record.
p: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.
t: am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum wa najwaahum; balaa wa rusulunaa ladaihim yaktuboon

ar: قل إن كان للرحمن ولد فأنا أول ٱلعبدين
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
y: Say: "If (Allah) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship."
p: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).
t: qul in kaana lir rahmaani walad; fa-ana awwalul 'aabideen

ar: سبحن رب ٱلسموت وٱلأرض رب ٱلعرش عما يصفون
tr: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
y: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
p: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
t: subhaana rabbis samaawaati wal ardi rabbil arshi 'ammaa yasifoon

ar: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلقوا يومهم ٱلذى يوعدون
tr: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
y: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
p: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.
t: fazarhum yakhoodoo wa yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee yoo'adoon

ar: وهو ٱلذى فى ٱلسماء إله وفى ٱلأرض إله وهو ٱلحكيم ٱلعليم
tr: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
y: It is He Who is Allah in heaven and Allah on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge.
p: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.
t: wa huwal lazee fissamaaa'i ilaahunw wa fil ardi ilaah; wa huwal hakeemul'aleem

ar: وتبارك ٱلذى له ملك ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما وعنده علم ٱلساعة وإليه ترجعون
tr: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
y: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back.
p: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.
t: wa tabaarakal lazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa wa 'indahoo 'ilmus saa'ati wa ilaihi turja'oon

ar: ولا يملك ٱلذين يدعون من دونه ٱلشفعة إلا من شهد بٱلحق وهم يعلمون
tr: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
y: And those whom they invoke besides Allah have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him).
p: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.
t: wa laa yamlikul lazeena yad'oona min doonihish shafaa'ata illaa man shahida bilhaqqi wa hum ya'lamoon

ar: ولئن سألتهم من خلقهم ليقولن ٱلله فأنى يؤفكون
tr: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
y: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, Allah: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)?
p: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
t: wa la'in sa altahum man khalaqahum la yaqoolun nallaahu fa annaa yu'fakoon

ar: وقيله يرب إن هؤلاء قوم لا يؤمنون
tr: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
y: (Allah has knowledge) of the (Prophet's) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe!"
p: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.
t: wa qeelihee yaa rabbi inna haa'ulaaa'i qawmul laa yu'minoon

ar: فٱصفح عنهم وقل سلم فسوف يعلمون
tr: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
y: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know!
p: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
t: fasfah 'anhum wa qul salaam; fasawfa ya'lamoon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم حم
tr: Ha, Meem.
y: Ha-Mim.
p: Ha. Mim.
t: haa meeem

ar: وٱلكتب ٱلمبين
tr: By the clear Book,
y: By the Book that makes things clear;-
p: By the Scripture that maketh plain
t: wal kitaabil mubeen

ar: إنا أنزلنه فى ليلة مبركة إنا كنا منذرين
tr: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
y: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
p: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
t: innaaa anzalnaahu fee lailatim mubaarakah; innaa kunnaa munzireen

ar: فيها يفرق كل أمر حكيم
tr: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
y: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,
p: Whereon every wise command is made clear
t: feehaa yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem

ar: أمرا من عندنا إنا كنا مرسلين
tr: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
y: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),
p: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -
t: amram min 'indinaaa; innaa kunnaa mursileen

ar: رحمة من ربك إنه هو ٱلسميع ٱلعليم
tr: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
y: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
p: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
t: rahmatam mir rabbik; innahoo huwas samee'ul 'aleem

ar: رب ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما إن كنتم موقنين
tr: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
y: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.
p: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
t: rabbis samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa; in kuntum mooqineen

ar: لا إله إلا هو يحى ويميت ربكم ورب ءابائكم ٱلأولين
tr: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
y: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.
p: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
t: laaa ilaaha illaa huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu rabbukum wa rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

ar: بل هم فى شك يلعبون
tr: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
y: Yet they play about in doubt.
p: Nay, but they play in doubt.
t: bal hum fee shakkiny yal'aboon

ar: فٱرتقب يوم تأتى ٱلسماء بدخان مبين
tr: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
y: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
p: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
t: fartaqib yawma taatis samaaa'u bidukhaanim mubeen

ar: يغشى ٱلناس هذا عذاب أليم
tr: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
y: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.
p: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.
t: yaghshan naasa haazaa 'azaabun aleem

ar: ربنا ٱكشف عنا ٱلعذاب إنا مؤمنون
tr: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
y: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"
p: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.
t: rabbanak shif 'annal 'azaaba innaa mu'minoon

ar: أنى لهم ٱلذكرى وقد جاءهم رسول مبين
tr: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
y: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-
p: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,
t: annaa lahumuz zikraa wa qad jaaa'ahum rasoolum mubeen

ar: ثم تولوا عنه وقالوا معلم مجنون
tr: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
y: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
p: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?
t: summaa tawallaw 'anhu wa qaaloo mu'allamum majnoon

ar: إنا كاشفوا ٱلعذاب قليلا إنكم عائدون
tr: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
y: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).
p: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).
t: innaa kaashiful 'azaabi qaleelaa; innakum 'aaa'indoon

ar: يوم نبطش ٱلبطشة ٱلكبرى إنا منتقمون
tr: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
y: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!
p: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.
t: yawma nabtishul batsha tal kubraa innaa muntaqimoon

ar: ولقد فتنا قبلهم قوم فرعون وجاءهم رسول كريم
tr: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
y: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,
p: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,
t: wa laqad fatannaa qablahum qawma fir'awna wa jaaa'ahum rasoolun kareem

ar: أن أدوا إلى عباد ٱلله إنى لكم رسول أمين
tr: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
y: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;
p: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.
t: an addooo ilaiya 'ibaadal laahi innee lakum rasoolun ameen

ar: وأن لا تعلوا على ٱلله إنى ءاتيكم بسلطن مبين
tr: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
y: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.
p: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
t: wa al laa ta'loo 'alal laahi innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen

ar: وإنى عذت بربى وربكم أن ترجمون
tr: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
y: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.
p: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
t: wa innee 'uztu bi rabbee wa rabbikum an tarjumoon

ar: وإن لم تؤمنوا لى فٱعتزلون
tr: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
y: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
p: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.
t: wa il lam tu'minoo lee fa'taziloon

ar: فدعا ربه أن هؤلاء قوم مجرمون
tr: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
y: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."
p: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
t: fada'aa rabbahooo anna haaa'ulaaa'i qawmum mujrimoon

ar: فأسر بعبادى ليلا إنكم متبعون
tr: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
y: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
p: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,
t: fa asri bi'ibaadee lailan innakum muttaba'oon

ar: وٱترك ٱلبحر رهوا إنهم جند مغرقون
tr: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
y: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."
p: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.
t: watrukil bahra rahwan innahum jundum mughraqoon

ar: كم تركوا من جنت وعيون
tr: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
y: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,
p: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,
t: kam tarakoo min jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ar: وزروع ومقام كريم
tr: And crops and noble sites
y: And corn-fields and noble buildings,
p: And the cornlands and the goodly sites
t: wa zuroo'inw wa maqaa min kareem

ar: ونعمة كانوا فيها فكهين
tr: And comfort wherein they were amused.
y: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
p: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!
t: wa na'matin kaanoo feehaa faakiheen

ar: كذلك وأورثنها قوما ءاخرين
tr: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
y: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!
p: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;
t: kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa qawman aakhareen

ar: فما بكت عليهم ٱلسماء وٱلأرض وما كانوا منظرين
tr: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
y: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).
p: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
t: famaa bakat 'alaihimus samaaa'u wal ardu wa maa kaanoo munzareen

ar: ولقد نجينا بنى إسرءيل من ٱلعذاب ٱلمهين
tr: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
y: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,
p: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;
t: wa laqad najjainaa baneee israaa'eela minal'azaabil muheen

ar: من فرعون إنه كان عاليا من ٱلمسرفين
tr: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
y: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.
p: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.
t: min fir'awn; innahoo kaana 'aaliyam minal musrifeen

ar: ولقد ٱخترنهم على علم على ٱلعلمين
tr: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
y: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
p: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.
t: wa laqadikh tarnaahum 'alaa 'ilmin 'alal 'aalameen

ar: وءاتينهم من ٱلءايت ما فيه بلؤا مبين
tr: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
y: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial
p: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.
t: wa aatainaahum minal aayaati maa feehi balaaa'um mubeen

ar: إن هؤلاء ليقولون
tr: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
y: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:
p: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:
t: inna haaa'ulaaa'i la yaqooloon

ar: إن هى إلا موتتنا ٱلأولى وما نحن بمنشرين
tr: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
y: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
p: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
t: in hiya illaa mawtatunal oolaa wa maa nahnu bimun shareen

ar: فأتوا بـابائنا إن كنتم صدقين
tr: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
y: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
p: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!
t: faatoo bi aabaaa'inaaa inkuntum saadiqeen

ar: أهم خير أم قوم تبع وٱلذين من قبلهم أهلكنهم إنهم كانوا مجرمين
tr: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
y: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.
p: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.
t: ahum khayrun am qawmu tubba'inw wallazeena min qablihim; ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen

ar: وما خلقنا ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما لعبين
tr: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
y: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:
p: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
t: wa maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa baina humaa laa'ibeen

ar: ما خلقنهما إلا بٱلحق ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون
tr: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
y: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.
p: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.
t: maa khalaqnaahumaaa illaa bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

ar: إن يوم ٱلفصل ميقتهم أجمعين
tr: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
y: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-
p: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,
t: inna yawmal fasli meeqaatuhum ajma'een

ar: يوم لا يغنى مولى عن مولى شيـا ولا هم ينصرون
tr: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
y: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
p: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
t: yawma laa yughnee mawlan 'am mawlan shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

ar: إلا من رحم ٱلله إنه هو ٱلعزيز ٱلرحيم
tr: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
y: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
p: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
t: illaa mar rahimal laah' innahoo huwal 'azeezur raheem

ar: إن شجرت ٱلزقوم
tr: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
y: Verily the tree of Zaqqum
p: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,
t: inna shajarataz zaqqoom

ar: طعام ٱلأثيم
tr: Is food for the sinful.
y: Will be the food of the Sinful,-
p: The food of the sinner!
t: ta'aamul aseem

ar: كٱلمهل يغلى فى ٱلبطون
tr: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
y: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
p: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies
t: kalmuhli yaghlee filbutoon

ar: كغلى ٱلحميم
tr: Like the boiling of scalding water.
y: Like the boiling of scalding water.
p: As the seething of boiling water.
t: kaghalyil hameem

ar: خذوه فٱعتلوه إلى سواء ٱلجحيم
tr: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
y: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!
p: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,
t: khuzoohu fa'tiloohu ilaa sawaaa'il jaheem

ar: ثم صبوا فوق رأسه من عذاب ٱلحميم
tr: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
y: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,
p: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.
t: summa subboo fawqa raasihee min 'azaabil hameem

ar: ذق إنك أنت ٱلعزيز ٱلكريم
tr: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
y: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!
p: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!
t: zuq innaka antal 'azeezul kareem

ar: إن هذا ما كنتم به تمترون
tr: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
y: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"
p: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.
t: inna haazaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon

ar: إن ٱلمتقين فى مقام أمين
tr: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
y: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,
p: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.
t: innal muttaqeena fee maqaamin ameen

ar: فى جنت وعيون
tr: Within gardens and springs,
y: Among Gardens and Springs;
p: Amid gardens and watersprings,
t: fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ar: يلبسون من سندس وإستبرق متقبلين
tr: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
y: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;
p: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.
t: yalbasoona min sundusinw wa istbraqim mutaqaabileen

ar: كذلك وزوجنهم بحور عين
tr: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
y: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.
p: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
t: kazaalika wa zawwajnaahum bihoorin 'een

ar: يدعون فيها بكل فكهة ءامنين
tr: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
y: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
p: They call therein for every fruit in safety.
t: yad'oona feehaa bikulli faakihatin aamineen

ar: لا يذوقون فيها ٱلموت إلا ٱلموتة ٱلأولى ووقىهم عذاب ٱلجحيم
tr: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
y: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-
p: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,
t: laa yazooqoona feehal mawtaa illal mawtatal oolaa wa qaqaahum 'azaabal jaheem

ar: فضلا من ربك ذلك هو ٱلفوز ٱلعظيم
tr: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
y: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!
p: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
t: fadlam mir rabbik; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem

ar: فإنما يسرنه بلسانك لعلهم يتذكرون
tr: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
y: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.
p: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.
t: fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika la'allahum yatazakkaroon

ar: فٱرتقب إنهم مرتقبون
tr: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
y: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
p: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
t: fartaqib innahum murta qiboon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم حم
tr: Ha, Meem.
y: Ha-Mim.
p: Ha. Mim.
t: haa-meeem

ar: تنزيل ٱلكتب من ٱلله ٱلعزيز ٱلحكيم
tr: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
y: The revelation of the Book is from Allah the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
p: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
t: tanzeelul kitaabi minal laahil 'azeezil hakeem

ar: إن فى ٱلسموت وٱلأرض لءايت للمؤمنين
tr: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
y: Verily in the heavens and the earth, are Signs for those who believe.
p: Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers.
t: innaa fis samaawaati wal ardi la aayaatil lilmu'mineen

ar: وفى خلقكم وما يبث من دابة ءايت لقوم يوقنون
tr: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
y: And in the creation of yourselves and the fact that animals are scattered (through the earth), are Signs for those of assured Faith.
p: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.
t: wa fee khalaqikum wa maa yabussu min daaabbatin aayaatul liqawminy-yooqinoon

ar: وٱختلف ٱليل وٱلنهار وما أنزل ٱلله من ٱلسماء من رزق فأحيا به ٱلأرض بعد موتها وتصريف ٱلريح ءايت لقوم يعقلون
tr: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
y: And in the alternation of Night and Day, and the fact that Allah sends down Sustenance from the sky, and revives therewith the earth after its death, and in the change of the winds,- are Signs for those that are wise.
p: And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense.
t: wakhtilaafil laili wannahaari wa maaa anzalal laahu minas samaaa'i mir rizqin fa ahyaa bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa wa tasreefir riyaahi aayaatul liqawminy ya'qiloon

ar: تلك ءايت ٱلله نتلوها عليك بٱلحق فبأى حديث بعد ٱلله وءايته يؤمنون
tr: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?
y: Such are the Signs of Allah, which We rehearse to thee in Truth; then in what exposition will they believe after (rejecting) Allah and His Signs?
p: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth. Then in what fact, after Allah and His portents, will they believe?
t: tilka aayatul laahi natloohaa 'alika bilhaqq, fabiayyi hadeesim ba'dal laahi wa aayaatihee yu'minoon

ar: ويل لكل أفاك أثيم
tr: Woe to every sinful liar
y: Woe to each sinful dealer in Falsehoods:
p: Woe unto each sinful liar,
t: wailul likulli affaakin aseem

ar: يسمع ءايت ٱلله تتلى عليه ثم يصر مستكبرا كأن لم يسمعها فبشره بعذاب أليم
tr: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
y: He hears the Signs of Allah rehearsed to him, yet is obstinate and lofty, as if he had not heard them: then announce to him a Penalty Grievous!
p: Who heareth the revelations of Allah recited unto him, and then continueth in pride as though he heard them not. Give him tidings of a painful doom.
t: yasma'u aayaatil laahi tutlaa 'alaihi summa yusirru mustakbiran ka-al lam yasma'haa fabashshirhu bi'azaabin aleem

ar: وإذا علم من ءايتنا شيـا ٱتخذها هزوا أولئك لهم عذاب مهين
tr: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
y: And when he learns something of Our Signs, he takes them in jest: for such there will be a humiliating Penalty.
p: And when he knoweth aught of Our revelations he maketh it a jest. For such there is a shameful doom.
t: wa izaa 'alima min aayaatinaa shai'anit takhazahaa huzuwaa; ulaaa'ika lahum 'azaabum muheen

ar: من ورائهم جهنم ولا يغنى عنهم ما كسبوا شيـا ولا ما ٱتخذوا من دون ٱلله أولياء ولهم عذاب عظيم
tr: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
y: In front of them is Hell: and of no profit to them is anything they may have earned, nor any protectors they may have taken to themselves besides Allah: for them is a tremendous Penalty.
p: Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.
t: minw waraaa'ihim jahannamu wa laa yughnee 'anhum maa kasaboo shai'anw wa laa mat takhazoo min doonil laahi awliyaaa'a wa lahum 'azaabun 'azeem

ar: هذا هدى وٱلذين كفروا بـايت ربهم لهم عذاب من رجز أليم
tr: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
y: This is (true) Guidance and for those who reject the Signs of their Lord, is a grievous Penalty of abomination.
p: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath.
t: haazaa hudanw wal lazeena kafaroo bi aayaati rabbihim lahum 'azaabum mir rijzin aleem

ar: ٱلله ٱلذى سخر لكم ٱلبحر لتجرى ٱلفلك فيه بأمره ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
tr: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
y: It is Allah Who has subjected the sea to you, that ships may sail through it by His command, that ye may seek of his Bounty, and that ye may be grateful.
p: Allah it is Who hath made the sea of service unto you that the ships may run thereon by His command, and that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful;
t: allaahul lazee sahkhara lakumul bahra litajriyal fulku feehi bi amrihee wa litabtaghoo min fadlihee wa la'allakum tashkuroon

ar: وسخر لكم ما فى ٱلسموت وما فى ٱلأرض جميعا منه إن فى ذلك لءايت لقوم يتفكرون
tr: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
y: And He has subjected to you, as from Him, all that is in the heavens and on earth: Behold, in that are Signs indeed for those who reflect.
p: And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect.
t: wa sakhkhara lakum maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi jamee'am minh; inna feezaalika la aayaatil liqawminy yatafakkaroon

ar: قل للذين ءامنوا يغفروا للذين لا يرجون أيام ٱلله ليجزى قوما بما كانوا يكسبون
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
y: Tell those who believe, to forgive those who do not look forward to the Days of Allah: It is for Him to recompense (for good or ill) each People according to what they have earned.
p: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.
t: qul lillazeena aamanoo yaghfiroo lillazeena laa yarjoona ayyaamal laahi liyajziya qawmam bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon

ar: من عمل صلحا فلنفسه ومن أساء فعليها ثم إلى ربكم ترجعون
tr: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
y: If any one does a righteous deed, it ensures to the benefit of his own soul; if he does evil, it works against (his own soul). In the end will ye (all) be brought back to your Lord.
p: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back.
t: maa 'amila saalihan falinafsihee wa man asaaa'a fa'alaihaa summa ilaa rabbikum turja'oon

ar: ولقد ءاتينا بنى إسرءيل ٱلكتب وٱلحكم وٱلنبوة ورزقنهم من ٱلطيبت وفضلنهم على ٱلعلمين
tr: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
y: We did aforetime grant to the Children of Israel the Book the Power of Command, and Prophethood; We gave them, for Sustenance, things good and pure; and We favoured them above the nations.
p: And verily we gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and the Command and the Prophethood, and provided them with good things and favoured them above (all) peoples;
t: wa laqad aatainaa baneee israaa'eelal kitaaba walhukma wan nubuwwata wa razaqnaahum minat taiyibaati wa faddalnaahum;alal 'aalameen

ar: وءاتينهم بينت من ٱلأمر فما ٱختلفوا إلا من بعد ما جاءهم ٱلعلم بغيا بينهم إن ربك يقضى بينهم يوم ٱلقيمة فيما كانوا فيه يختلفون
tr: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
y: And We granted them Clear Signs in affairs (of Religion): it was only after knowledge had been granted to them that they fell into schisms, through insolent envy among themselves. Verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment as to those matters in which they set up differences.
p: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.
t: wa aatainaahum baiyinaatim minal amri famakh talafooo illaa mim ba'di maa jaaa'ahumul 'ilmu baghyam bainahum; inna rabbaka yaqdee bainahum yawmal qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon

ar: ثم جعلنك على شريعة من ٱلأمر فٱتبعها ولا تتبع أهواء ٱلذين لا يعلمون
tr: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
y: Then We put thee on the (right) Way of Religion: so follow thou that (Way), and follow not the desires of those who know not.
p: And now have We set thee (O Muhammad) on a clear road of (Our) commandment; so follow it, and follow not the whims of those who know not.
t: summa ja'alnaaka 'alaa sharee'atim minal amri fattabi'haa wa laa tattabi'ahwaaa'al-lazeena laa ya'lamoon

ar: إنهم لن يغنوا عنك من ٱلله شيـا وإن ٱلظلمين بعضهم أولياء بعض وٱلله ولى ٱلمتقين
tr: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.
y: They will be of no use to thee in the sight of Allah: it is only Wrong-doers (that stand as) protectors, one to another: but Allah is the Protector of the Righteous.
p: Lo! they can avail thee naught against Allah. And lo! as for the wrong-doers, some of them are friends of others; and Allah is the Friend of those who ward off (evil).
t: innahum lany yughnoo 'anka minal laahi shai'aa; wa innaz zaalimeena ba'duhum awliyaaa'u ba'dinw wallaahu waliyyul muttaqeen

ar: هذا بصئر للناس وهدى ورحمة لقوم يوقنون
tr: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
y: These are clear evidences to men and a Guidance and Mercy to those of assured Faith.
p: This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure.
t: haazaa basaaa'iru linnaasi wa hudanw wa rahmatul liqawminy yooqinoon

ar: أم حسب ٱلذين ٱجترحوا ٱلسيـات أن نجعلهم كٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت سواء محياهم ومماتهم ساء ما يحكمون
tr: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
y: What! Do those who seek after evil ways think that We shall hold them equal with those who believe and do righteous deeds,- that equal will be their life and their death? Ill is the judgment that they make.
p: Or do those who commit ill-deeds suppose that We shall make them as those who believe and do good works, the same in life and death? Bad is their judgment!
t: am hasibal lazeenaj tarahus saiyiaati an naj'alahum kallazeena aamanoo wa 'amilu saalihaati sawaaa'am mahyaahum wa mamaatuhum; saaa'a maa yahkumoon

ar: وخلق ٱلله ٱلسموت وٱلأرض بٱلحق ولتجزى كل نفس بما كسبت وهم لا يظلمون
tr: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
y: Allah created the heavens and the earth for just ends, and in order that each soul may find the recompense of what it has earned, and none of them be wronged.
p: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged.
t: wa khalaqal laahus samaawaati wal arda bilhaqqi wa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa kasabat wa hum laa yuzlamoon

ar: أفرءيت من ٱتخذ إلهه هوىه وأضله ٱلله على علم وختم على سمعه وقلبه وجعل على بصره غشوة فمن يهديه من بعد ٱلله أفلا تذكرون
tr: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded?
y: Then seest thou such a one as takes as his god his own vain desire? Allah has, knowing (him as such), left him astray, and sealed his hearing and his heart (and understanding), and put a cover on his sight. Who, then, will guide him after Allah (has withdrawn Guidance)? Will ye not then receive admonition?
p: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed?
t: afara'ayta manit takhaza ilaahahoo hawaahu wa adal lahul laahu 'alaa 'ilminw wa khatama 'alaa sam'ihee wa qalbihee wa ja'ala 'alaa basarihee ghishaawatan famany yahdeehi mim ba'dil laah; afalaa tazakkaroon

ar: وقالوا ما هى إلا حياتنا ٱلدنيا نموت ونحيا وما يهلكنا إلا ٱلدهر وما لهم بذلك من علم إن هم إلا يظنون
tr: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
y: And they say: "What is there but our life in this world? We shall die and we live, and nothing but time can destroy us." But of that they have no knowledge: they merely conjecture:
p: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.
t: wa qaaloo maa hiya illaa hayaatunad dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa yuhlikunaaa illad dahr; wa maa lahum bizaalika min 'ilmin in hum illaayazunnoon

ar: وإذا تتلى عليهم ءايتنا بينت ما كان حجتهم إلا أن قالوا ٱئتوا بـابائنا إن كنتم صدقين
tr: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
y: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them their argument is nothing but this: They say, "Bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
p: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful.
t: wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim aayaatuna baiyinaatim maa kaana hujjatahum illaaa an qaalu'too bi aabaaa'inaaa in kuntum saadiqeen

ar: قل ٱلله يحييكم ثم يميتكم ثم يجمعكم إلى يوم ٱلقيمة لا ريب فيه ولكن أكثر ٱلناس لا يعلمون
tr: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
y: Say: "It is Allah Who gives you life, then gives you death; then He will gather you together for the Day of Judgment about which there is no doubt": But most men do not understand.
p: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not.
t: qulil laahu yuhyeekum summa yumeetukum summa yajma'ukum ilaa yawmil qiyaamati laa raiba feehi wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon

ar: ولله ملك ٱلسموت وٱلأرض ويوم تقوم ٱلساعة يومئذ يخسر ٱلمبطلون
tr: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
y: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and the Day that the Hour of Judgment is established,- that Day will the dealers in Falsehood perish!
p: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost.
t: wa lillaahi mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wa yawma taqoomus saa'atu yawma 'iziny yakhsarul mubtiloon

ar: وترى كل أمة جاثية كل أمة تدعى إلى كتبها ٱليوم تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
tr: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
y: And thou wilt see every sect bowing the knee: Every sect will be called to its Record: "This Day shall ye be recompensed for all that ye did!
p: And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do.
t: wa taraa kulla ummatin jaasiyah; kullu ummatin tud'aaa ilaa kitaabihaa al yawma tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon

ar: هذا كتبنا ينطق عليكم بٱلحق إنا كنا نستنسخ ما كنتم تعملون
tr: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
y: "This Our Record speaks about you with truth: For We were wont to put on Record all that ye did."
p: This Our Book pronounceth against you with truth. Lo! We have caused (all) that ye did to be recorded.
t: haazaa kitaabunaa yantiqu 'alaikum bilhaqq; innaa kunnaa nastansikhu maa kuntum ta'maloon

ar: فأما ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت فيدخلهم ربهم فى رحمته ذلك هو ٱلفوز ٱلمبين
tr: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
y: Then, as to those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them to His Mercy that will be the achievement for all to see.
p: Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph.
t: fa ammal lazeena aamaanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatih; zaalika huwal fawzul mubeen

ar: وأما ٱلذين كفروا أفلم تكن ءايتى تتلى عليكم فٱستكبرتم وكنتم قوما مجرمين
tr: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
y: But as to those who rejected Allah, (to them will be said): "Were not Our Signs rehearsed to you? But ye were arrogant, and were a people given to sin!
p: And as for those who disbelieved (it will be said unto them): Were not Our revelations recited unto you? But ye were scornful and became a guilty folk.
t: wa ammal lazeena kafarooo afalam takun aayaatee tutlaa 'alaikum fastakbartum wa kuntum qawmam mujrimeen

ar: وإذا قيل إن وعد ٱلله حق وٱلساعة لا ريب فيها قلتم ما ندرى ما ٱلساعة إن نظن إلا ظنا وما نحن بمستيقنين
tr: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "
y: "And when it was said that the promise of Allah was true, and that the Hour- there was no doubt about its (coming), ye used to say, 'We know not what is the hour: we only think it is an idea, and we have no firm assurance.'"
p: And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced.
t: wa izaa qeela inna wa'dallaahi haqqunw was saa'atu laa raiba feehaa qultum maa nadree mas saa'atu in nazunnu illaa zannanw wa maa nahnu bimustaiqineen

ar: وبدا لهم سيـات ما عملوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
tr: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
y: Then will appear to them the evil (fruits) of what they did, and they will be completely encircled by that which they used to mock at!
p: And the evils of what they did will appear unto them, and that which they used to deride will befall them.
t: wa badaa lahum saiyiaatu maa 'amiloo wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon

ar: وقيل ٱليوم ننسىكم كما نسيتم لقاء يومكم هذا ومأوىكم ٱلنار وما لكم من نصرين
tr: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
y: It will also be said: "This Day We will forget you as ye forgot the meeting of this Day of yours! and your abode is the Fire, and no helpers have ye!
p: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.
t: wa qeelal yawma nansaakum kamaa naseetum liqaaa'a yawmikum haazaa wa maawaakumun naaru wa maa lakum min naasireen

ar: ذلكم بأنكم ٱتخذتم ءايت ٱلله هزوا وغرتكم ٱلحيوة ٱلدنيا فٱليوم لا يخرجون منها ولا هم يستعتبون
tr: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
y: "This, because ye used to take the Signs of Allah in jest, and the life of the world deceived you:" (From) that Day, therefore, they shall not be taken out thence, nor shall they be received into Grace.
p: This, forasmuch as ye made the revelations of Allah a jest, and the life of the world beguiled you. Therefor this day they come not forth from thence, nor can they make amends.
t: zaalikum bi annakumut takhaztum aayaatil laahi huzuwanw wa gharratkumul hayaatud dunyaa; fal yawma laa yukhrajoona minhaa wa laahum yusta'taboon

ar: فلله ٱلحمد رب ٱلسموت ورب ٱلأرض رب ٱلعلمين
tr: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
y: Then Praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth,- Lord and Cherisher of all the Worlds!
p: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.
t: falillaahil hamdu rabbis samaawaati wa rabbil ardi rabbil-'aalameen

ar: وله ٱلكبرياء فى ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وهو ٱلعزيز ٱلحكيم
tr: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
y: To Him be glory throughout the heavens and the earth: and He is Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom!
p: And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
t: wa lahul kibriyaaa'u fissamaawaati wal ardi wa huwal 'azeezul hakeem

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم حم
tr: Ha, Meem.
y: Ha-Mim.
p: Ha. Mim.
t: haa-meeeem

ar: تنزيل ٱلكتب من ٱلله ٱلعزيز ٱلحكيم
tr: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
y: The Revelation of the Book is from Allah the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
p: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah the Mighty, the Wise.
t: tanzeelul kitaabi minal laahil-'azeezil hakeem

ar: ما خلقنا ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما إلا بٱلحق وأجل مسمى وٱلذين كفروا عما أنذروا معرضون
tr: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
y: We created not the heavens and the earth and all between them but for just ends, and for a Term Appointed: But those who reject Faith turn away from that whereof they are warned.
p: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.
t: maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaaa illaa bilhaqqi wa ajalim musammaa; wallazeena kafaroo 'ammaaa unziroo mu'ridoon

ar: قل أرءيتم ما تدعون من دون ٱلله أرونى ماذا خلقوا من ٱلأرض أم لهم شرك فى ٱلسموت ٱئتونى بكتب من قبل هذا أو أثرة من علم إن كنتم صدقين
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
y: Say: "Do ye see what it is ye invoke besides Allah? Show me what it is they have created on earth, or have they a share in the heavens bring me a book (revealed) before this, or any remnant of knowledge (ye may have), if ye are telling the truth!
p: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.
t: qul ara'aytum maa tad'oona min doonil laahi aroonee maazaa khalaqoo minal ardi am lahum shirkun fis samaawaati eetoonee bi kitaabim min qabli haazaaa aw asaaratim min 'ilmin in kuntum saadiqeen

ar: ومن أضل ممن يدعوا من دون ٱلله من لا يستجيب له إلى يوم ٱلقيمة وهم عن دعائهم غفلون
tr: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
y: And who is more astray than one who invokes besides Allah, such as will not answer him to the Day of Judgment, and who (in fact) are unconscious of their call (to them)?
p: And who is further astray than those who, instead of Allah, pray unto such as hear not their prayer until the Day of Resurrection, and are unconscious of their prayer,
t: wa man adallu mimmany yad'oo min doonil laahi mallaa yastajeebu lahooo ilaa yawmil qiyaamati wa hum'an du'aaa'ihim ghaafiloon

ar: وإذا حشر ٱلناس كانوا لهم أعداء وكانوا بعبادتهم كفرين
tr: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
y: And when mankind are gathered together (at the Resurrection), they will be hostile to them and reject their worship (altogether)!
p: And when mankind are gathered (to the Judgment) will become enemies for them, and will become deniers of having been worshipped.
t: wa izaa hushiran naasu kaanoo lahum a'daaa'anw wa kaanoo bi'ibaadatihim kaafireen

ar: وإذا تتلى عليهم ءايتنا بينت قال ٱلذين كفروا للحق لما جاءهم هذا سحر مبين
tr: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
y: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say, of the Truth when it comes to them: "This is evident sorcery!"
p: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say of the Truth when it reacheth them: This is mere magic.
t: wa izaa tutlaa 'alaihim aayaatunaa baiyinaatin qaalal lazeena kafaroo lilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum haazaa sihrum mubeen

ar: أم يقولون ٱفترىه قل إن ٱفتريته فلا تملكون لى من ٱلله شيـا هو أعلم بما تفيضون فيه كفى به شهيدا بينى وبينكم وهو ٱلغفور ٱلرحيم
tr: Or do they say, "He has invented it?" Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving the Merciful."
y: Or do they say, "He has forged it"? Say: "Had I forged it, then can ye obtain no single (blessing) for me from Allah. He knows best of that whereof ye talk (so glibly)! Enough is He for a witness between me and you! And he is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful."
p: Or say they: He hath invented it? Say (O Muhammad): If I have invented it, still ye have no power to support me against Allah. He is Best Aware of what ye say among yourselves concerning it. He sufficeth for a witness between me and you. And He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
t: am yaqooloonaf taraahu qul inif taraituhoo falaa tamlikoona lee minal laahi shai'an huwa a'lamu bimaa tufeedoona feehi kafaa bihee shaheedam bainee wa bainakum wa huwal ghafoorur raheem

ar: قل ما كنت بدعا من ٱلرسل وما أدرى ما يفعل بى ولا بكم إن أتبع إلا ما يوحى إلى وما أنا إلا نذير مبين
tr: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
y: Say: "I am no bringer of new-fangled doctrine among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I follow but that which is revealed to me by inspiration; I am but a Warner open and clear."
p: Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner.
t: qul maa kuntu bid'am minal rusuli wa maaa adreee ma yuf'alu bee wa laa bikum in attabi'u illaa maa yoohaaa ilaiya ya maaa ana illaa nazeerum mubeen

ar: قل أرءيتم إن كان من عند ٱلله وكفرتم به وشهد شاهد من بنى إسرءيل على مثله فـامن وٱستكبرتم إن ٱلله لا يهدى ٱلقوم ٱلظلمين
tr: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an was from Allah, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
y: Say: "See ye? If (this teaching) be from Allah, and ye reject it, and a witness from among the Children of Israel testifies to its similarity (with earlier scripture), and has believed while ye are arrogant, (how unjust ye are!) truly, Allah guides not a people unjust."
p: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye disbelieve therein, and a witness of the Children of Israel hath already testified to the like thereof and hath believed, and ye are too proud (what plight is yours)? Lo! Allah guideth not wrong-doing folk.
t: qul ara'aytum in kaana min 'indil laahi wa kafartum bihee wa shahida shaahidum mim banee israaa'eela 'alaa mislihee fa aamana wastak bartum innal laaha laa yahdil qawmaz zaalimeen

ar: وقال ٱلذين كفروا للذين ءامنوا لو كان خيرا ما سبقونا إليه وإذ لم يهتدوا به فسيقولون هذا إفك قديم
tr: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
y: The Unbelievers say of those who believe: "If (this Message) were a good thing, (such men) would not have gone to it first, before us!" And seeing that they guide not themselves thereby, they will say, "this is an (old,) falsehood!"
p: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe: If it had been (any) good, they would not have been before us in attaining it. And since they will not be guided by it, they say: This is an ancient lie;
t: wa qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanoo law kaana khairam maa sabaqoonaaa ilyh; wa iz lam yahtadoo bihee fasa yaqooloona haazaaa ifkun qadeem

ar: ومن قبله كتب موسى إماما ورحمة وهذا كتب مصدق لسانا عربيا لينذر ٱلذين ظلموا وبشرى للمحسنين
tr: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
y: And before this, was the Book of Moses as a guide and a mercy: And this Book confirms (it) in the Arabic tongue; to admonish the unjust, and as Glad Tidings to those who do right.
p: When before it there was the Scripture of Moses, an example and a mercy; and this is a confirming Scripture in the Arabic language, that it may warn those who do wrong and bring good tidings for the righteous.
t: wa min qablihee kitaabu moosaaa imaamanw-wa rahmah; wa haazaa kitaabum musad diqul lisaanan 'arabiyyal liyunziral lazeena zalamoo wa bushraa lilmuhsineen

ar: إن ٱلذين قالوا ربنا ٱلله ثم ٱستقموا فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
tr: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
y: Verily those who say, "Our Lord is Allah," and remain firm (on that Path),- on them shall be no fear, nor shall they grieve.
p: Lo! those who say: Our Lord is Allah, and thereafter walk aright, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
t: innal lazeena qaaloo rabbunal laahu summas taqaamoo falaa khawfun 'alaihim wa laahum yahzanoon

ar: أولئك أصحب ٱلجنة خلدين فيها جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
tr: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
y: Such shall be Companions of the Gardens, dwelling therein (for aye): a recompense for their (good) deeds.
p: Such are rightful owners of the Garden, immortal therein, as a reward for what they used to do.
t: ulaaa'ika ashabul jannati khaalideena feehaa jazaaa'am bimaa kaano ya'maloon

ar: ووصينا ٱلإنسن بولديه إحسنا حملته أمه كرها ووضعته كرها وحمله وفصله ثلثون شهرا حتى إذا بلغ أشده وبلغ أربعين سنة قال رب أوزعنى أن أشكر نعمتك ٱلتى أنعمت على وعلى ولدى وأن أعمل صلحا ترضىه وأصلح لى فى ذريتى إنى تبت إليك وإنى من ٱلمسلمين
tr: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
y: We have enjoined on man kindness to his parents: In pain did his mother bear him, and in pain did she give him birth. The carrying of the (child) to his weaning is (a period of) thirty months. At length, when he reaches the age of full strength and attains forty years, he says, "O my Lord! Grant me that I may be grateful for Thy favour which Thou has bestowed upon me, and upon both my parents, and that I may work righteousness such as Thou mayest approve; and be gracious to me in my issue. Truly have I turned to Thee and truly do I bow (to Thee) in Islam."
p: And We have commended unto man kindness toward parents. His mother beareth him with reluctance, and bringeth him forth with reluctance, and the bearing of him and the weaning of him is thirty months, till, when he attaineth full strength and reacheth forty years, he saith: My Lord! Arouse me that I may give thanks for the favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me and my parents, and that I may do right acceptable unto Thee. And be gracious unto me in the matter of my seed. Lo! I have turned unto Thee repentant, and lo! I am of those who surrender (unto Thee).
t: wa wassainal insaana biwaalidaihi ihsaanan hamalathu ummuhoo kurhanw-wa wada'athu kurhanw wa hamluhoo wa fisaaluhoo salaasoona shahraa; hattaaa izaa balagha ashuddahoo wa balagho arba'eena sanatan qaala rabbi aqzi'neee an ashkura ni'matakal lateee an'amta 'alaiya wa 'alaa waalidaiya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa aslih lee fee zurriyyatee innee tubtu ilaika wa innee minal muslimeen

ar: أولئك ٱلذين نتقبل عنهم أحسن ما عملوا ونتجاوز عن سيـاتهم فى أصحب ٱلجنة وعد ٱلصدق ٱلذى كانوا يوعدون
tr: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
y: Such are they from whom We shall accept the best of their deeds and pass by their ill deeds: (They shall be) among the Companions of the Garden: a promise! of truth, which was made to them (in this life).
p: Those are they from whom We accept the best of what they do, and overlook their evil deeds. (They are) among the owners of the Garden. This is the true promise which they were promised (in the world).
t: ulaaa'ikal lazeena nata qabbalu 'anhum ahsana maa 'amiloo wa natajaawazu 'an saiyiaatihim feee ashaabil jannati wa'das sidqil lazee kaanoo yoo'adoon

ar: وٱلذى قال لولديه أف لكما أتعداننى أن أخرج وقد خلت ٱلقرون من قبلى وهما يستغيثان ٱلله ويلك ءامن إن وعد ٱلله حق فيقول ما هذا إلا أسطير ٱلأولين
tr: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allah for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former people" -
y: But (there is one) who says to his parents, "Fie on you! Do ye hold out the promise to me that I shall be raised up, even though generations have passed before me (without rising again)?" And they two seek Allah's aid, (and rebuke the son): "Woe to thee! Have faith! for the promise of Allah is true." But he says, "This is nothing but tales of the ancients!"
p: And whoso saith unto his parents: Fie upon you both! Do ye threaten me that I shall be brought forth (again) when generations before me have passed away? And they twain cry unto Allah for help (and say): Woe unto thee! Believe! Lo! the promise of Allah is true. But he saith: This is naught save fables of the men of old:
t: wallazee qaala liwaali daihi uffil lakumaaa ata'idanineee an ukhraja wa qad khalatil quroonu min qablee wa humaa yastagheesaanil laaha wailaka aamin inna wa'dal laahi haqq, fa yaqoolu maa haazaaa illaaa asaateerul awwaleen

ar: أولئك ٱلذين حق عليهم ٱلقول فى أمم قد خلت من قبلهم من ٱلجن وٱلإنس إنهم كانوا خسرين
tr: Those are the ones upon whom the word has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
y: Such are they against whom is proved the sentence among the previous generations of Jinns and men, that have passed away; for they will be (utterly) lost.
p: Such are those on whom the Word concerning nations of the jinn and mankind which have passed away before them hath effect. Lo! they are the losers.
t: ulaaa'ikal lazeena haqqa 'alaihimul qawlu feee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal jinni wal insi innahum kaanoo khaasireen

ar: ولكل درجت مما عملوا وليوفيهم أعملهم وهم لا يظلمون
tr: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
y: And to all are (assigned) degrees according to the deeds which they (have done), and in order that (Allah) may recompense their deeds, and no injustice be done to them.
p: And for all there will be ranks from what they do, that He may pay them for their deeds; and they will not be wronged.
t: wa likullin darajaatum mimmaa 'amiloo wa liyuwaf fiyahum a'maalahum wa hum laa yuzlamoon

ar: ويوم يعرض ٱلذين كفروا على ٱلنار أذهبتم طيبتكم فى حياتكم ٱلدنيا وٱستمتعتم بها فٱليوم تجزون عذاب ٱلهون بما كنتم تستكبرون فى ٱلأرض بغير ٱلحق وبما كنتم تفسقون
tr: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
y: And on the Day that the Unbelievers will be placed before the Fire, (It will be said to them): "Ye received your good things in the life of the world, and ye took your pleasure out of them: but today shall ye be recompensed with a Penalty of humiliation: for that ye were arrogant on earth without just cause, and that ye (ever) transgressed."
p: And on the day when those who disbelieve are exposed to the Fire (it will be said): Ye squandered your good things in the life of the world and sought comfort therein. Now this day ye are rewarded with the doom of ignominy because ye were disdainful in the land without a right, and because ye used to transgress.
t: wa yawma yu'radul lazeena kafaroo 'alan naai azhabtum taiyibaatikum fee hayaatikumud dunyaa wastam ta'tum bihaa fal yawma tujzawna 'azaabal hooni bimaa kuntum tastakbiroona fil ardi bighairil haqqi wa bimaa kuntum tafsuqoon

ar: وٱذكر أخا عاد إذ أنذر قومه بٱلأحقاف وقد خلت ٱلنذر من بين يديه ومن خلفه ألا تعبدوا إلا ٱلله إنى أخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
tr: And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of 'Aad, when he warned his people in the [region of] al-Ahqaf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allah. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
y: Mention (Hud) one of 'Ad's (own) brethren: Behold, he warned his people about the winding Sand-tracts: but there have been warners before him and after him: "Worship ye none other than Allah: Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Mighty Day."
p: And make mention (O Muhammad) of the brother of A'ad when he warned his folk among the wind-curved sandhills - and verily warners came and went before and after him - saying: Serve none but Allah. Lo! I fear for you the doom of a tremendous Day.
t: wazkur akhaa 'aad, iz anzara qawmahoo bil ahqaafi wa qad khalatin nuzuru mim baini yadaihi wa min khalfiheee allaa ta'budooo illal laaha inneee akhaafu 'alaikum 'azaaba yawmin 'azeem

ar: قالوا أجئتنا لتأفكنا عن ءالهتنا فأتنا بما تعدنا إن كنت من ٱلصدقين
tr: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
y: They said: "Hast thou come in order to turn us aside from our gods? Then bring upon us the (calamity) with which thou dost threaten us, if thou art telling the truth?"
p: They said: Hast come to turn us away from our gods? Then bring upon us that wherewith thou threatenest us, if thou art of the truthful.
t: qaaloo aji'tanaa litaa fikanaa 'an aalihatinaa faatinaa bimaa ta'idunaaa in kunta minas saadiqeen

ar: قال إنما ٱلعلم عند ٱلله وأبلغكم ما أرسلت به ولكنى أرىكم قوما تجهلون
tr: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allah, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
y: He said: "The Knowledge (of when it will come) is only with Allah: I proclaim to you the mission on which I have been sent: But I see that ye are a people in ignorance!"..
p: He said: The knowledge is with Allah only. I convey unto you that wherewith I have been sent, but I see you are a folk that know not.
t: qaala innamal 'ilmu indal laahi wa uballighukum maaa uriltu bihee wa laakinneee araakum qawman tajhaloon

ar: فلما رأوه عارضا مستقبل أوديتهم قالوا هذا عارض ممطرنا بل هو ما ٱستعجلتم به ريح فيها عذاب أليم
tr: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
y: Then, when they saw the (Penalty in the shape of) a cloud traversing the sky, coming to meet their valleys, they said, "This cloud will give us rain!" "Nay, it is the (Calamity) ye were asking to be hastened!- A wind wherein is a Grievous Penalty!
