y: They impress on thee as a favour that they have embraced Islam. Say, "Count not your Islam as a favour upon me: Nay, Allah has conferred a favour upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if ye be true and sincere.
p: They make it a favour unto thee (Muhammad) that they have surrendered (unto Him). Say: Deem not your Surrender a favour unto me; but Allah doth confer a favour on you, inasmuch as He hath led you to the Faith, if ye are earnest.
t: yamunnoona 'alaika an aslamoo qul laa tamunnoo 'alaiya islaamakum balillaahu yamunnu 'alaikum an hadaakum lil eemaani in kuntum saadiqeen

ar: إن ٱلله يعلم غيب ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وٱلله بصير بما تعملون
tr: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
y: "Verily Allah knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth: and Allah Sees well all that ye do."
p: Lo! Allah knoweth the Unseen of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
t: innal laaha ya'lamu ghaibas samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu baseerum bimaa ta'maloon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ق وٱلقرءان ٱلمجيد
tr: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...
y: Qaf: By the Glorious Qur'an (Thou art Allah's Messenger).
p: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an,
t: qaaaf; wal qur aanil majeed

ar: بل عجبوا أن جاءهم منذر منهم فقال ٱلكفرون هذا شىء عجيب
tr: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
y: But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the Unbelievers say: "This is a wonderful thing!
p: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
t: bal 'ajibooo an jaa'ahum munzirum minhum faqaalal kaafiroona haazaa shai'un 'ajeeb

ar: أءذا متنا وكنا ترابا ذلك رجع بعيد
tr: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
y: "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."
p: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!
t: 'a-izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban zaalika raj'um ba'eed

ar: قد علمنا ما تنقص ٱلأرض منهم وعندنا كتب حفيظ
tr: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
y: We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
p: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.
t: qad 'alimnaa maa tanqu-sul-ardu minhum wa 'indanaa kitaabun hafeez

ar: بل كذبوا بٱلحق لما جاءهم فهم فى أمر مريج
tr: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
y: But they deny the Truth when it comes to them: so they are in a confused state.
p: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.
t: bal kazzaboo bilhaqqi lammaa jaaa'ahum fahum feee amrim mareej

ar: أفلم ينظروا إلى ٱلسماء فوقهم كيف بنينها وزينها وما لها من فروج
tr: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
y: Do they not look at the sky above them?- How We have made it and adorned it, and there are no flaws in it?
p: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?
t: afalam yanzurooo ilas samaaa'i fawqahum kaifa banainaahaa wa zaiyannaahaa wa maa lahaa min furooj

ar: وٱلأرض مددنها وألقينا فيها روسى وأنبتنا فيها من كل زوج بهيج
tr: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
y: And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
p: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,
t: wal arda madadnaahaa wa alqainaa feehaa rawaasiya wa ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej

ar: تبصرة وذكرى لكل عبد منيب
tr: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].
y: To be observed and commemorated by every devotee turning (to Allah).
p: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.
t: tabsiratanw wa zikraa likulli 'abdim muneeb

ar: ونزلنا من ٱلسماء ماء مبركا فأنبتنا به جنت وحب ٱلحصيد
tr: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
y: And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
p: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
t: wa nazzalnaa minas samaaa'i maaa'am mubaarakan fa ambatnaa bihee jannaatinw wa habbal haseed

ar: وٱلنخل باسقت لها طلع نضيد
tr: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
y: And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
p: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,
t: wannakhla baasiqaatil laha tal'un nadeed

ar: رزقا للعباد وأحيينا به بلدة ميتا كذلك ٱلخروج
tr: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
y: As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
p: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.
t: rizqal lil'ibaad, wa ahyainaa bihee baldatam maitaa; kazaalikal khurooj

ar: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وأصحب ٱلرس وثمود
tr: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
y: Before them was denied (the Hereafter) by the People of Noah, the Companions of the Rass, the Thamud,
p: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,
t: kazzabat qablahum qawmu noohinw wa ashaabur rassi wa samood

ar: وعاد وفرعون وإخون لوط
tr: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
y: The 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brethren of Lut,
p: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
t: wa 'aadunw wa fir'awnu wikhwaanu loot

ar: وأصحب ٱلأيكة وقوم تبع كل كذب ٱلرسل فحق وعيد
tr: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
y: The Companions of the Wood, and the People of Tubba'; each one (of them) rejected the messengers, and My warning was duly fulfilled (in them).
p: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.
t: wa ashaabul aykati wa qawmu tubba'; kullun kazzabar rusula fahaqqa wa'eed

ar: أفعيينا بٱلخلق ٱلأول بل هم فى لبس من خلق جديد
tr: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
y: Were We then weary with the first Creation, that they should be in confused doubt about a new Creation?
p: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
t: afa'a yeenaa bilkhalqil awwal; bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed

ar: ولقد خلقنا ٱلإنسن ونعلم ما توسوس به نفسه ونحن أقرب إليه من حبل ٱلوريد
tr: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
y: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
p: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
t: wa laqad khalaqnal insaana wa na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuhoo wa nahnu aqrabu ilaihi min hablil wareed

ar: إذ يتلقى ٱلمتلقيان عن ٱليمين وعن ٱلشمال قعيد
tr: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
y: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
p: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,
t: 'iz yatalaqqal mutalaqqi yaani 'anil yameeni wa 'anish shimaali qa'eed

ar: ما يلفظ من قول إلا لديه رقيب عتيد
tr: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
y: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
p: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.
t: maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladaihi raqeebun 'ateed

ar: وجاءت سكرة ٱلموت بٱلحق ذلك ما كنت منه تحيد
tr: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
y: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
p: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.
t: wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

ar: ونفخ فى ٱلصور ذلك يوم ٱلوعيد
tr: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
y: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
p: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
t: wa nufikha fis soor; zaalika yawmul wa'eed

ar: وجاءت كل نفس معها سائق وشهيد
tr: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
y: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
p: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.
t: wa jaaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saaa'iqunw wa shaheed

ar: لقد كنت فى غفلة من هذا فكشفنا عنك غطاءك فبصرك ٱليوم حديد
tr: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
y: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
p: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
t: laqad kunta fee ghaf latim min haazaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaaa'aka fabasarukal yawma hadeed

ar: وقال قرينه هذا ما لدى عتيد
tr: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
y: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
p: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
t: wa qaala qareenuhoo haazaa maa ladaiya 'ateed

ar: ألقيا فى جهنم كل كفار عنيد
tr: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
y: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of Allah)!-
p: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
t: alqiyaa fee jahannama kulla kaffaarin 'aneed

ar: مناع للخير معتد مريب
tr: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
y: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
p: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,
t: mannaa'il lilkhayri mu'tadim mureeb

ar: ٱلذى جعل مع ٱلله إلها ءاخر فألقياه فى ٱلعذاب ٱلشديد
tr: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
y: "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
p: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
t: allazee ja'ala ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara fa alqiyaahu fil'azaabish shadeed

ar: قال قرينه ربنا ما أطغيته ولكن كان فى ضلل بعيد
tr: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
y: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
p: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
t: qaala qareenuhoo rabbanaa maaa atghaituhoo wa laakin kaana fee dalaahim ba'eed

ar: قال لا تختصموا لدى وقد قدمت إليكم بٱلوعيد
tr: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
y: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
p: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
t: qaala laa takhtasimoo ladaayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaikum bilwa'eed

ar: ما يبدل ٱلقول لدى وما أنا بظلم للعبيد
tr: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
y: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
p: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.
t: maa yubaddalul qawlu ladaiya wa maaa ana bizal laamil lil'abeed

ar: يوم نقول لجهنم هل ٱمتلأت وتقول هل من مزيد
tr: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
y: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
p: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
t: yawma naqoolu li'jahannama halim talaati wa taqoolu hal mim mazeed

ar: وأزلفت ٱلجنة للمتقين غير بعيد
tr: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
y: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
p: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
t: wa uzlifatil jannatu lil muttaqeena ghaira ba'eed

ar: هذا ما توعدون لكل أواب حفيظ
tr: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
y: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to Allah) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
p: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,
t: haaza maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez

ar: من خشى ٱلرحمن بٱلغيب وجاء بقلب منيب
tr: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
y: "Who feared (Allah) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
p: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.
t: man khashiyar rahmaana bilghaibi wa jaaa'a biqalbim muneeb

ar: ٱدخلوها بسلم ذلك يوم ٱلخلود
tr: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
y: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
p: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
t: udkhuloohaa bisalaamin zaalika yawmul khulood

ar: لهم ما يشاءون فيها ولدينا مزيد
tr: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
y: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
p: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.
t: lahum maa yashaaa'oona feehaa wa ladainaa mazeed

ar: وكم أهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم أشد منهم بطشا فنقبوا فى ٱلبلد هل من محيص
tr: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
y: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
p: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?
t: wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil bilaad, hal mim mahees

ar: إن فى ذلك لذكرى لمن كان له قلب أو ألقى ٱلسمع وهو شهيد
tr: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
y: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
p: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
t: inna fee zaalika lazikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas sam'a wa huwa shaheed

ar: ولقد خلقنا ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما فى ستة أيام وما مسنا من لغوب
tr: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
y: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
p: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
t: wa laqad khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa bainahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wa maa massanaa mil lughoob

ar: فٱصبر على ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع ٱلشمس وقبل ٱلغروب
tr: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
y: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
p: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
t: fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuloo'ish shamsi wa qablal ghuroob

ar: ومن ٱليل فسبحه وأدبر ٱلسجود
tr: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
y: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
p: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.
t: wa minal laili fasabbih hu wa adbaaras sujood

ar: وٱستمع يوم يناد ٱلمناد من مكان قريب
tr: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
y: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
p: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
t: wastami' yawma yunaa dil munaadi mim makaanin qareeb

ar: يوم يسمعون ٱلصيحة بٱلحق ذلك يوم ٱلخروج
tr: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
y: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
p: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
t: yawma yasmaoonas sai hata bilhaqq zaalika yawmul khurooj

ar: إنا نحن نحى ونميت وإلينا ٱلمصير
tr: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
y: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
p: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.
t: innaa nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa ilainal maseer

ar: يوم تشقق ٱلأرض عنهم سراعا ذلك حشر علينا يسير
tr: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
y: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
p: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
t: yawma tashaqqaqul ardu 'anhum siraa'aa; zaalika hashrun 'alainaa yaseer

ar: نحن أعلم بما يقولون وما أنت عليهم بجبار فذكر بٱلقرءان من يخاف وعيد
tr: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
y: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!
p: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
t: nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wa maaa anta 'alihim bijabbaarin fazakkir bil quraani many yakhaafu wa'eed

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلذريت ذروا
tr: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
y: By the (Winds) that scatter broadcast;
p: By those that winnow with a winnowing
t: waz-zaariyaati zarwaa

ar: فٱلحملت وقرا
tr: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
y: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
p: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
t: falhaamilaati wiqraa

ar: فٱلجريت يسرا
tr: And those [ships] sailing with ease
y: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
p: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
t: faljaariyaati yusraa

ar: فٱلمقسمت أمرا
tr: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
y: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
p: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
t: falmuqassimaati amraa

ar: إنما توعدون لصادق
tr: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
y: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
p: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
t: innamaa too'adoona la-saadiq

ar: وإن ٱلدين لوقع
tr: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
y: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
p: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
t: wa innad deena la waaqi'

ar: وٱلسماء ذات ٱلحبك
tr: By the heaven containing pathways,
y: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
p: By the heaven full of paths,
t: wassamaaa'i zaatil hubuk

ar: إنكم لفى قول مختلف
tr: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
y: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
p: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
t: innakum lafee qawlim mukhtalif

ar: يؤفك عنه من أفك
tr: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
y: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
p: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
t: yu'faku 'anhu man ufik

ar: قتل ٱلخرصون
tr: Destroyed are the falsifiers
y: Woe to the falsehood-mongers,-
p: Accursed be the conjecturers
t: qutilal kharraasoon

ar: ٱلذين هم فى غمرة ساهون
tr: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
y: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
p: Who are careless in an abyss!
t: allazeena hum fee ghamratin saahoon

ar: يسـلون أيان يوم ٱلدين
tr: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
y: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
p: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
t: yas'aloona ayyaana yawmud deen

ar: يوم هم على ٱلنار يفتنون
tr: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
y: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
p: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
t: yawma hum 'alan naari yuftanoon

ar: ذوقوا فتنتكم هذا ٱلذى كنتم به تستعجلون
tr: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
y: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
p: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
t: zooqoo fitnatakum haa zal lazee kuntum bihee tas ta'jiloon

ar: إن ٱلمتقين فى جنت وعيون
tr: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
y: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
p: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
t: innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

ar: ءاخذين ما ءاتىهم ربهم إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك محسنين
tr: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
y: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
p: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
t: aakhizeena maaa aataahum rabbuhum; innahum kaanoo qabla zaalika muhsineen

ar: كانوا قليلا من ٱليل ما يهجعون
tr: They used to sleep but little of the night,
y: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
p: They used to sleep but little of the night,
t: kaanoo qaleelam minal laili maa yahja'oon

ar: وبٱلأسحار هم يستغفرون
tr: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
y: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
p: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
t: wa bilashaari hum yastaghfiroon

ar: وفى أمولهم حق للسائل وٱلمحروم
tr: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
y: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
p: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
t: wa feee amwaalihim haqqul lissaaa'ili walmahroom

ar: وفى ٱلأرض ءايت للموقنين
tr: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
y: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
p: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
t: wa fil ardi aayaatul lilmooqineen

ar: وفى أنفسكم أفلا تبصرون
tr: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
y: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
p: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
t: wa feee anfusikum; afalaa tubsiroon

ar: وفى ٱلسماء رزقكم وما توعدون
tr: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
y: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
p: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
t: wa fissamaaa'i rizqukum wa maa too'adoon

ar: فورب ٱلسماء وٱلأرض إنه لحق مثل ما أنكم تنطقون
tr: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
y: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
p: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
t: fawa rabbis samaaa'i wal ardi innahoo lahaqqum misla maa annakum tantiqoon

ar: هل أتىك حديث ضيف إبرهيم ٱلمكرمين
tr: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
y: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
p: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
t: hal ataaka hadeesu daifi ibraaheemal mukrameen

ar: إذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلما قال سلم قوم منكرون
tr: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
y: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
p: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
t: iz dakhaloo 'alaihi faqaaloo salaaman qaala salaamun qawmum munkaroon

ar: فراغ إلى أهله فجاء بعجل سمين
tr: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
y: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
p: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
t: faraagha ilaaa ahlihee fajaaa'a bi'ijlin sameen

ar: فقربه إليهم قال ألا تأكلون
tr: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
y: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
p: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
t: faqarrabahooo ilaihim qaala alaa taakuloon

ar: فأوجس منهم خيفة قالوا لا تخف وبشروه بغلم عليم
tr: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
y: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
p: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
t: fa awjasa minhm khee fatan qaaloo laa takhaf wa bashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem

ar: فأقبلت ٱمرأته فى صرة فصكت وجهها وقالت عجوز عقيم
tr: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
y: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
p: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
t: fa aqbalatim ra-atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa wa qaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem

ar: قالوا كذلك قال ربك إنه هو ٱلحكيم ٱلعليم
tr: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
y: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
p: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
t: qaaloo kazaaliki qaala rabbuki innahoo huwal hakeemul 'aleem

ar: قال فما خطبكم أيها ٱلمرسلون
tr: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
y: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
p: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
t: qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal mursaloon

ar: قالوا إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم مجرمين
tr: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
y: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
p: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
t: qaalooo innaaa ursilnaaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen

ar: لنرسل عليهم حجارة من طين
tr: To send down upon them stones of clay,
y: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
p: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
t: linursila 'alaihim hijaa ratam min teen

ar: مسومة عند ربك للمسرفين
tr: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
y: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
p: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
t: musawwamatan 'inda rabbika lilmusrifeen

ar: فأخرجنا من كان فيها من ٱلمؤمنين
tr: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
y: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
p: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
t: fa akhrajnaa man kaana feehaa minal mu'mineen

ar: فما وجدنا فيها غير بيت من ٱلمسلمين
tr: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
y: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
p: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
t: famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghaira baitim minal muslimeen

ar: وتركنا فيها ءاية للذين يخافون ٱلعذاب ٱلأليم
tr: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
y: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
p: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
t: wa taraknaa feehaaa aayatal lillazeena yakhaafoonal 'azaabal aleem

ar: وفى موسى إذ أرسلنه إلى فرعون بسلطن مبين
tr: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
y: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
p: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
t: wa fee moosaaa iz arsalnaahu ilaa fir'wna bisultaa nim mubeen

ar: فتولى بركنه وقال سحر أو مجنون
tr: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
y: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
p: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
t: fatawalla biruknihee wa qaala saahirun aw majnoon

ar: فأخذنه وجنوده فنبذنهم فى ٱليم وهو مليم
tr: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
y: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
p: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
t: fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi wa huwa muleem

ar: وفى عاد إذ أرسلنا عليهم ٱلريح ٱلعقيم
tr: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
y: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
p: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
t: wa fee 'aadin iz arsalnaa 'alaihimur reehal'aqeem

ar: ما تذر من شىء أتت عليه إلا جعلته كٱلرميم
tr: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
y: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
p: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
t: maa tazaru min shai'in atat 'alaihi illaa ja'alat hu karrameem

ar: وفى ثمود إذ قيل لهم تمتعوا حتى حين
tr: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
y: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
p: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
t: wa fee samooda iz qeela lahum tamatta''oo hattaa heen

ar: فعتوا عن أمر ربهم فأخذتهم ٱلصعقة وهم ينظرون
tr: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
y: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
p: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
t: fa'ataw 'an amri rabbihim fa akhazal humus saa'iqatu wa hum yanzuroon

ar: فما ٱستطعوا من قيام وما كانوا منتصرين
tr: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
y: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
p: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
t: famas tataa'oo min qiyaaminw wa maa kaanoo muntasireen

ar: وقوم نوح من قبل إنهم كانوا قوما فسقين
tr: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
y: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
p: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
t: wa qawma noohim min qablu innahum kaano qawman faasiqeen

ar: وٱلسماء بنينها بأييد وإنا لموسعون
tr: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
y: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of pace.
p: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
t: wassamaaa'a banainaa haa bi aydinw wa innaa lamoosi'oon

ar: وٱلأرض فرشنها فنعم ٱلمهدون
tr: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
y: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
p: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
t: wal arda farashnaahaa fani'mal maahidoon

ar: ومن كل شىء خلقنا زوجين لعلكم تذكرون
tr: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
y: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
p: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
t: wa min kulli shai'in khalaqnaa zawjaini la'allakum tazakkaroon

ar: ففروا إلى ٱلله إنى لكم منه نذير مبين
tr: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
y: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
p: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
t: fafirrooo ilal laahi innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

ar: ولا تجعلوا مع ٱلله إلها ءاخر إنى لكم منه نذير مبين
tr: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
y: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
p: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
t: wa laa taj'aloo ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhara innee lakum minhu nazeerum mubeen

ar: كذلك ما أتى ٱلذين من قبلهم من رسول إلا قالوا ساحر أو مجنون
tr: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
y: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
p: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
t: kazaalika maaa atal lazeena min qablihim mir rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon

ar: أتواصوا به بل هم قوم طاغون
tr: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
y: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
p: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.
t: atawaasaw bih; bal hum qawmun taaghoon

ar: فتول عنهم فما أنت بملوم
tr: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
y: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
p: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
t: fatawalla 'anhum famaaa anta bimaloom

ar: وذكر فإن ٱلذكرى تنفع ٱلمؤمنين
tr: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
y: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
p: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
t: wa zakkir fa innaz zikraa tanfa'ul mu'mineen

ar: وما خلقت ٱلجن وٱلإنس إلا ليعبدون
tr: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
y: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
p: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
t: wa maa khalaqtul jinna wal insa illaa liya'budoon

ar: ما أريد منهم من رزق وما أريد أن يطعمون
tr: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
y: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
p: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
t: maaa ureedu minhum mir rizqinw wa maaa ureedu anyyut'imoon

ar: إن ٱلله هو ٱلرزاق ذو ٱلقوة ٱلمتين
tr: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
y: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
p: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
t: innal laaha huwar razzaaqu zul quwwatil mateen

ar: فإن للذين ظلموا ذنوبا مثل ذنوب أصحبهم فلا يستعجلون
tr: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
y: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
p: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
t: fa inna lillazeena zalamoo zanoobam misla zanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon

ar: فويل للذين كفروا من يومهم ٱلذى يوعدون
tr: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
y: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
p: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
t: fawailul lillazeena kafaroo miny yawmihimul lazee yoo'adoon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلطور
tr: By the mount
y: By the Mount (of Revelation);
p: By the Mount,
t: wat-toor

ar: وكتب مسطور
tr: And [by] a Book inscribed
y: By a Decree inscribed
p: And a Scripture inscribed
t: wa kitaabim mastoor

ar: فى رق منشور
tr: In parchment spread open
y: In a Scroll unfolded;
p: On fine parchment unrolled,
t: fee raqqim manshoor

ar: وٱلبيت ٱلمعمور
tr: And [by] the frequented House
y: By the much-frequented Fane;
p: And the House frequented,
t: wal baitil ma'moor

ar: وٱلسقف ٱلمرفوع
tr: And [by] the heaven raised high
y: By the Canopy Raised High;
p: And the roof exalted,
t: wassaqfil marfoo'

ar: وٱلبحر ٱلمسجور
tr: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
y: And by the Ocean filled with Swell;-
p: And the sea kept filled,
t: wal bahril masjoor

ar: إن عذاب ربك لوقع
tr: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
y: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass;-
p: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
t: inna 'azaaba rabbika lawaaqi'

ar: ما له من دافع
tr: Of it there is no preventer.
y: There is none can avert it;-
p: There is none that can ward it off.
t: maa lahoo min daafi'

ar: يوم تمور ٱلسماء مورا
tr: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
y: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion.
p: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
t: yawma tamoorus samaaa'u mawraa

ar: وتسير ٱلجبال سيرا
tr: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
y: And the mountains will fly hither and thither.
p: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,
t: wa taseerul jibaalu sairaa

ar: فويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
y: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood;-
p: Then woe that day unto the deniers
t: fawailuny yawma 'izil lil mukaazzibeen

ar: ٱلذين هم فى خوض يلعبون
tr: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
y: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles.
p: Who play in talk of grave matters;
t: allazeena hum fee khawdiny yal'aboon

ar: يوم يدعون إلى نار جهنم دعا
tr: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
y: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly.
p: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
t: yawma yuda'-'oona ilaa naari jahannama da'-'aa

ar: هذه ٱلنار ٱلتى كنتم بها تكذبون
tr: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
y: "This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny!
p: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
t: haazihin naarul latee kuntum bihaa tukazziboon

ar: أفسحر هذا أم أنتم لا تبصرون
tr: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
y: "Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see?
p: Is this magic, or do ye not see?
t: afasihrun haazaaaa am antum laa tubsiroon

ar: ٱصلوها فٱصبروا أو لا تصبروا سواء عليكم إنما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
tr: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
y: "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
p: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
t: islawhaa fasbirooo aw laa tasbiroo sawaaa'un 'alaikum innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon

ar: إن ٱلمتقين فى جنت ونعيم
tr: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
y: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness,-
p: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
t: innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa na'eem

ar: فكهين بما ءاتىهم ربهم ووقىهم ربهم عذاب ٱلجحيم
tr: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
y: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
p: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
t: faakiheena bimaaa aataahum rabbuhum wa waqaahum rabbuhum 'azaabal jaheem

ar: كلوا وٱشربوا هنيـا بما كنتم تعملون
tr: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
y: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds."
p: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,
t: kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

ar: متكـين على سرر مصفوفة وزوجنهم بحور عين
tr: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
y: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes.
p: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
t: muttaki'eena 'alaa sururim masfoofatinw wa zawwaj naahum bihoorin 'een

ar: وٱلذين ءامنوا وٱتبعتهم ذريتهم بإيمن ألحقنا بهم ذريتهم وما ألتنهم من عملهم من شىء كل ٱمرئ بما كسب رهين
tr: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
y: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds.
p: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.
t: wallazeena aamanoo wattaba'at hum zurriyyatuhum bieemaanin alhaqnaa bihim zurriyyatahum wa maaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shai'; kullum ri'im bimaa kasaba raheen

ar: وأمددنهم بفكهة ولحم مما يشتهون
tr: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
y: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
p: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
t: wa amdadnaahum bifaa kihatinw wa lahmim mimmaa yashtahoon

ar: يتنزعون فيها كأسا لا لغو فيها ولا تأثيم
tr: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
y: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
p: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
t: yatanaaza'oona feehaa kaasal laa laghwun feehaa wa laa taaseem

ar: ويطوف عليهم غلمان لهم كأنهم لؤلؤ مكنون
tr: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
y: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
p: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
t: wa yatoofu 'alaihim ghilmaanul lahum ka annahum lu'lu'um maknoon

ar: وأقبل بعضهم على بعض يتساءلون
tr: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
y: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
p: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
t: wa aqbala ba'duhum 'alaa ba'diny yatasaaa'aloon

ar: قالوا إنا كنا قبل فى أهلنا مشفقين
tr: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
y: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people.
p: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
t: qaalooo innaa kunnaa qablu feee ahlinaa mushfiqeen

ar: فمن ٱلله علينا ووقىنا عذاب ٱلسموم
tr: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
y: "But Allah has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind.
p: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
t: famannnal laahu 'alainaa wa waqaanaa 'azaabas samoom

ar: إنا كنا من قبل ندعوه إنه هو ٱلبر ٱلرحيم
tr: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
y: "Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful!"
p: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.
t: innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'oohu innahoo huwal barrur raheem

ar: فذكر فما أنت بنعمت ربك بكاهن ولا مجنون
tr: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
y: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed.
p: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
t: fazakkir famaaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahininw wa laa majnoon

ar: أم يقولون شاعر نتربص به ريب ٱلمنون
tr: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
y: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time!"
p: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
t: am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raibal manoon

ar: قل تربصوا فإنى معكم من ٱلمتربصين
tr: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
y: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you!"
p: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
t: qul tarabbasoo fa innee ma'akum minal mutarabbiseen

ar: أم تأمرهم أحلمهم بهذا أم هم قوم طاغون
tr: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
y: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
p: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?
t: am taamuruhum ahlaamuhum bihaazaaa am hum qawmun taaghoon

ar: أم يقولون تقوله بل لا يؤمنون
tr: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
y: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith!
p: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!
t: am yaqooloona taqawwalah; bal laa yu'minoon

ar: فليأتوا بحديث مثله إن كانوا صدقين
tr: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
y: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth!
p: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.
t: falyaatoo bihadeesim misliheee in kaanoo saadiqeen

ar: أم خلقوا من غير شىء أم هم ٱلخلقون
tr: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
y: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
p: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
t: am khuliqoo min ghairi shai'in am humul khaaliqoon

ar: أم خلقوا ٱلسموت وٱلأرض بل لا يوقنون
tr: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
y: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief.
p: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
t: am khalaqus samaawaati wal ard; bal laa yooqinoon

ar: أم عندهم خزائن ربك أم هم ٱلمصيطرون
tr: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
y: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)?
p: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?
t: am'indahum khazaaa'inu rabbika am humul musaitiroon

ar: أم لهم سلم يستمعون فيه فليأت مستمعهم بسلطن مبين
tr: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
y: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof.
p: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
t: am lahum sullamuny yastami'oona feehi falyaati mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen

ar: أم له ٱلبنت ولكم ٱلبنون
tr: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
y: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons?
p: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?
t: am lahul banaatu wa lakumul banoon

ar: أم تسـلهم أجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
tr: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
y: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
p: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?
t: am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon

ar: أم عندهم ٱلغيب فهم يكتبون
tr: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
y: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?
p: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?
t: am 'indahumul ghaibu fahum yaktuboon

ar: أم يريدون كيدا فٱلذين كفروا هم ٱلمكيدون
tr: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
y: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot!
p: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
t: am yureedoona kaidan fallazeena kafaroo humul makeedoon

ar: أم لهم إله غير ٱلله سبحن ٱلله عما يشركون
tr: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
y: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him!
p: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
t: am lahum ilaahun ghairul laa; subhaanal laahi 'ammaa yushrikoon

ar: وإن يروا كسفا من ٱلسماء ساقطا يقولوا سحاب مركوم
tr: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
y: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
p: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
t: wa iny yaraw kisfam minas samaaa'i saaqitany yaqooloo sahaabum markoom

ar: فذرهم حتى يلقوا يومهم ٱلذى فيه يصعقون
tr: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
y: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-
p: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
t: fazarhum hatta yulaaqoo yawmahumul lazee feehi yus'aqoon

ar: يوم لا يغنى عنهم كيدهم شيـا ولا هم ينصرون
tr: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
y: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.
p: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
t: yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kaidumhum shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

ar: وإن للذين ظلموا عذابا دون ذلك ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون
tr: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
y: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
p: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
t: wa inna lillazeena zalamoo 'azaaban doona zalika wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

ar: وٱصبر لحكم ربك فإنك بأعيننا وسبح بحمد ربك حين تقوم
tr: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
y: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
p: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
t: wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa innaka bi-a'yuninaa wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom

ar: ومن ٱليل فسبحه وإدبر ٱلنجوم
tr: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
y: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!
p: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
t: wa minal laili fasabbihhu wa idbaaran nujoom

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلنجم إذا هوى
tr: By the star when it descends,
y: By the Star when it goes down,-
p: By the Star when it setteth,
t: wannajmi izaa hawaa

ar: ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوى
tr: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
y: Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled.
p: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;
t: maa dalla saahibukum wa maa ghawaa

ar: وما ينطق عن ٱلهوى
tr: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
y: Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire.
p: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
t: wa maa yyantiqu 'anilhawaaa

ar: إن هو إلا وحى يوحى
tr: It is not but a revelation revealed,
y: It is no less than inspiration sent down to him:
p: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,
t: in huwa illaa wahyuny yoohaa

ar: علمه شديد ٱلقوى
tr: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
y: He was taught by one Mighty in Power,
p: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,
t: 'allamahoo shadeedul quwaa

ar: ذو مرة فٱستوى
tr: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
y: Endued with Wisdom: for he appeared (in stately form);
p: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
t: zoo mirratin fastawaa

ar: وهو بٱلأفق ٱلأعلى
tr: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
y: While he was in the highest part of the horizon:
p: When he was on the uppermost horizon.
t: wa huwa bil ufuqil a'laa

ar: ثم دنا فتدلى
tr: Then he approached and descended
y: Then he approached and came closer,
p: Then he drew nigh and came down
t: summa danaa fatadalla

ar: فكان قاب قوسين أو أدنى
tr: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
y: And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer;
p: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,
t: fakaana qaaba qawsaini aw adnaa

ar: فأوحى إلى عبده ما أوحى
tr: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
y: So did (Allah) convey the inspiration to His Servant- (conveyed) what He (meant) to convey.
p: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.
t: fa awhaaa ilaa 'abdihee maaa awhaa

ar: ما كذب ٱلفؤاد ما رأى
tr: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
y: The (Prophet's) (mind and) heart in no way falsified that which he saw.
p: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.
t: maa kazabal fu'aadu maa ra aa

ar: أفتمرونه على ما يرى
tr: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
y: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he saw?
p: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?
t: afatumaaroonahoo 'alaa maayaraa

ar: ولقد رءاه نزلة أخرى
tr: And he certainly saw him in another descent
y: For indeed he saw him at a second descent,
p: And verily he saw him yet another time
t: wa laqad ra aahu nazlatan ukhraa

ar: عند سدرة ٱلمنتهى
tr: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
y: Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass:
p: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,
t: 'inda sidratil muntaha

ar: عندها جنة ٱلمأوى
tr: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
y: Near it is the Garden of Abode.
p: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.
t: 'indahaa jannatul maawaa

ar: إذ يغشى ٱلسدرة ما يغشى
tr: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
y: Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable!)
p: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
t: iz yaghshas sidrata maa yaghshaa

ar: ما زاغ ٱلبصر وما طغى
tr: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
y: (His) sight never swerved, nor did it go wrong!
p: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.
t: maa zaaghal basaru wa maa taghaa

ar: لقد رأى من ءايت ربه ٱلكبرى
tr: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
y: For truly did he see, of the Signs of his Lord, the Greatest!
p: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.
t: laqad ra aa min aayaati rabbihil kubraaa

ar: أفرءيتم ٱللت وٱلعزى
tr: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
y: Have ye seen Lat. and 'Uzza,
p: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza
t: afara'aytumul laata wal 'uzzaa

ar: ومنوة ٱلثالثة ٱلأخرى
tr: And Manat, the third - the other one?
y: And another, the third (goddess), Manat?
p: And Manat, the third, the other?
t: wa manaatas saalisatal ukhraa

ar: ألكم ٱلذكر وله ٱلأنثى
tr: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
y: What! for you the male sex, and for Him, the female?
p: Are yours the males and His the females?
t: a-lakumuz zakaru wa lahul unsaa

ar: تلك إذا قسمة ضيزى
tr: That, then, is an unjust division.
y: Behold, such would be indeed a division most unfair!
p: That indeed were an unfair division!
t: tilka izan qismatun deezaa

ar: إن هى إلا أسماء سميتموها أنتم وءاباؤكم ما أنزل ٱلله بها من سلطن إن يتبعون إلا ٱلظن وما تهوى ٱلأنفس ولقد جاءهم من ربهم ٱلهدى
tr: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
y: These are nothing but names which ye have devised,- ye and your fathers,- for which Allah has sent down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire!- Even though there has already come to them Guidance from their Lord!
p: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
t: in hiya illaaa asmaaa'un sammaitumoohaaa antum wa aabaaa'ukum maaa anzalal laahu bihaa min sultaan; inyyattabi'oona illaz zanna wa maa tahwal anfusu wa laqad jaaa'ahum mir rabbihimul hudaa

ar: أم للإنسن ما تمنى
tr: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
y: Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after?
p: Or shall man have what he coveteth?
t: am lil insaani maa taman naa

ar: فلله ٱلءاخرة وٱلأولى
tr: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
y: But it is to Allah that the End and the Beginning (of all things) belong.
p: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.
t: falillaahil aakhiratu wal oolaa

ar: وكم من ملك فى ٱلسموت لا تغنى شفعتهم شيـا إلا من بعد أن يأذن ٱلله لمن يشاء ويرضى
tr: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
y: How many-so-ever be the angels in the heavens, their intercession will avail nothing except after Allah has given leave for whom He pleases and that he is acceptable to Him.
p: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.
t: wa kam mim malakin fissamaawaati laa tughnee shafaa'atuhum shai'an illaa mim ba'di anyyaazanal laahu limany yashaaa'u wa yardaa

ar: إن ٱلذين لا يؤمنون بٱلءاخرة ليسمون ٱلملئكة تسمية ٱلأنثى
tr: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
y: Those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.
p: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
t: innal lazeena laa yu'minoona bil aakhirati la yusammoonal malaaa'ikata tasmiyatal unsaa

ar: وما لهم به من علم إن يتبعون إلا ٱلظن وإن ٱلظن لا يغنى من ٱلحق شيـا
tr: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
y: But they have no knowledge therein. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails nothing against Truth.
p: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.
t: wa maa lahum bihee min 'ilmin iny yattabi'oona illaz zanna wa innaz zanna laa yughnee minal haqqi shai'aa

ar: فأعرض عن من تولى عن ذكرنا ولم يرد إلا ٱلحيوة ٱلدنيا
tr: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
y: Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world.
p: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
t: fa a'rid 'am man tawallaa 'an zikrinaa wa lam yurid illal hayaatad dunyaa

ar: ذلك مبلغهم من ٱلعلم إن ربك هو أعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو أعلم بمن ٱهتدى
tr: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
y: That is as far as knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth best those who receive guidance.
p: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.
t: zalika mablaghuhum minal 'ilm; inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabee lihee wa huwa a'lamu bimanih tadaa

ar: ولله ما فى ٱلسموت وما فى ٱلأرض ليجزى ٱلذين أسـوا بما عملوا ويجزى ٱلذين أحسنوا بٱلحسنى
tr: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
y: Yea, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: so that He rewards those who do evil, according to their deeds, and He rewards those who do good, with what is best.
p: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.
t: wa lillaahi maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi liyajziyal lazeena asaaa'oo bimaa 'amiloo wa yajziyal lazeena ahsanoo bilhusnaa

ar: ٱلذين يجتنبون كبئر ٱلإثم وٱلفوحش إلا ٱللمم إن ربك وسع ٱلمغفرة هو أعلم بكم إذ أنشأكم من ٱلأرض وإذ أنتم أجنة فى بطون أمهتكم فلا تزكوا أنفسكم هو أعلم بمن ٱتقى
tr: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
y: Those who avoid great sins and shameful deeds, only (falling into) small faults,- verily thy Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you well when He brings you out of the earth, And when ye are hidden in your mothers' wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves: He knows best who it is that guards against evil.
p: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).
t: allazeena yajtaniboona kabaaa'iral ismi walfawaa hisha illal lamam; inna rabbaka waasi'ul maghfirah; huwa a'lamu bikum iz ansha akum minal ardi wa iz antum ajinnatun fee butooni umma haatikum falaa tuzakkooo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimanit taqaa

ar: أفرءيت ٱلذى تولى
tr: Have you seen the one who turned away
y: Seest thou one who turns back,
p: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,
t: afara'ayatal lazee tawallaa

ar: وأعطى قليلا وأكدى
tr: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
y: Gives a little, then hardens (his heart)?
p: And gave a little, then was grudging?
t: wa a'taa qaleelanw wa akdaa

ar: أعنده علم ٱلغيب فهو يرى
tr: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
y: What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see?
p: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?
t: a'indahoo 'ilmul ghaibi fahuwa yaraa

ar: أم لم ينبأ بما فى صحف موسى
tr: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
y: Nay, is he not acquainted with what is in the Books of Moses-
p: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
t: am lam yunabbaa bimaa fee suhuhfi moosa

ar: وإبرهيم ٱلذى وفى
tr: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
y: And of Abraham who fulfilled his engagements?-
p: And Abraham who paid his debt:
t: wa ibraaheemal lazee waffaaa

ar: ألا تزر وازرة وزر أخرى
tr: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
y: Namely, that no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another;
p: That no laden one shall bear another's load,
t: allaa taziru waaziratunw wizra ukhraa

ar: وأن ليس للإنسن إلا ما سعى
tr: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
y: That man can have nothing but what he strives for;
p: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,
t: wa al laisa lil insaani illaa maa sa'aa

ar: وأن سعيه سوف يرى
tr: And that his effort is going to be seen -
y: That (the fruit of) his striving will soon come in sight:
p: And that his effort will be seen.
t: wa anna sa'yahoo sawfa yuraa

ar: ثم يجزىه ٱلجزاء ٱلأوفى
tr: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
y: Then will he be rewarded with a reward complete;
p: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;
t: summa yujzaahul jazaaa 'al awfaa

ar: وأن إلى ربك ٱلمنتهى
tr: And that to your Lord is the finality
y: That to thy Lord is the final Goal;
p: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;
t: wa anna ilaa rabbikal muntahaa

ar: وأنه هو أضحك وأبكى
tr: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
y: That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears;
p: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,
t: wa annahoo huwa adhaka wa abkaa

ar: وأنه هو أمات وأحيا
tr: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
y: That it is He Who granteth Death and Life;
p: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;
t: wa annahoo huwa amaata wa ahyaa

ar: وأنه خلق ٱلزوجين ٱلذكر وٱلأنثى
tr: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
y: That He did create in pairs,- male and female,
p: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
t: wa annahoo khalaqaz zawjainiz zakara wal unsaa

ar: من نطفة إذا تمنى
tr: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
y: From a seed when lodged (in its place);
p: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;
t: min nutfatin izaa tumnaa

ar: وأن عليه ٱلنشأة ٱلأخرى
tr: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
y: That He hath promised a Second Creation (Raising of the Dead);
p: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;
t: wa anna 'alaihin nash atal ukhraa

ar: وأنه هو أغنى وأقنى
tr: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
y: That it is He Who giveth wealth and satisfaction;
p: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;
t: wa annahoo huwa aghnaa wa aqnaa

ar: وأنه هو رب ٱلشعرى
tr: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
y: That He is the Lord of Sirius (the Mighty Star);
p: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;
t: wa annahoo huwa rabbush shi'raa

ar: وأنه أهلك عادا ٱلأولى
tr: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
y: And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) ancient 'Ad (people),
p: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,
t: wa annahooo ahlak a 'aadanil oolaa

ar: وثمودا فما أبقى
tr: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
y: And the Thamud nor gave them a lease of perpetual life.
p: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;
t: wa samooda famaaa abqaa

ar: وقوم نوح من قبل إنهم كانوا هم أظلم وأطغى
tr: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
y: And before them, the people of Noah, for that they were (all) most unjust and most insolent transgressors,
p: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;
t: wa qawma noohim min qablu innahum kaanoo hum azlama wa atghaa

ar: وٱلمؤتفكة أهوى
tr: And the overturned towns He hurled down
y: And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah).
p: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
t: wal mu'tafikata ahwaa

ar: فغشىها ما غشى
tr: And covered them by that which He covered.
y: So that (ruins unknown) have covered them up.
p: So that there covered them that which did cover.
t: faghashshaahaa maa ghashshaa

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربك تتمارى
tr: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
y: Then which of the gifts of thy Lord, (O man,) wilt thou dispute about?
p: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbika tatamaaraa

ar: هذا نذير من ٱلنذر ٱلأولى
tr: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
y: This is a Warner, of the (series of) Warners of old!
p: This is a warner of the warners of old.
t: haazaa nazeerum minan nuzuril oolaa

ar: أزفت ٱلءازفة
tr: The Approaching Day has approached.
y: The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh:
p: The threatened Hour is nigh.
t: azifatil laazifah

ar: ليس لها من دون ٱلله كاشفة
tr: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.
y: No (soul) but Allah can lay it bare.
p: None beside Allah can disclose it.
t: laisa lahaa min doonil laahi kaashifah

ar: أفمن هذا ٱلحديث تعجبون
tr: Then at this statement do you wonder?
y: Do ye then wonder at this recital?
p: Marvel ye then at this statement,
t: afamin hazal hadeesi ta'jaboon

ar: وتضحكون ولا تبكون
tr: And you laugh and do not weep
y: And will ye laugh and not weep,-
p: And laugh and not weep,
t: wa tadhakoona wa laa tabkoon

ar: وأنتم سمدون
tr: While you are proudly sporting?
y: Wasting your time in vanities?
p: While ye amuse yourselves?
t: wa antum saamidoon

ar: فٱسجدوا لله وٱعبدوا
tr: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
y: But fall ye down in prostration to Allah, and adore (Him)!
p: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.
t: fasjudoo lillaahi wa'budoo

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ٱقتربت ٱلساعة وٱنشق ٱلقمر
tr: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
y: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
p: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
t: iqtarabatis saa'atu wsan shaqqal qamar

ar: وإن يروا ءاية يعرضوا ويقولوا سحر مستمر
tr: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
y: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."
p: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
t: wa iny yaraw aayatany yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrum mustamirr

ar: وكذبوا وٱتبعوا أهواءهم وكل أمر مستقر
tr: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
y: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
p: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
t: wa kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; wa kullu amrim mustaqirr

ar: ولقد جاءهم من ٱلأنباء ما فيه مزدجر
tr: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
y: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),
p: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,
t: wa laqad jaaa'ahum minal ambaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar

ar: حكمة بلغة فما تغن ٱلنذر
tr: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
y: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
p: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
t: hikmatum baalighatun famaa tughnin nuzur

ar: فتول عنهم يوم يدع ٱلداع إلى شىء نكر
tr: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
y: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,
p: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
t: fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai 'in nukur

ar: خشعا أبصرهم يخرجون من ٱلأجداث كأنهم جراد منتشر
tr: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
y: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
p: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
t: khushsha'an absaaruhum yakrujoona minal ajdaasi ka annahum jaraadum muntashir

ar: مهطعين إلى ٱلداع يقول ٱلكفرون هذا يوم عسر
tr: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
y: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.
p: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
t: muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir

ar: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح فكذبوا عبدنا وقالوا مجنون وٱزدجر
tr: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
y: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their messenger): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.
p: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
t: kazzabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoo nunw wazdujir

ar: فدعا ربه أنى مغلوب فٱنتصر
tr: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
y: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
p: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
t: fada'aa rabbahooo annee maghloobun fantasir

ar: ففتحنا أبوب ٱلسماء بماء منهمر
tr: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
y: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.
p: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
t: fafatahnaaa abwaabas sa maaa'i bimaa'im munhamir

ar: وفجرنا ٱلأرض عيونا فٱلتقى ٱلماء على أمر قد قدر
tr: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
y: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.
p: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.
t: wa fajjamal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir

ar: وحملنه على ذات ألوح ودسر
tr: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
y: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm-fibre:
p: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,
t: wa hamalnaahu 'alaa zaati alwaahinw wa dusur

ar: تجرى بأعيننا جزاء لمن كان كفر
tr: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
y: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!
p: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
t: tajree bi a'yuninaa jazaaa 'al liman kaana kufir

ar: ولقد تركنها ءاية فهل من مدكر
tr: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
y: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?
p: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?
t: wa laqat taraknaahaad aayatan fahal mim muddakir

ar: فكيف كان عذابى ونذر
tr: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
y: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?
p: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
t: fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ar: ولقد يسرنا ٱلقرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
tr: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
y: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
p: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
t: wa laqad yassamal quraana liz zikri fahal mimmuddakir

ar: كذبت عاد فكيف كان عذابى ونذر
tr: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
y: The 'Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?
p: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
t: kazzabat 'aadun fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ar: إنا أرسلنا عليهم ريحا صرصرا فى يوم نحس مستمر
tr: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
y: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,
p: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
t: innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsim mustamirr

ar: تنزع ٱلناس كأنهم أعجاز نخل منقعر
tr: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
y: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).
p: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
t: tanzi;un naasa ka anna huma'jaazu nakhlim munqa'ir

ar: فكيف كان عذابى ونذر
tr: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
y: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
p: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
t: 'fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ar: ولقد يسرنا ٱلقرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
tr: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
y: But We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
p: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
t: wa laqad yassamal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ar: كذبت ثمود بٱلنذر
tr: Thamud denied the warning
