y: The Thamud (also) rejected (their) Warners.
p: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings
t: kazzabat samoodu binnuzur

ar: فقالوا أبشرا منا وحدا نتبعه إنا إذا لفى ضلل وسعر
tr: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
y: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!
p: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
t: faqaalooo a-basharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw wa su'ur

ar: أءلقى ٱلذكر عليه من بيننا بل هو كذاب أشر
tr: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
y: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"
p: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
t: 'a-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi mim baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir

ar: سيعلمون غدا من ٱلكذاب ٱلأشر
tr: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
y: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!
p: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.
t: sa-ya'lamoona ghadam manil kazzaabul ashir

ar: إنا مرسلوا ٱلناقة فتنة لهم فٱرتقبهم وٱصطبر
tr: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
y: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!
p: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
t: innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir

ar: ونبئهم أن ٱلماء قسمة بينهم كل شرب محتضر
tr: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
y: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one's right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).
p: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.
t: wa nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatum bainahum kullu shirbim muhtadar

ar: فنادوا صاحبهم فتعاطى فعقر
tr: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
y: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).
p: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
t: fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa'aqar

ar: فكيف كان عذابى ونذر
tr: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
y: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
p: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
t: fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur

ar: إنا أرسلنا عليهم صيحة وحدة فكانوا كهشيم ٱلمحتظر
tr: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
y: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.
p: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.
t: innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaano kahasheemil muhtazir

ar: ولقد يسرنا ٱلقرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
tr: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
y: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
p: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
t: wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ar: كذبت قوم لوط بٱلنذر
tr: The people of Lot denied the warning.
y: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.
p: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
t: kazzabat qawmu lootim binnuzur

ar: إنا أرسلنا عليهم حاصبا إلا ءال لوط نجينهم بسحر
tr: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
y: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut's household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-
p: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
t: innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala loot najjainaahum bisahar

ar: نعمة من عندنا كذلك نجزى من شكر
tr: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
y: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.
p: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
t: ni'matam min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar

ar: ولقد أنذرهم بطشتنا فتماروا بٱلنذر
tr: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
y: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.
p: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.
t: wa laqad anzarahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw binnuzur

ar: ولقد رودوه عن ضيفه فطمسنا أعينهم فذوقوا عذابى ونذر
tr: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
y: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
p: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
t: wa laqad raawadoohu 'andaifee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

ar: ولقد صبحهم بكرة عذاب مستقر
tr: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
y: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
p: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
t: wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan 'azaabum mustaqirr

ar: فذوقوا عذابى ونذر
tr: So taste My punishment and warning.
y: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
p: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!
t: fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur

ar: ولقد يسرنا ٱلقرءان للذكر فهل من مدكر
tr: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
y: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
p: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
t: wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir

ar: ولقد جاء ءال فرعون ٱلنذر
tr: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
y: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from Allah).
p: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh
t: wa laqad jaaa'a aala fir'awnan nuzur

ar: كذبوا بـايتنا كلها فأخذنهم أخذ عزيز مقتدر
tr: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
y: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.
p: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.
t: kazzaboo bi aayaatinaa kullihaa fa akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir

ar: أكفاركم خير من أولئكم أم لكم براءة فى ٱلزبر
tr: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
y: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?
p: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?
t: akuffaarukum khairum min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz zubur

ar: أم يقولون نحن جميع منتصر
tr: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
y: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?
p: Or say they: We are a host victorious?
t: am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'um muntasir

ar: سيهزم ٱلجمع ويولون ٱلدبر
tr: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
y: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
p: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.
t: sa yuhzamul jam'u wa yuwalloonad dubur

ar: بل ٱلساعة موعدهم وٱلساعة أدهى وأمر
tr: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
y: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter.
p: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).
t: balis saa'atu maw'iduhum was saa'atu adhaa wa amarr

ar: إن ٱلمجرمين فى ضلل وسعر
tr: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
y: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.
p: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
t: innal mujrimeena fee dalaalinw wa su'ur

ar: يوم يسحبون فى ٱلنار على وجوههم ذوقوا مس سقر
tr: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
y: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"
p: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
t: yawma yushaboona fin naari'alaa wujoohimim zooqoo massa saqar

ar: إنا كل شىء خلقنه بقدر
tr: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
y: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.
p: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
t: innaa kulla shai'in khalaqnaahu biqadar

ar: وما أمرنا إلا وحدة كلمح بٱلبصر
tr: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
y: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.
p: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.
t: wa maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bilbasar

ar: ولقد أهلكنا أشياعكم فهل من مدكر
tr: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
y: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?
p: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?
t: wa laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir

ar: وكل شىء فعلوه فى ٱلزبر
tr: And everything they did is in written records.
y: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):
p: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,
t: wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz zubur

ar: وكل صغير وكبير مستطر
tr: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
y: Every matter, small and great, is on record.
p: And every small and great thing is recorded.
t: wa kullu sagheerinw wa kabeerim mustatar

ar: إن ٱلمتقين فى جنت ونهر
tr: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
y: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
p: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
t: innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa nahar

ar: فى مقعد صدق عند مليك مقتدر
tr: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
y: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
p: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
t: fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda maleekim muqtadir

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ٱلرحمن
tr: The Most Merciful
y: (Allah) Most Gracious!
p: The Beneficent
t: ar rahmaan

ar: علم ٱلقرءان
tr: Taught the Qur'an,
y: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an.
p: Hath made known the Qur'an.
t: 'allamal quran

ar: خلق ٱلإنسن
tr: Created man,
y: He has created man:
p: He hath created man.
t: khalaqal insaan

ar: علمه ٱلبيان
tr: [And] taught him eloquence.
y: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).
p: He hath taught him utterance.
t: 'allamalhul bayaan

ar: ٱلشمس وٱلقمر بحسبان
tr: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
y: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;
p: The sun and the moon are made punctual.
t: ashshamsu walqamaru bihusbaan

ar: وٱلنجم وٱلشجر يسجدان
tr: And the stars and trees prostrate.
y: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration.
p: The stars and the trees prostrate.
t: wannajmu washshajaru yasjudan

ar: وٱلسماء رفعها ووضع ٱلميزان
tr: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
y: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),
p: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
t: wassamaaa'a rafa'ahaa wa wada'al meezan

ar: ألا تطغوا فى ٱلميزان
tr: That you not transgress within the balance.
y: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.
p: That ye exceed not the measure,
t: allaa tatghaw fil meezaan

ar: وأقيموا ٱلوزن بٱلقسط ولا تخسروا ٱلميزان
tr: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
y: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
p: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
t: wa aqeemul wazna bilqisti wa laa tukhsirul meezaan

ar: وٱلأرض وضعها للأنام
tr: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
y: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
p: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
t: wal arda wada'ahaa lilanaame

ar: فيها فكهة وٱلنخل ذات ٱلأكمام
tr: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
y: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);
p: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
t: feehaa faakihatunw wan nakhlu zaatul akmaam

ar: وٱلحب ذو ٱلعصف وٱلريحان
tr: And grain having husks and scented plants.
y: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
p: Husked grain and scented herb.
t: walhabbu zul 'asfi war raihaanu

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan

ar: خلق ٱلإنسن من صلصل كٱلفخار
tr: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
y: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,
p: He created man of clay like the potter's,
t: khalaqal insaana min salsaalin kalfakhkhaari

ar: وخلق ٱلجان من مارج من نار
tr: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
y: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke:
p: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.
t: wa khalaqal jaaan mim maarijim min naar

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan

ar: رب ٱلمشرقين ورب ٱلمغربين
tr: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
y: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests:
p: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
t: rabbul mashriqayni wa rabbul maghribayni

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan

ar: مرج ٱلبحرين يلتقيان
tr: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
y: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:
p: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.
t: marajal bahrayni yalta qiyaani

ar: بينهما برزخ لا يبغيان
tr: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
y: Between them is a Barrier which they do not transgress:
p: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).
t: bainahumaa barzakhul laa yabghiyaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan

ar: يخرج منهما ٱللؤلؤ وٱلمرجان
tr: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
y: Out of them come Pearls and Coral:
p: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.
t: yakhruju minhumal lu 'lu u wal marjaanu

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan

ar: وله ٱلجوار ٱلمنشـات فى ٱلبحر كٱلأعلم
tr: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
y: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains:
p: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.
t: wa lahul jawaaril mun sha'aatu fil bahri kal a'laam

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: كل من عليها فان
tr: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
y: All that is on earth will perish:
p: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;
t: kullu man 'alaihaa faan

ar: ويبقى وجه ربك ذو ٱلجلل وٱلإكرام
tr: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
y: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
p: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.
t: wa yabqaa wajhu rabbika zul jalaali wal ikraam

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: يسـله من فى ٱلسموت وٱلأرض كل يوم هو فى شأن
tr: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
y: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!
p: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
t: yas'aluhoo man fissamaawaati walard; kulla ywmin huwa fee shaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: سنفرغ لكم أيه ٱلثقلان
tr: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
y: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!
p: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
t: sanafrughu lakum ayyuhas saqalaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: يمعشر ٱلجن وٱلإنس إن ٱستطعتم أن تنفذوا من أقطار ٱلسموت وٱلأرض فٱنفذوا لا تنفذون إلا بسلطن
tr: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
y: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!
p: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
t: yaa ma'sharal jinni wal insi inis tata'tum an tanfuzoo min aqtaaris samaawaati wal ardi fanfuzoo; laa tanfuzoona illaa bisultaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: يرسل عليكما شواظ من نار ونحاس فلا تنتصران
tr: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
y: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have:
p: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.
t: yursalu 'alaikumaa shuwaazum min naarifiw-wa nuhaasun falaa tantasiraan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: فإذا ٱنشقت ٱلسماء فكانت وردة كٱلدهان
tr: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
y: When the sky is rent asunder, and it becomes red like ointment:
p: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -
t: fa-izan shaqqatis samaaa'u fakaanat wardatan kaddihaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: فيومئذ لا يسـل عن ذنبه إنس ولا جان
tr: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
y: On that Day no question will be asked of man or Jinn as to his sin.
p: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.
t: fa-yawma'izil laa yus'alu 'an zambiheee insunw wa laa jaann

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: يعرف ٱلمجرمون بسيمهم فيؤخذ بٱلنوصى وٱلأقدام
tr: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
y: (For) the sinners will be known by their marks: and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
p: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
t: yu'raful mujrimoona biseemaahum fa'yu'khazu binna waasi wal aqdaam

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: هذه جهنم ٱلتى يكذب بها ٱلمجرمون
tr: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
y: This is the Hell which the Sinners deny:
p: This is hell which the guilty deny.
t: haazihee jahannamul latee yukazzibu bihal mujrimoon

ar: يطوفون بينها وبين حميم ءان
tr: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
y: In its midst and in the midst of boiling hot water will they wander round!
p: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.
t: yatoofoona bainahaa wa baina hameemim aan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: ولمن خاف مقام ربه جنتان
tr: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
y: But for such as fear the time when they will stand before (the Judgment Seat of) their Lord, there will be two Gardens-
p: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens.
t: wa liman khaafa maqaama rabbihee jannataan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: ذواتا أفنان
tr: Having [spreading] branches.
y: Containing all kinds (of trees and delights);-
p: Of spreading branches.
t: zawaataaa afnaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: فيهما عينان تجريان
tr: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
y: In them (each) will be two Springs flowing (free);
p: Wherein are two fountains flowing.
t: feehimaa 'aynaani tajriyaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: فيهما من كل فكهة زوجان
tr: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
y: In them will be Fruits of every kind, two and two.
p: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.
t: feehimaa min kulli faakihatin zawjaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: متكـين على فرش بطائنها من إستبرق وجنى ٱلجنتين دان
tr: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
y: They will recline on Carpets, whose inner linings will be of rich brocade: the Fruit of the Gardens will be near (and easy of reach).
p: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.
t: muttaki'eena 'alaa furushim bataaa'inuhaa min istabraq; wajanal jannataini daan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: فيهن قصرت ٱلطرف لم يطمثهن إنس قبلهم ولا جان
tr: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
y: In them will be (Maidens), chaste, restraining their glances, whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
p: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them.
t: feehinna qaasiratut tarfi lam yatmishunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: كأنهن ٱلياقوت وٱلمرجان
tr: As if they were rubies and coral.
y: Like unto Rubies and coral.
p: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone.
t: ka annahunnal yaaqootu wal marjaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: هل جزاء ٱلإحسن إلا ٱلإحسن
tr: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
y: Is there any Reward for Good - other than Good?
p: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?
t: hal jazaaa'ul ihsaani illal ihsaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: ومن دونهما جنتان
tr: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
y: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens,-
p: And beside them are two other gardens,
t: wa min doonihimaa jannataan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: مدهامتان
tr: Dark green [in color].
y: Dark-green in colour (from plentiful watering).
p: Dark green with foliage.
t: mudhaaammataan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: فيهما عينان نضاختان
tr: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
y: In them (each) will be two Springs pouring forth water in continuous abundance:
p: Wherein are two abundant springs.
t: feehimaa 'aynaani nad daakhataan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: فيهما فكهة ونخل ورمان
tr: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
y: In them will be Fruits, and dates and pomegranates:
p: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.
t: feehimaa faakihatunw wa nakhlunw wa rummaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: فيهن خيرت حسان
tr: In them are good and beautiful women -
y: In them will be fair (Companions), good, beautiful;-
p: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful -
t: feehinna khairaatun hisaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: حور مقصورت فى ٱلخيام
tr: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
y: Companions restrained (as to their glances), in (goodly) pavilions;-
p: Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions -
t: hoorum maqsooraatun fil khiyaam

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: لم يطمثهن إنس قبلهم ولا جان
tr: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
y: Whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
p: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them -
t: lam yatmis hunna insun qablahum wa laa jaaann

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: متكـين على رفرف خضر وعبقرى حسان
tr: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
y: Reclining on green Cushions and rich Carpets of beauty.
p: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.
t: muttaki'eena 'alaa rafratin khudrinw wa 'abqariyyin hisaan

ar: فبأى ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
tr: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
y: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
p: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
t: fabi ayyi aalaaa'i rabbikumaa tukazzibaan.

ar: تبرك ٱسم ربك ذى ٱلجلل وٱلإكرام
tr: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
y: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
p: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
t: tabaarakasmu rabbika zil-jalaali wal-ikraam

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إذا وقعت ٱلواقعة
tr: When the Occurrence occurs,
y: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,
p: When the event befalleth -
t: izaa waqa'atil waaqi'ah

ar: ليس لوقعتها كاذبة
tr: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
y: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.
p: There is no denying that it will befall -
t: laisa liwaq'atihaa kaazibah

ar: خافضة رافعة
tr: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
y: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;
p: Abasing (some), exalting (others);
t: khafidatur raafi'ah

ar: إذا رجت ٱلأرض رجا
tr: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
y: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,
p: When the earth is shaken with a shock
t: izaa rujjatil ardu rajjaa

ar: وبست ٱلجبال بسا
tr: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
y: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,
p: And the hills are ground to powder
t: wa bussatil jibaalu bassaa

ar: فكانت هباء منبثا
tr: And become dust dispersing.
y: Becoming dust scattered abroad,
p: So that they become a scattered dust,
t: fakaanat habaaa'am mumbassaa

ar: وكنتم أزوجا ثلثة
tr: And you become [of] three kinds:
y: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.
p: And ye will be three kinds:
t: wa kuntum azwaajan salaasah

ar: فأصحب ٱلميمنة ما أصحب ٱلميمنة
tr: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
y: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
p: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
t: fa as haabul maimanati maaa as haabul maimanah

ar: وأصحب ٱلمشـمة ما أصحب ٱلمشـمة
tr: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
y: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
p: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?
t: wa as haabul mash'amati maaa as haabul mash'amah

ar: وٱلسبقون ٱلسبقون
tr: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
y: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).
p: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:
t: wassaabiqoonas saabiqoon

ar: أولئك ٱلمقربون
tr: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
y: These will be those Nearest to Allah:
p: Those are they who will be brought nigh
t: ulaaa'ikal muqarraboon

ar: فى جنت ٱلنعيم
tr: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
y: In Gardens of Bliss:
p: In gardens of delight;
t: fee jannaatin na'eem

ar: ثلة من ٱلأولين
tr: A [large] company of the former peoples
y: A number of people from those of old,
p: A multitude of those of old
t: sullatum minal awwaleen

ar: وقليل من ٱلءاخرين
tr: And a few of the later peoples,
y: And a few from those of later times.
p: And a few of those of later time.
t: wa qaleelum minal aa khireen

ar: على سرر موضونة
tr: On thrones woven [with ornament],
y: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
p: On lined couches,
t: 'alaa sururim mawdoonah

ar: متكـين عليها متقبلين
tr: Reclining on them, facing each other.
y: Reclining on them, facing each other.
p: Reclining therein face to face.
t: muttaki'eena 'alaihaa mutaqabileen

ar: يطوف عليهم ولدن مخلدون
tr: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
y: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
p: There wait on them immortal youths
t: yatoofu 'alaihim wildaa num mukkhalladoon

ar: بأكواب وأباريق وكأس من معين
tr: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
y: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
p: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
t: bi akwaabinw wa abaareeq, wa kaasim mim ma'een

ar: لا يصدعون عنها ولا ينزفون
tr: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
y: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
p: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
t: laa yusadda'oona 'anhaa wa laa yunzifoon

ar: وفكهة مما يتخيرون
tr: And fruit of what they select
y: And with fruits, any that they may select:
p: And fruit that they prefer
t: wa faakihatim mimmaa yatakhaiyaroon

ar: ولحم طير مما يشتهون
tr: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
y: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
p: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
t: wa lahmi tairim mimmaa yashtahoon

ar: وحور عين
tr: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
y: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
p: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
t: wa hoorun'een

ar: كأمثل ٱللؤلؤ ٱلمكنون
tr: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
y: Like unto Pearls well-guarded.
p: Like unto hidden pearls,
t: ka amsaalil lu'lu'il maknoon

ar: جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
tr: As reward for what they used to do.
y: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
p: Reward for what they used to do.
t: jazaaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon

ar: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تأثيما
tr: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
y: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
p: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
t: laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwanw wa laa taaseemaa

ar: إلا قيلا سلما سلما
tr: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."
y: Only the saying, "Peace! Peace".
p: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
t: illaa qeelan salaaman salaamaa

ar: وأصحب ٱليمين ما أصحب ٱليمين
tr: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
y: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
p: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
t: wa as haabul yameeni maaa as haabul yameen

ar: فى سدر مخضود
tr: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
y: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
p: Among thornless lote-trees
t: fee sidrim makhdood

ar: وطلح منضود
tr: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
y: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
p: And clustered plantains,
t: wa talhim mandood

ar: وظل ممدود
tr: And shade extended
y: In shade long-extended,
p: And spreading shade,
t: wa zillim mamdood

ar: وماء مسكوب
tr: And water poured out
y: By water flowing constantly,
p: And water gushing,
t: wa maaa'im maskoob

ar: وفكهة كثيرة
tr: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
y: And fruit in abundance.
p: And fruit in plenty
t: wa faakihatin kaseerah

ar: لا مقطوعة ولا ممنوعة
tr: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
y: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
p: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
t: laa maqtoo'atinw wa laa mamnoo'ah

ar: وفرش مرفوعة
tr: And [upon] beds raised high.
y: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
p: And raised couches;
t: wa furushim marfoo'ah

ar: إنا أنشأنهن إنشاء
tr: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
y: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
p: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
t: innaaa anshaanaahunna inshaaa'aa

ar: فجعلنهن أبكارا
tr: And made them virgins,
y: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
p: And made them virgins,
t: faja'alnaahunna abkaaraa

ar: عربا أترابا
tr: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
y: Beloved (by nature), equal in age,-
p: Lovers, friends,
t: 'uruban atraabaa

ar: لأصحب ٱليمين
tr: For the companions of the right [who are]
y: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
p: For those on the right hand;
t: li as haabil yameen

ar: ثلة من ٱلأولين
tr: A company of the former peoples
y: A (goodly) number from those of old,
p: A multitude of those of old
t: sullatum minal awwa leen

ar: وثلة من ٱلءاخرين
tr: And a company of the later peoples.
y: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
p: And a multitude of those of later time.
t: wa sullatum minal aakhireen

ar: وأصحب ٱلشمال ما أصحب ٱلشمال
tr: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
y: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
p: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?
t: wa as haabush shimaali maaa as haabush shimaal

ar: فى سموم وحميم
tr: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
y: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
p: In scorching wind and scalding water
t: fee samoominw wa hameem

ar: وظل من يحموم
tr: And a shade of black smoke,
y: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
p: And shadow of black smoke,
t: wa zillim miny yahmoom

ar: لا بارد ولا كريم
tr: Neither cool nor beneficial.
y: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
p: Neither cool nor refreshing.
t: laa baaridinw wa laa kareem

ar: إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك مترفين
tr: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
y: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
p: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
t: innaahum kaanoo qabla zaalika mutrafeen

ar: وكانوا يصرون على ٱلحنث ٱلعظيم
tr: And they used to persist in the great violation,
y: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
p: And used to persist in the awful sin.
t: wa kaanoo yusirroona 'alal hinsil 'azeem

ar: وكانوا يقولون أئذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظما أءنا لمبعوثون
tr: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
y: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
p: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
t: wa kaanoo yaqooloona a'izaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaabanw wa izaaman'ainnaa lamab'oosoon

ar: أوءاباؤنا ٱلأولون
tr: And our forefathers [as well]?"
y: "(We) and our fathers of old?"
p: And also our forefathers?
t: awa aabaaa'unal awwaloon

ar: قل إن ٱلأولين وٱلءاخرين
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
y: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
p: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
t: qul innal awwaleena wal aakhireen

ar: لمجموعون إلى ميقت يوم معلوم
tr: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
y: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
p: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
t: lamajmoo'oona ilaa meeqaati yawmim ma'loon

ar: ثم إنكم أيها ٱلضالون ٱلمكذبون
tr: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
y: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
p: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
t: summa innakum ayyuhad daaalloonal mukazziboon

ar: لءاكلون من شجر من زقوم
tr: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
y: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
p: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
t: la aakiloona min shaja rim min zaqqoom

ar: فمالـون منها ٱلبطون
tr: And filling with it your bellies
y: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
p: And will fill your bellies therewith;
t: famaali'oona minhal butoon

ar: فشربون عليه من ٱلحميم
tr: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
y: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
p: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
t: fashaariboona 'alaihi minal hameem

ar: فشربون شرب ٱلهيم
tr: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
y: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
p: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
t: fashaariboona shurbal heem

ar: هذا نزلهم يوم ٱلدين
tr: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
y: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
p: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
t: haazaa nuzuluhum yawmad deen

ar: نحن خلقنكم فلولا تصدقون
tr: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
y: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
p: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
t: nahnu khalaqnaakum falaw laa tusaddiqoon

ar: أفرءيتم ما تمنون
tr: Have you seen that which you emit?
y: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
p: Have ye seen that which ye emit?
t: afara'aytum maa tumnoon

ar: ءأنتم تخلقونه أم نحن ٱلخلقون
tr: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
y: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
p: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
t: 'a-antum takhluqoo nahooo am nahnul khaaliqoon

ar: نحن قدرنا بينكم ٱلموت وما نحن بمسبوقين
tr: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
y: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
p: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
t: nahnu qaddarnaa baina kumul mawta wa maa nahnu bimasbooqeen

ar: على أن نبدل أمثلكم وننشئكم فى ما لا تعلمون
tr: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
y: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
p: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
t: 'alaaa an nubaddila amsaalakum wa nunshi'akum fee maa laa ta'lamoon

ar: ولقد علمتم ٱلنشأة ٱلأولى فلولا تذكرون
tr: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
y: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
p: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
t: wa laqad 'alimtumun nash atal oolaa falaw laa tazakkaroon

ar: أفرءيتم ما تحرثون
tr: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
y: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
p: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?
t: afara'aytum maa tahrusoon

ar: ءأنتم تزرعونه أم نحن ٱلزرعون
tr: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
y: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
p: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?
t: 'a-antum tazra'oonahooo am nahnuz zaari'ooon

ar: لو نشاء لجعلنه حطما فظلتم تفكهون
tr: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
y: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
p: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
t: law nashaaa'u laja'al naahu hutaaman fazaltum tafakkahoon

ar: إنا لمغرمون
tr: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
y: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
p: Lo! we are laden with debt!
t: innaa lamughramoon

ar: بل نحن محرومون
tr: Rather, we have been deprived."
y: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
p: Nay, but we are deprived!
t: bal nahnu mahroomoon

ar: أفرءيتم ٱلماء ٱلذى تشربون
tr: And have you seen the water that you drink?
y: See ye the water which ye drink?
p: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?
t: afara'aytumul maaa'allazee tashraboon

ar: ءأنتم أنزلتموه من ٱلمزن أم نحن ٱلمنزلون
tr: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
y: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
p: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?
t: 'a-antum anzaltumoohu minal muzni am nahnul munziloon

ar: لو نشاء جعلنه أجاجا فلولا تشكرون
tr: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
y: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
p: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?
t: law nashaaa'u ja'alnaahu ujaajan falaw laa tashkuroon

ar: أفرءيتم ٱلنار ٱلتى تورون
tr: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
y: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
p: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
t: afara'aytumun naaral latee tooroon

ar: ءأنتم أنشأتم شجرتها أم نحن ٱلمنشـون
tr: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
y: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
p: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?
t: 'a-antum anshaatum shajaratahaaa am nahnul munshi'oon

ar: نحن جعلنها تذكرة ومتعا للمقوين
tr: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,
y: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
p: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
t: nahnu ja'alnaahaa tazkira tanw wa mataa'al lilmuqween

ar: فسبح بٱسم ربك ٱلعظيم
tr: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
y: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
p: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
t: fasabbih bismi rabbikal 'azeem

ar: فلا أقسم بموقع ٱلنجوم
tr: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
y: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
p: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
t: falaa uqsimu bimaawaa qi'innujoom

ar: وإنه لقسم لو تعلمون عظيم
tr: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
y: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
p: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
t: wa innahoo laqasamul lawta'lamoona'azeem

ar: إنه لقرءان كريم
tr: Indeed, it is a noble Qur'an
y: That this is indeed a qur'an Most Honourable,
p: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
t: innahoo la quraanun kareem

ar: فى كتب مكنون
tr: In a Register well-protected;
y: In Book well-guarded,
p: In a Book kept hidden
t: fee kitaabim maknoon

ar: لا يمسه إلا ٱلمطهرون
tr: None touch it except the purified.
y: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
p: Which none toucheth save the purified,
t: laa yamassuhooo illal mutahharoon

ar: تنزيل من رب ٱلعلمين
tr: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
y: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
p: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
t: tanzeelum mir rabbil'aalameen

ar: أفبهذا ٱلحديث أنتم مدهنون
tr: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
y: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
p: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
t: afabihaazal hadeesi antum mudhinoon

ar: وتجعلون رزقكم أنكم تكذبون
tr: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
y: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
p: And make denial thereof your livelihood?
t: wa taj'aloona rizqakum annakum tukazziboon

ar: فلولا إذا بلغت ٱلحلقوم
tr: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
y: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
p: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
t: falaw laaa izaa balaghatil hulqoom

ar: وأنتم حينئذ تنظرون
tr: And you are at that time looking on -
y: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
p: And ye are at that moment looking
t: wa antum heena'izin tanzuroon

ar: ونحن أقرب إليه منكم ولكن لا تبصرون
tr: And Our angels are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
y: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
p: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
t: wa nahnu aqrabu ilaihi minkum wa laakil laa tubsiroon

ar: فلولا إن كنتم غير مدينين
tr: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
y: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
p: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
t: falaw laaa in kuntum ghira madeeneen

ar: ترجعونها إن كنتم صدقين
tr: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
y: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
p: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?
t: tarji'oonahaaa in kuntum saadiqeen

ar: فأما إن كان من ٱلمقربين
tr: And if the deceased was of those brought near to Allah,
y: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to Allah,
p: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
t: fa ammaaa in kaana minal muqarrabeen

ar: فروح وريحان وجنت نعيم
tr: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
y: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
p: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
t: farawhunw wa raihaa nunw wa jannatu na'eem

ar: وأما إن كان من أصحب ٱليمين
tr: And if he was of the companions of the right,
y: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
p: And if he is of those on the right hand,
t: wa ammaaa in kaana min as haabil yameen

ar: فسلم لك من أصحب ٱليمين
tr: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."
y: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
p: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
t: fasalaamul laka min as haabil yameen

ar: وأما إن كان من ٱلمكذبين ٱلضالين
tr: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
y: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
p: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
t: wa ammaaa in kaana minal mukazzibeenad daaalleen

ar: فنزل من حميم
tr: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water
y: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
p: Then the welcome will be boiling water
t: fanuzulum min hameem

ar: وتصلية جحيم
tr: And burning in Hellfire
y: And burning in Hell-Fire.
p: And roasting at hell-fire.
t: wa tasliyatu jaheem

ar: إن هذا لهو حق ٱليقين
tr: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
y: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
p: Lo! this is certain truth.
t: inna haaza lahuwa haqqul yaqeen

ar: فسبح بٱسم ربك ٱلعظيم
tr: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
y: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
p: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
t: fasabbih bismi rabbikal 'azeem

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم سبح لله ما فى ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وهو ٱلعزيز ٱلحكيم
tr: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allah, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
y: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth,- let it declare the Praises and Glory of Allah: for He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
p: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
t: sabbaha lillaahi maa fissamaawaati wal ardi wa huwal 'azeezul hakeem

ar: له ملك ٱلسموت وٱلأرض يحى ويميت وهو على كل شىء قدير
tr: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
y: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: It is He Who gives Life and Death; and He has Power over all things.
p: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.
t: lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ardi yuhyee wa yumeetu wa huwa 'alaa kulli shai'in qadeer

ar: هو ٱلأول وٱلءاخر وٱلظهر وٱلباطن وهو بكل شىء عليم
tr: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
y: He is the First and the Last, the Evident and the Immanent: and He has full knowledge of all things.
p: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.
t: huwal awwalu wal'aakhiru waz zaahiru wal baatinu wa huwa bikulli shai'in aleem

ar: هو ٱلذى خلق ٱلسموت وٱلأرض فى ستة أيام ثم ٱستوى على ٱلعرش يعلم ما يلج فى ٱلأرض وما يخرج منها وما ينزل من ٱلسماء وما يعرج فيها وهو معكم أين ما كنتم وٱلله بما تعملون بصير
tr: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allah, of what you do, is Seeing.
y: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in Six Days, and is moreover firmly established on the Throne (of Authority). He knows what enters within the earth and what comes forth out of it, what comes down from heaven and what mounts up to it. And He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah sees well all that ye do.
p: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
t: huwal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda fee sittati ayyaamin summas tawaa 'alal 'arsh; ya'lamu maa yaliju filardi wa maa yakhruju minhaa wa maa yanzilu minas samaaa'i wa maa ya'ruju feeha wa huwa ma'akum ayna maa kuntum; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer

ar: له ملك ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وإلى ٱلله ترجع ٱلأمور
tr: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allah are returned [all] matters.
y: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: and all affairs are referred back to Allah.
p: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.
t: lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wa ilal laahi turja'ul umoor

ar: يولج ٱليل فى ٱلنهار ويولج ٱلنهار فى ٱليل وهو عليم بذات ٱلصدور
tr: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and he is Knowing of that within the breasts.
y: He merges Night into Day, and He merges Day into Night; and He has full knowledge of the secrets of (all) hearts.
p: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts.
t: yoolijul laila fin nahaari wa yoolijun nahaara fil lail; wa huwa 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor

ar: ءامنوا بٱلله ورسوله وأنفقوا مما جعلكم مستخلفين فيه فٱلذين ءامنوا منكم وأنفقوا لهم أجر كبير
tr: Believe in Allah and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
y: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend (in charity) out of the (substance) whereof He has made you heirs. For, those of you who believe and spend (in charity),- for them is a great Reward.
p: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward.
t: aaaminoo billaahi wa rasoolihee wa anfiqoo mimmaa ja'alakum mustakh lafeena feehi fallazeena aamanoo minkum wa anfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeer

ar: وما لكم لا تؤمنون بٱلله وٱلرسول يدعوكم لتؤمنوا بربكم وقد أخذ ميثقكم إن كنتم مؤمنين
tr: And why do you not believe in Allah while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
y: What cause have ye why ye should not believe in Allah?- and the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord, and has indeed taken your Covenant, if ye are men of Faith.
p: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers?
t: wa maa lakum laa tu'minoona billaahi war rasoolu yad'ookum lituu'minoo bi rabbikum wa qad akhaza meesaaqakum in kuntum mu'mineen

ar: هو ٱلذى ينزل على عبده ءايت بينت ليخرجكم من ٱلظلمت إلى ٱلنور وإن ٱلله بكم لرءوف رحيم
tr: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful.
y: He is the One Who sends to His Servant Manifest Signs, that He may lead you from the depths of Darkness into the Light and verily Allah is to you most kind and Merciful.
p: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful.
t: huwal lazee yunazzilu 'alaa 'abdiheee aayaatim baiyinaatil liyukhrijakum minaz zulumaati ilan noor; wa innal laaha bikum la ra'oofur raheem

ar: وما لكم ألا تنفقوا فى سبيل ٱلله ولله ميرث ٱلسموت وٱلأرض لا يستوى منكم من أنفق من قبل ٱلفتح وقتل أولئك أعظم درجة من ٱلذين أنفقوا من بعد وقتلوا وكلا وعد ٱلله ٱلحسنى وٱلله بما تعملون خبير
tr: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allah while to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allah has promised the best [reward]. And Allah, with what you do, is Acquainted.
y: And what cause have ye why ye should not spend in the cause of Allah?- For to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Not equal among you are those who spent (freely) and fought, before the Victory, (with those who did so later). Those are higher in rank than those who spent (freely) and fought afterwards. But to all has Allah promised a goodly (reward). And Allah is well acquainted with all that ye do.
p: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
t: wa maa lakum allaa tunfiqoo fee sabeelil laahi wa lillaahi meeraasus samaawaati wal-ard; laa yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qablil fat-hi wa qaatal; ulaaaika a'zamu darajatam minal lazeena anfaqoo mim ba'du wa qaataloo; wa kullanw wa'adallaahul husnaa; wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer

ar: من ذا ٱلذى يقرض ٱلله قرضا حسنا فيضعفه له وله أجر كريم
tr: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
y: Who is he that will Loan to Allah a beautiful loan? for (Allah) will increase it manifold to his credit, and he will have (besides) a liberal Reward.
p: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward?
t: man zal lazee yuqridul laaha qardan hasanan fa yudaa'ifahoo lahoo wa lahooo ajrun kareem

ar: يوم ترى ٱلمؤمنين وٱلمؤمنت يسعى نورهم بين أيديهم وبأيمنهم بشرىكم ٱليوم جنت تجرى من تحتها ٱلأنهر خلدين فيها ذلك هو ٱلفوز ٱلعظيم
tr: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
y: One Day shalt thou see the believing men and the believing women- how their Light runs forward before them and by their right hands: (their greeting will be): "Good News for you this Day! Gardens beneath which flow rivers! to dwell therein for aye! This is indeed the highest Achievement!"
p: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.
t: yawma taral mu'mineena walmu'minaati yas'aa nooruhum baina aydeehim wa biaymaanihim bushraakumul yawma jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feeha; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem

ar: يوم يقول ٱلمنفقون وٱلمنفقت للذين ءامنوا ٱنظرونا نقتبس من نوركم قيل ٱرجعوا وراءكم فٱلتمسوا نورا فضرب بينهم بسور له باب باطنه فيه ٱلرحمة وظهره من قبله ٱلعذاب
tr: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
y: One Day will the Hypocrites- men and women - say to the Believers: "Wait for us! Let us borrow (a Light) from your Light!" It will be said: "Turn ye back to your rear! then seek a Light (where ye can)!" So a wall will be put up betwixt them, with a gate therein. Within it will be Mercy throughout, and without it, all alongside, will be (Wrath and) Punishment!
p: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.
t: yawma yaqoolul munaa fiqoona walmunaafiqaatu lillazeena aamanun zuroonaa naqtabis min noorikum qeelarji'oo waraaa'akum faltamisoo nooran faduriba bainahum bisooril lahoo baab, baatinuhoo feehir rahmatu wa zaahiruhoo min qibalihi-'azaab

ar: ينادونهم ألم نكن معكم قالوا بلى ولكنكم فتنتم أنفسكم وتربصتم وٱرتبتم وغرتكم ٱلأمانى حتى جاء أمر ٱلله وغركم بٱلله ٱلغرور
tr: The hypocrites will call to the believers, "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you concerning Allah.
y: (Those without) will call out, "Were we not with you?" (The others) will reply, "True! but ye led yourselves into temptation; ye looked forward (to our ruin); ye doubted (Allah's Promise); and (your false) desires deceived you; until there issued the Command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you in respect of Allah.
p: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah;
t: yunaadoonahum alam nakum ma'akum qaaloo balaa wa laakinnakum fatantum anfusakum wa tarabbastum wartabtum wa gharratkumul amaaniyyu hatta jaaa'a amrul laahi wa gharrakum billaahil gharoor

ar: فٱليوم لا يؤخذ منكم فدية ولا من ٱلذين كفروا مأوىكم ٱلنار هى مولىكم وبئس ٱلمصير
tr: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination.
y: "This Day shall no ransom be accepted of you, nor of those who rejected Allah." Your abode is the Fire: that is the proper place to claim you: and an evil refuge it is!"
p: So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end.
t: fal yawma laa yu'khazu minkum fidyatunw wa laa minal lazeena kafaroo; maawaakumun naaru hiya maw laakum wa bi'sal maseer

ar: ألم يأن للذين ءامنوا أن تخشع قلوبهم لذكر ٱلله وما نزل من ٱلحق ولا يكونوا كٱلذين أوتوا ٱلكتب من قبل فطال عليهم ٱلأمد فقست قلوبهم وكثير منهم فسقون
tr: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allah and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
y: Has not the Time arrived for the Believers that their hearts in all humility should engage in the remembrance of Allah and of the Truth which has been revealed (to them), and that they should not become like those to whom was given Revelation aforetime, but long ages passed over them and their hearts grew hard? For many among them are rebellious transgressors.
p: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.
t: alam yaani laillzeena aamanooo an takhsha'a quloo buhum lizikril laahi wa maa nazala minal haqqi wa laa yakoonoo kallazeena ootul kitaaba min qablu fataala 'alaihimul amadu faqasat quloobuhum wa kaseerum minhum faasiqoon

ar: ٱعلموا أن ٱلله يحى ٱلأرض بعد موتها قد بينا لكم ٱلءايت لعلكم تعقلون
tr: Know that Allah gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.
y: Know ye (all) that Allah giveth life to the earth after its death! already have We shown the Signs plainly to you, that ye may learn wisdom.
p: Know that Allah quickeneth the earth after its death. We have made clear Our revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.
t: i'lamooo annal laaha yuhyil arda ba'da mawtihaa; qad baiyannaa lakumul aayaati la'allakum ta'qiloon

ar: إن ٱلمصدقين وٱلمصدقت وأقرضوا ٱلله قرضا حسنا يضعف لهم ولهم أجر كريم
tr: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allah a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
y: For those who give in Charity, men and women, and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan, it shall be increased manifold (to their credit), and they shall have (besides) a liberal reward.
p: Lo! those who give alms, both men and women, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan, it will be doubled for them, and theirs will be a rich reward.
t: innal mussaddiqeena wal mussaddiqaati wa aqradul laaha qardan hassanany yudaa'afu lahum wa lahum ajrun kareem

ar: وٱلذين ءامنوا بٱلله ورسله أولئك هم ٱلصديقون وٱلشهداء عند ربهم لهم أجرهم ونورهم وٱلذين كفروا وكذبوا بـايتنا أولئك أصحب ٱلجحيم
tr: And those who have believed in Allah and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
y: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers- they are the Sincere (lovers of Truth), and the witnesses (who testify), in the eyes of their Lord: They shall have their Reward and their Light. But those who reject Allah and deny Our Signs,- they are the Companions of Hell-Fire.
p: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
t: wallazeena aamanoo billaahi wa rusuliheee ulaaa'ika humus siddeeqoona wash shuhadaaa'u 'inda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wa nooruhum wallazeena kafaroo wa kazzaboo bi aayaatinaaa ulaaaika as haabul jaheem

ar: ٱعلموا أنما ٱلحيوة ٱلدنيا لعب ولهو وزينة وتفاخر بينكم وتكاثر فى ٱلأمول وٱلأولد كمثل غيث أعجب ٱلكفار نباته ثم يهيج فترىه مصفرا ثم يكون حطما وفى ٱلءاخرة عذاب شديد ومغفرة من ٱلله ورضون وما ٱلحيوة ٱلدنيا إلا متع ٱلغرور
tr: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allah and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
y: Know ye (all), that the life of this world is but play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting and multiplying, (in rivalry) among yourselves, riches and children. Here is a similitude: How rain and the growth which it brings forth, delight (the hearts of) the tillers; soon it withers; thou wilt see it grow yellow; then it becomes dry and crumbles away. But in the Hereafter is a Penalty severe (for the devotees of wrong). And Forgiveness from Allah and (His) Good Pleasure (for the devotees of Allah). And what is the life of this world, but goods and chattels of deception?
p: Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion.
t: i'lamooo annamal hayaa tud dunyaa la'ibunw wa lahwunw wa zeenatunw wa takaasurun bainakum wa takaasurn fil amwaali wal awlaad, kamasali ghaisin a'jabal kuffaara nabaatuhoo summa yaheeju fataraahu musfaaran summa yakoonu hutaamaa; wa fil aakhirati 'azaabun shadeedunw wa magh firatum minal laahi wa ridwaan; wa mal haiyaa tuddun yaaa illaa mataa'ul ghuroor

ar: سابقوا إلى مغفرة من ربكم وجنة عرضها كعرض ٱلسماء وٱلأرض أعدت للذين ءامنوا بٱلله ورسله ذلك فضل ٱلله يؤتيه من يشاء وٱلله ذو ٱلفضل ٱلعظيم
tr: Race toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allah and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allah which He gives to whom He wills, and Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
y: Be ye foremost (in seeking) Forgiveness from your Lord, and a Garden (of Bliss), the width whereof is as the width of heaven and earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers: that is the Grace of Allah, which He bestows on whom he pleases: and Allah is the Lord of Grace abounding.
p: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.
t: saabiqooo ilaa maghfiratim mir rabbikum wa jannatin 'arduhaa ka-'ardis samaaa'i wal ardi u'iddat lillazeena aamanoo billaahi wa rusulih; zaalika fadlul laahi yu'teehi many yashaaa'; wal laahu zul fadlil 'azeem

ar: ما أصاب من مصيبة فى ٱلأرض ولا فى أنفسكم إلا فى كتب من قبل أن نبرأها إن ذلك على ٱلله يسير
tr: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah, is easy -
y: No misfortune can happen on earth or in your souls but is recorded in a decree before We bring it into existence: That is truly easy for Allah:
p: Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah -
t: maaa asaaba mim musee batin fil ardi wa laa feee anfusikum illaa fee kitaabim min qabli an nabra ahaa; innaa zaalika 'alal laahi yaseer

ar: لكيلا تأسوا على ما فاتكم ولا تفرحوا بما ءاتىكم وٱلله لا يحب كل مختال فخور
tr: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allah does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -
y: In order that ye may not despair over matters that pass you by, nor exult over favours bestowed upon you. For Allah loveth not any vainglorious boaster,-
p: That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters,
t: likailaa taasaw 'alaa maa faatakum wa laa tafrahoo bimaaa aataakum; wallaahu laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor

ar: ٱلذين يبخلون ويأمرون ٱلناس بٱلبخل ومن يتول فإن ٱلله هو ٱلغنى ٱلحميد
tr: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
y: Such persons as are covetous and commend covetousness to men. And if any turn back (from Allah's Way), verily Allah is Free of all Needs, Worthy of all Praise.
p: Who hoard and who enjoin upon the people avarice. And whosoever turneth away, still Allah is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.
t: allazeeena yabkhaloona wa yaamuroonan naasa bil bukhl; wa many yatawalla fa innal laaha huwal ghaniyyul hameed

ar: لقد أرسلنا رسلنا بٱلبينت وأنزلنا معهم ٱلكتب وٱلميزان ليقوم ٱلناس بٱلقسط وأنزلنا ٱلحديد فيه بأس شديد ومنفع للناس وليعلم ٱلله من ينصره ورسله بٱلغيب إن ٱلله قوى عزيز
tr: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allah may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
y: We sent aforetime our messengers with Clear Signs and sent down with them the Book and the Balance (of Right and Wrong), that men may stand forth in justice; and We sent down Iron, in which is (material for) mighty war, as well as many benefits for mankind, that Allah may test who it is that will help, Unseen, Him and His messengers: For Allah is Full of Strength, Exalted in Might (and able to enforce His Will).
p: We verily sent Our messengers with clear proofs, and revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance, that mankind may observe right measure; and He revealed iron, wherein is mighty power and (many) uses for mankind, and that Allah may know him who helpeth Him and His messengers, though unseen. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
t: laqad arsalnaa rusulanaa bilbaiyinaati wa anzalnaa ma'ahumul kitaaba wal meezaana liyaqooman naasu bilqist, wa anzalnal hadeeda feehi baasun shadeedunw wa manaafi'u linnaasi wa liya'lamal laahu many yansuruhoo wa rusulahoo bilghaib; innal laaha qawiyyn 'azeez

ar: ولقد أرسلنا نوحا وإبرهيم وجعلنا فى ذريتهما ٱلنبوة وٱلكتب فمنهم مهتد وكثير منهم فسقون
tr: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
y: And We sent Noah and Abraham, and established in their line Prophethood and Revelation: and some of them were on right guidance. But many of them became rebellious transgressors.
p: And We verily sent Noah and Abraham and placed the prophethood and the scripture among their seed, and among them there is he who goeth right, but many of them are evil-livers.
t: wa laqad arsalnaa noohanw wa ibraaheema wa ja'alnaa fee zurriyyatihiman nubuwwata wal kitaaba faminhum muhtad; wa kaseerum minhum faasiqoon

ar: ثم قفينا على ءاثرهم برسلنا وقفينا بعيسى ٱبن مريم وءاتينه ٱلإنجيل وجعلنا فى قلوب ٱلذين ٱتبعوه رأفة ورحمة ورهبانية ٱبتدعوها ما كتبنها عليهم إلا ٱبتغاء رضون ٱلله فما رعوها حق رعايتها فـاتينا ٱلذين ءامنوا منهم أجرهم وكثير منهم فسقون
tr: Then We sent following their footsteps Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allah. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
y: Then, in their wake, We followed them up with (others of) Our messengers: We sent after them Jesus the son of Mary, and bestowed on him the Gospel; and We ordained in the hearts of those who followed him Compassion and Mercy. But the Monasticism which they invented for themselves, We did not prescribe for them: (We commanded) only the seeking for the Good Pleasure of Allah; but that they did not foster as they should have done. Yet We bestowed, on those among them who believed, their (due) reward, but many of them are rebellious transgressors.
p: Then We caused Our messengers to follow in their footsteps; and We caused Jesus, son of Mary, to follow, and gave him the Gospel, and placed compassion and mercy in the hearts of those who followed him. But monasticism they invented - We ordained it not for them - only seeking Allah's pleasure, and they observed it not with right observance. So We give those of them who believe their reward, but many of them are evil-livers.
t: summa qaffainaa 'alaa aasaarihim bi rusulinaa wa qaffainaa be 'eesab ni maryama wa aatainaahul injeela wa ja'alnaa fee quloobil lazeenat taba' oohu raafatanw wa rahmatanw wa rahbaaniyyatanib tada' oohaa maa katanaahaa 'alaihim illab tighaaa'a ridwaanil laahi famaa ra'awhaa haqqa ri'aayatihaa fa aatainal lazeena aamanoo minhum ajrahum wa kaseerum minhum faasiqoon

ar: يأيها ٱلذين ءامنوا ٱتقوا ٱلله وءامنوا برسوله يؤتكم كفلين من رحمته ويجعل لكم نورا تمشون به ويغفر لكم وٱلله غفور رحيم
tr: O you who have believed, fear Allah and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
y: O ye that believe! Fear Allah, and believe in His Messenger, and He will bestow on you a double portion of His Mercy: He will provide for you a Light by which ye shall walk (straight in your path), and He will forgive you (your past): for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
p: O ye who believe! Be mindful of your duty to Allah and put faith in His messenger. He will give you twofold of His mercy and will appoint for you a light wherein ye shall walk, and will forgive you. Allah is Forgiving, Merciful;
t: yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamaanut taqullaaha wa aaminoo bi rasoolihee yu'tikum kiflaini mir rahmatihee wa yaj'al lakum nooran tamshoona bihee wa yaghfir lakum; wallaahu ghafoorur raheem

ar: لئلا يعلم أهل ٱلكتب ألا يقدرون على شىء من فضل ٱلله وأن ٱلفضل بيد ٱلله يؤتيه من يشاء وٱلله ذو ٱلفضل ٱلعظيم
tr: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allah and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
