y: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!
p: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.
t: fa-ammaa samoodu fauhlikoo bittaaghiyah

ar: وأما عاد فأهلكوا بريح صرصر عاتية
tr: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
y: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;
p: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,
t: wa ammaa 'aadun fa uhlikoo bireehin sarsarin 'aatiyah

ar: سخرها عليهم سبع ليال وثمنية أيام حسوما فترى ٱلقوم فيها صرعى كأنهم أعجاز نخل خاوية
tr: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
y: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!
p: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
t: sakhkharahaa 'alaihim sab'a la yaalinw wa samaaniyata ayyaamin husooman fataral qawma feehaa sar'aa ka annahum a'jaazu nakhlin khaawiyah

ar: فهل ترى لهم من باقية
tr: Then do you see of them any remains?
y: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?
p: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?
t: fahal taraa lahum mim baaqiyah

ar: وجاء فرعون ومن قبله وٱلمؤتفكت بٱلخاطئة
tr: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
y: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.
p: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,
t: wa jaaa'a firawnu wa man qablahoo wal mu'tafikaatu bilhaati'ah

ar: فعصوا رسول ربهم فأخذهم أخذة رابية
tr: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
y: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
p: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
t: fa'ansaw rasoola rabbihim fa akhazahum akhzatar raabiyah

ar: إنا لما طغا ٱلماء حملنكم فى ٱلجارية
tr: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
y: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),
p: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship
t: innaa lammaa taghal maaa'u hamalnaakum fil jaariyah

ar: لنجعلها لكم تذكرة وتعيها أذن وعية
tr: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
y: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.
p: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.
t: linaj'alahaa lakum tazki ratanw-wa ta'iyahaa unzununw waa'iyah

ar: فإذا نفخ فى ٱلصور نفخة وحدة
tr: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
y: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,
p: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast
t: fa izaa nufikha fis soori nafkhatunw waahidah

ar: وحملت ٱلأرض وٱلجبال فدكتا دكة وحدة
tr: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
y: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-
p: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,
t: wa humilatil ardu wal jibaalu fadukkataa dakkatanw waahidah

ar: فيومئذ وقعت ٱلواقعة
tr: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
y: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.
p: Then, on that day will the Event befall.
t: fa yawma'izinw waqa'atil waaqi'ah

ar: وٱنشقت ٱلسماء فهى يومئذ واهية
tr: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
y: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,
p: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.
t: wanshaqqatis samaaa'u fahiya yawma 'izinw-waahiyah

ar: وٱلملك على أرجائها ويحمل عرش ربك فوقهم يومئذ ثمنية
tr: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
y: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.
p: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.
t: wal malaku 'alaaa arjaaa'ihaa; wa yahmilu 'arsha rabbika fawqahum yawma'izin samaaniyah

ar: يومئذ تعرضون لا تخفى منكم خافية
tr: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
y: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.
p: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.
t: yawma'izin tu'radoona laa takhfaa min kum khaafiyah

ar: فأما من أوتى كتبه بيمينه فيقول هاؤم ٱقرءوا كتبيه
tr: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
y: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
p: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
t: fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fa yaqoolu haaa'umuq ra'oo kitaabiyah

ar: إنى ظننت أنى ملق حسابيه
tr: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
y: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"
p: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.
t: innee zannantu annee mulaaqin hisaabiyah

ar: فهو فى عيشة راضية
tr: So he will be in a pleasant life -
y: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
p: Then he will be in blissful state
t: fahuwa fee 'eeshatir raadiyah

ar: فى جنة عالية
tr: In an elevated garden,
y: In a Garden on high,
p: In a high garden
t: fee jannnatin 'aaliyah

ar: قطوفها دانية
tr: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
y: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.
p: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.
t: qutoofuhaa daaniyah

ar: كلوا وٱشربوا هنيـا بما أسلفتم فى ٱلأيام ٱلخالية
tr: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
y: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"
p: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.
t: kuloo washraboo haneee'am bimaaa aslaftum fil ayyaamil khaliyah

ar: وأما من أوتى كتبه بشماله فيقول يليتنى لم أوت كتبيه
tr: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
y: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!
p: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
t: wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo bishimaalihee fa yaqoolu yaalaitanee lam oota kitaaabiyah

ar: ولم أدر ما حسابيه
tr: And had not known what is my account.
y: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!
p: And knew not what my reckoning!
t: wa lam adri maa hisaabiyah

ar: يليتها كانت ٱلقاضية
tr: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
y: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!
p: Oh, would that it had been death!
t: yaa laitahaa kaanatil qaadiyah

ar: ما أغنى عنى ماليه
tr: My wealth has not availed me.
y: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!
p: My wealth hath not availed me,
t: maaa aghnaa 'annee maaliyah

ar: هلك عنى سلطنيه
tr: Gone from me is my authority."
y: "My power has perished from me!"...
p: My power hath gone from me.
t: halaka 'annee sultaaniyah

ar: خذوه فغلوه
tr: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
y: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,
p: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him
t: khuzoohu faghullooh

ar: ثم ٱلجحيم صلوه
tr: Then into Hellfire drive him.
y: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.
p: And then expose him to hell-fire
t: summal jaheema sallooh

ar: ثم فى سلسلة ذرعها سبعون ذراعا فٱسلكوه
tr: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
y: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!
p: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.
t: summa fee silsilatin zar'uhaa sab'oona ziraa'an faslukooh

ar: إنه كان لا يؤمن بٱلله ٱلعظيم
tr: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
y: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.
p: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,
t: innahoo kaana laa yu'minubillaahil 'azeem

ar: ولا يحض على طعام ٱلمسكين
tr: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
y: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
p: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.
t: wa laa yahuddu 'alaa ta'aamil miskeen

ar: فليس له ٱليوم ههنا حميم
tr: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
y: "So no friend hath he here this Day.
p: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
t: falaysa lahul yawma haahunaa hameem

ar: ولا طعام إلا من غسلين
tr: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
y: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
p: Nor any food save filth
t: wa laa ta'aamun illaa min ghisleen

ar: لا يأكله إلا ٱلخطـون
tr: None will eat it except the sinners.
y: "Which none do eat but those in sin."
p: Which none but sinners eat.
t: laa yaakuluhooo illal khati'oon

ar: فلا أقسم بما تبصرون
tr: So I swear by what you see
y: So I do call to witness what ye see,
p: But nay! I swear by all that ye see
t: falaaa uqsimu bimaa tubsiroon

ar: وما لا تبصرون
tr: And what you do not see
y: And what ye see not,
p: And all that ye see not
t: wa maa laa tubsiroon

ar: إنه لقول رسول كريم
tr: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
y: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;
p: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.
t: innahoo laqawlu rasoolin kareem

ar: وما هو بقول شاعر قليلا ما تؤمنون
tr: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
y: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!
p: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!
t: wa ma huwa biqawli shaa'ir; qaleelam maa tu'minoon

ar: ولا بقول كاهن قليلا ما تذكرون
tr: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
y: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.
p: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!
t: wa laa biqawli kaahin; qaleelam maa tazakkaroon

ar: تنزيل من رب ٱلعلمين
tr: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
y: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
p: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
t: tanzeelum mir rabbil 'aalameen

ar: ولو تقول علينا بعض ٱلأقاويل
tr: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
y: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,
p: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,
t: wa law taqawwala 'alainaa ba'dal aqaaweel

ar: لأخذنا منه بٱليمين
tr: We would have seized him by the right hand;
y: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,
p: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
t: la-akhaznaa minhu bilyameen

ar: ثم لقطعنا منه ٱلوتين
tr: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
y: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:
p: And then severed his life-artery,
t: summa laqata'naa minhul wateen

ar: فما منكم من أحد عنه حجزين
tr: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
y: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).
p: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.
t: famaa minkum min ahadin'anhu haajizeen

ar: وإنه لتذكرة للمتقين
tr: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
y: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
p: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
t: wa innahoo latazkiratul lilmuttaqeen

ar: وإنا لنعلم أن منكم مكذبين
tr: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
y: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).
p: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).
t: wa inna lana'lamu anna minkum mukazzibeen

ar: وإنه لحسرة على ٱلكفرين
tr: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
y: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
p: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.
t: wa innahu lahasratun 'alal kaafireen

ar: وإنه لحق ٱليقين
tr: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
y: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.
p: And lo! it is absolute truth.
t: wa innahoo lahaqqul yaqeen

ar: فسبح بٱسم ربك ٱلعظيم
tr: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
y: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
p: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
t: fasbbih bismi rabbikal 'azeem

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم سأل سائل بعذاب واقع
tr: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
y: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-
p: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall
t: sa ala saaa'ilum bi'azaa binw-waaqi'

ar: للكفرين ليس له دافع
tr: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
y: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-
p: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,
t: lilkaafireen laisa lahoo daafi'

ar: من ٱلله ذى ٱلمعارج
tr: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent.
y: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
p: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways
t: minal laahi zil ma'aarij

ar: تعرج ٱلملئكة وٱلروح إليه فى يوم كان مقداره خمسين ألف سنة
tr: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
y: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:
p: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.
t: ta'rujul malaaa'ikatu war roohu ilaihi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo khamseena alfa sanah

ar: فٱصبر صبرا جميلا
tr: So be patient with gracious patience.
y: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
p: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.
t: fasbir ssabran jameelaa

ar: إنهم يرونه بعيدا
tr: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
y: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):
p: Lo! they behold it afar off
t: inaahum yarawnahoo ba'eedaa

ar: ونرىه قريبا
tr: But We see it [as] near.
y: But We see it (quite) near.
p: While we behold it nigh:
t: wa naraahu qareebaa

ar: يوم تكون ٱلسماء كٱلمهل
tr: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
y: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,
p: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,
t: yawma takoonus samaaa'u kalmuhl

ar: وتكون ٱلجبال كٱلعهن
tr: And the mountains will be like wool,
y: And the mountains will be like wool,
p: And the hills become as flakes of wool,
t: wa takoonul jibaalu kal'ihn

ar: ولا يسـل حميم حميما
tr: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
y: And no friend will ask after a friend,
p: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend
t: wa laa yas'alu hameemun hameemaa

ar: يبصرونهم يود ٱلمجرم لو يفتدى من عذاب يومئذ ببنيه
tr: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
y: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,
p: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
t: yubassaroonahum; ya waddul mujrimu law yaftadee min 'azaabi yawma'izim bibaneeh

ar: وصحبته وأخيه
tr: And his wife and his brother
y: His wife and his brother,
p: And his spouse and his brother
t: wa saahibatihee wa akheeh

ar: وفصيلته ٱلتى تـويه
tr: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
y: His kindred who sheltered him,
p: And his kin that harboured him
t: wa faseelathil latee tu'weeh

ar: ومن فى ٱلأرض جميعا ثم ينجيه
tr: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
y: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:
p: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.
t: wa man fil ardi jamee'an summa yunjeeh

ar: كلا إنها لظى
tr: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
y: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
p: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
t: kallaa innahaa lazaa

ar: نزاعة للشوى
tr: A remover of exteriors.
y: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
p: Eager to roast;
t: nazzaa'atal lishshawaa

ar: تدعوا من أدبر وتولى
tr: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
y: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
p: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),
t: tad'oo man adbara wa tawallaa

ar: وجمع فأوعى
tr: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
y: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
p: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.
t: w jama'a fa aw'aa

ar: إن ٱلإنسن خلق هلوعا
tr: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
y: Truly man was created very impatient;-
p: Lo! man was created anxious,
t: innal insaana khuliqa haloo'aa

ar: إذا مسه ٱلشر جزوعا
tr: When evil touches him, impatient,
y: Fretful when evil touches him;
p: Fretful when evil befalleth him
t: izaa massahush sharru jazoo'aa

ar: وإذا مسه ٱلخير منوعا
tr: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
y: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
p: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;
t: wa izaa massahul khairu manoo'aa

ar: إلا ٱلمصلين
tr: Except the observers of prayer -
y: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
p: Save worshippers.
t: illal musalleen

ar: ٱلذين هم على صلاتهم دائمون
tr: Those who are constant in their prayer
y: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
p: Who are constant at their worship
t: allazeena hum 'alaa salaatihim daaa'imoon

ar: وٱلذين فى أمولهم حق معلوم
tr: And those within whose wealth is a known right
y: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
p: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
t: wallazeena feee amwaalihim haqqum ma'loom

ar: للسائل وٱلمحروم
tr: For the petitioner and the deprived -
y: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
p: For the beggar and the destitute;
t: lissaaa 'ili walmahroom

ar: وٱلذين يصدقون بيوم ٱلدين
tr: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
y: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
p: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
t: wallazeena yusaddiqoona bi yawmid deen

ar: وٱلذين هم من عذاب ربهم مشفقون
tr: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
y: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
p: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -
t: wallazeena hum min 'azaabi rabbihim mushfiqoon

ar: إن عذاب ربهم غير مأمون
tr: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
y: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
p: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
t: inna 'azaaba rabbihim ghairu maamoon

ar: وٱلذين هم لفروجهم حفظون
tr: And those who guard their private parts
y: And those who guard their chastity,
p: And those who preserve their chastity
t: wallazeena hum lifuroo jihim haafizoon

ar: إلا على أزوجهم أو ما ملكت أيمنهم فإنهم غير ملومين
tr: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
y: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
p: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;
t: illaa 'alaaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fainnahum ghairu maloomeen

ar: فمن ٱبتغى وراء ذلك فأولئك هم ٱلعادون
tr: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
y: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
p: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;
t: famanib taghaa waraaa'a zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul 'aadoon

ar: وٱلذين هم لأمنتهم وعهدهم رعون
tr: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
y: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
p: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,
t: wallazeena hum li amaa naatihim wa 'ahdihim raa'oon

ar: وٱلذين هم بشهدتهم قائمون
tr: And those who are in their testimonies upright
y: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
p: And those who stand by their testimony
t: wallazeena hum bishahaadaatihim qaaa'imoon

ar: وٱلذين هم على صلاتهم يحافظون
tr: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
y: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
p: And those who are attentive at their worship.
t: wallazeena hum 'alaa salaatihim yuhaafizoon

ar: أولئك فى جنت مكرمون
tr: They will be in gardens, honored.
y: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
p: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.
t: ulaaa'ika fee jannaatim mukramoon

ar: فمال ٱلذين كفروا قبلك مهطعين
tr: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
y: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
p: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,
t: famaa lil lazeena kafaroo qibalaka muhti'een

ar: عن ٱليمين وعن ٱلشمال عزين
tr: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
y: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
p: On the right and on the left, in groups?
t: 'anil yameeni wa 'anish shimaali 'izeen

ar: أيطمع كل ٱمرئ منهم أن يدخل جنة نعيم
tr: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
y: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
p: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
t: ayatma'u kullum ri'im minhum anyyudkhala jannata na'eem

ar: كلا إنا خلقنهم مما يعلمون
tr: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
y: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
p: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.
t: kallaaa innaa khalaq nahum mimmaa ya'lamoon

ar: فلا أقسم برب ٱلمشرق وٱلمغرب إنا لقدرون
tr: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
y: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
p: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able
t: falaaa uqsimu bi rabbil mashaariqi wal maghaaribi innaa laqaadiroon

ar: على أن نبدل خيرا منهم وما نحن بمسبوقين
tr: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
y: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
p: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.
t: 'alaaa an nubaddila khairam minhum wa maa nahnu bimasbooqeen

ar: فذرهم يخوضوا ويلعبوا حتى يلقوا يومهم ٱلذى يوعدون
tr: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
y: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
p: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,
t: fazarhum yakhoodoo wa yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yaw mahumul lazee yoo'adoon

ar: يوم يخرجون من ٱلأجداث سراعا كأنهم إلى نصب يوفضون
tr: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
y: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
p: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,
t: yawma yakhrujoona minal ajdaasi siraa'an ka anna hum ilaa nusubiny yoofidoon

ar: خشعة أبصرهم ترهقهم ذلة ذلك ٱليوم ٱلذى كانوا يوعدون
tr: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
y: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
p: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
t: khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillah; zaalikal yawmul lazee kaanoo yoo'adoon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إنا أرسلنا نوحا إلى قومه أن أنذر قومك من قبل أن يأتيهم عذاب أليم
tr: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
y: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
p: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.
t: innaaa arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee an anzir qawmaka min qabli any yaatiyahum 'azaabun aleem

ar: قال يقوم إنى لكم نذير مبين
tr: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
y: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
p: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
t: qaala yaa qawmi innee lakum nazeerum mubeen

ar: أن ٱعبدوا ٱلله وٱتقوه وأطيعون
tr: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
y: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:
p: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,
t: ani'udul laaha watta qoohu wa atee'oon

ar: يغفر لكم من ذنوبكم ويؤخركم إلى أجل مسمى إن أجل ٱلله إذا جاء لا يؤخر لو كنتم تعلمون
tr: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
y: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
p: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
t: yaghfir lakum min zunoobikum wa yu'akhkhirkum ilaaa ajalim musammaa; innaa ajalal laahi izaa jaaa'a laa yu'akhkhar; law kuntum ta'lamoon

ar: قال رب إنى دعوت قومى ليلا ونهارا
tr: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
y: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
p: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
t: qaala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee lailanw wa naharaa

ar: فلم يزدهم دعاءى إلا فرارا
tr: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
y: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
p: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;
t: falam yazid hum du'aaa 'eee illaa firaaraa

ar: وإنى كلما دعوتهم لتغفر لهم جعلوا أصبعهم فى ءاذانهم وٱستغشوا ثيابهم وأصروا وٱستكبروا ٱستكبارا
tr: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
y: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
p: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
t: wa inee kullamaa da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'alooo asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim wastaghshaw siyaabahum wa asaarroo wastakbarus tikbaaraa

ar: ثم إنى دعوتهم جهارا
tr: Then I invited them publicly.
y: "So I have called to them aloud;
p: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,
t: summa innee da'aw tuhum jihaara

ar: ثم إنى أعلنت لهم وأسررت لهم إسرارا
tr: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
y: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
p: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
t: summaa inneee a'lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum israaraa

ar: فقلت ٱستغفروا ربكم إنه كان غفارا
tr: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
y: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
p: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
t: faqultus taghfiroo rabakam innahoo kaana ghaffaaraa

ar: يرسل ٱلسماء عليكم مدرارا
tr: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
y: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
p: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
t: yursilis samaaa'a 'alaikum midraaraa

ar: ويمددكم بأمول وبنين ويجعل لكم جنت ويجعل لكم أنهرا
tr: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
y: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
p: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
t: wa yumdidkum bi am waalinw wa baneena wa yaj'al lakum jannaatinw wa yaj'al lakum anhaaraa

ar: ما لكم لا ترجون لله وقارا
tr: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
y: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-
p: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity
t: maa lakum laa tarjoona lillaahi waqaaraa

ar: وقد خلقكم أطوارا
tr: While He has created you in stages?
y: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
p: When He created you by (divers) stages?
t: wa qad khalaqakum at waaraa

ar: ألم تروا كيف خلق ٱلله سبع سموت طباقا
tr: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
y: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
p: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
t: alam taraw kaifa khalaqal laahu sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa

ar: وجعل ٱلقمر فيهن نورا وجعل ٱلشمس سراجا
tr: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
y: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
p: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
t: wa ja'alal qamara feehinna nooranw wa ja'alash shamsa siraajaa

ar: وٱلله أنبتكم من ٱلأرض نباتا
tr: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
y: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
p: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,
t: wallaahu ambatakum minal ardi nabaataa

ar: ثم يعيدكم فيها ويخرجكم إخراجا
tr: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
y: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
p: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.
t: summa yu'eedukum feehaa wa ukhrijukum ikhraajaa

ar: وٱلله جعل لكم ٱلأرض بساطا
tr: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
y: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
p: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you
t: wallaahu ja'ala lakumul arda bisaataa

ar: لتسلكوا منها سبلا فجاجا
tr: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
y: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"
p: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.
t: litaslukoo minhaa subulan fijaajaa

ar: قال نوح رب إنهم عصونى وٱتبعوا من لم يزده ماله وولده إلا خسارا
tr: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
y: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
p: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
t: qaala noohur robbi innahum 'asawnee wattaba'oo mal lam yazid hu maaluhoo wa waladuhooo illaa khasaara

ar: ومكروا مكرا كبارا
tr: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
y: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
p: And they have plotted a mighty plot,
t: wa makaroo makran kubbaaraa

ar: وقالوا لا تذرن ءالهتكم ولا تذرن ودا ولا سواعا ولا يغوث ويعوق ونسرا
tr: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
y: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-
p: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
t: wa qaaloo laa tazarunna aalihatakum wa laa tazarunna waddanw wa laa suwaa'anw wa laa yaghoosa wa ya'ooqa wa nasraa

ar: وقد أضلوا كثيرا ولا تزد ٱلظلمين إلا ضللا
tr: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
y: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."
p: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.
t: wa qad adalloo kasee ranw wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa dalaalaa

ar: مما خطيـتهم أغرقوا فأدخلوا نارا فلم يجدوا لهم من دون ٱلله أنصارا
tr: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
y: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.
p: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
t: mimmaa khateee' aatihim ughriqoo fa udkhiloo naaran falam yajidoo lahum min doonil laahi ansaaraa

ar: وقال نوح رب لا تذر على ٱلأرض من ٱلكفرين ديارا
tr: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
y: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
p: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
t: wa qaala noohur rabbi laa tazar 'alal ardi minal kaafireena daiyaaraa

ar: إنك إن تذرهم يضلوا عبادك ولا يلدوا إلا فاجرا كفارا
tr: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
y: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
p: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
t: innaka in tazarhum yudil loo 'ibaadaka wa laa yalidooo illaa faajiran kaffaaraa

ar: رب ٱغفر لى ولولدى ولمن دخل بيتى مؤمنا وللمؤمنين وٱلمؤمنت ولا تزد ٱلظلمين إلا تبارا
tr: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
y: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
p: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
t: rabbigh fir lee wa liwaa lidaiya wa liman dakhala baitiya mu'minanw wa lil mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم قل أوحى إلى أنه ٱستمع نفر من ٱلجن فقالوا إنا سمعنا قرءانا عجبا
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
y: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
p: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
t: qul oohiya ilaiya annna hustama'a nafarum minal jinnni faqaalooo innaa sami'naa quraanan 'ajabaa

ar: يهدى إلى ٱلرشد فـامنا به ولن نشرك بربنا أحدا
tr: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
y: 'It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.
p: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.
t: yahdeee ilar rushdi fa aamannaa bihee wa lan nushrika bi rabbinaaa ahadaa

ar: وأنه تعلى جد ربنا ما ٱتخذ صحبة ولا ولدا
tr: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
y: 'And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
p: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,
t: wa annahoo ta'aalaa jaddu rabbinaa mat takhaza saahibatanw wa la waladaa

ar: وأنه كان يقول سفيهنا على ٱلله شططا
tr: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
y: 'There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah;
p: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.
t: wa annahoo kaana yaqoolu safeehunaa 'alal laahi shatataa

ar: وأنا ظننا أن لن تقول ٱلإنس وٱلجن على ٱلله كذبا
tr: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
y: 'But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah.
p: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -
t: wa annaa zanannaaa al lan taqoolal insu wal jinnu 'alal laahi kazibaa

ar: وأنه كان رجال من ٱلإنس يعوذون برجال من ٱلجن فزادوهم رهقا
tr: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
y: 'True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.
p: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);
t: wa annahoo kaana rijaa lum minal insi ya'oozoona birijaalim minal jinni fazaa doohum rahaqaa

ar: وأنهم ظنوا كما ظننتم أن لن يبعث ٱلله أحدا
tr: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
y: 'And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment).
p: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -
t: wa annahum zannoo kamaa zanantum al lany yab'asal laahu ahadaa

ar: وأنا لمسنا ٱلسماء فوجدنها ملئت حرسا شديدا وشهبا
tr: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
y: 'And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
p: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.
t: wa annaa lamasnas sa maaa'a fa wajadnaahaa muli'at harasan shadeedanw wa shuhubaa

ar: وأنا كنا نقعد منها مقعد للسمع فمن يستمع ٱلءان يجد له شهابا رصدا
tr: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
y: 'We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
p: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
t: wa annaa kunnaa naq'udu minhaa maqaa'ida lis'sam'i famany yastami'il aana yajid lahoo shihaabar rasada

ar: وأنا لا ندرى أشر أريد بمن فى ٱلأرض أم أراد بهم ربهم رشدا
tr: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
y: 'And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.
p: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.
t: wa annaa laa nadreee asharrun ureeda biman fil ardi am araada bihim rabbuhum rashadaa

ar: وأنا منا ٱلصلحون ومنا دون ذلك كنا طرائق قددا
tr: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
y: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.
p: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.
t: wa annaa minnas saalihoona wa minnaa doona zaalika kunnaa taraaa'ilqa qidadaa

ar: وأنا ظننا أن لن نعجز ٱلله فى ٱلأرض ولن نعجزه هربا
tr: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
y: 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
p: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
t: wa annaa zanannaaa al lan nu'jizal laaha fil ardi wa lan nu'jizahoo harabaa

ar: وأنا لما سمعنا ٱلهدى ءامنا به فمن يؤمن بربه فلا يخاف بخسا ولا رهقا
tr: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
y: 'And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.
p: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.
t: wa annaa lammaa sami'nal hudaaa aamannaa bihee famany yu'mim bi rabbihee falaa yakhaafu bakhsanw wa laa rahaqaa

ar: وأنا منا ٱلمسلمون ومنا ٱلقسطون فمن أسلم فأولئك تحروا رشدا
tr: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
y: 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
p: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.
t: wa annaa minnal muslimoona wa minnal qaasitoona faman aslama fa ulaaa'ika taharraw rashadaa

ar: وأما ٱلقسطون فكانوا لجهنم حطبا
tr: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
y: 'But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire'-
p: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.
t: wa ammal qaasitoona fa kaanoo li jahannama hatabaa

ar: وألو ٱستقموا على ٱلطريقة لأسقينهم ماء غدقا
tr: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
y: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.
p: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
t: wa alla wis taqaamoo 'alat tareeqati la asqaynaahum maa'an ghadaqaa

ar: لنفتنهم فيه ومن يعرض عن ذكر ربه يسلكه عذابا صعدا
tr: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
y: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.
p: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
t: linaftinahum feeh; wa many yu'rid 'an zikri rabbihee yasluk hu 'azaaban sa'adaa

ar: وأن ٱلمسجد لله فلا تدعوا مع ٱلله أحدا
tr: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
y: "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;
p: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.
t: wa annal masaajida lillaahi falaa tad'oo ma'al laahi ahadaa

ar: وأنه لما قام عبد ٱلله يدعوه كادوا يكونون عليه لبدا
tr: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
y: "Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."
p: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.
t: wa annahoo lammaa qaama 'adul laahi yad'oohu kaadoo yakoonoona 'alaihi libadaa

ar: قل إنما أدعوا ربى ولا أشرك به أحدا
tr: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
y: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."
p: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
t: qul innamaaa ad'oo rabbee wa laaa ushriku biheee ahadaa

ar: قل إنى لا أملك لكم ضرا ولا رشدا
tr: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
y: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."
p: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.
t: qul innee laaa amliku lakum darranw wa laa rashadaa

ar: قل إنى لن يجيرنى من ٱلله أحد ولن أجد من دونه ملتحدا
tr: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
y: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,
p: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
t: qul innee lany yujeeranee minal laahi ahad, wa lan ajida min doonihee multahadaa

ar: إلا بلغا من ٱلله ورسلته ومن يعص ٱلله ورسوله فإن له نار جهنم خلدين فيها أبدا
tr: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
y: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."
p: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.
t: illaa balaagham minal laahi wa risaalaatih; wa many ya'sil laaha wa rasoolahoo fa inna lahoo naara jahannama khaalideena feehaaa abadaa

ar: حتى إذا رأوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من أضعف ناصرا وأقل عددا
tr: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
y: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
p: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
t: hattaaa izaa ra aw maa yoo'adoona fasaya'lamoona man ad'afu naasiranw wa aqallu 'adadaa

ar: قل إن أدرى أقريب ما توعدون أم يجعل له ربى أمدا
tr: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
y: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
p: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
t: qul in adreee a qareebum maa too'adoona am yaj'alu lahoo rabbeee amadaa

ar: علم ٱلغيب فلا يظهر على غيبه أحدا
tr: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
y: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-
p: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,
t: 'aalimul ghaibi falaa yuzhiru alaa ghaibiheee ahadaa

ar: إلا من ٱرتضى من رسول فإنه يسلك من بين يديه ومن خلفه رصدا
tr: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
y: "Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,
p: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him
t: illaa manir tadaa mir rasoolin fa innahoo yasluku mim baini yadihi wa min khalfihee rasadaa

ar: ليعلم أن قد أبلغوا رسلت ربهم وأحاط بما لديهم وأحصى كل شىء عددا
tr: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
y: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."
p: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
t: liya'lama an qad ablaghoo risaalaati rabbihim wa ahaata bima ladihim wa ahsaa kulla shai'in 'adadaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم يأيها ٱلمزمل
tr: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
y: O thou folded in garments!
p: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!
t: yaw ayyuhal muzzammil

ar: قم ٱليل إلا قليلا
tr: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
y: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-
p: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -
t: qumil laila illaa qaleelaa

ar: نصفه أو ٱنقص منه قليلا
tr: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
y: Half of it,- or a little less,
p: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof
t: nisfahooo awinqus minhu qaleelaa

ar: أو زد عليه ورتل ٱلقرءان ترتيلا
tr: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
y: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.
p: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,
t: aw zid 'alaihi wa rattilil qur'aana tarteela

ar: إنا سنلقى عليك قولا ثقيلا
tr: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
y: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.
p: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.
t: innaa sanulqee 'alika qawalan saqeelaa

ar: إن ناشئة ٱليل هى أشد وطـا وأقوم قيلا
tr: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
y: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
p: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.
t: inn naashi'atal laili hiya ashadddu wat anw wa aqwamu qeelaa

ar: إن لك فى ٱلنهار سبحا طويلا
tr: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
y: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
p: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.
t: inna laka fin nahaari sabhan taweelaa

ar: وٱذكر ٱسم ربك وتبتل إليه تبتيلا
tr: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
y: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
p: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
t: wazkuris ma rabbika wa tabattal ilaihi tabteelaa

ar: رب ٱلمشرق وٱلمغرب لا إله إلا هو فٱتخذه وكيلا
tr: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
y: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
p: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -
t: rabbul mashriqi wal maghriibi laaa ilaaha illaa huwa fattakhizhu wakeelaa

ar: وٱصبر على ما يقولون وٱهجرهم هجرا جميلا
tr: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
y: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
p: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
t: wasbir 'alaa maa yaqoo loona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa

ar: وذرنى وٱلمكذبين أولى ٱلنعمة ومهلهم قليلا
tr: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
y: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
p: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
t: wa zarnee walmukaz zibeena ulin na'mati wa mahhilhum qaleelaa

ar: إن لدينا أنكالا وجحيما
tr: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
y: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
p: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
t: inna ladainaaa ankaalanw wa jaheemaa

ar: وطعاما ذا غصة وعذابا أليما
tr: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
y: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
p: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
t: wa ta'aaman zaa ghussa tinw wa'azaaban aleemaa

ar: يوم ترجف ٱلأرض وٱلجبال وكانت ٱلجبال كثيبا مهيلا
tr: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
y: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
p: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
t: yawma tarjuful ardu waljibaalu wa kaanatil jibaalu kaseebam maheelaa

ar: إنا أرسلنا إليكم رسولا شهدا عليكم كما أرسلنا إلى فرعون رسولا
tr: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
y: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
p: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.
t: innaa arsalnaaa ilaikum rasoolan shahidan 'alikum kamaaa arsalnaaa ilaa fir'awna rasoolna

ar: فعصى فرعون ٱلرسول فأخذنه أخذا وبيلا
tr: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
y: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.
p: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.
t: fa'asaa fir'awnur rasoola fa akhaznaahu akhzanw wabeelaa

ar: فكيف تتقون إن كفرتم يوما يجعل ٱلولدن شيبا
tr: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
y: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-
p: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
t: fakaifa tattaqoona in kafartum yawmany yaj'alul wildaana sheeba

ar: ٱلسماء منفطر به كان وعده مفعولا
tr: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
y: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.
p: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.
t: assamaaa'u munfatirum bih; kaana wa'duhoo maf'oola

ar: إن هذه تذكرة فمن شاء ٱتخذ إلى ربه سبيلا
tr: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
y: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!
p: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.
t: inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeelaa

ar: إن ربك يعلم أنك تقوم أدنى من ثلثى ٱليل ونصفه وثلثه وطائفة من ٱلذين معك وٱلله يقدر ٱليل وٱلنهار علم أن لن تحصوه فتاب عليكم فٱقرءوا ما تيسر من ٱلقرءان علم أن سيكون منكم مرضى وءاخرون يضربون فى ٱلأرض يبتغون من فضل ٱلله وءاخرون يقتلون فى سبيل ٱلله فٱقرءوا ما تيسر منه وأقيموا ٱلصلوة وءاتوا ٱلزكوة وأقرضوا ٱلله قرضا حسنا وما تقدموا لأنفسكم من خير تجدوه عند ٱلله هو خيرا وأعظم أجرا وٱستغفروا ٱلله إن ٱلله غفور رحيم
tr: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
y: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
p: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
t: inna rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min sulusa yil laili wa nisfahoo wa sulusahoo wa taaa'ifatum minal lazeena ma'ak; wal laahu yuqaddirul laila wanna haar; 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaikum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal quraan; 'alima an sa yakoonu minkum mardaa wa aakharoona yadriboona fil ardi yabtaghoona min fadlil laahi wa aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelil laahi faqra'oo ma tayassara minhu wa aqeemus salaata wa aatuz zakaata wa aqridul laaha qardan hasanaa; wa maa tuqadimoo li anfusikum min khairin tajidoohu 'indal laahi huwa khayranw wa a'zama ajraa; wastaghfirul laahaa innal laaha ghafoorur raheem.

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم يأيها ٱلمدثر
tr: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
y: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
p: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,
t: yaaa ayyuhal muddassir

ar: قم فأنذر
tr: Arise and warn
y: Arise and deliver thy warning!
p: Arise and warn!
t: qum fa anzir

ar: وربك فكبر
tr: And your Lord glorify
y: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
p: Thy Lord magnify,
t: wa rabbaka fakabbir

ar: وثيابك فطهر
tr: And your clothing purify
y: And thy garments keep free from stain!
p: Thy raiment purify,
t: wa siyaabaka fatahhir

ar: وٱلرجز فٱهجر
tr: And uncleanliness avoid
y: And all abomination shun!
p: Pollution shun!
t: warrujza fahjur

ar: ولا تمنن تستكثر
tr: And do not confer favor to acquire more
y: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
p: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!
t: wa laa tamnun tastaksir

ar: ولربك فٱصبر
tr: But for your Lord be patient.
y: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!
p: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!
t: wa li rabbika fasbir

ar: فإذا نقر فى ٱلناقور
tr: And when the trumpet is blown,
y: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
p: For when the trumpet shall sound,
t: fa izaa nuqira fin naaqoor

ar: فذلك يومئذ يوم عسير
tr: That Day will be a difficult day
y: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
p: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,
t: fazaalika yawma 'iziny yawmun 'aseer

ar: على ٱلكفرين غير يسير
tr: For the disbelievers - not easy.
y: Far from easy for those without Faith.
p: Not of ease, for disbelievers.
t: 'alal kaafireena ghayru yaseer

ar: ذرنى ومن خلقت وحيدا
tr: Leave Me with the one I created alone
y: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
p: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,
t: zamee wa man khalaqtu waheedaa

ar: وجعلت له مالا ممدودا
tr: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
y: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
p: And then bestowed upon him ample means,
t: wa ja'altu lahoo maalam mamdoodaa

ar: وبنين شهودا
tr: And children present [with him]
y: And sons to be by his side!-
p: And sons abiding in his presence
t: wa baneena shuhoodaa

ar: ومهدت له تمهيدا
tr: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
y: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
p: And made (life) smooth for him.
t: wa mahhattu lahoo tamheeda

ar: ثم يطمع أن أزيد
tr: Then he desires that I should add more.
y: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
p: Yet he desireth that I should give more.
t: summa yat ma'u an azeed

ar: كلا إنه كان لءايتنا عنيدا
tr: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
y: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
p: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
t: kallaaa innahoo kaana li aayaatinaa 'aneedaa

ar: سأرهقه صعودا
tr: I will cover him with arduous torment.
y: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
p: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.
t: sa urhiquhoo sa'oodaa

ar: إنه فكر وقدر
tr: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
y: For he thought and he plotted;-
p: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -
t: innahoo fakkara wa qaddar

ar: فقتل كيف قدر
tr: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
y: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
p: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!
t: faqutila kayfa qaddar

ar: ثم قتل كيف قدر
tr: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
y: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
p: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -
t: summa qutila kaifa qaddar

ar: ثم نظر
tr: Then he considered [again];
y: Then he looked round;
p: Then looked he,
t: summa nazar

ar: ثم عبس وبسر
tr: Then he frowned and scowled;
y: Then he frowned and he scowled;
p: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.
t: summa 'abasa wa basar

ar: ثم أدبر وٱستكبر
tr: Then he turned back and was arrogant
y: Then he turned back and was haughty;
p: Then turned he away in pride
t: summaa adbara wastakbar

ar: فقال إن هذا إلا سحر يؤثر
tr: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
y: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
p: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;
t: faqaala in haazaaa illaa sihruny yu'sar

ar: إن هذا إلا قول ٱلبشر
tr: This is not but the word of a human being."
y: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
p: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.
t: in haazaaa illaa qawlul bashar

ar: سأصليه سقر
tr: I will drive him into Saqar.
y: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
p: Him shall I fling unto the burning.
t: sa usleehi saqar

ar: وما أدرىك ما سقر
tr: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
y: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
p: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -
t: wa maaa adraaka maa saqar

ar: لا تبقى ولا تذر
tr: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
y: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
p: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught
t: laa tubqee wa laa tazar

ar: لواحة للبشر
tr: Blackening the skins.
y: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
p: It shrivelleth the man.
t: lawwaahatul lilbashar

ar: عليها تسعة عشر
tr: Over it are nineteen [angels].
y: Over it are Nineteen.
p: Above it are nineteen.
t: 'alaihaa tis'ata 'ashar

ar: وما جعلنا أصحب ٱلنار إلا ملئكة وما جعلنا عدتهم إلا فتنة للذين كفروا ليستيقن ٱلذين أوتوا ٱلكتب ويزداد ٱلذين ءامنوا إيمنا ولا يرتاب ٱلذين أوتوا ٱلكتب وٱلمؤمنون وليقول ٱلذين فى قلوبهم مرض وٱلكفرون ماذا أراد ٱلله بهذا مثلا كذلك يضل ٱلله من يشاء ويهدى من يشاء وما يعلم جنود ربك إلا هو وما هى إلا ذكرى للبشر
tr: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
y: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
p: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
t: wa maaja''alnaaa as haaban naari illaa malaaa 'ikatanw wa maa ja'alnaa 'iddatahum illaa fitnatal lillazeena kafaroo liyastayqinal lazeena ootul kitaaba wa yazdaadal lazeena aamanooo eemaananw wa laa yartaabal lazeena ootul kitaaba walmu'minoona wa liyaqoolal lazeena fee quloo bihim maradunw walkaafiroona maazaaa araadal laahu bihaazaa masalaa; kazaalika yudillul laahu many yashaaa'u wa yahdee many yashaaa'; wa maa ya'lamu junooda rabbika illaa hoo; wa maa hiya illaa zikraa lil bashar

ar: كلا وٱلقمر
tr: No! By the moon
y: Nay, verily: By the Moon,
p: Nay, by the Moon
t: kallaa walqamar

ar: وٱليل إذ أدبر
tr: And [by] the night when it departs
y: And by the Night as it retreateth,
p: And the night when it withdraweth
t: wallaili adbar

ar: وٱلصبح إذا أسفر
tr: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
y: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
p: And the dawn when it shineth forth,
t: wassub hi izaaa asfar

ar: إنها لإحدى ٱلكبر
tr: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
y: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
p: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)
t: innahaa la ihdal kubar

ar: نذيرا للبشر
tr: As a warning to humanity -
y: A warning to mankind,-
p: As a warning unto men,
t: nazeeral lilbashar

ar: لمن شاء منكم أن يتقدم أو يتأخر
tr: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
y: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
p: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.
t: liman shaaa'a minkum any yataqaddama aw yata akhkhar

ar: كل نفس بما كسبت رهينة
tr: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
y: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
p: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;
t: kullu nafsim bim kasabat raheenah

ar: إلا أصحب ٱليمين
tr: Except the companions of the right,
y: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
p: Save those who will stand on the right hand.
t: illaaa as haabal yameen

ar: فى جنت يتساءلون
tr: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
y: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
p: In gardens they will ask one another
t: fee jannaatiny yata saaa'aloon

ar: عن ٱلمجرمين
tr: About the criminals,
y: And (ask) of the Sinners:
p: Concerning the guilty:
t: 'anil mujrimeen

ar: ما سلككم فى سقر
tr: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
y: "What led you into Hell Fire?"
p: What hath brought you to this burning?
t: maa salakakum fee saqar

ar: قالوا لم نك من ٱلمصلين
tr: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
y: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
p: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
t: qaaloo lam naku minal musalleen

ar: ولم نك نطعم ٱلمسكين
tr: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
y: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
p: Nor did we feed the wretched.
t: wa lam naku nut'imul miskeen

ar: وكنا نخوض مع ٱلخائضين
tr: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
y: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
p: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,
t: wa kunnaa nakhoodu ma'al khaaa'ideen

ar: وكنا نكذب بيوم ٱلدين
tr: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
y: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
p: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
t: wa kunnaa nukazzibu bi yawmid deen

ar: حتى أتىنا ٱليقين
tr: Until there came to us the certainty."
y: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
p: Till the Inevitable came unto us.
t: hattaaa ataanal yaqeen

ar: فما تنفعهم شفعة ٱلشفعين
tr: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
y: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
p: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.
t: famaa tanfa'uhum shafaa'atush shaafi'een

ar: فما لهم عن ٱلتذكرة معرضين
tr: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
y: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
p: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,
t: famaa lahum 'anittazkirati mu'rideen

ar: كأنهم حمر مستنفرة
tr: As if they were alarmed donkeys
y: As if they were affrighted asses,
p: As they were frightened asses
t: ka annahum humurum mustanfirah

ar: فرت من قسورة
tr: Fleeing from a lion?
y: Fleeing from a lion!
p: Fleeing from a lion?
t: farrat min qaswarah

ar: بل يريد كل ٱمرئ منهم أن يؤتى صحفا منشرة
tr: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
y: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
p: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).
t: bal yureedu kullum ri'im minhum any yu'taa suhufam munashsharah

ar: كلا بل لا يخافون ٱلءاخرة
tr: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
y: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
p: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.
t: kallaa bal laa yakhaafoonal aakhirah

ar: كلا إنه تذكرة
tr: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
y: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
p: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.
t: kallaaa innahoo tazkirah

ar: فمن شاء ذكره
tr: Then whoever wills will remember it.
y: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
p: So whosoever will may heed.
t: fa man shaaa'a zakarah

ar: وما يذكرون إلا أن يشاء ٱلله هو أهل ٱلتقوى وأهل ٱلمغفرة
tr: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
y: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
p: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.
t: wa maa yazkuroona illaaa any yashaaa'al laah; huwa ahlut taqwaa wa ahlul maghfirah

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم لا أقسم بيوم ٱلقيمة
tr: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
y: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;
p: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
t: laaa uqsimu bi yawmil qiyaamah

ar: ولا أقسم بٱلنفس ٱللوامة
tr: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
y: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
p: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
t: wa laaa uqsimu bin nafsil lawwaamah

ar: أيحسب ٱلإنسن ألن نجمع عظامه
tr: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
y: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?
p: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
t: ayahsabul insaanu al lan najm'a 'izaamah

ar: بلى قدرين على أن نسوى بنانه
tr: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
y: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.
p: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!
t: balaa qaadireena 'alaaa an nusawwiya banaanah

ar: بل يريد ٱلإنسن ليفجر أمامه
tr: But man desires to continue in sin.
y: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
p: But man would fain deny what is before him.
t: bal yureedul insaanu liyafjura amaamah

ar: يسـل أيان يوم ٱلقيمة
tr: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
y: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
p: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
t: yas'alu ayyyaana yawmul qiyaamah

ar: فإذا برق ٱلبصر
tr: So when vision is dazzled
y: At length, when the sight is dazed,
p: But when sight is confounded
t: fa izaa bariqal basar

ar: وخسف ٱلقمر
tr: And the moon darkens
y: And the moon is buried in darkness.
p: And the moon is eclipsed
t: we khasafal qamar

ar: وجمع ٱلشمس وٱلقمر
tr: And the sun and the moon are joined,
y: And the sun and moon are joined together,-
p: And sun and moon are united,
t: wa jumi'ash shamusu wal qamar

ar: يقول ٱلإنسن يومئذ أين ٱلمفر
tr: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
y: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"
p: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
t: yaqoolul insaanu yaw ma 'izin aynal mafarr

ar: كلا لا وزر
tr: No! There is no refuge.
y: By no means! No place of safety!
p: Alas! No refuge!
t: kallaa laa wazar

ar: إلى ربك يومئذ ٱلمستقر
tr: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
y: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.
p: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.
t: ilaa rabbika yawma 'izinil mustaqarr

ar: ينبؤا ٱلإنسن يومئذ بما قدم وأخر
tr: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
y: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.
p: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
t: yunabba 'ul insaanu yawma 'izim bimaa qaddama wa akhkhar

ar: بل ٱلإنسن على نفسه بصيرة
tr: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
y: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,
p: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
t: balil insaanu 'alaa nafsihee baseerah

ar: ولو ألقى معاذيره
tr: Even if he presents his excuses.
y: Even though he were to put up his excuses.
p: Although he tender his excuses.
t: wa law alqaa ma'aazeerah

ar: لا تحرك به لسانك لتعجل به
tr: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
y: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.
p: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.
t: laa tuharrik bihee lisaa naka lita'jala bih

ar: إن علينا جمعه وقرءانه
tr: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
y: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
p: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
t: inna 'alainaa jam'ahoo wa qur aanah

ar: فإذا قرأنه فٱتبع قرءانه
tr: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
y: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
p: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;
t: fa izaa qaraanaahu fattabi' qur aanah

ar: ثم إن علينا بيانه
tr: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
y: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):
p: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.
t: summa inna 'alainaa bayaanah

ar: كلا بل تحبون ٱلعاجلة
tr: No! But you love the immediate
y: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,
p: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
t: kallaa bal tuhibboonal 'aajilah

ar: وتذرون ٱلءاخرة
tr: And leave the Hereafter.
y: And leave alone the Hereafter.
p: And neglect the Hereafter.
t: wa tazaroonal aakhirah

ar: وجوه يومئذ ناضرة
tr: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
y: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
p: That day will faces be resplendent,
t: wujoohuny yawma 'izin naadirah

ar: إلى ربها ناظرة
tr: Looking at their Lord.
y: Looking towards their Lord;
p: Looking toward their Lord;
t: ilaa rabbihaa naazirah

ar: ووجوه يومئذ باسرة
tr: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
y: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,
p: And that day will other faces be despondent,
t: wa wujoohuny yawma 'izim baasirah

ar: تظن أن يفعل بها فاقرة
tr: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
y: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;
p: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.
t: tazunnu any yuf'ala bihaa faaqirah

ar: كلا إذا بلغت ٱلتراقى
tr: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
y: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),
p: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
t: kallaaa izaa balaghatit taraaqee

ar: وقيل من راق
tr: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
y: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"
p: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?
t: wa qeela man raaq

ar: وظن أنه ٱلفراق
tr: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
y: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;
p: And he knoweth that it is the parting;
t: wa zanna annahul firaaq

ar: وٱلتفت ٱلساق بٱلساق
tr: And the leg is wound about the leg,
y: And one leg will be joined with another:
p: And agony is heaped on agony;
t: waltaffatis saaqu bissaaq

ar: إلى ربك يومئذ ٱلمساق
tr: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
y: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!
p: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
t: ilaa rabbika yawma'izinil masaaq

ar: فلا صدق ولا صلى
tr: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
y: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-
p: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
t: falaa saddaqa wa laa sallaa

ar: ولكن كذب وتولى
tr: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
y: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!
p: But he denied and flouted.
t: wa laakin kazzaba wa tawalla

ar: ثم ذهب إلى أهله يتمطى
tr: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
y: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!
p: Then went he to his folk with glee.
t: summa zahaba ilaaa ahlihee yatamatta

ar: أولى لك فأولى
tr: Woe to you, and woe!
y: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
p: Nearer unto thee and nearer,
t: awlaa laka fa awlaa

ar: ثم أولى لك فأولى
tr: Then woe to you, and woe!
y: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
p: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
t: summa awlaa laka fa awla

ar: أيحسب ٱلإنسن أن يترك سدى
tr: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
y: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?
p: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?
t: ayahsabul insaanu anyytraka sudaa

ar: ألم يك نطفة من منى يمنى
tr: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
y: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
p: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?
