t: alam yaku nutfatam mim maniyyiny yumnaa

ar: ثم كان علقة فخلق فسوى
tr: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
y: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.
p: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
t: summa kaana 'alaqata fakhalaq fasawwaa

ar: فجعل منه ٱلزوجين ٱلذكر وٱلأنثى
tr: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
y: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.
p: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
t: faja'ala minhuz zawjayniz zakara wal unsaa

ar: أليس ذلك بقدر على أن يحى ٱلموتى
tr: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
y: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
p: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
t: alaisa zaalika biqaadirin 'alaaa any yuhyiyal mawtaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم هل أتى على ٱلإنسن حين من ٱلدهر لم يكن شيـا مذكورا
tr: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
y: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
p: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
t: hal ataa 'alal insaani heenum minad dahri lam yakun shai'am mazkooraa

ar: إنا خلقنا ٱلإنسن من نطفة أمشاج نبتليه فجعلنه سميعا بصيرا
tr: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
y: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
p: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
t: innaa khalaqnal insaana min nutfatin amshaajin nabta leehi faja'alnaahu samee'am baseeraa

ar: إنا هدينه ٱلسبيل إما شاكرا وإما كفورا
tr: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
y: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
p: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
t: innaa hadainaahus sabeela immaa shaakiranw wa immaa kafoora

ar: إنا أعتدنا للكفرين سلسلا وأغللا وسعيرا
tr: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
y: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
p: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
t: innaaa a'tadnaa lilkaa fireena salaasila wa aghlaalanw wa sa'eeraa

ar: إن ٱلأبرار يشربون من كأس كان مزاجها كافورا
tr: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
y: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
p: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
t: innal abraara yashra boona min kaasin kaana mizaa juhaa kaafooraa

ar: عينا يشرب بها عباد ٱلله يفجرونها تفجيرا
tr: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
y: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
p: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
t: 'aynany yashrabu bihaa 'ibaadul laahi yafajjiroonahaa tafjeeraa

ar: يوفون بٱلنذر ويخافون يوما كان شره مستطيرا
tr: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
y: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
p: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
t: yoofoona binnazri wa yakhaafoona yawman kaana sharruhoo mustateeraa

ar: ويطعمون ٱلطعام على حبه مسكينا ويتيما وأسيرا
tr: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
y: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
p: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
t: wa yut''imoonat ta'aama 'alaa hubbihee miskeenanw wa yatemanw wa aseeraa

ar: إنما نطعمكم لوجه ٱلله لا نريد منكم جزاء ولا شكورا
tr: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
y: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
p: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
t: innaamaa nut'imukum li wajhil laahi laa nureedu minkum jazaaa'anw wa laa shukooraa

ar: إنا نخاف من ربنا يوما عبوسا قمطريرا
tr: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
y: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
p: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
t: innaa nakhaafu mir rabbinna yawman 'aboosan qamtareeraa

ar: فوقىهم ٱلله شر ذلك ٱليوم ولقىهم نضرة وسرورا
tr: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
y: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
p: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
t: fa waqaahumul laahu sharra zaalikal yawmi wa laqqaahum nadratanw wa surooraa

ar: وجزىهم بما صبروا جنة وحريرا
tr: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
y: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
p: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
t: wa jazaahum bimaa sabaroo janatanw wa hareeraa

ar: متكـين فيها على ٱلأرائك لا يرون فيها شمسا ولا زمهريرا
tr: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
y: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.
p: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
t: muttaki'eena feeha 'alal araaa 'iki laa yarawna feehaa shamsanw wa laa zamhareeraa

ar: ودانية عليهم ظللها وذللت قطوفها تذليلا
tr: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
y: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
p: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
t: wa daaniyatan 'alaihim zilaaluhaa wa zullilat qutoofu haa tazleela

ar: ويطاف عليهم بـانية من فضة وأكواب كانت قواريرا
tr: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
y: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
p: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
t: wa yutaafu 'alaihim bi aaniyatim min fiddatinw wa akwaabin kaanat qawaareeraa

ar: قواريرا من فضة قدروها تقديرا
tr: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
y: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
p: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
t: qawaareera min fiddatin qaddaroohaa taqdeeraa

ar: ويسقون فيها كأسا كان مزاجها زنجبيلا
tr: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
y: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
p: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
t: wa yusawna feehaa kaasan kaana mizaajuhaa zanjabeelaa

ar: عينا فيها تسمى سلسبيلا
tr: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
y: A fountain there, called Salsabil.
p: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
t: 'aynan feeha tusammaa salsabeelaa

ar: ويطوف عليهم ولدن مخلدون إذا رأيتهم حسبتهم لؤلؤا منثورا
tr: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
y: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
p: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
t: wa yatoofu 'alaihim wildaanum mukhalladoona izaa ra aytahum hasibtahum lu'lu 'am mansoora

ar: وإذا رأيت ثم رأيت نعيما وملكا كبيرا
tr: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
y: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
p: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
t: wa izaa ra ayta summa ra ayta na'eemanw wa mulkan kabeera

ar: عليهم ثياب سندس خضر وإستبرق وحلوا أساور من فضة وسقىهم ربهم شرابا طهورا
tr: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
y: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
p: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
t: 'aaliyahum siyaabu sundusin khudrunw wa istabraq, wa hullooo asaawira min fiddatinw wa saqaahum rabbuhum sharaaban tahooraa

ar: إن هذا كان لكم جزاء وكان سعيكم مشكورا
tr: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
y: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
p: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
t: innaa haazaa kaana lakum jazz 'anw wa kaana sa'yukum mashkooraa

ar: إنا نحن نزلنا عليك ٱلقرءان تنزيلا
tr: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
y: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.
p: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;
t: innaa nahnu nazzalnaa 'alaikal quraana tanzeelaa

ar: فٱصبر لحكم ربك ولا تطع منهم ءاثما أو كفورا
tr: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
y: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
p: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
t: fasbir lihukmi rabbika wa laa tuti' minhum aasiman aw kafooraa

ar: وٱذكر ٱسم ربك بكرة وأصيلا
tr: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
y: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,
p: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
t: wazkuris ma rabbika bukratanw wa aseelaa

ar: ومن ٱليل فٱسجد له وسبحه ليلا طويلا
tr: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
y: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
p: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
t: wa minal laili fasjud lahoo wa sabbihhu lailan taweelaa

ar: إن هؤلاء يحبون ٱلعاجلة ويذرون وراءهم يوما ثقيلا
tr: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
y: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
p: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
t: inna haaa'ulaa'i yuhibboona 'aajilata wa yazaroona waraaa'ahum yawman saqeelaa

ar: نحن خلقنهم وشددنا أسرهم وإذا شئنا بدلنا أمثلهم تبديلا
tr: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
y: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
p: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
t: nahnu khalaqnaahum wa shadadnaaa asrahum wa izaa shi'naa baddalnaaa amsaala hum tabdeelaa

ar: إن هذه تذكرة فمن شاء ٱتخذ إلى ربه سبيلا
tr: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
y: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
p: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
t: inna haazihee tazkiratun fa man shaaa'at takhaza ilaa rabbihee sabeela

ar: وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء ٱلله إن ٱلله كان عليما حكيما
tr: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
y: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
p: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
t: wa maa tashaaa'oona illaa anyyashaaa'al laah; innal laahaa kaana'aleeman hakeema

ar: يدخل من يشاء فى رحمته وٱلظلمين أعد لهم عذابا أليما
tr: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
y: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
p: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
t: yudkhilu mai yashaaa'u fee rahmatih; wazzaalimeena a'adda lahum 'azaaban aleemaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلمرسلت عرفا
tr: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
y: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);
p: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
t: wal mursalaati'urfaa

ar: فٱلعصفت عصفا
tr: And the winds that blow violently
y: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
p: By the raging hurricanes,
t: fal'aasifaati 'asfaa

ar: وٱلنشرت نشرا
tr: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
y: And scatter (things) far and wide;
p: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;
t: wannaashiraati nashraa

ar: فٱلفرقت فرقا
tr: And those [angels] who bring criterion
y: Then separate them, one from another,
p: By those who winnow with a winnowing,
t: falfaariqaati farqaa

ar: فٱلملقيت ذكرا
tr: And those [angels] who deliver a message
y: Then spread abroad a Message,
p: By those who bring down the Reminder,
t: falmulqiyaati zikra

ar: عذرا أو نذرا
tr: As justification or warning,
y: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
p: To excuse or to warn,
t: 'uzran aw nuzraa

ar: إنما توعدون لوقع
tr: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
y: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
p: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.
t: innamaa too'adoona lawaaqi'

ar: فإذا ٱلنجوم طمست
tr: So when the stars are obliterated
y: Then when the stars become dim;
p: So when the stars are put out,
t: fa izam nujoomu tumisat

ar: وإذا ٱلسماء فرجت
tr: And when the heaven is opened
y: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
p: And when the sky is riven asunder,
t: wa izas samaaa'u furijat

ar: وإذا ٱلجبال نسفت
tr: And when the mountains are blown away
y: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
p: And when the mountains are blown away,
t: wa izal jibaalu nusifat

ar: وإذا ٱلرسل أقتت
tr: And when the messengers' time has come...
y: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
p: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -
t: wa izar rusulu uqqitat

ar: لأى يوم أجلت
tr: For what Day was it postponed?
y: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
p: For what day is the time appointed?
t: li ayyi yawmin ujjilat

ar: ليوم ٱلفصل
tr: For the Day of Judgement.
y: For the Day of Sorting out.
p: For the Day of Decision.
t: li yawmil fasl

ar: وما أدرىك ما يوم ٱلفصل
tr: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
y: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
p: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
t: wa maaa adraaka maa yawmul fasl

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailuny yawma 'izillilmukazzibeen

ar: ألم نهلك ٱلأولين
tr: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
y: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
p: Destroyed We not the former folk,
t: alam nuhlikil awwaleen

ar: ثم نتبعهم ٱلءاخرين
tr: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
y: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
p: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?
t: summa nutbi'uhumul aakhireen

ar: كذلك نفعل بٱلمجرمين
tr: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
y: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
p: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
t: kazzlika naf'alu bilmujrimeen

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailunw yawma 'izil lil mukazzibeen

ar: ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين
tr: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
y: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
p: Did We not create you from a base fluid
t: alam nakhlukkum mimmaaa'im maheen

ar: فجعلنه فى قرار مكين
tr: And We placed it in a firm lodging
y: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
p: Which We laid up in a safe abode
t: faja'alnaahu fee qaraarim makeen

ar: إلى قدر معلوم
tr: For a known extent.
y: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
p: For a known term?
t: illaa qadrim ma'loom

ar: فقدرنا فنعم ٱلقدرون
tr: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
y: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
p: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
t: faqadarnaa fani'mal qaadiroon

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen

ar: ألم نجعل ٱلأرض كفاتا
tr: Have We not made the earth a container
y: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
p: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
t: alam naj'alil arda kifaataa

ar: أحياء وأموتا
tr: Of the living and the dead?
y: The living and the dead,
p: Both for the living and the dead,
t: ahyaaa'anw wa amwaataa

ar: وجعلنا فيها روسى شمخت وأسقينكم ماء فراتا
tr: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
y: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
p: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?
t: wa ja'alnaa feehaa rawaasiya shaamikhaatinw wa asqainaakum maaa'an furaataa

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen

ar: ٱنطلقوا إلى ما كنتم به تكذبون
tr: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
y: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
p: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;
t: intaliqooo ilaa maa kuntum bihee tukazziboon

ar: ٱنطلقوا إلى ظل ذى ثلث شعب
tr: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
y: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
p: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,
t: intaliqooo ilaa zillin zee salaasi shu'ab

ar: لا ظليل ولا يغنى من ٱللهب
tr: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
y: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
p: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
t: laa zaleelinw wa laa yughnee minal lahab

ar: إنها ترمى بشرر كٱلقصر
tr: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
y: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
p: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,
t: innahaa tarmee bishararin kalqasr

ar: كأنه جملت صفر
tr: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
y: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
p: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.
t: ka annahoo jimaalatun sufr

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailuny yawma 'izil lilmukazibeen

ar: هذا يوم لا ينطقون
tr: This is a Day they will not speak,
y: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
p: This is a day wherein they speak not,
t: haazaa yawmu laa uantiqoon

ar: ولا يؤذن لهم فيعتذرون
tr: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
y: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
p: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.
t: wa laa yu'zanu lahum fa ya'taziroon

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailunw yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen

ar: هذا يوم ٱلفصل جمعنكم وٱلأولين
tr: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
y: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
p: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
t: haaza yawmul fasli jama 'naakum wal awwaleen

ar: فإن كان لكم كيد فكيدون
tr: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
y: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
p: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
t: fa in kaana lakum kaidun fakeedoon

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailuny yawma'izil lilmukazzibeen

ar: إن ٱلمتقين فى ظلل وعيون
tr: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
y: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
p: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
t: innal muttaqeena fee zilaalinw wa 'uyoon

ar: وفوكه مما يشتهون
tr: And fruits from whatever they desire,
y: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
p: And fruits such as they desire.
t: wa fawaakiha mimmaa yastahoon

ar: كلوا وٱشربوا هنيـا بما كنتم تعملون
tr: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
y: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
p: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.
t: kuloo washraboo haneee 'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon

ar: إنا كذلك نجزى ٱلمحسنين
tr: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
y: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
p: Thus do We reward the good.
t: innaa kazaalika najzil muhsineen

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailuny yawma 'izil lilmuzkazzibeen

ar: كلوا وتمتعوا قليلا إنكم مجرمون
tr: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
y: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
p: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
t: kuloo wa tamatta'oo qaleelan innakum mujrimoon

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailunny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen

ar: وإذا قيل لهم ٱركعوا لا يركعون
tr: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
y: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
p: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
t: wa izaa qeela lahumur ka'oo aa yarka'oon

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
y: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailunny yawma 'izil lilmukazzibeen

ar: فبأى حديث بعده يؤمنون
tr: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
y: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
p: In what statement, after this, will they believe?
t: fabi ayyi hadeesim ba'dahoo yu'minoon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم عم يتساءلون
tr: About what are they asking one another?
y: Concerning what are they disputing?
p: Whereof do they question one another?
t: 'amma yatasaa-aloon

ar: عن ٱلنبإ ٱلعظيم
tr: About the great news -
y: Concerning the Great News,
p: (It is) of the awful tidings,
t: 'anin-nabaa-il 'azeem

ar: ٱلذى هم فيه مختلفون
tr: That over which they are in disagreement.
y: About which they cannot agree.
p: Concerning which they are in disagreement.
t: allazi hum feehi mukh talifoon

ar: كلا سيعلمون
tr: No! They are going to know.
y: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!
p: Nay, but they will come to know!
t: kallaa sa y'alamoon

ar: ثم كلا سيعلمون
tr: Then, no! They are going to know.
y: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!
p: Nay, again, but they will come to know!
t: thumma kallaa sa y'alamoon

ar: ألم نجعل ٱلأرض مهدا
tr: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
y: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,
p: Have We not made the earth an expanse,
t: alam naj'alil arda mihaa da

ar: وٱلجبال أوتادا
tr: And the mountains as stakes?
y: And the mountains as pegs?
p: And the high hills bulwarks?
t: wal jibaala au taada

ar: وخلقنكم أزوجا
tr: And We created you in pairs
y: And (have We not) created you in pairs,
p: And We have created you in pairs,
t: wa khalaq naakum azwaaja

ar: وجعلنا نومكم سباتا
tr: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
y: And made your sleep for rest,
p: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
t: waja'alnan naumakum subata

ar: وجعلنا ٱليل لباسا
tr: And made the night as clothing
y: And made the night as a covering,
p: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
t: waja'alnal laila libasa

ar: وجعلنا ٱلنهار معاشا
tr: And made the day for livelihood
y: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
p: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
t: waja'alnan nahara ma 'aasha

ar: وبنينا فوقكم سبعا شدادا
tr: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
y: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
p: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
t: wa banaina fauqakum sab 'an shi daada

ar: وجعلنا سراجا وهاجا
tr: And made [therein] a burning lamp
y: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
p: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
t: waja'alna siraajaw wah haaja

ar: وأنزلنا من ٱلمعصرت ماء ثجاجا
tr: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
y: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
p: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
t: wa anzalna minal m'usiraati maa-an saj-jaaja

ar: لنخرج به حبا ونباتا
tr: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
y: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
p: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
t: linukh rija bihee habbaw wana baata

ar: وجنت ألفافا
tr: And gardens of entwined growth.
y: And gardens of luxurious growth?
p: And gardens of thick foliage.
t: wa jan naatin alfafa

ar: إن يوم ٱلفصل كان ميقتا
tr: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
y: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
p: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
t: inna yaumal-fasli kana miqaata

ar: يوم ينفخ فى ٱلصور فتأتون أفواجا
tr: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
y: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
p: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
t: yauma yun fakhu fis-soori fataa toona afwaaja

ar: وفتحت ٱلسماء فكانت أبوبا
tr: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
y: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
p: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
t: wa futiha tis samaa-u fakaanat abwaaba

ar: وسيرت ٱلجبال فكانت سرابا
tr: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
y: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
p: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
t: wa suyyi raatil jibaalu fa kaanat saraaba

ar: إن جهنم كانت مرصادا
tr: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
y: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
p: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,
t: inna jahan nama kaanat mirsaada

ar: للطغين مـابا
tr: For the transgressors, a place of return,
y: For the transgressors a place of destination:
p: A home for the rebellious.
t: lit taa gheena ma aaba

ar: لبثين فيها أحقابا
tr: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
y: They will dwell therein for ages.
p: They will abide therein for ages.
t: laa bitheena feehaa ahqaaba

ar: لا يذوقون فيها بردا ولا شرابا
tr: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
y: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
p: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
t: laa ya zooqoona feeha bar daw walaa sharaaba

ar: إلا حميما وغساقا
tr: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
y: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
p: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
t: illa hamee maw-wa ghas saaqa

ar: جزاء وفاقا
tr: An appropriate recompense.
y: A fitting recompense (for them).
p: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).
t: jazaa-aw wi faaqa

ar: إنهم كانوا لا يرجون حسابا
tr: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
y: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
p: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
t: innahum kaanu laa yarjoona hisaaba

ar: وكذبوا بـايتنا كذابا
tr: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
y: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
p: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
t: wa kazzabu bi aayaa tina kizzaba

ar: وكل شىء أحصينه كتبا
tr: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
y: And all things have We preserved on record.
p: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
t: wa kulla shai-in ahsai naahu kitaa ba

ar: فذوقوا فلن نزيدكم إلا عذابا
tr: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
y: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
p: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
t: fa zooqoo falan-nazee dakum ill-laa azaaba

ar: إن للمتقين مفازا
tr: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
y: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;
p: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
t: inna lil mutta qeena mafaaza

ar: حدائق وأعنبا
tr: Gardens and grapevines
y: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;
p: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,
t: hadaa-iqa wa a'anaa ba

ar: وكواعب أترابا
tr: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
y: And voluptuous women of equal age;
p: And voluptuous women of equal age;
t: wa kaawa 'iba at raaba

ar: وكأسا دهاقا
tr: And a full cup.
y: And a cup full (to the brim).
p: And a full cup.
t: wa ka'san di haaqa

ar: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا كذبا
tr: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
y: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
p: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
t: laa yasma'oona fiha lagh waw walaa kizzaba

ar: جزاء من ربك عطاء حسابا
tr: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
y: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
p: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
t: jazaa-am mir-rabbika ataa-an hisaaba

ar: رب ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وما بينهما ٱلرحمن لا يملكون منه خطابا
tr: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
y: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
p: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
t: rabbis samaa waati wal ardi wa maa baina humar rahmaani laa yam likoona minhu khi taaba

ar: يوم يقوم ٱلروح وٱلملئكة صفا لا يتكلمون إلا من أذن له ٱلرحمن وقال صوابا
tr: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
y: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
p: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
t: yauma yaqoo mur roohu wal malaa-ikatu saf-fal laa yata kalla moona illa man azina lahur rahmaanu wa qaala sawaaba

ar: ذلك ٱليوم ٱلحق فمن شاء ٱتخذ إلى ربه مـابا
tr: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
y: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
p: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
t: zaalikal yaumul haqqu faman shaa-at ta khaaza ill-laa rabbihi ma-aaba

ar: إنا أنذرنكم عذابا قريبا يوم ينظر ٱلمرء ما قدمت يداه ويقول ٱلكافر يليتنى كنت تربا
tr: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
y: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (metre) dust!"
p: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
t: in naa anzar naakum azaaban qareebaiy-yauma yan zurul marr-u maa qaddamat yadaahu wa ya qoolul-kaafiru yaa lai tanee kuntu turaaba

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلنزعت غرقا
tr: By those [angels] who extract with violence
y: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
p: By those who drag forth to destruction,
t: wan naazi 'aati gharqa

ar: وٱلنشطت نشطا
tr: And [by] those who remove with ease
y: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
p: By the meteors rushing,
t: wan naa shi taati nashta

ar: وٱلسبحت سبحا
tr: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
y: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
p: By the lone stars floating,
t: wass saabi-haati sabha

ar: فٱلسبقت سبقا
tr: And those who race each other in a race
y: Then press forward as in a race,
p: By the angels hastening,
t: fass saabi qaati sabqa

ar: فٱلمدبرت أمرا
tr: And those who arrange [each] matter,
y: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
p: And those who govern the event,
t: fal mu dab-bi raati amra

ar: يوم ترجف ٱلراجفة
tr: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
y: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
p: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
t: yawma tarjufur raajifa

ar: تتبعها ٱلرادفة
tr: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
y: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):
p: And the second followeth it,
t: tatba'u har raadifa

ar: قلوب يومئذ واجفة
tr: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
y: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
p: On that day hearts beat painfully
t: quloobuny-yau maaiziw-waaji-fa

ar: أبصرها خشعة
tr: Their eyes humbled.
y: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.
p: While eyes are downcast
t: absaa ruhaa khashi'ah

ar: يقولون أءنا لمردودون فى ٱلحافرة
tr: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
y: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
p: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
t: ya qoo loona a-inna lamar doo doona fil haafirah

ar: أءذا كنا عظما نخرة
tr: Even if we should be decayed bones?
y: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
p: Even after we are crumbled bones?
t: aizaa kunna 'izaa man-nakhirah

ar: قالوا تلك إذا كرة خاسرة
tr: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
y: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
p: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
t: qaalu tilka izan karratun khaasirah.

ar: فإنما هى زجرة وحدة
tr: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
y: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
p: Surely it will need but one shout,
t: fa inna ma hiya zajratuw-waahida

ar: فإذا هم بٱلساهرة
tr: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
y: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
p: And lo! they will be awakened.
t: faizaa hum biss saahirah

ar: هل أتىك حديث موسى
tr: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
y: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
p: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?
t: hal ataaka hadeethu musaa

ar: إذ نادىه ربه بٱلواد ٱلمقدس طوى
tr: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
y: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
p: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
t: iz nadaahu rabbuhu bil waadil-muqad dasi tuwa

ar: ٱذهب إلى فرعون إنه طغى
tr: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
y: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
p: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
t: izhab ilaa fir'auna innahu taghaa.

ar: فقل هل لك إلى أن تزكى
tr: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
y: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
p: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
t: faqul hal laka ilaa-an tazakka.

ar: وأهديك إلى ربك فتخشى
tr: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
y: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"
p: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
t: wa ahdi yaka ila rabbika fatakh sha

ar: فأرىه ٱلءاية ٱلكبرى
tr: And he showed him the greatest sign,
y: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
p: And he showed him the tremendous token.
t: fa araahul-aayatal kubra.

ar: فكذب وعصى
tr: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
y: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);
p: But he denied and disobeyed,
t: fa kazzaba wa asaa.

ar: ثم أدبر يسعى
tr: Then he turned his back, striving.
y: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
p: Then turned he away in haste,
t: thumma adbara yas'aa.

ar: فحشر فنادى
tr: And he gathered [his people] and called out
y: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
p: Then gathered he and summoned
t: fa hashara fanada.

ar: فقال أنا ربكم ٱلأعلى
tr: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
y: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
p: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
t: faqala ana rabbu kumul-a'laa.

ar: فأخذه ٱلله نكال ٱلءاخرة وٱلأولى
tr: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
y: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
p: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
t: fa-akha zahul laahu nakalal aakhirati wal-oola.

ar: إن فى ذلك لعبرة لمن يخشى
tr: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
y: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).
p: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
t: inna fee zaalika la'ibratal limaiy-yaksha

ar: ءأنتم أشد خلقا أم ٱلسماء بنىها
tr: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
y: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
p: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
t: a-antum a shaddu khalqan amis samaa-u banaaha.

ar: رفع سمكها فسوىها
tr: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
y: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
p: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
t: raf'a sam kaha fasaw waaha

ar: وأغطش ليلها وأخرج ضحىها
tr: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
y: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
p: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
t: wa aghtasha lailaha wa akhraja duhaaha.

ar: وٱلأرض بعد ذلك دحىها
tr: And after that He spread the earth.
y: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
p: And after that He spread the earth,
t: wal arda b'ada zaalika dahaaha.

ar: أخرج منها ماءها ومرعىها
tr: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
y: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
p: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
t: akhraja minha maa-aha wa mar 'aaha.

ar: وٱلجبال أرسىها
tr: And the mountains He set firmly
y: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
p: And He made fast the hills,
t: wal jibala arsaaha.

ar: متعا لكم ولأنعمكم
tr: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
y: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
p: A provision for you and for your cattle.
t: mataa'al lakum wali an 'aamikum.

ar: فإذا جاءت ٱلطامة ٱلكبرى
tr: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
y: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
p: But when the great disaster cometh,
t: fa-izaa jaaa'atit taaam matul kubraa.

ar: يوم يتذكر ٱلإنسن ما سعى
tr: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
y: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
p: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
t: yauma yata zakkarul insaanu ma sa'aa.

ar: وبرزت ٱلجحيم لمن يرى
tr: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
y: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
p: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
t: wa burrizatil-jaheemu limany-yaraa.

ar: فأما من طغى
tr: So as for he who transgressed
y: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
p: Then, as for him who rebelled
t: fa ammaa man taghaa.

ar: وءاثر ٱلحيوة ٱلدنيا
tr: And preferred the life of the world,
y: And had preferred the life of this world,
p: And chose the life of the world,
t: wa aasaral hayaatad dunyaa

ar: فإن ٱلجحيم هى ٱلمأوى
tr: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
y: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;
p: Lo! hell will be his home.
t: fa innal jaheema hiyal maawaa.

ar: وأما من خاف مقام ربه ونهى ٱلنفس عن ٱلهوى
tr: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
y: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
p: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
t: wa ammaa man khaafa maqaama rabbihee wa nahan nafsa 'anil hawaa

ar: فإن ٱلجنة هى ٱلمأوى
tr: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
y: Their abode will be the Garden.
p: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
t: fa innal jannata hiyal maawaa

ar: يسـلونك عن ٱلساعة أيان مرسىها
tr: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
y: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?
p: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?
t: yas'aloonaka 'anis saa'ati ayyaana mursaahaa

ar: فيم أنت من ذكرىها
tr: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
y: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
p: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
t: feema anta min zikraahaa

ar: إلى ربك منتهىها
tr: To your Lord is its finality.
y: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
p: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
t: ilaa rabbika muntahaa haa

ar: إنما أنت منذر من يخشىها
tr: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
y: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
p: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
t: innamaaa anta munziru maiy yakshaahaa

ar: كأنهم يوم يرونها لم يلبثوا إلا عشية أو ضحىها
tr: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
y: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
p: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
t: ka annahum yawma yarawnahaa lam yalbasooo illaa 'ashiyyatan aw duhaahaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم عبس وتولى
tr: The Prophet frowned and turned away
y: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away,
p: He frowned and turned away
t: 'abasa wa tawallaa.

ar: أن جاءه ٱلأعمى
tr: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
y: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
p: Because the blind man came unto him.
t: an jaa-ahul 'a-maa

ar: وما يدريك لعله يزكى
tr: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
y: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
p: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
t: wa maa yudreeka la'allahu yaz zakkaa.

ar: أو يذكر فتنفعه ٱلذكرى
tr: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
y: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
p: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
t: au yaz zak karu fatanfa 'ahuz zikraa.

ar: أما من ٱستغنى
tr: As for he who thinks himself without need,
y: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
p: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
t: amma manis taghnaa

ar: فأنت له تصدى
tr: To him you give attention.
y: To him dost thou attend;
p: Unto him thou payest regard.
t: fa-anta lahu tasaddaa

ar: وما عليك ألا يزكى
tr: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
y: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
p: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
t: wa ma 'alaika allaa yaz zakka.

ar: وأما من جاءك يسعى
tr: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
y: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
p: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
t: wa amma man jaa-aka yas'a

ar: وهو يخشى
tr: While he fears [Allah],
y: And with fear (in his heart),
p: And hath fear,
t: wahuwa yakhshaa,

ar: فأنت عنه تلهى
tr: From him you are distracted.
y: Of him wast thou unmindful.
p: From him thou art distracted.
t: fa-anta 'anhu talah haa.

ar: كلا إنها تذكرة
tr: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
y: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
p: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
t: kalla innaha tazkirah

ar: فمن شاء ذكره
tr: So whoever wills may remember it.
y: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
p: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
t: faman shaa a zakarah

ar: فى صحف مكرمة
tr: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
y: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
p: On honoured leaves
t: fi suhufim mukar rama,

ar: مرفوعة مطهرة
tr: Exalted and purified,
y: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,
p: Exalted, purified,
t: marfoo'atim mutah hara,

ar: بأيدى سفرة
tr: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
y: (Written) by the hands of scribes-
p: (Set down) by scribes
t: bi'aidee safara

ar: كرام بررة
tr: Noble and dutiful.
y: Honourable and Pious and Just.
p: Noble and righteous.
t: kiraamim bararah.

ar: قتل ٱلإنسن ما أكفره
tr: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
y: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;
p: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!
t: qutilal-insanu maa akfarah.

ar: من أى شىء خلقه
tr: From what substance did He create him?
y: From what stuff hath He created him?
p: From what thing doth He create him?
t: min aiyyi shai-in khalaq

ar: من نطفة خلقه فقدره
tr: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
y: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
p: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
t: min nutfah; khalaqahu faqad-darah.

ar: ثم ٱلسبيل يسره
tr: Then He eased the way for him;
y: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
p: Then maketh the way easy for him,
t: thummas sabeela yas-sarah

ar: ثم أماته فأقبره
tr: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
y: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
p: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
t: thumma amatahu fa-aqbarah

ar: ثم إذا شاء أنشره
tr: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
y: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
p: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
t: thumma iza shaa-a ansharah

ar: كلا لما يقض ما أمره
tr: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
y: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.
p: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
t: kalla lamma yaqdi maa amarah.

ar: فلينظر ٱلإنسن إلى طعامه
tr: Then let mankind look at his food -
y: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
p: Let man consider his food:
t: falyanzuril insanu ilaa ta-amih

ar: أنا صببنا ٱلماء صبا
tr: How We poured down water in torrents,
y: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
p: How We pour water in showers
t: anna sabab nalmaa-a sabba.

ar: ثم شققنا ٱلأرض شقا
tr: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
y: And We split the earth in fragments,
p: Then split the earth in clefts
t: thumma sha qaqnal-arda shaqqa.

ar: فأنبتنا فيها حبا
tr: And caused to grow within it grain
y: And produce therein corn,
p: And cause the grain to grow therein
t: fa ambatna feeha habba

ar: وعنبا وقضبا
tr: And grapes and herbage
y: And Grapes and nutritious plants,
p: And grapes and green fodder
t: wa 'inabaw-wa qadba

ar: وزيتونا ونخلا
tr: And olive and palm trees
y: And Olives and Dates,
p: And olive-trees and palm-trees
t: wa zaitoonaw wanakh la'

ar: وحدائق غلبا
tr: And gardens of dense shrubbery
y: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
p: And garden-closes of thick foliage
t: wa hadaa-iqa ghulba

ar: وفكهة وأبا
tr: And fruit and grass -
y: And fruits and fodder,-
p: And fruits and grasses:
t: wa faki hataw-wa abba.

ar: متعا لكم ولأنعمكم
tr: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
y: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
p: Provision for you and your cattle.
t: mata'al-lakum wa li-an'amikum.

ar: فإذا جاءت ٱلصاخة
tr: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
y: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
p: But when the Shout cometh
t: faiza jaa-atis saakhah.

ar: يوم يفر ٱلمرء من أخيه
tr: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
y: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
p: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
t: yauma yafir-rul mar-u min akheeh

ar: وأمه وأبيه
tr: And his mother and his father
y: And from his mother and his father,
p: And his mother and his father
t: wa ummihee wa abeeh

ar: وصحبته وبنيه
tr: And his wife and his children,
y: And from his wife and his children.
p: And his wife and his children,
t: wa sahi batihee wa baneeh.

ar: لكل ٱمرئ منهم يومئذ شأن يغنيه
tr: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
y: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
p: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
t: likul limri-im-minuhm yaumaa-izin shaa nuy-yughneeh

ar: وجوه يومئذ مسفرة
tr: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
y: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
p: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
t: wujoo huny-yauma-izim-musfira;

ar: ضاحكة مستبشرة
tr: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
y: Laughing, rejoicing.
p: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;
t: dahi katum mustab shirah

ar: ووجوه يومئذ عليها غبرة
tr: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
y: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
p: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
t: wa wujoohuy yauma-izin 'alaiha ghabar a

ar: ترهقها قترة
tr: Blackness will cover them.
y: Blackness will cover them:
p: Veiled in darkness,
t: tarhaquha qatarah.

ar: أولئك هم ٱلكفرة ٱلفجرة
tr: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
y: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
p: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
t: ulaa-ika humul-kafa ratul-fajarah.

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إذا ٱلشمس كورت
tr: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
y: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
p: When the sun is overthrown,
t: izash shamsu kuwwirat

ar: وإذا ٱلنجوم ٱنكدرت
tr: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
y: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
p: And when the stars fall,
t: wa izan nujoomun kadarat

ar: وإذا ٱلجبال سيرت
tr: And when the mountains are removed
y: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
p: And when the hills are moved,
t: wa izal jibaalu suyyirat

ar: وإذا ٱلعشار عطلت
tr: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
y: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
p: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
t: wa izal 'ishaaru 'uttilat

ar: وإذا ٱلوحوش حشرت
tr: And when the wild beasts are gathered
y: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
p: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
t: wa izal wuhooshu hushirat

ar: وإذا ٱلبحار سجرت
tr: And when the seas are filled with flame
y: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
p: And when the seas rise,
t: wa izal bihaaru sujjirat

ar: وإذا ٱلنفوس زوجت
tr: And when the souls are paired
y: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);
p: And when souls are reunited,
t: wa izan nufoosu zuwwijat

ar: وإذا ٱلموءدة سئلت
tr: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
y: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -
p: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
t: wa izal maw'oodatu su'ilat

ar: بأى ذنب قتلت
tr: For what sin she was killed
y: For what crime she was killed;
p: For what sin she was slain,
t: bi ayyi zambin qutilat

ar: وإذا ٱلصحف نشرت
tr: And when the pages are made public
y: When the scrolls are laid open;
p: And when the pages are laid open,
t: wa izas suhufu nushirat

ar: وإذا ٱلسماء كشطت
tr: And when the sky is stripped away
y: When the world on High is unveiled;
p: And when the sky is torn away,
t: wa izas samaaa'u kushitat

ar: وإذا ٱلجحيم سعرت
tr: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
y: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
p: And when hell is lighted,
t: wa izal jaheemu su'-'irat

ar: وإذا ٱلجنة أزلفت
tr: And when Paradise is brought near,
y: And when the Garden is brought near;-
p: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
t: wa izal jannatu uzlifat

ar: علمت نفس ما أحضرت
tr: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
y: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
p: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
t: 'alimat nafsum maaa ahdarat

ar: فلا أقسم بٱلخنس
tr: So I swear by the retreating stars -
y: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
p: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
t: falaaa uqsimu bil khunnas

ar: ٱلجوار ٱلكنس
tr: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
y: Go straight, or hide;
p: The stars which rise and set,
t: al jawaaril kunnas

ar: وٱليل إذا عسعس
tr: And by the night as it closes in
y: And the Night as it dissipates;
p: And the close of night,
t: wallaili izaa 'as'as

ar: وٱلصبح إذا تنفس
tr: And by the dawn when it breathes
y: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
p: And the breath of morning
t: wassubhi izaa tanaffas

ar: إنه لقول رسول كريم
tr: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
y: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
p: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
t: innahoo laqawlu rasoolin kareem

ar: ذى قوة عند ذى ٱلعرش مكين
tr: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
y: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
p: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
t: zee quwwatin 'inda zil 'arshi makeen

ar: مطاع ثم أمين
tr: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
y: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
p: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;
t: mutaa'in samma ameen

ar: وما صاحبكم بمجنون
tr: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
y: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
p: And your comrade is not mad.
t: wa maa saahibukum bimajnoon

ar: ولقد رءاه بٱلأفق ٱلمبين
tr: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
y: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
p: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
t: wa laqad ra aahu bilufuqil mubeen

ar: وما هو على ٱلغيب بضنين
tr: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
y: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
p: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
t: wa maa huwa 'alal ghaibi bidaneen

ar: وما هو بقول شيطن رجيم
tr: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
y: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
p: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
t: wa maa huwa biqawli shaitaanir rajeem

ar: فأين تذهبون
tr: So where are you going?
y: When whither go ye?
p: Whither then go ye?
t: fa ayna tazhaboon

ar: إن هو إلا ذكر للعلمين
tr: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
y: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
p: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
t: in huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen

ar: لمن شاء منكم أن يستقيم
tr: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
y: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
p: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
t: liman shaaa'a minkum ai yastaqeem

ar: وما تشاءون إلا أن يشاء ٱلله رب ٱلعلمين
tr: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
y: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
p: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
t: wa maa tashaaa'oona illaaa ai yashaaa 'al laahu rabbul 'aalameen

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إذا ٱلسماء ٱنفطرت
tr: When the sky breaks apart
y: When the Sky is cleft asunder;
p: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
t: izas samaaa'un fatarat

ar: وإذا ٱلكواكب ٱنتثرت
tr: And when the stars fall, scattering,
y: When the Stars are scattered;
p: When the planets are dispersed,
t: wa izal kawaakibun tasarat

ar: وإذا ٱلبحار فجرت
tr: And when the seas are erupted
y: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
p: When the seas are poured forth,
t: wa izal bihaaru fujjirat

ar: وإذا ٱلقبور بعثرت
tr: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
y: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-
p: And the sepulchres are overturned,
t: wa izal qubooru bu'sirat

ar: علمت نفس ما قدمت وأخرت
tr: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
y: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
p: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
t: 'alimat nafsum maa qaddamat wa akhkharat

ar: يأيها ٱلإنسن ما غرك بربك ٱلكريم
tr: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
y: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
p: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
t: yaaa ayyuhal insaaanu maa gharraka bi rabbikal kareem

ar: ٱلذى خلقك فسوىك فعدلك
tr: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
y: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
p: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
t: allazee khalaqaka fasaw waaka fa'adalak

ar: فى أى صورة ما شاء ركبك
tr: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
y: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
p: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
t: feee ayye sooratim maa shaaa'a rakkabak

ar: كلا بل تكذبون بٱلدين
tr: No! But you deny the Recompense.
y: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!
p: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
t: kalla bal tukazziboona bid deen

ar: وإن عليكم لحفظين
tr: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
y: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
p: Lo! there are above you guardians,
t: wa inna 'alaikum lahaa fizeen

ar: كراما كتبين
tr: Noble and recording;
y: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
p: Generous and recording,
t: kiraaman kaatibeen

ar: يعلمون ما تفعلون
tr: They know whatever you do.
y: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
p: Who know (all) that ye do.
t: ya'lamoona ma taf'aloon

ar: إن ٱلأبرار لفى نعيم
tr: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
y: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
p: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
t: innal abraara lafee na'eem

ar: وإن ٱلفجار لفى جحيم
tr: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
y: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
p: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
t: wa innal fujjaara lafee jaheem

ar: يصلونها يوم ٱلدين
tr: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
y: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
p: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
t: yaslawnahaa yawmad deen

ar: وما هم عنها بغائبين
tr: And never therefrom will they be absent.
y: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
p: And will not be absent thence.
t: wa maa hum 'anhaa bighaaa 'ibeen

ar: وما أدرىك ما يوم ٱلدين
tr: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
y: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
p: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
t: wa maaa adraaka maa yawmud deen

ar: ثم ما أدرىك ما يوم ٱلدين
tr: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
y: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
p: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
t: summa maaa adraaka maa yawmud deen

ar: يوم لا تملك نفس لنفس شيـا وٱلأمر يومئذ لله
tr: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
y: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
p: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
t: yawma laa tamliku nafsul linafsin shai'anw walamru yawma'izil lillaah

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ويل للمطففين
tr: Woe to those who give less [than due],
y: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
p: Woe unto the defrauders:
t: wailul lil mutaffifeen

ar: ٱلذين إذا ٱكتالوا على ٱلناس يستوفون
tr: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
y: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
p: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
t: allazeena izak taaloo 'alan naasi yastawfoon

ar: وإذا كالوهم أو وزنوهم يخسرون
tr: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
y: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
p: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
t: wa izaa kaaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroon

ar: ألا يظن أولئك أنهم مبعوثون
tr: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
y: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
p: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
t: alaa yazunnu ulaaa'ika annahum mab'oosoon

ar: ليوم عظيم
tr: For a tremendous Day -
y: On a Mighty Day,
p: Unto an Awful Day,
t: li yawmin 'azeem

ar: يوم يقوم ٱلناس لرب ٱلعلمين
tr: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
y: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
p: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
t: yawma yaqoomun naasu li rabbil 'aalameen

ar: كلا إن كتب ٱلفجار لفى سجين
tr: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
y: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
p: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
t: kallaaa inna kitaabal fujjaari lafee sijjeen

ar: وما أدرىك ما سجين
tr: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
y: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
p: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
t: wa maa adraaka maa sijjeen

ar: كتب مرقوم
tr: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
y: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.
p: A written record.
t: kitaabum marqoom

ar: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
tr: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
y: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
p: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
t: wailuny yawma'izil lil mukazzibeen

ar: ٱلذين يكذبون بيوم ٱلدين
tr: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
y: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
p: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
t: allazeena yukazziboona bi yawmid deen

ar: وما يكذب به إلا كل معتد أثيم
tr: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
y: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
p: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
t: wa maa yukazzibu biheee illaa kullu mu'tadin aseem

ar: إذا تتلى عليه ءايتنا قال أسطير ٱلأولين
tr: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
y: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
p: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
t: izaa tutlaa'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

ar: كلا بل ران على قلوبهم ما كانوا يكسبون
tr: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
y: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
p: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
t: kallaa bal raana 'alaa quloobihim maa kaanoo yaksiboon

ar: كلا إنهم عن ربهم يومئذ لمحجوبون
tr: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
y: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
p: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
t: kallaaa innahum 'ar rabbihim yawma'izil lamah jooboon

ar: ثم إنهم لصالوا ٱلجحيم
tr: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
y: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
p: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
t: summa innahum lasaa lul jaheem

ar: ثم يقال هذا ٱلذى كنتم به تكذبون
tr: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
y: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
p: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
t: summa yuqaalu haazal lazee kuntum bihee tukazziboon

ar: كلا إن كتب ٱلأبرار لفى عليين
tr: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
y: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
p: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -
t: kallaaa inna kitaabal abraari lafee'illiyyeen

ar: وما أدرىك ما عليون
tr: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
y: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
p: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
t: wa maaa adraaka maa 'illiyyoon

ar: كتب مرقوم
tr: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
y: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,
p: A written record,
t: kitaabum marqoom

ar: يشهده ٱلمقربون
tr: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
y: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
p: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
t: yashhadu hul muqarra boon

ar: إن ٱلأبرار لفى نعيم
tr: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
y: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
p: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
t: innal abraara lafee na'eem

ar: على ٱلأرائك ينظرون
tr: On adorned couches, observing.
y: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
p: On couches, gazing,
t: 'alal araaa'iki yanzuroon

ar: تعرف فى وجوههم نضرة ٱلنعيم
tr: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
y: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
p: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
t: ta'rifu fee wujoohihim nadratan na'eem

ar: يسقون من رحيق مختوم
tr: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
y: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
p: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
t: yusqawna mir raheeqim makhtoom

ar: ختمه مسك وفى ذلك فليتنافس ٱلمتنفسون
tr: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
y: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
p: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
t: khitaamuhoo misk; wa fee zaalika falyatanaafasil mutanaafisoon

ar: ومزاجه من تسنيم
tr: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
y: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
p: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
t: wa mizaajuhoo min tasneem

ar: عينا يشرب بها ٱلمقربون
tr: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
y: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
p: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
t: 'ainaiy yashrabu bihal muqarraboon

ar: إن ٱلذين أجرموا كانوا من ٱلذين ءامنوا يضحكون
tr: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
y: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
p: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
t: innal lazeena ajramoo kaanoo minal lazeena aamanoo yadhakoon

ar: وإذا مروا بهم يتغامزون
tr: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
y: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
p: And wink one to another when they passed them;
t: wa izaa marroo bihim yataghaamazoon

ar: وإذا ٱنقلبوا إلى أهلهم ٱنقلبوا فكهين
tr: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
y: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
p: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
t: wa izan qalabooo ilaaa ahlihimun qalaboo fakiheen

ar: وإذا رأوهم قالوا إن هؤلاء لضالون
tr: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
y: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
p: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
t: wa izaa ra awhum qaalooo inna haaa'ulaaa'i ladaaal loon

ar: وما أرسلوا عليهم حفظين
tr: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
y: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
p: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
t: wa maaa ursiloo 'alaihim haafizeen

ar: فٱليوم ٱلذين ءامنوا من ٱلكفار يضحكون
tr: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
y: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
p: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
t: fal yawmal lazeena aamanoo minal kuffaari yadhakoon

ar: على ٱلأرائك ينظرون
tr: On adorned couches, observing.
y: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
p: On high couches, gazing.
t: 'alal araaa'iki yanzuroon

ar: هل ثوب ٱلكفار ما كانوا يفعلون
tr: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
y: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
p: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
t: hal suwwibal kuffaaru maa kaanoo yaf'aloon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إذا ٱلسماء ٱنشقت
tr: When the sky has split [open]
y: When the sky is rent asunder,
p: When the heaven is split asunder
t: izas samaaa'un shaqqat

ar: وأذنت لربها وحقت
tr: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
y: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
p: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
t: wa azinat li rabbihaa wa huqqat

ar: وإذا ٱلأرض مدت
tr: And when the earth has been extended
y: And when the earth is flattened out,
p: And when the earth is spread out
t: wa izal ardu muddat

ar: وألقت ما فيها وتخلت
tr: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
y: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
p: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
t: wa alqat maa feehaa wa takhallat

ar: وأذنت لربها وحقت
tr: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
y: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
p: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
t: wa azinat li rabbihaa wa huqqat

ar: يأيها ٱلإنسن إنك كادح إلى ربك كدحا فملقيه
tr: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
y: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
p: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
t: yaaa ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa rabbika kad han famulaaqeeh

ar: فأما من أوتى كتبه بيمينه
tr: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
y: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
p: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
t: fa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenih

ar: فسوف يحاسب حسابا يسيرا
tr: He will be judged with an easy account
y: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
p: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
t: fasawfa yuhaasabu hi saabai yaseeraa

ar: وينقلب إلى أهله مسرورا
tr: And return to his people in happiness.
y: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
p: And will return unto his folk in joy.
t: wa yanqalibu ilaaa ahlihee masrooraa

ar: وأما من أوتى كتبه وراء ظهره
tr: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
y: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
p: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
t: wa ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih

ar: فسوف يدعوا ثبورا
tr: He will cry out for destruction
y: Soon will he cry for perdition,
p: He surely will invoke destruction
t: fasawfa yad'oo subooraa

ar: ويصلى سعيرا
tr: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
y: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
p: And be thrown to scorching fire.
t: wa yaslaa sa'eeraa

ar: إنه كان فى أهله مسرورا
tr: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
y: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
p: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
t: innahoo kaana feee ahlihee masrooraa

ar: إنه ظن أن لن يحور
tr: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
y: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
p: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
t: innahoo zanna al lai yahoor

ar: بلى إن ربه كان به بصيرا
tr: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
y: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
p: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
t: balaaa inna rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa

ar: فلا أقسم بٱلشفق
tr: So I swear by the twilight glow
y: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
p: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
t: falaaa uqsimu bishshafaq

ar: وٱليل وما وسق
tr: And [by] the night and what it envelops
y: The Night and its Homing;
p: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
t: wallaili wa maa wasaq

ar: وٱلقمر إذا ٱتسق
tr: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
y: And the Moon in her fullness:
p: And by the moon when she is at the full,
t: walqamari izat tasaq

ar: لتركبن طبقا عن طبق
tr: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
y: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
p: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
t: latarkabunna tabaqan 'an tabaq

ar: فما لهم لا يؤمنون
tr: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
y: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
p: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
t: famaa lahum laa yu'minoon

ar: وإذا قرئ عليهم ٱلقرءان لا يسجدون
tr: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
y: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
p: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
t: wa izaa quri'a 'alaihimul quraanu laa yasjudoon

ar: بل ٱلذين كفروا يكذبون
tr: But those who have disbelieved deny,
y: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
p: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
t: balil lazeena kafaroo yukazziboon

ar: وٱلله أعلم بما يوعون
tr: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
y: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
p: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
t: wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yoo'oon

ar: فبشرهم بعذاب أليم
tr: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
y: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
p: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
t: fabashshirhum bi'azaabin aleem

ar: إلا ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت لهم أجر غير ممنون
tr: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
y: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
p: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
t: illal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلسماء ذات ٱلبروج
tr: By the sky containing great stars
y: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
p: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
t: wassamaaa'i zaatil burooj

ar: وٱليوم ٱلموعود
tr: And [by] the promised Day
y: By the promised Day (of Judgment);
p: And by the Promised Day.
t: wal yawmil maw'ood

ar: وشاهد ومشهود
tr: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
y: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
p: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
t: wa shaahidinw wa mashhood

ar: قتل أصحب ٱلأخدود
tr: Cursed were the companions of the trench
y: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
p: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
t: qutila as haabul ukhdood

ar: ٱلنار ذات ٱلوقود
tr: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
y: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel:
p: Of the fuel-fed fire,
t: annaari zaatil waqood

ar: إذ هم عليها قعود
tr: When they were sitting near it
y: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
p: When they sat by it,
t: iz hum 'alaihaa qu'ood

ar: وهم على ما يفعلون بٱلمؤمنين شهود
tr: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
y: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
p: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
t: wa hum 'alaa maa yaf'aloona bilmu 'mineena shuhood

ar: وما نقموا منهم إلا أن يؤمنوا بٱلله ٱلعزيز ٱلحميد
tr: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
y: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
p: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
t: wa maa naqamoo minhum illaaa aiyu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil hameed

ar: ٱلذى له ملك ٱلسموت وٱلأرض وٱلله على كل شىء شهيد
tr: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
y: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.
p: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
t: allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in shaheed

ar: إن ٱلذين فتنوا ٱلمؤمنين وٱلمؤمنت ثم لم يتوبوا فلهم عذاب جهنم ولهم عذاب ٱلحريق
tr: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
y: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
p: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
t: innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu jahannama wa lahum 'azaabul hareeq

ar: إن ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت لهم جنت تجرى من تحتها ٱلأنهر ذلك ٱلفوز ٱلكبير
tr: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
y: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
p: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
