t: innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer

ar: إن بطش ربك لشديد
tr: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
y: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
p: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
t: inna batsha rabbika lashadeed

ar: إنه هو يبدئ ويعيد
tr: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
y: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
p: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
t: innahoo huwa yubdi'u wa yu'eed

ar: وهو ٱلغفور ٱلودود
tr: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
y: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
p: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
t: wa huwal ghafoorul wadood

ar: ذو ٱلعرش ٱلمجيد
tr: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
y: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
p: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
t: zul 'arshil majeed

ar: فعال لما يريد
tr: Effecter of what He intends.
y: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
p: Doer of what He will.
t: fa' 'aalul limaa yureed

ar: هل أتىك حديث ٱلجنود
tr: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
y: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
p: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
t: hal ataaka hadeesul junood

ar: فرعون وثمود
tr: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
y: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud?
p: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?
t: fir'awna wa samood

ar: بل ٱلذين كفروا فى تكذيب
tr: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
y: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
p: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
t: balil lazeena kafaroo fee takzeeb

ar: وٱلله من ورائهم محيط
tr: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
y: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!
p: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
t: wallaahu minw waraaa'ihim muheet

ar: بل هو قرءان مجيد
tr: But this is an honored Qur'an
y: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,
p: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
t: bal huwa quraanum majeed

ar: فى لوح محفوظ
tr: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
y: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!
p: On a guarded tablet.
t: fee lawhim mahfooz

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلسماء وٱلطارق
tr: By the sky and the night comer -
y: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
p: By the heaven and the Morning Star
t: wassamaaa'i wattaariq

ar: وما أدرىك ما ٱلطارق
tr: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
y: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
p: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
t: wa maaa adraaka mattaariq

ar: ٱلنجم ٱلثاقب
tr: It is the piercing star -
y: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-
p: - The piercing Star!
t: annajmus saaqib

ar: إن كل نفس لما عليها حافظ
tr: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
y: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
p: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
t: in kullu nafsil lammaa 'alaihaa haafiz

ar: فلينظر ٱلإنسن مم خلق
tr: So let man observe from what he was created.
y: Now let man but think from what he is created!
p: So let man consider from what he is created.
t: fal yanzuril insaanu mimma khuliq

ar: خلق من ماء دافق
tr: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
y: He is created from a drop emitted-
p: He is created from a gushing fluid
t: khuliqa mim maaa'in daafiq

ar: يخرج من بين ٱلصلب وٱلترائب
tr: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
y: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
p: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
t: yakhruju mim bainissulbi wat taraaa'ib

ar: إنه على رجعه لقادر
tr: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
y: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
p: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
t: innahoo 'alaa raj'ihee laqaadir

ar: يوم تبلى ٱلسرائر
tr: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
y: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,
p: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
t: yawma tublas saraaa'ir

ar: فما له من قوة ولا ناصر
tr: Then man will have no power or any helper.
y: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
p: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
t: famaa lahoo min quwwatinw wa laa naasir

ar: وٱلسماء ذات ٱلرجع
tr: By the sky which returns [rain]
y: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),
p: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
t: wassamaaa'i zaatir raj'

ar: وٱلأرض ذات ٱلصدع
tr: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
y: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-
p: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
t: wal ardi zaatis sad'

ar: إنه لقول فصل
tr: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
y: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
p: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,
t: innahoo laqawlun fasl

ar: وما هو بٱلهزل
tr: And it is not amusement.
y: It is not a thing for amusement.
p: It is no pleasantry.
t: wa maa huwa bil hazl

ar: إنهم يكيدون كيدا
tr: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
y: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
p: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
t: innahum yakeedoona kaidaa

ar: وأكيد كيدا
tr: But I am planning a plan.
y: And I am planning a scheme.
p: And I plot a plot (against them).
t: wa akeedu kaidaa

ar: فمهل ٱلكفرين أمهلهم رويدا
tr: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
y: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
p: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
t: famahhilil kaafireena amhilhum ruwaidaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم سبح ٱسم ربك ٱلأعلى
tr: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
y: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
p: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
t: sabbihisma rabbikal a'laa

ar: ٱلذى خلق فسوى
tr: Who created and proportioned
y: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
p: Who createth, then disposeth;
t: allazee khalaqa fasawwaa

ar: وٱلذى قدر فهدى
tr: And who destined and [then] guided
y: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
p: Who measureth, then guideth;
t: wallazee qaddara fahadaa

ar: وٱلذى أخرج ٱلمرعى
tr: And who brings out the pasture
y: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,
p: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,
t: wallazeee akhrajal mar'aa

ar: فجعله غثاء أحوى
tr: And [then] makes it black stubble.
y: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
p: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
t: faja'alahoo ghusaaa'an ahwaa

ar: سنقرئك فلا تنسى
tr: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
y: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
p: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
t: sanuqri'uka falaa tansaaa

ar: إلا ما شاء ٱلله إنه يعلم ٱلجهر وما يخفى
tr: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
y: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
p: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
t: illaa maa shaaa'al laah; innahoo ya'lamul jahra wa maa yakhfaa

ar: ونيسرك لليسرى
tr: And We will ease you toward ease.
y: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
p: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
t: wa nu-yassiruka lilyusraa

ar: فذكر إن نفعت ٱلذكرى
tr: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
y: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
p: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
t: fazakkir in nafa'atizzikraa

ar: سيذكر من يخشى
tr: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
y: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
p: He will heed who feareth,
t: sa yazzakkaru maiyakhshaa

ar: ويتجنبها ٱلأشقى
tr: But the wretched one will avoid it -
y: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
p: But the most hapless will flout it,
t: wa yatajannabuhal ashqaa

ar: ٱلذى يصلى ٱلنار ٱلكبرى
tr: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
y: Who will enter the Great Fire,
p: He who will be flung to the great Fire
t: allazee yaslan naaral kubraa

ar: ثم لا يموت فيها ولا يحيى
tr: Neither dying therein nor living.
y: In which they will then neither die nor live.
p: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
t: summa laa yamootu feehaa wa laa yahyaa

ar: قد أفلح من تزكى
tr: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
y: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
p: He is successful who groweth,
t: qad aflaha man tazakkaa

ar: وذكر ٱسم ربه فصلى
tr: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
y: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
p: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
t: wa zakaras ma rabbihee fasallaa

ar: بل تؤثرون ٱلحيوة ٱلدنيا
tr: But you prefer the worldly life,
y: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
p: But ye prefer the life of the world
t: bal tu'siroonal hayaatad dunyaa

ar: وٱلءاخرة خير وأبقى
tr: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
y: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
p: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
t: wal aakhiratu khairunw wa abqaa

ar: إن هذا لفى ٱلصحف ٱلأولى
tr: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
y: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
p: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
t: inna haazaa lafis suhu fil oolaa

ar: صحف إبرهيم وموسى
tr: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
y: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
p: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
t: suhufi ibraaheema wa moosaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم هل أتىك حديث ٱلغشية
tr: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
y: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
p: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?
t: hal ataaka hadeesul ghaashiyah

ar: وجوه يومئذ خشعة
tr: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
y: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
p: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
t: wujoohuny yawma 'izin khaashi'ah

ar: عاملة ناصبة
tr: Working [hard] and exhausted.
y: Labouring (hard), weary,-
p: Toiling, weary,
t: 'aamilatun naasibah

ar: تصلى نارا حامية
tr: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
y: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
p: Scorched by burning fire,
t: taslaa naaran haamiyah

ar: تسقى من عين ءانية
tr: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
y: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
p: Drinking from a boiling spring,
t: tusqaa min 'aynin aaniyah

ar: ليس لهم طعام إلا من ضريع
tr: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
y: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'
p: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
t: laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree'

ar: لا يسمن ولا يغنى من جوع
tr: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
y: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
p: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
t: laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo'

ar: وجوه يومئذ ناعمة
tr: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
y: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
p: In that day other faces will be calm,
t: wujoohuny yawma 'izin naa'imah

ar: لسعيها راضية
tr: With their effort [they are] satisfied
y: Pleased with their striving,-
p: Glad for their effort past,
t: lisa'yihaa raadiyah

ar: فى جنة عالية
tr: In an elevated garden,
y: In a Garden on high,
p: In a high Garden
t: fee jannatin 'aaliyah

ar: لا تسمع فيها لغية
tr: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
y: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
p: Where they hear no idle speech,
t: laa tasma'u feehaa laaghiyah

ar: فيها عين جارية
tr: Within it is a flowing spring.
y: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
p: Wherein is a gushing spring,
t: feehaa 'aynun jaariyah

ar: فيها سرر مرفوعة
tr: Within it are couches raised high
y: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
p: Wherein are couches raised
t: feehaa sururum marfoo'ah

ar: وأكواب موضوعة
tr: And cups put in place
y: Goblets placed (ready),
p: And goblets set at hand
t: wa akwaabum mawdoo 'ah

ar: ونمارق مصفوفة
tr: And cushions lined up
y: And cushions set in rows,
p: And cushions ranged
t: wa namaariqu masfoofah

ar: وزرابى مبثوثة
tr: And carpets spread around.
y: And rich carpets (all) spread out.
p: And silken carpets spread.
t: wa zaraabiyyu mabsoosah

ar: أفلا ينظرون إلى ٱلإبل كيف خلقت
tr: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
y: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
p: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
t: afalaa yanzuroona ilalibili kaifa khuliqat

ar: وإلى ٱلسماء كيف رفعت
tr: And at the sky - how it is raised?
y: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
p: And the heaven, how it is raised?
t: wa ilas samaaa'i kaifa rufi'at

ar: وإلى ٱلجبال كيف نصبت
tr: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
y: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
p: And the hills, how they are set up?
t: wa ilal jibaali kaifa nusibat

ar: وإلى ٱلأرض كيف سطحت
tr: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
y: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
p: And the earth, how it is spread?
t: wa ilal ardi kaifa sutihat

ar: فذكر إنما أنت مذكر
tr: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
y: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
p: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
t: fazakkir innama anta muzakkir

ar: لست عليهم بمصيطر
tr: You are not over them a controller.
y: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
p: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
t: lasta 'alaihim bimusaitir

ar: إلا من تولى وكفر
tr: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
y: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-
p: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
t: illaa man tawallaa wa kafar

ar: فيعذبه ٱلله ٱلعذاب ٱلأكبر
tr: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
y: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
p: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
t: fa yu'azzibuhul laahul 'azaabal akbar

ar: إن إلينا إيابهم
tr: Indeed, to Us is their return.
y: For to Us will be their return;
p: Lo! unto Us is their return
t: innaa ilainaaa iyaabahum

ar: ثم إن علينا حسابهم
tr: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
y: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
p: And Ours their reckoning.
t: summa inna 'alainaa hisaabahum

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلفجر
tr: By the dawn
y: By the break of Day
p: By the Dawn
t: wal-fajr

ar: وليال عشر
tr: And [by] ten nights
y: By the Nights twice five;
p: And ten nights,
t: wa layaalin 'ashr

ar: وٱلشفع وٱلوتر
tr: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
y: By the even and odd (contrasted);
p: And the Even and the Odd,
t: wash shaf'i wal watr

ar: وٱليل إذا يسر
tr: And [by] the night when it passes,
y: And by the Night when it passeth away;-
p: And the night when it departeth,
t: wallaili izaa yasr

ar: هل فى ذلك قسم لذى حجر
tr: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
y: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?
p: There surely is an oath for thinking man.
t: hal fee zaalika qasamul lizee hijr

ar: ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بعاد
tr: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
y: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-
p: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
t: alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi'aad

ar: إرم ذات ٱلعماد
tr: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
y: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,
p: With many-columned Iram,
t: iramaa zaatil 'imaad

ar: ٱلتى لم يخلق مثلها فى ٱلبلد
tr: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
y: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?
p: The like of which was not created in the lands;
t: allatee lam yukhlaq misluhaa fil bilaad

ar: وثمود ٱلذين جابوا ٱلصخر بٱلواد
tr: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
y: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-
p: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;
t: wa samoodal lazeena jaabus sakhra bil waad

ar: وفرعون ذى ٱلأوتاد
tr: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
y: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?
p: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,
t: wa fir'awna zil awtaad

ar: ٱلذين طغوا فى ٱلبلد
tr: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
y: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
p: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
t: allazeena taghaw fil bilaad

ar: فأكثروا فيها ٱلفساد
tr: And increased therein the corruption.
y: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).
p: And multiplied iniquity therein?
t: fa aksaroo feehal fasaad

ar: فصب عليهم ربك سوط عذاب
tr: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
y: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
p: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
t: fasabba 'alaihim rabbuka sawta 'azaab

ar: إن ربك لبٱلمرصاد
tr: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
y: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
p: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
t: inna rabbaka labil mirsaad

ar: فأما ٱلإنسن إذا ما ٱبتلىه ربه فأكرمه ونعمه فيقول ربى أكرمن
tr: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
y: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
p: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
t: fa ammal insaanu izaa mab talaahu rabbuhoo fa akramahoo wa na' 'amahoo fa yaqoolu rabbeee akraman

ar: وأما إذا ما ٱبتلىه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربى أهنن
tr: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
y: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
p: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
t: wa ammaaa izaa mabtalaahu faqadara 'alaihi rizqahoo fa yaqoolu rabbeee ahaanan

ar: كلا بل لا تكرمون ٱليتيم
tr: No! But you do not honor the orphan
y: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
p: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
t: kalla bal laa tukrimooo nal yateem

ar: ولا تحضون على طعام ٱلمسكين
tr: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
y: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
p: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
t: wa laa tahaaaddoona 'alaata'aamil miskeen

ar: وتأكلون ٱلتراث أكلا لما
tr: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
y: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,
p: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
t: wa taakuloonat turaasa aklal lammaa

ar: وتحبون ٱلمال حبا جما
tr: And you love wealth with immense love.
y: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!
p: And love wealth with abounding love.
t: wa tuhibboonal maala hubban jammaa

ar: كلا إذا دكت ٱلأرض دكا دكا
tr: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
y: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,
p: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,
t: kallaaa izaaa dukkatil ardu dakkan dakka

ar: وجاء ربك وٱلملك صفا صفا
tr: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
y: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
p: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
t: wa jaaa'a rabbuka wal malaku saffan saffaa

ar: وجاىء يومئذ بجهنم يومئذ يتذكر ٱلإنسن وأنى له ٱلذكرى
tr: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
y: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
p: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
t: wa jeee'a yawma'izim bi jahannnam; yawma 'iziny yatazakkarul insaanu wa annaa lahuz zikraa

ar: يقول يليتنى قدمت لحياتى
tr: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
y: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"
p: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
t: yaqoolu yaa laitanee qaddamtu lihayaatee

ar: فيومئذ لا يعذب عذابه أحد
tr: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
y: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
p: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
t: fa yawma izil laa yu'azzibu 'azaabahooo ahad

ar: ولا يوثق وثاقه أحد
tr: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
y: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
p: None bindeth as He then will bind.
t: wa laa yoosiqu wasaaqa hooo ahad

ar: يأيتها ٱلنفس ٱلمطمئنة
tr: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
y: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
p: But ah! thou soul at peace!
t: yaaa ayyatuhan nafsul mutma 'innah

ar: ٱرجعى إلى ربك راضية مرضية
tr: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
y: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
p: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
t: irji'eee ilaa rabbiki raadiyatam mardiyyah

ar: فٱدخلى فى عبدى
tr: And enter among My [righteous] servants
y: "Enter thou, then, among My devotees!
p: Enter thou among My bondmen!
t: fadkhulee fee 'ibaadee

ar: وٱدخلى جنتى
tr: And enter My Paradise."
y: "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!
p: Enter thou My Garden!
t: wadkhulee jannatee

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم لا أقسم بهذا ٱلبلد
tr: I swear by this city, Makkah -
y: I do call to witness this City;-
p: Nay, I swear by this city -
t: laaa uqsimu bihaazal balad

ar: وأنت حل بهذا ٱلبلد
tr: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
y: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
p: And thou art an indweller of this city -
t: wa anta hillum bihaazal balad

ar: ووالد وما ولد
tr: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
y: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
p: And the begetter and that which he begat,
t: wa waalidinw wa maa walad

ar: لقد خلقنا ٱلإنسن فى كبد
tr: We have certainly created man into hardship.
y: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
p: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
t: laqad khalaqnal insaana fee kabad

ar: أيحسب أن لن يقدر عليه أحد
tr: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
y: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
p: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
t: ayahsabu al-lai yaqdira 'alaihi ahad

ar: يقول أهلكت مالا لبدا
tr: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
y: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
p: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
t: yaqoolu ahlaktu maalal lubadaa

ar: أيحسب أن لم يره أحد
tr: Does he think that no one has seen him?
y: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
p: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
t: ayahsabu al lam yarahooo ahad

ar: ألم نجعل له عينين
tr: Have We not made for him two eyes?
y: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
p: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
t: alam naj'al lahoo 'aynayn

ar: ولسانا وشفتين
tr: And a tongue and two lips?
y: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
p: And a tongue and two lips,
t: wa lisaananw wa shafatayn

ar: وهدينه ٱلنجدين
tr: And have shown him the two ways?
y: And shown him the two highways?
p: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
t: wa hadaynaahun najdayn

ar: فلا ٱقتحم ٱلعقبة
tr: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
y: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
p: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
t: falaq tahamal-'aqabah

ar: وما أدرىك ما ٱلعقبة
tr: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
y: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
p: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
t: wa maaa adraaka mal'aqabah

ar: فك رقبة
tr: It is the freeing of a slave
y: (It is:) freeing the bondman;
p: (It is) to free a slave,
t: fakku raqabah

ar: أو إطعم فى يوم ذى مسغبة
tr: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
y: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
p: And to feed in the day of hunger.
t: aw it'aamun fee yawmin zee masghabah

ar: يتيما ذا مقربة
tr: An orphan of near relationship
y: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
p: An orphan near of kin,
t: yateeman zaa maqrabah

ar: أو مسكينا ذا متربة
tr: Or a needy person in misery
y: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
p: Or some poor wretch in misery,
t: aw miskeenan zaa matrabah

ar: ثم كان من ٱلذين ءامنوا وتواصوا بٱلصبر وتواصوا بٱلمرحمة
tr: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
y: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
p: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
t: summa kaana minal lazeena aamanoo wa tawaasaw bissabri wa tawaasaw bilmarhamah

ar: أولئك أصحب ٱلميمنة
tr: Those are the companions of the right.
y: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
p: Their place will be on the right hand.
t: ulaaa'ika as-haabul maimanah

ar: وٱلذين كفروا بـايتنا هم أصحب ٱلمشـمة
tr: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
y: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
p: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
t: wallazeena kafaroo bi aayaatinaa hum as-haabul mash'amah

ar: عليهم نار مؤصدة
tr: Over them will be fire closed in.
y: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
p: Fire will be an awning over them.
t: alaihim naarum mu'sadah

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلشمس وضحىها
tr: By the sun and its brightness
y: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
p: By the sun and his brightness,
t: wash shamsi wa duhaa haa

ar: وٱلقمر إذا تلىها
tr: And [by] the moon when it follows it
y: By the Moon as she follows him;
p: And the moon when she followeth him,
t: wal qamari izaa talaa haa

ar: وٱلنهار إذا جلىها
tr: And [by] the day when it displays it
y: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;
p: And the day when it revealeth him,
t: wannahaari izaa jallaa haa

ar: وٱليل إذا يغشىها
tr: And [by] the night when it covers it
y: By the Night as it conceals it;
p: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
t: wallaili izaa yaghshaa haa

ar: وٱلسماء وما بنىها
tr: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
y: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;
p: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
t: wassamaaa'i wa maa banaahaa

ar: وٱلأرض وما طحىها
tr: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
y: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:
p: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
t: wal ardi wa maa tahaahaa

ar: ونفس وما سوىها
tr: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
y: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;
p: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
t: wa nafsinw wa maa sawwaahaa

ar: فألهمها فجورها وتقوىها
tr: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
y: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
p: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
t: fa-alhamahaa fujoorahaa wa taqwaahaa

ar: قد أفلح من زكىها
tr: He has succeeded who purifies it,
y: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
p: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
t: qad aflaha man zakkaahaa

ar: وقد خاب من دسىها
tr: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
y: And he fails that corrupts it!
p: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
t: wa qad khaaba man dassaahaa

ar: كذبت ثمود بطغوىها
tr: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
y: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
p: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
t: kazzabat samoodu bi taghwaahaaa

ar: إذ ٱنبعث أشقىها
tr: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
y: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
p: When the basest of them broke forth
t: izim ba'asa ashqaahaa

ar: فقال لهم رسول ٱلله ناقة ٱلله وسقيها
tr: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
y: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
p: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
t: faqaala lahum rasoolul laahi naaqatal laahi wa suqiyaahaa

ar: فكذبوه فعقروها فدمدم عليهم ربهم بذنبهم فسوىها
tr: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
y: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
p: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
t: fakazzaboohu fa'aqaroohaa fadamdama 'alaihim rabbuhum bizambihim fasaw waahaa

ar: ولا يخاف عقبها
tr: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
y: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
p: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
t: wa laa yakhaafu'uqbaahaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱليل إذا يغشى
tr: By the night when it covers
y: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
p: By the night enshrouding
t: wallaili izaa yaghshaa

ar: وٱلنهار إذا تجلى
tr: And [by] the day when it appears
y: By the Day as it appears in glory;
p: And the day resplendent
t: wannahaari izaa tajalla

ar: وما خلق ٱلذكر وٱلأنثى
tr: And [by] He who created the male and female,
y: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
p: And Him Who hath created male and female,
t: wa maa khalaqaz zakara wal unthaa

ar: إن سعيكم لشتى
tr: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
y: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
p: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
t: inna sa'yakum lashattaa

ar: فأما من أعطى وٱتقى
tr: As for he who gives and fears Allah
y: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),
p: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
t: fa ammaa man a'taa wattaqaa

ar: وصدق بٱلحسنى
tr: And believes in the best [reward],
y: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
p: And believeth in goodness;
t: wa saddaqa bil husnaa

ar: فسنيسره لليسرى
tr: We will ease him toward ease.
y: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
p: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
t: fasanu yassiruhoo lilyusraa

ar: وأما من بخل وٱستغنى
tr: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
y: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
p: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
t: wa ammaa mam bakhila wastaghnaa

ar: وكذب بٱلحسنى
tr: And denies the best [reward],
y: And gives the lie to the best,-
p: And disbelieveth in goodness;
t: wa kazzaba bil husnaa

ar: فسنيسره للعسرى
tr: We will ease him toward difficulty.
y: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
p: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
t: fasanu yassiruhoo lil'usraa

ar: وما يغنى عنه ماله إذا تردى
tr: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
y: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
p: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
t: wa maa yughnee 'anhu maaluhooo izaa taraddaa

ar: إن علينا للهدى
tr: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
y: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
p: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
t: inna 'alainaa lal hudaa

ar: وإن لنا للءاخرة وٱلأولى
tr: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
y: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
p: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
t: wa inna lanaa lal aakhirata wal oolaa

ar: فأنذرتكم نارا تلظى
tr: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
y: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
p: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
t: fa anzartukum naaran talazzaa

ar: لا يصلىها إلا ٱلأشقى
tr: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
y: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
p: Which only the most wretched must endure,
t: laa yaslaahaaa illal ashqaa

ar: ٱلذى كذب وتولى
tr: Who had denied and turned away.
y: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
p: He who denieth and turneth away.
t: allazee kazzaba wa tawallaa

ar: وسيجنبها ٱلأتقى
tr: But the righteous one will avoid it -
y: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-
p: Far removed from it will be the righteous
t: wa sa yujannnabuhal atqaa

ar: ٱلذى يؤتى ماله يتزكى
tr: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
y: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
p: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
t: allazee yu'tee maalahoo yatazakkaa

ar: وما لأحد عنده من نعمة تجزى
tr: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
y: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
p: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
t: wa maa li ahadin 'indahoo min ni'matin tujzaaa

ar: إلا ٱبتغاء وجه ربه ٱلأعلى
tr: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
y: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
p: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
t: illab tighaaa'a wajhi rabbihil a 'laa

ar: ولسوف يرضى
tr: And he is going to be satisfied.
y: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
p: He verily will be content.
t: wa lasawfa yardaa

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلضحى
tr: By the morning brightness
y: By the Glorious Morning Light,
p: By the morning hours
t: wad duhaa

ar: وٱليل إذا سجى
tr: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
y: And by the Night when it is still,-
p: And by the night when it is stillest,
t: wal laili iza sajaa

ar: ما ودعك ربك وما قلى
tr: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
y: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
p: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
t: ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa

ar: وللءاخرة خير لك من ٱلأولى
tr: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
y: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
p: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
t: walal-aakhiratu khairul laka minal-oola

ar: ولسوف يعطيك ربك فترضى
tr: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
y: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
p: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
t: wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda

ar: ألم يجدك يتيما فـاوى
tr: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
y: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
p: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
t: alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa

ar: ووجدك ضالا فهدى
tr: And He found you lost and guided [you],
y: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
p: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
t: wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada

ar: ووجدك عائلا فأغنى
tr: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
y: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
p: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
t: wa wa jadaka 'aa-ilan fa aghnaa

ar: فأما ٱليتيم فلا تقهر
tr: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
y: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
p: Therefor the orphan oppress not,
t: fa am mal yateema fala taqhar

ar: وأما ٱلسائل فلا تنهر
tr: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
y: Nor repulse the petitioner (unheard);
p: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
t: wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar

ar: وأما بنعمة ربك فحدث
tr: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
y: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
p: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
t: wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ألم نشرح لك صدرك
tr: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
y: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
p: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
t: alam nashrah laka sadrak

ar: ووضعنا عنك وزرك
tr: And We removed from you your burden
y: And removed from thee thy burden
p: And eased thee of the burden
t: wa wa d'ana 'anka wizrak

ar: ٱلذى أنقض ظهرك
tr: Which had weighed upon your back
y: The which did gall thy back?-
p: Which weighed down thy back;
t: allazee anqada zahrak

ar: ورفعنا لك ذكرك
tr: And raised high for you your repute.
y: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
p: And exalted thy fame?
t: wa raf 'ana laka zikrak

ar: فإن مع ٱلعسر يسرا
tr: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
y: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
p: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
t: fa inna ma'al usri yusra

ar: إن مع ٱلعسر يسرا
tr: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
y: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
p: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;
t: inna ma'al 'usri yusra

ar: فإذا فرغت فٱنصب
tr: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
y: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
p: So when thou art relieved, still toil
t: fa iza faragh ta fansab

ar: وإلى ربك فٱرغب
tr: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
y: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
p: And strive to please thy Lord.
t: wa ilaa rabbika far ghab

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلتين وٱلزيتون
tr: By the fig and the olive
y: By the Fig and the Olive,
p: By the fig and the olive,
t: wat teeni waz zaitoon

ar: وطور سينين
tr: And [by] Mount Sinai
y: And the Mount of Sinai,
p: By Mount Sinai,
t: wa toori sineen

ar: وهذا ٱلبلد ٱلأمين
tr: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],
y: And this City of security,-
p: And by this land made safe;
t: wa haazal balad-il ameen

ar: لقد خلقنا ٱلإنسن فى أحسن تقويم
tr: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
y: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
p: Surely We created man of the best stature
t: laqad khalaqnal insaana fee ahsani taqweem

ar: ثم رددنه أسفل سفلين
tr: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
y: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
p: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
t: thumma ra dad naahu asfala saafileen

ar: إلا ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت فلهم أجر غير ممنون
tr: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
y: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
p: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
t: ill-lal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati; falahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon

ar: فما يكذبك بعد بٱلدين
tr: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
y: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
p: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?
t: fama yu kaz zibuka b'adu bid deen

ar: أليس ٱلله بأحكم ٱلحكمين
tr: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
y: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?
p: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
t: alai sal laahu bi-ahkamil haakimeen

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ٱقرأ بٱسم ربك ٱلذى خلق
tr: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
y: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
p: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
t: iqra bismi rab bikal lazee khalaq

ar: خلق ٱلإنسن من علق
tr: Created man from a clinging substance.
y: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
p: Createth man from a clot.
t: khalaqal insaana min 'alaq

ar: ٱقرأ وربك ٱلأكرم
tr: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
y: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
p: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
t: iqra wa rab bukal akram

ar: ٱلذى علم بٱلقلم
tr: Who taught by the pen -
y: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-
p: Who teacheth by the pen,
t: al lazee 'allama bil qalam

ar: علم ٱلإنسن ما لم يعلم
tr: Taught man that which he knew not.
y: Taught man that which he knew not.
p: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
t: 'al lamal insaana ma lam y'alam

ar: كلا إن ٱلإنسن ليطغى
tr: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
y: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,
p: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
t: kallaa innal insaana layatghaa

ar: أن رءاه ٱستغنى
tr: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
y: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
p: That he thinketh himself independent!
t: ar-ra aahus taghnaa

ar: إن إلى ربك ٱلرجعى
tr: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
y: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).
p: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
t: innna ilaa rabbikar ruj'aa

ar: أرءيت ٱلذى ينهى
tr: Have you seen the one who forbids
y: Seest thou one who forbids-
p: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
t: ara-aital lazee yanhaa

ar: عبدا إذا صلى
tr: A servant when he prays?
y: A votary when he (turns) to pray?
p: A slave when he prayeth?
t: 'abdan iza sallaa

ar: أرءيت إن كان على ٱلهدى
tr: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
y: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
p: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
t: ara-aita in kana 'alal hudaa

ar: أو أمر بٱلتقوى
tr: Or enjoins righteousness?
y: Or enjoins Righteousness?
p: Or enjoineth piety?
t: au amara bit taqwaa

ar: أرءيت إن كذب وتولى
tr: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
y: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
p: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
t: ara-aita in kaz zaba wa ta walla

ar: ألم يعلم بأن ٱلله يرى
tr: Does he not know that Allah sees?
y: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?
p: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
t: alam y'alam bi-an nal lahaa yaraa

ar: كلا لئن لم ينته لنسفعا بٱلناصية
tr: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
y: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
p: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
t: kalla la illam yantahi la nasfa'am bin nasiyah

ar: ناصية كذبة خاطئة
tr: A lying, sinning forelock.
y: A lying, sinful forelock!
p: The lying, sinful forelock -
t: nasiyatin kazi batin khaatiyah

ar: فليدع ناديه
tr: Then let him call his associates;
y: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
p: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
t: fal yad'u naadiyah

ar: سندع ٱلزبانية
tr: We will call the angels of Hell.
y: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
p: We will call the guards of hell.
t: sanad 'uz zabaaniyah

ar: كلا لا تطعه وٱسجد وٱقترب
tr: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
y: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
p: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
t: kalla; la tuti'hu wasjud waqtarib

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إنا أنزلنه فى ليلة ٱلقدر
tr: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
y: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:
p: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
t: innaa anzalnaahu fee lailatil qadr

ar: وما أدرىك ما ليلة ٱلقدر
tr: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
y: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
p: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
t: wa maa adraaka ma lailatul qadr

ar: ليلة ٱلقدر خير من ألف شهر
tr: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
y: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
p: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
t: lailatul qadri khairum min alfee shahr

ar: تنزل ٱلملئكة وٱلروح فيها بإذن ربهم من كل أمر
tr: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
y: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:
p: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
t: tanaz zalul malaa-ikatu war roohu feeha bi izni-rab bihim min kulli amr

ar: سلم هى حتى مطلع ٱلفجر
tr: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
y: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!
p: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
t: salaamun hiya hattaa mat la'il fajr

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم لم يكن ٱلذين كفروا من أهل ٱلكتب وٱلمشركين منفكين حتى تأتيهم ٱلبينة
tr: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
y: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence,-
p: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,
t: lam ya kunil lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena mun fak keena hattaa ta-tiya humul bayyinah

ar: رسول من ٱلله يتلوا صحفا مطهرة
tr: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
y: An messenger from Allah, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy:
p: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages
t: rasoolum minal laahi yatlu suhufam mutahharah

ar: فيها كتب قيمة
tr: Within which are correct writings.
y: Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.
p: Containing correct scriptures.
t: feeha kutubun qaiyimah

ar: وما تفرق ٱلذين أوتوا ٱلكتب إلا من بعد ما جاءتهم ٱلبينة
tr: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
y: Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence.
p: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.
t: wa maa tafarraqal lazeena ootul kitaaba il-la mim b'adi ma jaa-at humul baiyyinah

ar: وما أمروا إلا ليعبدوا ٱلله مخلصين له ٱلدين حنفاء ويقيموا ٱلصلوة ويؤتوا ٱلزكوة وذلك دين ٱلقيمة
tr: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
y: And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship Allah, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight.
p: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.
t: wa maa umiroo il-la liy'abu dul laaha mukhliseena lahud-deena huna faa-a wa yuqeemus salaahta wa yu-tuz zakaata; wa zaalika deenul qaiyimah

ar: إن ٱلذين كفروا من أهل ٱلكتب وٱلمشركين فى نار جهنم خلدين فيها أولئك هم شر ٱلبرية
tr: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
y: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.
p: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.
t: innal lazeena kafaru min ahlil kitaabi wal mushri keena fee nari jahan nama khaali deena feeha; ulaa-ika hum shar rul ba reeyah

ar: إن ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت أولئك هم خير ٱلبرية
tr: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
y: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures.
p: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.
t: innal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saalihaati ula-ika hum khairul bareey yah

ar: جزاؤهم عند ربهم جنت عدن تجرى من تحتها ٱلأنهر خلدين فيها أبدا رضى ٱلله عنهم ورضوا عنه ذلك لمن خشى ربه
tr: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
y: Their reward is with Allah: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; Allah well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher.
p: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
t: jazaa-uhum inda rabbihim jan naatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihal an haaru khalideena feeha abada; radiy-yallaahu 'anhum wa ra du 'an zaalika liman khashiya rabbah.

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إذا زلزلت ٱلأرض زلزالها
tr: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
y: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
p: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
t: izaa zul zilatil ardu zil zaalaha

ar: وأخرجت ٱلأرض أثقالها
tr: And the earth discharges its burdens
y: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
p: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
t: wa akh rajatil ardu athqaalaha

ar: وقال ٱلإنسن ما لها
tr: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
y: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-
p: And man saith: What aileth her?
t: wa qaalal insaanu ma laha

ar: يومئذ تحدث أخبارها
tr: That Day, it will report its news
y: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
p: That day she will relate her chronicles,
t: yawmaa izin tuhad dithu akhbaaraha

ar: بأن ربك أوحى لها
tr: Because your Lord has commanded it.
y: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
p: Because thy Lord inspireth her.
t: bi-anna rabbaka awhaa laha

ar: يومئذ يصدر ٱلناس أشتاتا ليروا أعملهم
tr: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
y: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
p: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
t: yawma iziy yas durun naasu ash tatal liyuraw a'maalahum

ar: فمن يعمل مثقال ذرة خيرا يره
tr: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
y: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!
p: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
t: famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai raiy-yarah

ar: ومن يعمل مثقال ذرة شرا يره
tr: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
y: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
p: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
t: wa maiy-y'amal mithqala zarratin sharraiy-yarah

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلعديت ضبحا
tr: By the racers, panting,
y: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
p: By the snorting courses,
t: wal'aadi yaati dabha

ar: فٱلموريت قدحا
tr: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
y: And strike sparks of fire,
p: Striking sparks of fire
t: fal moori yaati qadha

ar: فٱلمغيرت صبحا
tr: And the chargers at dawn,
y: And push home the charge in the morning,
p: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
t: fal mugheeraati subha

ar: فأثرن به نقعا
tr: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
y: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
p: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
t: fa atharna bihee naq'a

ar: فوسطن به جمعا
tr: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
y: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
p: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
t: fawa satna bihee jam'a

ar: إن ٱلإنسن لربه لكنود
tr: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
y: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
p: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
t: innal-insana lirabbihee lakanood

ar: وإنه على ذلك لشهيد
tr: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
y: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
p: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
t: wa innahu 'alaa zaalika la shaheed

ar: وإنه لحب ٱلخير لشديد
tr: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
y: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
p: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
t: wa innahu lihubbil khairi la shadeed

ar: أفلا يعلم إذا بعثر ما فى ٱلقبور
tr: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
y: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
p: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
t: afala ya'lamu iza b'uthira ma filquboor

ar: وحصل ما فى ٱلصدور
tr: And that within the breasts is obtained,
y: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
p: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
t: wa hussila maa fis sudoor

ar: إن ربهم بهم يومئذ لخبير
tr: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
y: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
p: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
t: inna rabbahum bihim yauma 'izil la khabeer

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ٱلقارعة
tr: The Striking Calamity -
y: The (Day) of Noise and Clamour:
p: The Calamity!
t: al qaari'ah

ar: ما ٱلقارعة
tr: What is the Striking Calamity?
y: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?
p: What is the Calamity?
t: mal qaariah

ar: وما أدرىك ما ٱلقارعة
tr: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
y: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
p: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
t: wa maa adraaka mal qaari'ah

ar: يوم يكون ٱلناس كٱلفراش ٱلمبثوث
tr: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
y: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,
p: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
t: yauma ya koonun naasu kal farashil mabthooth

ar: وتكون ٱلجبال كٱلعهن ٱلمنفوش
tr: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
y: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
p: And the mountains will become as carded wool.
t: wa ta koonul jibalu kal 'ihnil manfoosh

ar: فأما من ثقلت موزينه
tr: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
y: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,
p: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
t: fa-amma man thaqulat mawa zeenuh

ar: فهو فى عيشة راضية
tr: He will be in a pleasant life.
y: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
p: He will live a pleasant life.
t: fahuwa fee 'ishatir raadiyah

ar: وأما من خفت موزينه
tr: But as for one whose scales are light,
y: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-
p: But as for him whose scales are light,
t: wa amma man khaffat mawa zeenuh

ar: فأمه هاوية
tr: His refuge will be an abyss.
y: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.
p: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,
t: fa-ummuhu haawiyah

ar: وما أدرىك ما هيه
tr: And what can make you know what that is?
y: And what will explain to thee what this is?
p: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
t: wa maa adraaka maa hiyah

ar: نار حامية
tr: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
y: (It is) a Fire Blazing fiercely!
p: Raging Fire.
t: naarun hamiyah

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ألهىكم ٱلتكاثر
tr: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
y: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
p: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
t: al haaku mut takathur

ar: حتى زرتم ٱلمقابر
tr: Until you visit the graveyards.
y: Until ye visit the graves.
p: Until ye come to the graves.
t: hatta zurtumul-maqaabir

ar: كلا سوف تعلمون
tr: No! You are going to know.
y: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
p: Nay, but ye will come to know!
t: kalla sawfa ta'lamoon

ar: ثم كلا سوف تعلمون
tr: Then no! You are going to know.
y: Again, ye soon shall know!
p: Nay, but ye will come to know!
t: thumma kalla sawfa ta'lamoon

ar: كلا لو تعلمون علم ٱليقين
tr: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
y: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
p: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
t: kalla law ta'lamoona 'ilmal yaqeen

ar: لترون ٱلجحيم
tr: You will surely see the Hellfire.
y: Ye shall certainly see Hell-Fire!
p: For ye will behold hell-fire.
t: latara-wun nal jaheem

ar: ثم لترونها عين ٱليقين
tr: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
y: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
p: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
t: thumma latara wunnaha 'ainal yaqeen

ar: ثم لتسـلن يومئذ عن ٱلنعيم
tr: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
y: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
p: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
t: thumma latus alunna yauma-izin 'anin na'eem

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم وٱلعصر
tr: By time,
y: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages),
p: By the declining day,
t: wal' asr

ar: إن ٱلإنسن لفى خسر
tr: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
y: Verily Man is in loss,
p: Lo! man is a state of loss,
t: innal insaana lafee khusr

ar: إلا ٱلذين ءامنوا وعملوا ٱلصلحت وتواصوا بٱلحق وتواصوا بٱلصبر
tr: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
y: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.
p: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.
t: il lal lazeena aamanu wa 'amilus saali haati wa tawa saw bil haqqi wa tawa saw bis sabr

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ويل لكل همزة لمزة
tr: Woe to every scorner and mocker
y: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
p: Woe unto every slandering traducer,
t: wai lul-li kulli hu mazatil-lumaza

ar: ٱلذى جمع مالا وعدده
tr: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
y: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,
p: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
t: al-lazi jama'a maalaw wa'addadah

ar: يحسب أن ماله أخلده
tr: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
y: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
p: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
t: yahsabu anna maalahu akhladah

ar: كلا لينبذن فى ٱلحطمة
tr: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
y: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
p: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
t: kalla layum ba zanna fil hutamah

ar: وما أدرىك ما ٱلحطمة
tr: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
y: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
p: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
t: wa maa adraaka mal-hutamah

ar: نار ٱلله ٱلموقدة
tr: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
y: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),
p: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
t: narul laahil-mooqada

ar: ٱلتى تطلع على ٱلأفـدة
tr: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
y: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:
p: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
t: al latee tat tali'u 'alalafidah

ar: إنها عليهم مؤصدة
tr: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
y: It shall be made into a vault over them,
p: Lo! it is closed in on them
t: innaha 'alaihim moosada

ar: فى عمد ممددة
tr: In extended columns.
y: In columns outstretched.
p: In outstretched columns.
t: fee 'amadim-mu mad dadah

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم ألم تر كيف فعل ربك بأصحب ٱلفيل
tr: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
y: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
p: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
t: alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel

ar: ألم يجعل كيدهم فى تضليل
tr: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
y: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
p: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
t: alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel

ar: وأرسل عليهم طيرا أبابيل
tr: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
y: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
p: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
t: wa arsala 'alaihim tairan abaabeel

ar: ترميهم بحجارة من سجيل
tr: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
y: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
p: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
t: tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel

ar: فجعلهم كعصف مأكول
tr: And He made them like eaten straw.
y: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
p: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?
t: faja 'alahum ka'asfim m'akool

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم لإيلف قريش
tr: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
y: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,
p: For the taming of Qureysh.
t: li-ilaafi quraish

ar: إلفهم رحلة ٱلشتاء وٱلصيف
tr: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
y: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
p: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
t: elaafihim rihlatash shitaa-i wass saif

ar: فليعبدوا رب هذا ٱلبيت
tr: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
y: Let them adore the Lord of this House,
p: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
t: fal y'abudu rabba haazal-bait

ar: ٱلذى أطعمهم من جوع وءامنهم من خوف
tr: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
y: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
p: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
t: allazi at'amahum min ju'inw-wa-aamana hum min khawf

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم أرءيت ٱلذى يكذب بٱلدين
tr: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
y: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?
p: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
t: ara-aital lazee yu kazzibu bid deen

ar: فذلك ٱلذى يدع ٱليتيم
tr: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
y: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),
p: That is he who repelleth the orphan,
t: fa zaalikal lazi yadu'ul-yateem

ar: ولا يحض على طعام ٱلمسكين
tr: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
y: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.
p: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.
t: wa la ya huddu 'alaa ta'amil miskeen

ar: فويل للمصلين
tr: So woe to those who pray
y: So woe to the worshippers
p: Ah, woe unto worshippers
t: fa wai lul-lil mu salleen

ar: ٱلذين هم عن صلاتهم ساهون
tr: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
y: Who are neglectful of their prayers,
p: Who are heedless of their prayer;
t: al lazeena hum 'an salaatihim sahoon

ar: ٱلذين هم يراءون
tr: Those who make show [of their deeds]
y: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
p: Who would be seen (at worship)
t: al lazeena hum yuraa-oon

ar: ويمنعون ٱلماعون
tr: And withhold [simple] assistance.
y: But refuse (to supply) (even) neighbourly needs.
p: Yet refuse small kindnesses!
t: wa yamna'oonal ma'oon

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إنا أعطينك ٱلكوثر
tr: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
y: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
p: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
t: innaa a'taina kal kauthar

ar: فصل لربك وٱنحر
tr: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
y: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
p: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
t: fa salli li rabbika wanhar

ar: إن شانئك هو ٱلأبتر
tr: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
y: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
p: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
t: inna shani-aka huwal abtar

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم قل يأيها ٱلكفرون
tr: Say, "O disbelievers,
y: Say: O ye that reject Faith!
p: Say: O disbelievers!
t: qul yaa-ai yuhal kaafiroon

ar: لا أعبد ما تعبدون
tr: I do not worship what you worship.
y: I worship not that which ye worship,
p: I worship not that which ye worship;
t: laa a'budu ma t'abudoon

ar: ولا أنتم عبدون ما أعبد
tr: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
y: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
p: Nor worship ye that which I worship.
t: wa laa antum 'aabidoona maa a'bud

ar: ولا أنا عابد ما عبدتم
tr: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
y: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,
p: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.
t: wa laa ana 'abidum maa 'abattum

ar: ولا أنتم عبدون ما أعبد
tr: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
y: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
p: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
t: wa laa antum 'aabidoona ma a'bud

ar: لكم دينكم ولى دين
tr: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
y: To you be your Way, and to me mine.
p: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.
t: lakum deenukum wa liya deen.

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم إذا جاء نصر ٱلله وٱلفتح
tr: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
y: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,
p: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
t: iza jaa-a nas rullahi walfath

ar: ورأيت ٱلناس يدخلون فى دين ٱلله أفواجا
tr: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
y: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,
p: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
t: wa ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajah

ar: فسبح بحمد ربك وٱستغفره إنه كان توابا
tr: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
y: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
p: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
t: fa sab bih bihamdi rabbika was taghfir, innahu kaana tawwaaba

ar: بسم ٱلله ٱلرحمن ٱلرحيم تبت يدا أبى لهب وتب
tr: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
y: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
p: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
t: tab bat yadaa abee lahabinw-wa tabb

ar: ما أغنى عنه ماله وما كسب
tr: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
y: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
p: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
t: maa aghna 'anhu maaluhu wa ma kasab

ar: سيصلى نارا ذات لهب
tr: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
y: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
p: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
t: sa yas laa naran zaata lahab

ar: وٱمرأته حمالة ٱلحطب
tr: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
y: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
p: And his wife, the wood-carrier,
t: wam ra-atuh hamma latal-hatab

ar: فى جيدها حبل من مسد
tr: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
y: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
p: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
t: fee jeediha hab lum mim-masad

ar: قل هو ٱلله أحد
tr: Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One,
t: qul huwallāhu aḥad

ar: ٱلله ٱلصمد
tr: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
t: allāhuṣ-ṣamad

ar: لم يلد ولم يولد
tr: He neither begets nor is born,
t: lam yalid wa lam yūlad

ar: ولم يكن له كفوا أحد
tr: Nor is there to Him any equivalent.'
t: wa lam yakun lahū kufuwan aḥad

ar: قل أعوذ برب ٱلفلق
tr: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
t: qul aʿūdhu birabbil-falaq

ar: من شر ما خلق
tr: From the evil of that which He created
t: min sharri mā khalaq

ar: ومن شر غاسق إذا وقب
tr: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
t: wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab

ar: ومن شر ٱلنفثت فى ٱلعقد
tr: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
t: wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-ʿuqad

ar: ومن شر حاسد إذا حسد
tr: And from the evil of an envier when he envies.'
t: wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad

ar: قل أعوذ برب ٱلناس
tr: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
t: qul aʿūdhu birabbin-nās

ar: ملك ٱلناس
tr: The Sovereign of mankind,
t: malikin-nās

ar: إله ٱلناس
tr: The God of mankind,
t: ilāhin-nās

ar: من شر ٱلوسواس ٱلخناس
tr: From the evil of the retreating whisperer
t: min sharril-waswāsil-khannās

ar: ٱلذى يوسوس فى صدور ٱلناس
tr: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind —
t: alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās

ar: من ٱلجنة وٱلناس
tr: From among the jinn and mankind.'
t: minal-jinnati wan-nās
